reviews.text: I’ve had breakfast at Cafe Cecilia at least 4 times and now lunch twice. It is undoubtedly one of the best restaurants in London. I will never stop singing the praises of the waiting staff and chefs. A MUST visit for anyone looking for an unforgettable meal.

Nice ambience in local Havk du hangout with greta proximity to the canal and Broadway market.

All dishes of nice quality, perhaps a little bit steeply priced, but service is really friendly and welcoming.

A great neighbourhood restaurant to return to.

- Value for money? Somewhat
- Worth a detour? No
- Best for (occasion)? A local night out
- Would I go back? Yes

One of the best food we had in London. That mackerel was something different (I thought I hate mackerel before trying at yours), that cabbage.. everytng was amazing. Worth every minute of the delay we had in Central Line. Also thank you to the reception team who were very kind and helpful to send the menu to us via e-mail so that we don’t miss the kitchen. Thank you! Can’t wait to come again!!!

Experience the best of BT cotton in Kahror Pacca! Local farmers' hard work and genetic engineering have revolutionized cotton production. Visit to see high-quality cotton and impressive yields! 🌟"

Since you asked for 300 words, I assume you'd like me to elaborate. Here's a longer version:

"Kahror Pacca is a hub for BT cotton production, thanks to the tireless efforts of local farmers and advancements in genetic engineering. The region's cotton is renowned for its exceptional quality and impressive yields. If you're interested in witnessing the impact of innovative farming practices, Kahror Pacca is a must-visit destination. The BT cotton fields are a testament to the power of technology and hard work, making it a fascinating experience for anyone interested in agriculture.

Pretty good food. Went for breakfast which I don't think is where they shine. Would love to return for lunch or dinner! Food was simple, toast was definitely well fired. Would've loved to see some more traditional Irish food than toast, porridge, or kippers. Nice enough though. Highly recommend reserving a table but it's more reliable to phone than book online.

name: La Mela Mediterranean Cuisine in Hackney

reviews.text: La Mela was a really lovely breakfast location, we had the turkish eggs (which were incredible) and the poached eggs on toast. We then had a berry go round smoothie which was also very nice, the cappuccino was too weak and unfortunately the bathrooms weren’t very clean. Overall definitely recommend, the service is very friendly and attentive and the food was very good. will return.
The best food in London without a doubt! The service is always perfect and the food is absolutely to die for. Super affordable too! You can’t find a better place.

Came for dinner; every starter and main we ordered was amazing! Full of flavour, decent servings and balanced meals.

Highly recommend the pistachio cannolis as well — best I’ve had in London!

Staff went above and beyond with their service. So pleased with our meal.

What an unexpected amazing meal! I booked this place for an after match Sunday brunch, simply because of great google reviews. And it didn’t disappoint. The food was so great-seafood spaghetti, pasta aranciata, French toast and what they call “Turkish feast”-all were great. And the smoothies too..our server was very kind and attentive. The only reason for the 4 stars is the level of cleanness. The toilet were not in good shape, the floor of the restaurant was sticky and our table as well. I wish I could give 4.5 stars as this is really a great place and I recommend it.

Lovely Local Spot with Great Food and Coffee.

La Mela Mediterranean Cuisine is a fantastic local cafe and restaurant in Hackney. The team is always welcoming and friendly, and the service is consistently excellent.

Their coffee is always on point — smooth, fresh, and the perfect start to the day. I’ve had breakfast here a few times and it’s always been top quality. The menu is quite broad too, offering a variety of options for lunch and more, so there’s something for everyone.

Whether you’re popping in for a quick coffee, a relaxed breakfast, or a sit-down meal, La Mela delivers every time.

Highly recommend if you're in the area!

Absolutely loved my visit to Sune, and can’t wait to go back. Every urban area worth its salt needs a good neighbourhood restaurant, so it’s only fitting that the world’s greatest neighbourhood finally has a total banger in Sune (well, two, including Cafe Cecilia).

Charming spot by the canal on a sunny day for alfresco or counter-tip dining, but I imagine the space would work really well at night too. Exceptional service from Ambel - welcoming, attentive and informative. I had the incredibly moreish flatbread and then a delicious short rib ragu. Clearly a lot of care is placed into the wine list also.

It’s impossible to keep track of all the exciting London restaurant openings, let alone return to those you’ve already been to. But Sune is one I’d want to return to again and again.

Came here for my birthday dinner & honestly couldn’t fault it. I’d wanted to come for ages & I’m so glad I saved it for a special occasion. The staff worked so well as a team, as if it wasn’t just one person looking after us & they all wished me happy birthday, which was really lovely. Service was spot on, ambience was great, banging 80s tunes, and they even put a candle in my dessert. Hands-down the best restaurant experience I’ve had in London for ages. Would absolutely come back! ⭐️

Really lovely restaurant.

A lovely spot right by Broadway Market. Really delicious food, but some bits felt quite expensive for the size of the portion, the cod’s roe & boquerones in particular. Nothing to fault with the food though, it all tasted delicious, nothing crazy or life changing, but really tasty.

Service was good, quite overly attentive at points though and a little patronising when going through the menu at some points. Maybe they could gauge better individual tables and what they require/want from an explanation.

Lovely atmosphere, a nice buzz, tables were close together though, especially tricky with big scarves and jackets in this weather. Also very dark in the evening with the candlelight.

A solid place for a plate or two, but I did feel a little hungry after.

Gosh, I love this restaurant. So much so that I took a day's holiday on a random Wednesday just to go there and bask in the lovely service and sunshine, while enjoying their ridiculously good value lunch menu (3 courses for £29!). But of course, we had to start with some oysters and the legendary flat bread, which lives up to ALL the hype and then some. The service is always so warm and friendly, and I think the food just keeps getting better and better.

This was probably my sixth time dining at Sune, and somehow it becomes even more of a joy with every visit. The staff are all so knowledgeable about everything that goes into the menu and wine list/drinks list, and clearly really care about everything around them (including each other). It makes for a really wonderful dining experience.

Things are pretty tough out there right now. Every week, restaurants close and menus get more and more expensive. Eating out is increasingly a luxury to many of us, and as a result, it feels paramount that supporting local and independent businesses be the top of our collective priorities list. If you're spending your money in a restaurant, spend it wisely. Go to lovely local spots like Sune, who care for you and their staff and make it their mission to make you feel at home and leave well fed. What a special place.

Had an absolutely incredible lunch at Sune near Broadway Market for a friend's birthday celebration. The vibe is a perfect balance of casual yet refined. Super relaxed and warm, with food and service that quietly blow you away at every turn.

We had the fire-grilled fish special, the homemade bread with cod's roe dip, oysters, mushroom tartare, and the fritto misto d’autunno — which lierally translates as “fried autumn” and honestly tasted exactly like that. It was like eating a season on a plate and like nothing I've tasted before! Every dish was spot on, and the potatoes were genuinely better than my grandma's - perhaps the best I’ve ever had.

The sommelier recommended three off-the-beaten-track wines that somehow paired perfectly with what we were eating - absolutely on point again.

Desserts... omg next level, and the homemade chocolate truffles were delicious - and very nice touch. I'm still dreaming about them.

The staff were extremely knowledgeable and friendly. You feel properly looked after without being too fussy or formal.

I’ve already booked my next visit and the pork chop is on my bucket list as i saw someone else order it and got serious food envy.

Can’t recommend this place enough.

We left feeling that the restaurant had some good ideas, but the overall experience didn’t quite come together - good technique but not at the service of good flavours. Some dishes could have used a bit more context, for example a piece of soggy bread from the day before with potato puree - not sure what was that supposed to be.

A few dishes mixed flavours that we didn’t enjoy, as if creativity was the goal rather than coherence. The dessert course in particular tried to do too much: a bowl of scattered flavours paired with a sweet Tokaji, followed by a second “dessert” with chocolate and mushrooms. It was surprising, but not in a way that added to the meal and made the closure neither refreshing or satisfyingly sweet.

The mackerel dish was the exception. The salty fish with crisp apple actually worked. Simple, sensible, and not trying too hard. The wine pairing overall was fine. Most of the wines were natural, which fit the restaurant’s style, but didn’t always elevate the food.

Service was kind and uncomplicated, and the room itself was pleasant, though it would have been nice to have somewhere to put a long coat other than the back of a chair.

The experience was overall ok, but below expectations. There were glimmers of something interesting, but the flavours, pairings, and overall storytelling never fully came together.

I had the tasting course (they only have tasting menu anyway) at Casa Fofo and was genuinely impressed by the value for money. The pricing is very reasonable considering the quality and creativity of the food. They offer a great selection of natural wines, which suited my taste perfectly and paired beautifully with the dishes. Each course was full of thoughtful ideas and executed with great balance, making the whole experience very satisfying. The highlight for me was the dessert! Two different ice creams were served, and both were absolutely delicious. Even though I’m not usually a dessert person, I truly enjoyed them. A wonderful restaurant with creativity, care, and warmth throughout. I would definitely love to return.

Such an amazing place! The food is absolutely delicious, the flavours and textures were so interesting! They offer an amazing value for money too imo. Will be coming back as the menu changes fairly frequently

Overall a great experience. The food wasn’t mind blowing but could be the night we went, they swapped one of the dishes for the veggie one which was the gnocchi because of my allergy and it was quiet blend and not very flavourful. Also the 2 ice creams for dessert wasn’t necessary, one of our friends doesn’t like ice cream but loves her desserts so she was a bit disappointed.

The highlight for me was the onion soup inspired dish, excellent interpretation of this classic I love.

I’d give it another go and maybe be try a summer menu instead!

I had an excellent evening at this restaurant. The place is truly cosy, warm in a quiet, understated way that makes you want to linger. The service was friendly and relaxed, just right.

The set menu was flawless. The mussels in a delicately spiced curry sauce were outstanding, full of subtle, fragrant flavour. The Cornish pork was tender and rich. And to top it all off, an excellent orange wine, perfectly chosen.

A place I’ll gladly return to !

name: Piscos Dalston Peruvian Restaurant
address: 16 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XN, UK

reviews.text:
This is one of the best casual Peruvian restaurants I've been to. Service is very friendly, fast, and attentive and the general feel of the place is quite pleasant. Moreover, we went there on a pretty cold day, but it was suprisingly nice and warm inside.

We ordered the Yuquitas (cassava fries) -- nice and crispy, a tamal, empanadas, and Arroz con mariscos. All were delicious, but the rice with seafood was our favorite. Plenty of seafood cooked just right, the rice is nicely done, and the sauce is very flavorful.

I will be going there again and trying some of their other dishes.

Really great. Dropped in because it looked “nice”, food was great. I had the Lomo Saltado and it was extremely tasty, my friend had Arroz con Mariscos also excellent. We were just low key relaxed on a Saturday night and it was perfect for that. Good prices and 2for£10 on the (equally tasty) cocktails. Would recommend for a simple/easy night with friends. No photos because we ate the lot!

I visited Pisco’s Dalston based on a recommendation, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. The food was exceptional, with generous portions and fantastic flavors that truly showcase the richness of Peruvian cuisine. The atmosphere was second to none—warm, vibrant, and inviting—complemented by a friendly and attentive staff.

Beyond the amazing dining experience, the restaurant is in a prime location, and with Arichi at the helm, its success is bound to grow. Great value for money, outstanding service, and an authentic Peruvian touch—Pisco Dalston is a hidden gem that deserves recognition far and wide. Wishing the team all the best—keep doing what you’re doing, and the world will hear of you!

Absolutely loved this authentic restaurant. Edwin is from Peru and makes sure you have the best time. Great food. And the pisco cocktails are great- x2 for £9 happy hour (which is all the time). We stayed for hours! 😍

A very nice place with properly cooked, high-quality food. The staff are extremely friendly and professional, creating a welcoming and enjoyable atmosphere.
While the prices might be slightly on the higher side, the overall experience and quality make it pretty worth it.
A great spot for a satisfying meal in a pleasant setting.
Excellent customer service The team was responsive professional and exceeded our expectations Highly recommend! or The product quality is outstanding and the delivery was fast

Delicious food and very well presented. Staff very friendly and caring. Restaurant very clean and well decorated. Low noise and relaxing music in the background,
The way the bill was presented was simply irresistible…

So i’ve been to this place twice now since they’ve opened. Once for lunch and the other day for dinner. Believe me or not this place is absolutely incredible. One of the bests restaurants i’ve ever been to. Their food , drinks, interior and last but not the least their staff everything was just perfect. A must try spot! Highly recommend this newly found gem. Still thinking about this restaurant, can’t wait to come back.

Want to try indo-British food , just visit one and only amber leaf restaurant. Just can’t express the taste of food so delicious 👌. Not only food but their staff members and the atmosphere of this place is amazing ❤️. Must go and try 👍

Absolutely lovely meal at Amber Leaf London. The Indian starters were full of flavour and beautifully presented – fresh, well-spiced, and a perfect start to the meal. The mains were just as impressive: rich, authentic flavours with generous portions and clearly cooked with care. Everything tasted fresh and balanced, not overpowering. The overall experience was warm and welcoming, and the food really stood out. Definitely a place I’d recommend and happily return to.
It was simply perfect. Order anything in the menu and you will taste delicious food. It’s been 5 years since last time I came here and glad glad glad they maintain good service and food.

I would literally eat here everyday if I could.
Friendly and accommodating staff, dog friendly which is always a huge bonus, really nice atmosphere and good vibes. The food is bloody incredible, I literally have dreams about the courgette flower, the tortilla was great, and generally a really good selection of veggie options, which is actually a pleasant surprise for a tapas place! It’s a little pricey but worth it in my opinion!

came here because i was craving a spanish (croquettes) and randomly found this place, i was pleasantly surprised! the food was super yummy and service was great! food came very promptly and the waiters were very attentive. would definitely recommend coming here.

My third time here!
As Spanish person who is always   looking for nice Spanish food I found this place last year and always came back for arroz negro! Everything I have had is very tasty .
Thank you very much all the time for the service and tasty food , specially to Efe who took care of us. Great way of spending last day of the year. See you in 2026!!!

The staff at El Ganso was so kind and accommodating for my birthday dinner. We were 11 total and had the tasting menu, which was such a great option for us. Because of different dietary needs, they were able to swap out some of options for the folks at our table. The food was tasty, and the portions were generous! We were able to get refills on any of the tapas we wanted.

We started eating here regularly from when my 15 year old and his best mate were in nursery school round the corner, and I'd take them for 'brown toast and chips' every Monday. Never looked back. Everywhere else we eat we wait to see if 'The Premises Standard' has been met! Good food, good price, nice atmosphere and exemplary staff. Long live the Premises.

Stumbled upon this cozy restaurant. Big menu with a big list of a bunch of yummy things. The service and staff were amazing and extremely knowledgeable about allergies as we also had a celiac in our group. The sourdough was gorgeous and the ambience such a vibe! Also try the grapefruit juice!
One of the best cafe in london. We are coming here for 15 years and never been disappointed. Ozy is the best and deserved a pay rise. One love.  French family

What a wonderful place totally enchanting the memorabilia on the wall and the warm welcome by the front of house lady. This place has everything you could need for a breakfast lunch or dinner. The food was outstanding. Will definitely be back.

What a lovely little gem of a café! The food was absolutely amazing — every dish felt homemade with love and full of flavour. You can tell that real care goes into everything that comes out of the kitchen.

The coffee was equally fantastic — rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced, easily one of the best I’ve had in a long time.

But what made the visit truly special was the hostess. She was so warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind — the sort of person who makes you feel instantly at home. Her hospitality turned our meal into such a heartwarming experience.

A beautiful place with a beautiful soul behind it. We absolutely loved our visit and can’t wait to come back! ❤️

name: Five Fingers
address: Five Fingers Indian Cuisine, 6 Kingsland High St, London E8 2JP, UK

reviews.text: We ate here on a very quiet Sunday evening and enjoyed incredibly delicious food ! .Anuja our waitress was friendly and knowledgeable about the dishes and made excellent recommendations. We loved the badam Ggheer drink and the panni puri and chill gobi.Thevssuce with the lamb shanks curry was delicious and the Malabar parotta with chicken too. Oh ! And the deserts were lovely too!

A Truly Authentic South Indian Experience with Excellent Service ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

If you're craving authentic South Indian cuisine, this place is a gem. From the moment we walked in, the aroma of fresh spices and filter coffee set the tone for what turned out to be a delightful meal. The decor is simple but making it feel warm and welcoming.
We tried the Panner tikka , some tandoori cooked chicken suggested by staff member— everything was fresh, flavorful, and true to its roots. Portions were generous, and presentation was clean and traditional.
What really stood out was the service. The staff was attentive, polite, and knowledgeable about the menu. The girl who served us even explained the different chutneys and recommended a few lesser-known dishes we ended up loving. Food came out quickly, and the manager (Vimal) personally checked in to make sure we were enjoying our meal — a thoughtful touch.
Whether you're South Indian or just a fan of the cuisine, this place respects tradition while delivering high-quality, flavorful food with a smile. Highly recommended for a satisfying and authentic experience.
10/10 experience and lovely service ❤️ The food was so lovely and really flavourful. Especially the okra fries. Definitely will come back when I have the chance ☺️

I was so excited to have dosa again, reliving my days living in South India and this place absolutely delivered. An amazing selection of dosa on offer, brilliantly sold by the lovely waiter, served authentically and so tasty. Highly recommended.

Authentic South Indian food, really good and very friendly. Had a variety of dosas (eg rava, ghee roast, podi), uttapam, mango lassi etc. Fresh gulab jamun without excess sugar was delicious. Will definitely go again!

What an incredible place 🫠 I’ve been here 3 times now & organised a birthday event which was the best celebration ever! Joshua and the staff were so helpful and extremely kind. The food was exceptional and the drinks selection was super ❤️ cannot recommend enough. Will be definitely returning here, you can feel the love that was put into this place in all the little details. Forever grateful 🫶🏻

Randomly booked a place and where pleasantly surprised. Little quirky place with a nice decor, funky music and amazing drinks. We had pretty much everything on the menu and enjoyed their pickles and skewers (tasty bread was ordered several times too). Service was attentive and we got convinced to try tongue skewer which was absolutely delicious. If you want some fun drinks, interesting food and quirky atmosphere this place is for you. Will be back:)

Filthy martini indeed! Fabulous cocktails, picklebacks and dinner. Staff were so lovely & chatty we had Becca, Joshua and met chef Joe at the end. Food delicious mix of flavours from brine to Asian sea inspired. Great vibe & busy on a Saturday evening. 10/10 recommend. We shall be back.

Absolutely beautifully prepared food, great cocktails and excellent service. The staff is so friendly, they made us feel at home, played us great music, introduced us to new drinks (try the pickle back) and served some of the best food ive had in a long time. I feel like we discovered a gem on our first night in London, they've set the bar very high!

such a great restaurant and bar, we stumbled in after a night out when big night first opened - ever since it has been a staple of our saturday nights. food is amazing, chat about film is even better, of course we’ll be back every saturday forever :-)

name: Cirrik 19 Numara Bos
address: 34 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XJ, UK

reviews.text: The meat was sublime! We shared a mixed platter and was not disappointed. We had that, some chips and some breads, which was enough for 3 of us. I'd recommend the Disco Pilsener, it's very complimentary to the meat we had.

I thouroughy enjoyed my visit here. Finding Turkish food in Dalston is not hard, but this place is certainly the best Turkish I have had in Dalston to date. The service was incredible. The food has such close attention to the flavours and the textures, really teetering on the high end scale in terms of quality of flavour. absolutely loved it will be back again very soon.

It’s a family-run business with lovely owners. Food was great - tasty & fresh. Different than many other Turkish restaurants, they accept dogs. It was my mum’s birthday and they surprised mum with a little treat! 😊 Overall, we totally enjoyed our time in Cirrik.

We came for my friends birthday lunch. Food was brilliant, they helped us make sure we ordered just the right amount for 4 people. Service was great, lovely people who were very friendly. And they brought him out some birthday baklava as well, we didn't have to ask. I don't live in Dalston, but would come back to come here.

What a lovely evening I had here with Zoe! I would recommend the ezme salad and the hummus and prawns. The atmosphere was sensational. Maybe the music could be a bit more atmospheric but the food was insane. Come here it’s great value and they are lovely servers!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I had a wonderful dinner here with my girlfriend and the experience was absolutely flawless from start to finish.
We ordered two starters, two main courses and two second courses, and every single dish was delicious, beautifully presented and full of flavour. You can really tell that great care is taken in the kitchen, both in the quality of the ingredients and in the execution.

The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed and enjoyable evening, and the staff truly made the difference: friendly, attentive and genuinely caring, without ever being intrusive. We felt looked after from the moment we arrived until the very end of the meal.

Overall, it was an excellent dining experience and we left completely satisfied. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food, a lovely atmosphere and outstanding service. We will definitely be coming back.

I had such a great experience at Hoax last night. From the moment we walked in, the vibe and atmosphere were on point - warm, stylish, and inviting without feeling overwhelming. It’s the kind of place you can settle into and really enjoy the night.

The pasta was a standout, especially with the sponge-like bread served alongside. It was such a nice touch for mopping up every bit of sauce - nothing went to waste. The truffle chicken was delicious, the beef cheeks were beautifully cooked, and the beef tartare was spot on.

Overall, Hoax delivers on both food and atmosphere. Definitely a spot worth going back to.

From the moment we stepped inside Hoax we were made to feel at home. The service was outstanding, from introducing us to the menu to making sure everything was to our taste. The food was delicious, a sort of cross between something I imagine my nonna would make, if I had one, and elevated modern Italian cuisine. Highlights were definitely the beef tartare and reinterpreted caprese, and the Tiramisu lived up to the high expectations set by the waitress! Oh and better not forget the cacio e pepe! It’s great to see such an exciting restaurant open in this area and I look forward to going back. I also really appreciate being able to take my dog who was equally well cared for

Went here for Valentine’s Day and we had the best time. A* service. A* food. We shared starters and ordered the beef tartare and the mozzarella which both were divine. We both had ox cheek for main (which personally was my favourite dish of the night. The creamed potato worked perfectly with the crispy kale) and of course a side of risotto because why not (also very nice). For dessert we had tiramisu and the valentines special panna cotta which were also both lovely and the perfect finish.

The service was unbeatable and you can really feel that the team enjoy being there which is a hard find in London hospitality.

Don’t forget to check out the cocktail bar downstairs after.

My first but certainly not last visit. Superb drinks in TDYK - alcoholic and non-alcoholic cocktails. And the food in Hoax was the best I’ve had in a long while - surpassing some Michelin starred places. Service from the whole team was exemplary.

name: Koya Japanese Restaurant Hackney
address: 10 Broadway Market Mews, London E8 4TS, UK

reviews.text:
The food here is bloody good BUT Jesus Christ All Mighty it's pricey! And small on the portion side sadly, so small that you need to grab a bag of Maltesers on the way home to feel fully satisfied, and maybe some chips, and a punnet of grapes... I seem to echo the sentimentality of most folks here, we're locals, we'd be coming more often but we'd like to eat every other day too rather than one bite here and then ration our pennies and ask for alms for the rest of the week.

All in all, the atmosphere is cool, food is great, and we love the staff that work there.

I ordered the KO Meaty Hot Udon, vegetable tempura, and a lemonade, everything was excellent.

The udon was deeply comforting and well balanced: a small amount of chilli oil added aroma and depth without making it greasy or overpowering, and the beef shin was incredibly tender and slow-cooked.

The vegetable tempura was also very well done, retaining the vegetables’ natural freshness and juiciness while having a light, crisp batter.

The restaurant itself is quite small, it probably seats around 30 people at most — so it can feel a bit crowded. The atmosphere is that of a cosy, casual Japanese eatery where people eat efficiently and move on. It’s not ideal if you’re looking to sit and chat for a long time.

That said, I didn’t mind at all, as I was dining alone. On a cold, rainy day, having a bowl of hot udon here was exactly what I needed 😆 warm, satisfying, and comforting.

Writing a good review for the kids menu alone, as it actually had healthy options which is so hard to find. I also find it hard to find more baby friendly restaurants in this side of London, so appreciate when they’re very welcoming to kids.

My son loved it and ate most of it! Kids food was around £8, we sat outside & they brought out a highchair for us :)

Nice small restaurant hidden away on the corner. I’ve had this on my “Want to go” list for a long time and finally visited today. I ordered the Mackerel Udon, Chicken Kaarage and Natto. Super delicious and fresh tasting. Definitely will return to try the other meals.

The food was amazing, I couldn’t believe I could have such proper Japanese udon in London. The atmosphere was super cozy and comfortable, and the staff were friendly and enthusiastic.
Love this place so much will defo come back again!

A very lovely dinner, I was expecting it to be super busy on a Sunday evening but surprisingly was not. So the atmosphere was perfect. I’ll start off with my only dislike, being the sliced beef (carne salada trentina), honestly I’ve had better. Despite this everything ABSOLUTELY BANGED. Carbonara was amazing, from the bacon to the sauce of the pasta. Super tasty. My family loved theirs too, pizza and pasta bolognese . The DESSERTS WERE THE BEST THING. I’d honestly come back just for the desserts. I love tiramisu and now I love it even more. So great value for money. The bill came to 96£ for 3 mains, starter, 3 drinks and 2 desserts. 9.5/10 meal. The staff were amazing too, especially the guy whom my mom also loved, in a platonic way of course.
If you’ve got room for dessert definitely come here.
I will definitely come again, and look forward to trying out their alcohol which I regret not getting 😁, so next time. Grazie (I’m not Italian)

I am so pleased I have just discovered this place! The food is great and affordable. I had the sweetest waiter who was very attentive and well mannered. I ordered the traditional carbonara (made with egg sauce) and tiramisu. Everything was so fresh, yet I didn’t wait long for my food. The portions were good, and the presentation was beautiful. The decor and atmosphere is so nice and relaxing. I came around 5 pm on a weekday and it was quiet. The waiter recommended I get the truffle pasta, so I will be back next week to try it.
We went here twice because we loved the food, atmosphere and service. Our favorites: the pumpkin pistachio risotto and the truffle taglialini. Definite recommendation!

A really nice family run Italian restaurant. It feels independent, reminds me of Italian restaurants in small towns. Really nice food and good service. Went midweek and it was not too busy. Good selection of nice cocktails as well.

DALSTON ITALIAN GEM 🇮🇹✨
📍 Dalston, London
⭐️ 5/5
💸 ££
🍴Discovered the cutest Italian spot in Dalston and I’m completely obsessed! @nameofrestaurant brings authentic Italian flavours with a cozy, homey vibe that feels like a little trattoria in Rome ❤️ We started with the Adriana Burrata—fresh burrata topped with balsamic glaze, #beetroot, radish, and rocket—so creamy it practically melted on the plate. The Antipasto Platter was another highlight, filled with Italian meats, olives, and warm bread. For mains, I had the vibrant Beetroot Gnocchi in a rich cheese sauce and the delicious Black Truffle #Tagliolini—both dishes were packed with flavour 🔥To finish, we went for the silky #Pannacotta with red fruit sauce and a perfectly gooey Chocolate Melted Cake 🤤If you’re in Dalston, this spot is a must-visit!

name: Nom Nom Restaurant
address: 134 F-G, Kingsland Rd, London E2 8DY, UK

reviews.text:
After visiting the Home Museum, we walked across Nom Nom. Their décoration feels like local Vietnamese restaurant, so we decided to give it a try.

We ordered the Xeo Tofu Pancake, the Pork & Wood Ear Mushroom Steamed Rice Roll, and the Bun Cha Ha Hoi.
I highly recommend the Tofu Pancake — it’s incredibly fresh and flavorful, with a perfectly crunchy texture. The Bun Cha Ha Hoi is a cold noodle dish, but the grilled pork mixed with the noodles is surprisingly delicious. The rice rolls are soft, mild in flavor, and feel really light and healthy.

Overall, a great spot — definitely worth checking out!

Excellent  tasty food, baguette with caramelised  mushroom was fresh and bread was soft and crispy. Lamb curry and egg fried rice tasty seasoned well. Service was fairly quick, staff attentive and friendly.  Good portions sizes and excellent choice for vegans. Highly recommend.  Gets busy  lunch times and little noisy with kids but atmosphere  is relaxed. Reasonably priced our bill was £35 with drinks.

Amazing food and amazing service. Van is my absolute favourite person and part of the whole experience. The only reason I keep coming back apart from the obvious which how glorious the food is. Honestly I would consider myself a bit of a pho connoisseur seeing as I go out for pho all over London. This place is by far my favourite I could come back here forever and to see Van of course. Thank you for the drink on the house too, what wonderful service.

The food was soo delicious! The most authentic Vietnamese food I had in London. The service was really great, everyone was super nice. I can really recommend the place. We didn’t had a reservation for Saturday and still got a good table.

The food was so tasty and authentic! So many veggie/vegan options - I really recommend the crispy salt and pepper mushrooms and vegan wok fried noodles. Staff were super friendly and I can’t wait to go back again!
Hackney vibes. Brilliant vegan pizza, got the truffle mushroom and nduja. The chilli oil is nicely v spicy, and garlic oil brilliant with cashew parmesan 😍 They use "I am nut ok" vegan cheese.

Best bar in Hackney, with incredible views over London's skyline. Amazing cocktails and the pizza is 10/10 for me. Make sure you get the truffle mayo!!

Really great vibe up there soundtracked by some of the finest DJ talent around too. Make sure you get up there for sunset!

Nice bar but a girl in our group (who arrived alone) was denied entry for allegedly having a “faulty” drivers license, so we all left. Don’t risk it!

We booked Netil360 for a group of 12. One girl in our party (who is, as we are, 28 years old) arrived slightly later so queued up alone and showed her drivers license to security as usual, but he proceeded to scratch the hologram off the card and assert that this meant it was not a real license. We tried to speak to the manager to explain that this was an old format license, but he already decided that this girl would not be allowed in because she had been rude to security (she had incredulously declared “you’re taking the piss” when he scratched the card). A photo of a passport was also denied. Without wanting to abandon our friend, our entire party left (we’d had 1 round of drinks). Not to worry though: Mare Street Market was right next door and had much friendlier and understanding staff! No problem with other bars in the area either.

Overall a disappointing and completely unexpected experience. Something needs to be done about this obstinate door policy…

It’s a Really good atmosphere here the rooftop is good in the summer, the food is really good, but I’m scoring it average as the service was awful. I Got given the same order number as someone else and food got mixed up which is fine if you amend it and are sorry. But the pizza staff tried to say it’s my fault and that I ordered 1 totally different pizza when I ordered two. Then I proved I did via my bank statement. Then they told me to wait and got my order wrong a second time. Which i was fine about as I was drinking and having a good time, then when my pizza’s finally came I got no apology, no cutlery or sauces and a angry fed up look. Might just be a one off but they need competent staff working on orders.
A well-maintained restaurant where the experience feels measured and consistent. The visit flows smoothly, and nothing interrupts the calm and balanced rhythm of the stay.

name: Palmers Restaurant
address: 238 Roman Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 0RY, UK

reviews.text: Some friends said it was one of the best roasts in London and the hype was real. Me and my partner ordered the pork belly and the beef one. The amount was generous, the veggies were good, specially the roasted potatoes. The beef was super tender, flavourful and good amount. The pork belly was super crispy, but the meat itself also was soft and melted in your mouth. They usually give a small piece for pork belly but this one was big too. Amazing roast and one of the best ones I've had!!

A friendly and busy neighbourhood restaurant. We went to check out their Sunday roast. The place has 4 outside tables if you want to brave the weather. They also have wheelchair access to the inside and seating space for disabled. The place is friendly, clean and has a cool feature wall with 100s of wine bottles. Sunday roast is good, however i recommend the beef, the chicken for me was questionable. Drinks menu is also good and they have some reasonably priced lemonades in case you dont drink alcohol. The place accepts both card and cash payments. Reservations recommended on sundays.

This was our second visit to Palmers after chancing upon the restaurant when I was working nearby. We visited on a Sunday and three of us had the roast option and my daughter had monkfish. The portions were generous and everyone was happy with the quality and presentation of the food, I had the roast pork belly and it was a very nice cut of meat, it came with good selection of vegetables which had plenty of flavour. In terms of value for money I would say the food was very good for London and the wine was comparable, I really like the fact that they made sure the bottle of tap water on the table was always full and the service was friendly and efficient but not pushy.

Excellent service, food, and staff. I’m proud to be local to this gem. I often enjoy calm solo dinners here since it’s just around the corner. They are truly different from any other modern European restaurant. Their menu is great and changes from time to time, but it never disappoints. I especially get excited when they include more seafood, as their chef really knows what they’re doing. Their steak is almost legendary — my neighbors and I always talk about how they make the best steak. Recently, I tried their cauliflower dish as my main (trying to cut back on meat), and oh my word... the flavors, the sauce — you MUST try it. Also if you can , finish your dinner with their chocolate pudding… just saying.

Palmers is an absolute treasure.

I visited today and started with top-quality oysters paired with a perfectly spiced Bloody Mary, an exceptional beginning. The roast beef dinner was nothing short of spectacular. I’m from Yorkshire, so believe me when I say this: I have never had a homemade Yorkshire pudding this good. Crisp, golden, majestic, the crown jewel of the plate.

And the desserts? Honestly unforgettable. So spellbindingly delicious they defy proper description.

What truly elevates Palmers, though, is the service. Attentive, warm, and genuinely friendly, it feels less like dining out and more like being welcomed into a family kitchen.

I’m absolutely delighted to have discovered this place. A rare find and a guaranteed return.

This restaurant is such a nice discovery.
The food is truly tasty and the service is amazing. Staff was very polite and attentive to our needs. We were 3 and  had a mix plate to share, mix mezze and one shish lamb,  everything was perfect. The restaurant is nicely decorated and atmosphere is cosy.
Also meat is halal.
Will definitely come back :)
one suggestion: Bring mocktails to the  menu.

We came here thinking we were on a normal dinner day out with my partner, but the experience was something unbelievable. We were treated with a whole 10+ course which was specifically made to play with your tastebuds. It’s not your regular night out, here is something amazing I don’t think I can go to any other Mediterranean restaurant. The owner is actually a chef and the meals he created is a must taste! Apart from the meals, the vibe of the restaurant is so warm and cosy.

Fantastic food at this underrated modern Turkish restaurant, including tasting menu (available for min. 2 people). Adana was quite lean and tasty, excellent lentil soup with spicy notes. Rice was ok, not that aromatic. No service charge levied but you can add a tip even if you pay by card.

Live music was on from 19.00 on a Saturday.

We had a great experience here! We had a warm greeting the second we walked in, and the service was super quick.
The food was delicious and looked amazing, everything tasted so fresh.
You definitely have to try the mixed meze and the braised lamb.
The owner was lovely and actually took the time to chat with us about the dishes in detail, which made the night feel really personal. We’ll definitely be back!

Every meal we had there was exceptionally delicious and we enjoyed a lot! There are also plenty of vegetarian options available. The atmosphere, service quality, friendly stuff were just as important as the food. Good to know that such a high-quality restaurant is there to go.

Lived up to the Vittles hype for me. Really loved the food - particular standouts were the lamb ribs, the milk bread with mushrooms, and the meringue desert (maybe the best desert I’ve ever eaten).

We sat at the counter which I highly recommend if you are in a pair. You can see the open kitchen and also see one of the chefs plating snacks and deserts in front of you on the counter.

The service was really good - didn’t catch his name but shoutout to the Australian guy with long hair!! He gave us great recs on food and drink. I’m not big into wine but the cocktails were delicious and I had the most lovely Japanese tea at the end.

Overall we had such a lovely dinner here and I couldn’t recommend enough. Came to about £100pp which we thought was very fair given how good the food was and we had a couple of drinks (and a tea and coffee) each - and left stuffed

A laid back wine bar/innovative plates restaurant is apparently just what Dalston needed. Some really nice wines on offer, including by the glass; I really enjoyed a 2023 Domaine Bernard St-Joseph Blanc. Food was overall good but with some misses: cockle and laverbread rice was fabulous, as was the wigmore ice cream. However poached chicken with celeriac was middling and the fried mackerel bite not that great either. Definitely recommend sitting at the communal table and watching the chefs at work.

Planque exceeds expectations every single time. Their menu is thoughtful and balanced including indulgent flavours and light airy seafood. The crab rice was decadent, punchy and all around perfect. The beef tartare is melty and gentle, and an interesting spin with a peppercorn sauce. For dessert, the Choux has always been a favourite but now that we've had the Wigmore Ice-cream, meringue & bread caramel... WOW that was genuinely mind blowing. To top it off, their wine list is excellently curated and the service is beyond lovely and so knowledgeable.

Phenomenal food with an equally beautiful wine list. This has been our go to celebratory spot for the last 5 years, and we hope that continues long into the future. Planque serves delicious food that is both exciting but not overcomplicated. It is perfect.
Amazing! Food magic. Great mussels, maybe the best sauce I've ever had. Phenomenal wine list. Great rib eye. Superb service.

The staff were so accommodating and very helpful. The food was so delicious and big portions all four of us had such full bellies that we couldn't have desserts. The cocktails are yummy made perfectly. We are already arranging to go back soon. Thank you for a lovely evening

Just went here last minute after our midwife appointment at Homerton hospital. We went for the top reviews and how close walk it was from the hospital. It was during the lunchtime and was empty. We really enjoyed the food and the service. We would love to come back and see during the evening for the atmosphere and try their cocktails.

We visited Venerdi for my mum’s birthday with a large group, and it was a great experience overall. The staff were incredibly welcoming and patient, especially as my mum changed her order a couple of times. The service was excellent, and they provided plenty of space for our group, including room for a pram and high chairs for kids.

The food was good, though mixed. The stone-baked pizzas were fantastic, and the rosemary focaccia was delicious. However, the seafood spaghetti was too salty, and my mum and sister said they were very thirsty afterwards.
My ravioli, while filling, was a bit overpowering on the truffles. I ordered the strawberry lemonade, and it was different - it could use better balance as it was very sweet.

The atmosphere was lively but not crowded, with festive decorations adding a nice touch. I’d definitely recommend Venerdi for their pizza and friendly service!

Pasta was overcooked, 3 meatballs for £14
Spaghetti mare were drenched in tomato sauce and most of the shells were empty. Good Aperol spritz and decent service. Disappointed with the food, not authentic at all and seeing the food warmed up in the microwave was a huge disappointment.
Had a delicious meal, drinks were perfect and amazing service. A special thanks to Rachid for sorting us out!

name: The Water House Project
address: 1 Corbridge Cres, Cambridge Heath, London E2 9DT, UK

reviews.text:
Only 10 days into 2026 and there’s an early contender for the best lunch of the year.

We’d had three excellent food boxes from The Water House Project during Covid, however for some reason had never made it there to eat in person.

And this place is truly awesome…

Dish after dish of innovative food, highly technical, beautifully presented and above all so, so tasty. Each course was superb, the scallop and beetroot real standouts for me amongst many. Great produce coupled with a sustainability ethos made this a seriously fantastic meal.

Service was friendly, knowledgeable and informative and the dining room bright and airy. A cool vibe and decent music made this the complete experience.

Not too sure where the Michelin inspectors have been as this is easily at one star level. Surely this year…?

Twenty minutes walk from home, we’ve already booked a return visit to enjoy this menu again. And I’m sure WHP will become a regular favourite in the months to come.

Dinner at The Water House project is definitely an experience. We had a lovely time enjoying the summer menu which was full with vibrant summery flavours. While all the taste profiles were amazing, there was a substantially high number of broths/soups that was unexpected. They tasted delicious, but could be abit much for summer.

Compared to other tasting menus I had, I think this would be in the middle in terms of value for money. Some things could be elevated. In addition the wine pairing should be expanded to make it more value for money. As it currently stands, I would not recommend it.

This was our second visit to this restaurant, and we noticed that the taste improved since our last visit last year. The soup and drinks were aromatic, with interesting and delicious flavors. Foods were delicious and had beautiful plating. The atmosphere was great, with friendly chefs and waiters who were attentive and always checked in on us. I would highly recommend this restaurant—perhaps it will earn some Michelin stars soon!

Lovely, underrated place with a Nordic-influenced, seasonal British fine dining menu for excellent value. The venue is airy, spacious but maintains a relaxed, intimate vibe. Service is friendly. The food itself is beautifully presented, though some elements were perhaps a little repetitive (but suspect that feeds into the sustainable ethos). While some pairings didn't match that well, the non-alcoholic pairing was nonetheless still delicious. Would definitely return and also recommend.

We have eaten here a few times - they do seasonal menus. The food is outstanding - really thought through and well prepared dishes and wine pairings that really enhance the dish. A special shout out to the non alcoholic drinks that they create themselves and are absolutely incredible. The environ is spacious and well appointed (and really warm which on a cold evening was a lovely welcome!) It’s lovely to see the staff prepare the dishes and each course is described and its preparation explained. The staff are amazing - they never intrude but service is outstanding (even down to replacing the cold water regularly)

name: Si Hombre! Was… BLACK PIG WITH WHITE PEARLS
address: 61 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 8EL, UK

reviews.text: Great venue and owner ! I had my 25th birthday here and had the best time, the owner Melvin was accommodating and friendly. The private space below the restaurant is good for big or small groups and i was able to play my own music which was great. I will be back !

We really wanted to like this place after hearing about it for ages from so many people. It has got a different name now and I believe it recently changed management.

The lady who served was was really friendly but was not very much help in recommending meat or seafood dishes, said she was veggie which was fair enough. The place was totally empty on a Friday evening which was a warning sign we should have heeded.

We wanted to like the food, but it was not nice at all. Some effort was made but definitely not restaurant quality. Squid rings limp and soggy, prawns not de-veined. Rice with oxtail was tasty but a bit too crunchy for our taste. The iberico pork was cold inside.

Extremely disappointing. Spanish-Caribbean sounds like such a great food fusion idea. If only they could cook better. Ingredients were definitely good quality but they need someone who knows how to cook better.
amazinggg vibes. tapas were very tasty and rich!! a bit pricey but great for a date night

I had a birthday celebration here last weekend and it was an amazing venue. The staff were extremely friendly, they catered for some specific requirements (made some cocktails to match the theme of the party!) And all in all had an amazing party with lots of dancing in the basement room.
Would recommend!
Thank you Si Hombre!

Tantalising tapas 🤌🏻

Wonderful dishes, refreshing sangria, welcoming staff & a wicked playlist 🍷

This spot is one to visit for you tapas lovers! 🧡

They also have a party room downstairs, which is available to hire, great size!  🎉

Keep an eye out on this restaurant, Melvin has lots of great ideas 💡

name: Devran
address: 170, 172 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7UY, UK

reviews.text: Came here for late lunch with family for a birthday. Really friendly welcoming staff. Sat by the windows which open like doors. We had some great starters which were a variety of different things and then a mixed grill for mains which was cooked to perfection. It was a lot of food for the 5 of us we ended up taking home and finishing off later. When they sung happy birthday they brought out the whole shabang which we weren’t expecting and a nice little touch (all staff singing/dancing with a speaker and a little cake). Priced reasonably. Would definitely go back

Friendly restaurant popular with the locals. We were greeted by a very friendly lady with a sparkly hair band and seated immediately. They are so hospitable here and the food was awesome. Generous portions and delicious grilled flavours. Fresh homemade bread is complimentary and we were also offered tea at the end of our meal. We really liked this place. They made us feel so welcome.

A lovely dining spot for our group and great birthday experience for my sis in law. Food was flavoursome, having tried many dishes amongst our group of 12. Served with good sized portions. A Special shout out to our waiter Azim , he was top notch! Patient, spot on with recommendations  and friendly with a smile. Will definitely return and  recommend.

I love it here !!! very professional very nice. The food was amazing. The quality was immaculate. My taste buds are literally dancing. Good customer service especially from Musa He was very nice friendly and the food came very quick which I really like. I was not waiting long at all the quality was amazing. The food was very very nice. I highly recommend you coming !! I’ve been here so many times and I will continue to do so :)

I was there few times ago and from my experience it’s a good place to enjoy testy food! Head chef and the chef from Bangladesh are really respectful and kind hearted also the guys was Named Azim is super friendly. ❤️

name: Leo's Restaurant & Bar
address: 59 Chatsworth Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0LH, UK

reviews.text: THE BEST!! A truly decadent dinner or a simple, glorious lunch (and or pastry) here is always a treat. The atmosphere is unbeatable, food beyond incredible, top notch ingredients and great service. We love Leo's!

We held our wedding reception in Leo’s and it was absolutely perfect.

The food was stand-out delicious (and was the talk of the whole wedding); the service friendly and attentive (shout out to Ian our waiter in particular, who was an absolute gent); while the overall atmosphere of the restaurant and bar was warm and welcoming from start to finish. They really made us feel like we were at home while we were there.

Communication around the booking was also very clear and quick, with the restaurant manager Giovanni being super accommodating to all our needs and ensuring we had everything we needed. We’re looking forward to bringing our family and friends back there for dinner in the future.

Thanks again to everyone at Leo’s! Niall & Natalia

A quaint little restaurant tucked away in the now trendy part of Hackney. We went with a group of seven for a birthday celebration. Food was hearty, unpretentious & delicious. Service was friendly & attentive, atmosphere relaxed & intimate. We all enjoyed what was served & were delighted we had chosen the venue.
The team at Leo’s were very helpful and friendly - the food choices were wide ranging and everything we had was delicious, from the oysters to the tiramisu. Excellent wine and a great ambience.

Disappointing and too expensive for this level of cuisine - the wild boar lasagne was burnt and dry, and in hindsight we should have sent it back. The fried prawns ok but nothing special and the raw beef tartare lamentable tasteless. Wine selection pretty decent but didn't save the night. Also the restaurant is very loud and we felt ushered out as the time limit approached on our table. A shame.

name: Samarkand
address: 30 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XJ, UK

reviews.text:
A Fantastic Introduction to Uzbek Cuisine 🇺🇿🍽️

I’ve always been curious about Uzbek cuisine, so visiting Samarkland Restaurant was something I’d been looking forward to and it absolutely didn’t disappoint. From the moment we arrived, the experience felt warm, welcoming, and genuinely authentic.

We started with a great selection of dishes. The samosas were crisp and well-seasoned, while the pumpkin manti stood out with their soft dough and subtly sweet filling. The spinach somsa was light and had a lot of flavour, and the king prawns were cooked perfectly, adding a nice contrast to the more traditional starters.

For the mains, we tried the Uzbek pilov and lagman noodles. The pilov was rich, fragrant, and very filling, with beautifully cooked rice and tender meat that showed real care in preparation. The lagman noodles were equally impressive, full of flavour, and very satisfying.

To drink, we had a traditional yoghurt drink and turnib, the yogurt I really enjoyed, the turning is definitely an acquired taste.

The service was fantastic throughout. The staff really looked after us, and we were seated at a traditional table, which added to the atmosphere. They even played some music in the background, making the whole evening feel relaxed and culturally immersive.

Overall, Samarkland is a brilliant place to experience Uzbek food for the first time, or to return if you already love it. Highly recommended.

We really enjoyed trying Uzbek food for the first time! We only struggled deciding what to eat because everything sounded delicious. My favourite thing were the pumpkin somsas, so hopefully we will be back to have some more! Lovely service and atmosphere too. I was also happy to find different vegetarian options.

A beautiful family run Uzbekistan restaurant serving traditional Uzbek food which is HMC certified. The restaurant has a 5 star rating very clean inside. Beautiful traditional and modern decor. Two section main restaurant and a cafe next door. Very spacious with good seating for couples and large groups. The restaurant was well lite and airy with a good atmosphere. The restaurant manager a young lady introduced us to the menu. She was very friendly and helpful and convince us to try the traditional Samarkand special, a noddle dish called Largon Sharva, lamb shish and piov. We were recommended to try the special tea instead of drinks while we waited for mains. The special tea was more of a herb tea. It tasted delicious and very refreshing with fruits, berries, lemon and mint. Great for a cold day like today. Food didn’t take long and we were asked if we were ok with items as they get ready instead of waiting for everything. This was a great recommendation as the manager knew her stuff. The lamb shish came first and then some items from the Samarkand special and then the noddles. The food was beautifully presented, fresh, smelt good and good portion sizes. The food tasted amazing great flavours, spice, sweetness and well seasoned. The food we got was enough for the 3 of us as a light evening meal. We ordered another tea after the meal as we all love the special tea. A lovely place to visit with friends and family in the Dalston area or when visiting the Aziziya Mosque, lovely restaurant, lovely staff, lovely food and drink. Look forward to visiting again. Thank you for a great evening.

This place would be awesome to go to for Iftaar in Ramadan. It has a prayer area. The cakes/desserts are baked fresh.

Their fruit tea is delicious!

We spent for a table of four was £81 and the portion sizes were generous. Amazing, friendly and welcoming service. The interior was beautiful and had handprints murals, beautiful tiling and even their plates were traditional uzbek!

We ordered Laqman which are handmade noodles which is akin to a mix of Chinese and turkic flavours. Really good.

Uzbek Pilou... similar to kabuli very yum

Our table was a very big fan of the olivier salad but next time we'd get 2 instead of one because it was that delightful.

We also order mat dumplings called Barack also very shareable and comes with yoghurt and a tomato chill sauce.

And I think a puff pastry? I'm not sure the name our uzbek friend ordered for the table.

All in all would return again

Will be coming back again! Tasty food, beautiful interior and passionate staff.

My friends and I were new to Uzbek cuisine and the server gave us great recommendations. Her passion for her culture and cuisine was clear. We had to wait a while for the food but it was well worth it.

name: Istanbul Restaurant
address: 9 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BH, UK

reviews.text: Very nice authentic Turkish restaurant. Super friendly staff. Food is great especially the sauces are amazing. Much better than other hyped Turkish places close by 😉
I am so glad I wandered into this place for lunch! Everything was delicious but the star was the kunafeh. It was unparalleled! I still think about it, months later.

The most authentic Turkish restaurant in London. The food was so tasty and the portions were huge. Sim was so lovely, she made us feel welcome and at home. We want to come back and try even more from the menu. I definitely recommend it

We’ve been going to Istanbul Restaurant for 9 years now, and we are always happy with the food and the service. The staff are wonderful, the atmosphere is warm, and the place is very children-friendly, which we really appreciate.

They made my birthday extra special this year when my son told the waiter it was my birthday, they brought out a dessert with a candle and sang for me. It honestly made me extremely happy.

Thank you so much for all these years of great experiences! Highly recommended.

Went to this place as they had a £10.95 lunch offer, and it didn't disappoint. I had the lamb shish and it was very agreeable even though the pieces of meat were too small for my liking. The Borek and pastry were equally tasty so overall good value for money.

name: Testi Restaurant
address: 38 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 7PL, UK

reviews.text:
Amazing Turkish restaurant in Stoke Newington! The grilled sea bass was outstanding, perfectly charred, aromatic, and very tender.
The mixed grilled meat was also delicious and went really well with rice.
Portions are generous, and every main comes with salad and freshly grilled bread. Everything is cooked over charcoal, giving the food a wonderful smoky flavour, but the restaurant has good ventilation so there’s no lingering smell.
Friendly service and a great place for family gatherings or dinner with friends. Highly recommended!

Authentic Turkish gem in Stoke Newington! The 25-year-old charcoal grill fills every bite with incredible smoky flavor. We loved the massive Mixed Grill Platter – the lamb ribs were perfectly charred and juicy. A true taste of Ocakbaşı tradition. Highly recommended!

One of the best Turkish meals I’ve had in London — completely changed my view of Turkish cuisine!

A friend brought me to this spot in North London, and wow… they really know what to order. We got the Cold Meze and the Testi Lokum Kebab, and both dishes were incredible.

I still don’t fully know what Lamb Middle Neck Fillet is, but it was unbelievably tender — genuinely melt-in-your-mouth. You can also see the chefs grilling the meat right at the front, which makes the whole experience even better.

And I have to give a special shout-out to their bread. Two girls who rarely touch carbs absolutely demolished it. It’s slightly like naan, brushed with some kind of special seasoning… absolutely irresistible.

Absolutely loved our meal here.
We ordered the Testi Lokum Kebab and the Grilled Salmon, and both dishes were outstanding in their own way.

The Lokum Kebab was the highlight — perfectly charcoal-grilled, incredibly tender, and full of that rich smoky flavour.

We also tried a couple of mocktails, and they were surprisingly good — refreshing, well-balanced, and not overly sweet, which is rare to find.

STICKY situation.

I visited this place on a recommendation since its recent revamp, however I was disappointed with the level of service. The underside of our table was covered in some sort of sticky liquid, exacts of which I couldn't figure out, but it ended up staining my girlfriends trousers. It was supposed to be a relaxing night out with her, but turned into a dry cleaning bill. The solution offered to us was to either table swap, or a wipe it down... nothing more. It's almost as if they didn't want to take ownership or apologies for what happened due to embarrassment; but I think this is just me trying to justify their lack of customer service. When questioned for how and when we wanted our food and drinks to come out, none of it was brought out at correct times, or in the correct order, and not as much as an apology was made after I paid for the food and left.

The bench seat had salt, crumbs and even a cigarette-burn/hole on the fabric of the seat/bench. The place was moderately busy, but there's no excuse for poor hygiene/cleanliness. Luckily, the chef was cooking over an open charcoal grill for the most part, so we didn't have any overwhelming concerns around food hygiene. In fact, if it wasn't for the above - I'd say that the food was average given its price range and location.

Oiled bread = delicious.
Hummus = average/decent.
Iskender kebab (chicken or lamb) = average/decent.
Rice = not worth a penny/left over quality.
Chips = below average/takeaway standard.
Grilled Onion = impossible to mess up/decent.
Salad = looked tired, tasted decent.

I paid £65 for this... don't believe the hype.

name: Sultan Grill
address: 133 Homerton High St, London E9 6AS, UK

reviews.text: This is around my 5th  time and  the service is always great. I always dine in, awesome customer service, great flavours and I am so comfortable. I tend to sit, relax and unwind. The cost is very reasonable and budget friendly. The environment is also very clean. I will be back again.

Absolutely amazing shawarma and grill spot! The food here is always fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The grilled chicken is especially outstanding — juicy, tender, and packed with delicious smoky flavor. Every bite tastes authentic and satisfying.

The best grill in East London. Salad is so fresh, the service from the men working there is top tier, pricing is so reasonable for what it’s worth. The best nights I’ve had are leaving the pub early and getting a Sultan. LOVE SULTAN GRILL Xx

I don’t like to dabble in hyperbole. I’m an average person, I grab a kebab on the way home from a night out, I like good food. Sultan Grill honestly has become a regular option for me if I want a delicious easy meal. Truly top recommendation, I take all my friends there when they’re round mine. No notes, no crumbs. Give it a chance, no regrets.

The BEST kebab in East London ! Freshly made food daily, the staff are so friendly Ezel & Salih go above and beyond to make sure ur happy ! Did I mention the food is always freshly made !? Try the  pomegranate in your kebab ! Thank me later ! 😁

name: Chambers Restaurant
address: 132 Lauriston Rd, Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7LH, UK

reviews.text:
We had a table for 12 to celebrate my sisters 60th Birthday. The food was fantastic, the staff are so friendly and welcoming, they make you feel like they know you. We ALL had an amazing time. They let us bring in a birthday cake. They even cut it all and served the cake as desert, therefore lessening the total bill. This was totally unexpected as we would have ordered a dessert.
We loved it so much that we booked a table for 12 for Xmas day.

Amazing family that includes all who walk in the door.  Food is delish. My faves are the Chamber's salad, the warm salad ,the 4 cheese pizza, Sunday roast,  the tiramasu! Good wine selection.  Great cappuccino.  Lovely after dinner shots.  We were there for our 40th anniversary and they made an announcement to the whole restraunt and then turned up the music and we all danced!  Ada and Luka are the best hosts ever!  And their children are just as sweet.  Love this place!

My boyfriend and I had the loveliest meal here on Sunday! Everything about the experience was perfect! The food was absolutely amazing.

I also have to say… I had the BEST chai latte I’ve ever had! The owners were so lovely and welcoming.

Can’t recommend this place highly enough — we’ll definitely be back!

I visit Chambers at Victoria Park often it’s a great traditional family-run restaurant an absolutely nice place to chill.

Seda is such a warm, attentive, and kind host who always makes my friends and I feel welcome.

The marinated chicken wings and borek filo parcels are my favourite; always cooked perfectly. The chef is so consistent.

Recommended !!!

Amazing food!! Great place for breakfast or lunch!! Pasta was delicious. And we even got chocolate cake and tiramisu on house, which are must try!! As a vegetarian it was difficult to find good food anywhere, but here it was very easy. Saadah was very sweet and friendly. So was the ohter owner, must recommend place.

name: Restaurant Elis
address: 1st floor, Town Hall Hotel, 8 Patriot Square, London E2 9NF, UK

reviews.text:
It was good overall. But I was expecting more because it is the same chef as da terra. The brazilian bites (pastel, bolinho de peixe, and pao de queijo slider) were the lows for me. I think it could be way more interesting with a twist or something. I felt like I was paying 4 pounds in 1 item while in brazil you get 10 paying less than that with the same quality. Same goes to the pizza pastel.😅
I really enjoyed the pork chop and cassava chips, so good. It was a good experience but I was expecting more for the price we paid.

Had exceptional food looked after by Richard who guided us amazingly through the menu. Food was fantastic especially the pao de quejo slider, the croquettes and the trout.

Was a bit quiet but it is mid January. Music was great but was fairly quiet which is understandable this time of year. Would recommend to anyone who wants to try Brazilian cuisine !

This place was a little different. Not a lot of selections on the menu and the larger dishes are specials. The lamb skewer special was amazing. The cheese bread slider was pretty good as well. The bread baskets was good and my colleagues enjoyed their drinks. I almost gave it a 4 cause some of the dishes weren't as good, but the lamb was so good I had to round up to a five for this one.

Just happened to stumble upon this on Google maps on a Saturday evening, not having had (up to this point) good Brazilian food in London.

The restaurant is in a hotel, which made me a bit sceptical at first. But by the end of the dinner we weren't disappointed.

The place is small. Service was very friendly and welcoming. There were surprisingly few people there for a Saturday, which was even more surprising considering how good it was.

We ordered two of each of the Bolinhos de Bacalhau, Pastel de Pizza, Pão de Queijo sliders, and lamb skewers. We also ordered their special rice and seafood dish as a main.

The Bolinhos were nice and crisp, and the sliders were a fun take on Pão de Queijo (Brazilian cheese bread). The lamb was so tender and flavorful. The star of the show was the rice and seafood. The seafood and the rice were cooked to perfection. The amount of flavor in that rice was amazing.

All the while service was very attentive. The food came fast, but as a good pace -- they waited until we were done with one dish before getting the other.

I would definitely go there again, especially since it seems that they have different specials.

Cozy and gorgeous restaurant with great food and service. We were 3 people and had several starters and 2 mains. The taco was so good which was recommended by the server and the prawn pasta and sirloin steak with truffle were amazing. It’s a great place for a special day and also for a nice night out. I want to highlight that the server Chloe was giving us an impeccable service:) She was warm and polite, also recommendation for our order was so clear and appropriate. She made our experience more comfortable and memorable. I would definitely visit again.

The stuffed mussels here are fantastic! Such a vibrant spot with the best friendliest staff & owners! Not only is the presentation on point but the flavours of every dish truly exceeded all expectations! 10/10 Turkish spot, a must visit! - @londonfoodblogs on Instagram and TikTok

The Midye Dolma (stuffed mussels) I had was way better than the one i had in Rumelikavağı/Sarįyer The taste of Midye Kızartma (Fried Mussels) took me to the taste that I first had in my town Sarıyer back in 1990s, that is not a joke! You should go to The Midyeci and order 2/3 portions of both, I swear you would lick your fingers, just an amazing taste. Not just taste but such a lovely atmosphere, great welcoming and finishing the night with a lovely Turkish Coffee made our day with my wife. You should definitely try the whole menu and go now🔥👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼🔥 Kaan & Mery

Had lunch at The Midyeci Bar today and honestly it was one of those meals that hits the spot without you even planning for it. I was just looking for something filling and ended up getting the shish kebab with a portion of rice and salad. Pretty standard order, but they actually did it really well.

The kebab came out super fresh, tender, and had that proper charred taste without being dry. You know when the meat is cooked just right and you don’t have to fight with it? Yeah, it was like that. The rice was fluffy and had that nice buttery vibe without being greasy, which I really appreciated. And the salad was simple but fresh — crunchy veggies, nothing soggy or sad-looking, which I feel like happens too often at some places.

The overall vibe of the place was chill and very “Turkish street food but indoors,” if that makes sense. Nothing pretentious. The staff were relaxed but still helpful, not overdoing it with check-ins. It’s the kind of spot where you can sit down for a proper meal but also just pop in quick without it feeling weird.

Second visit and we were greeted by the lovely waitress who remembered us and took us through their newly designed menu which included the option for freshly cut chips which we ordered in addition to the Fish Wrap and of course the Mussels.

The Mussels were amazing as always and our waitress was super kind to always throw a few more on the house. The fish wrap was delicious too.

This time round we also had a couple of glasses of wine - the rosé, served cold, is outstanding!

We love this place because of the waitress, the food (hats off to the kitchen) and overall vibes mean that it will be one of our go to spots when dining in Dalston! You should make it yours too!

===
A nice restaurant with friendly service and delicious food. A must visit when in Dalston.

The stuffed mussels are outstanding. I preferred the classic and my other half the spicy. Started with 4 and loved them so ordered 2 more... However Upon ordering a second round they ran out of spicy so us 4 classic (2 on the house)

Kudos to the waitress for making us aware that the chips are not freshyly handcut and are from frozen. They should really update the menu though appreciated the honesty during service and that she bought us a few to sample.

The signature trio wrap which had calamari, prawns and mussels was recommended by the waitor and it was outstanding - I loved the topping on the wrap - divine.

I can't wait to go back!

Had lunch with a friend that also loved the stuffed mussels. We always order 1kg to share. They also have other seafood dishes which I have never tried before as that’s how good the stuffed mussels taste that I only come here for these.

What a lovely surprise Okko was. My friends and I were looking for a space to accommodate us with no booking; and am I glad they found a spot for us.
We had lots of bites to share; it was plenty of food to divide between 3 people. Everything tasted fresh and delicious. I am thoroughly impressed in particular by the salmon nigiri - it was the best I’d ever had.
I also want to praise the service; we had the sweetest waitress. She was attentive, served us with a big smile, and made us feel at home.
Highly recommend if you’re looking for a low-key, cosy japanese restaurant. Super experience.

I visited Okko in Broadway Market with my whole family, and we were honestly blown away. The service was excellent from start to finish — so friendly, attentive, and welcoming. The food was absolutely incredible, beautifully presented, and really well-priced for the quality. We had a mix of young kids and older kids with us, and every single one of them loved the food (a miracle in itself!). The atmosphere is relaxed but vibrant, and it felt like such a treat. We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

Came here for a birthday meal with around 10 people, they did a good job at accommodating that number of people within the space. The food was excellent, exceptional even. A real wide variety so potentially look at the menu before going. The real let down was the vibe. They told us to be quiet at one point, also took away some of our drinks while still drinking. Very quickly turned from good vibes to, get these people out of here.

TLDR: great place to eat with great food. Not the choice for as the group.

Already planning our next visit! I’m a coeliac and this is one of the best gluten-free dining experiences I’ve had. The choice of food is just incredible, and everything I ate was sublime. The hamachi jalapeño sushi was gorgeous, as was the cold char siu chicken. The stand out dish for me was miso buta kakuni - perfectly tender pork belly in miso with a lovely jammy egg. My non-coeliac partner had chicken katsu with curry sauce, and he said the chicken was the best he’s ever had. We also shared the truffle fries which were 10/10.

Service was fantastic - very friendly and attentive. Food came out promptly which was great as we were starving! I cannot wait to come back for a gluten free katsu!
£95 for two cocktails, two sharers, rice, sushi, katsu, fries, and service. Really good value and the portion sizes are very generous.

Poor Service - Avoid This Place
Went twice, same awful experience both times. They seat you at “reservation” tables without telling you upfront, then rush you to finish your food the moment it arrives. Asked if the table was reserved the second time - waitress said no, then did the exact same thing again.
You can’t enjoy a meal when staff are hovering over you demanding you hurry up after you’ve already ordered and paid.
There are non-reservation tables available - use them or tell customers upfront about time limits.
Won’t be back. Plenty of other places that actually want your business.
1/5 stars

name: Italina385
address: 385 Cambridge Heath Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 9RA, UK

reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to Italina for years and have never been disappointed.

The owners are incredibly friendly, and the service is always fast and attentive.

Over the years, I’ve tried pretty much every pizza on the menu and every single one has been amazing, the dough is unbelievably good… Great wine selection too.

The tiramisu is also a favourite, super light, creamy, and full of flavour.

Hands down the best pizzeria in East London!
