It's a low key neighnbourhood Italian in Bethnal Green that probably mostly supplies locals with pizzas, but is a surprisingly terrific restaurant.  Not living in the area, we were last here maybe eight years ago, but I still remember the pasta alla vongole I had on that occasion.  We've been to a lot of more expensive, and more famous Italians in London, but this place really reminds me of eating at trattorias on vacation in Italy.  Simple menu, terrific ingredients cooked in a way you can taste the individual components, and everything homemade.  They do serve dried pasta, which I actually prefer because its texture is more chewy.

My companion had the bruschetta to start followed by the burrata served on a bed of  grilled vegatables.  Both of his starters came with a fantastic focaccia which had big airy bubbles toasted to a crisp.  There was a tiny drizzle of pesto on the burrata that looked bright green and  tasted homemade.  I didn't taste the bruschetta, but my companion praised the sparing use of red onion in the tomato mix, making it perfectly balanced.

I had the scialatelli alla vongole, of course, with a side of the grilled vegetable salad with goat cheese.  I asked them to just bring both dishes as ready because I didn't want to eat them in sequence.  That's exactly how I got them, with the grilled veg first, and the pasta maybe 5 minutes later to eat along side.  My partner got his two starters in non overlapping sequence, exactly as requested as well.

The vongole was great.  There were maybe 8 clams in shells decorating the dish but plenty more shelled clams stirred through the pasta.  The clams were perfectly cooked and still tender and juicy.  I liked the restrained use of fresh cherry tomato sauteed in olive oil, which didn't dominate.  I could taste the good quality olive oil. The thick scialatelli was delightfully chewy.  It wasn't quite as spectacular as the version I ate on my last visit eight years ago, which included an unorthodox quantity of garlic.  Maybe next time I will ask if the current chef is willing to put in a little garlic for me.  The grilled vegetable salad with a thin slice of toasted goat cheese was excellent.  On top of the mixed green salad there were slices of grilled courgette, grilled eggplant and very sweet strips of peeled red pepper.  I was happy to note that the roasted pepper was homemade, having no hint of the acidic preservatives that peeled roast peppers from a jar has.

The cheapest bottles of wine are £29 and £30, and dinner including a bottle of red came to £78.  Music and noise levels are low.  There was an 80s pop soundtrack playing during our visit. We will definitely be back and won't wait eight years before our next visit.
Really amazing Italian place! Some of the best Italian I have had in London. Authentic and really tasty. I had the clams and my partner had an amazing beef ragu

Great and tasty traditional Italian restaurant! Service was great and fast, kind staff, and very flavorful pizzas. Tiramisu as dessert is very recommended, creamy and traditional. Overall very recommended, plus the location seem very traditional, it felt as being in a small restaurant in Italy!

It's hard to find good pizza nowadays around London and Italina it's a place for a proper Italian pizza. The food was amazing and I truly mean it. I have enjoyed every single bite of food. Everything was just spot on. I really do recommend this tiny Italian restaurant.

name: Mangal 2 Restaurant
address: 4 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XN, UK

reviews.text:
Came here for dinner on the recommendations of some friends and did not regret my decision.

Really good authentic Turkish food which really scratches an itch. The menu is quite extensive and there are many grilled meat options which take me back to the ocakbasis of Istanbul. The smells coming from the kitchen were so enticing!

I ordered the Adana kebab which was nicely spiced - really delicious. All the salads were super fresh and complimented the main dish. I really cannot fault it at all.

Excellent dinner rounded off with some lovely Turkish tea which come in the traditional tulip shaped glasses.

Without doubt, I can say that I will be back. Five stars! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Mangal 2 restaurant is one of my favourite places to eat in London as well as beyond.
an institution in East London with fantastic cooking, great service and wonderful vibes.
i have been a regular for years and have never not had a terrific time here - a must-visit in my opinion.

We had this on our list as a place to try for a long time. Unfortunately after having authentic Turkish food in the area over the years, this place paled in comparison. I had hoped for a very tasty elevated Turkish experience. Instead it was overpriced, good but not great food with hints of its Turkish roots.

The lamb ribs were the star. While there were only 3 for £18.50, they were very tasty with the sauce and grilled perfectly. The chicken main (“whole poussin”) was pretty good too. Very hot off the grill when served. However, the lamb neck over (I think) creamed barley was not great at all. The meat was shredded and quite rich which was made it very heavy because it just room temperature at best and not seasoned well. The barley risotto was literally cold. We could barely finish the dish.

The hummus was just okay. Tasted like too much tahini was in it, and not balanced. It was £9.5 then you had to pay at least £3 to get any bread (pide) with it! And the pide was tiny. So I guess if you’re on a budget you’re meant to have a hummus starter and eat it with a fork or a spoon. We ordered 2 pides to have the hummus (one special cull yaw fat one for £5) and a regular one. So almost £20 on hummus alone!

However, I will the service was really good. And the restaurant itself it well appointed and bright.

Overall almost £100 for a decent to okay meal. My suggestion is try a traditional Turkish mangal that are nearby. Much better food, more of it and almost half the price.

Wa wa wee wa - been on the list for a long time, wish we’d gone sooner. Everything was 10/10 - we did the set menu and everything was absolutely delicious. So well thought out and brilliant, things like fermented olives with the fish and the smoked grapes with the lamb ribs just elevate everything. Will definitely come back.

We did the tasting menu. Most dishes were great except for the hummus which had a super strong acidic taste to it which made it unpalatable. It was also fairly difficult to eat the leaves themselves of the vine leaf sarma although tasty filling inside. The best dishes we had were the cull yaw kofte, courgette müever, stone bass and the star of the show the halka tatlısı with mountain tea custard + candied mulberries for dessert.

We went to Behind for a special occasion, and honestly, it delivered exactly what I hoped it would, and then some. It’s Michelin starred, but it doesn’t feel stiff or intimidating, which I really appreciated.

The fish focused tasting menu was genuinely spectacular. Every course felt thoughtful and confident, clean flavours, beautifully cooked, nothing trying too hard to show off. You can tell this is a kitchen that knows exactly what it’s doing. It’s absolutely worthy of its star, no question. Credit where it’s due to Chef Andy Beynon, the cooking here feels calm, assured, and very intentional.

I really liked the open kitchen setup. There’s a nice energy in the room, you can see the team working, but it never feels chaotic or distracting. It actually adds to the experience and makes the whole place feel more alive.

We did the wine pairing and I’m glad we did. The selections were spot on, and the sommelier explained each wine in a way that was clear and engaging without being pretentious or overbearing. It flowed naturally with the meal and elevated the whole experience.

Overall, this is a great spot for a date or an anniversary. Refined but relaxed, special without being stuffy. One of those meals you leave feeling quietly impressed rather than overwhelmed, and that, to me, is exactly what a great restaurant should do.

This place is a complete gem. Delicious, creative, and inspiring menu (loved the “prawn toast”, but every dish was incredible! Exquisite service (every dish is presented by one of the very knowledgeable chefs). It’s super friendly and feels classy but relaxed. The wine pairings were perfect and the ambience is great. Thoroughly recommended if you love seafood and great food! Looking forward to seeing their ongoing success and achievements. A new fave!

The most incredible experience at Behind!!!
Our favourite meal out we’ve ever had!
All the food was delicious, such depth of flavours and beautiful presentation.
The atmosphere was calm yet still lots to see with the chefs cooking away/interacting with all the diners. We felt very welcome!
I would recommend this restaurant over and over again ☺️

We had an unforgettable evening at Behind restaurant. Chef Andy and his incredible team delivered a truly exceptional experience. Every dish was a piece of art with a very unique taste. the unique one-table, open kitchen concept was great too.

Came here for solo birthday lunch and it exceeded my high expectations ✨ The food, service and atmosphere were all great. Each dish is served and explained by the chefs and prepared in front of you. The wine paring perfectly complimented each dish. 10/10 would recommend to anyone who loves fish/seafood

name: Stone Cave
address: 111 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text:
Stone Cave Restaurant exceeded our expectations in every possible way. From the moment you walk in, you’re struck by the amazing atmosphere—colorful, exotic lamps hanging from the ceiling create a warm, almost magical ambiance that immediately makes you feel comfortable.
The staff is exceptionally friendly, attentive, and courteous without ever being intrusive. Service was also impressively fast; the food arrived very quickly without compromising quality.
The food was simply outstanding—the best we’ve had in a very long time. The quality of the meat is excellent: incredibly tender, perfectly cooked, and mildly seasoned, allowing all the different flavors to truly stand out. Every bite was balanced and full of taste. Portion sizes are impressively generous, and everything was cooked exactly to perfection.
We also tried the non-alcoholic cocktails, which were among the best we’ve had compared to many other bars—fresh, creative, and full of flavor. To top it all off, we were pleasantly surprised with a complimentary Turkish tea at the end, a small but thoughtful gesture that perfectly rounded off the experience.
Overall, Stone Cave is an absolute gem and a must-visit for anyone who appreciates outstanding food, great service, and a unique atmosphere. We will definitely be back.

lovely experience here! The food came promptly, the service was so good that as soon as we finished a plate, they cleared it up. We particularly enjoyed the chicken pasta with chillies, such a good balance of taste. The brownies were warm, soft and nice with the soft scoop. Complimentary Turkish tea to pair it with too. Definitely recommend. Interior very unique and song choice too!

This is such a lovely cafe so reasonably priced too,  including a free tea with your breakfast which is non existent these days. Decor is fun and makes you feel like your somewhere else would definitely recommend it's a hidden gem, lots of insta photo opportunities inside too. Staff are so lovely and welcoming which always makes a visit worthwhile 😍

This place is exceptional. Super friendly, polite staff, excellent food. I had the cave breakfast and we shared a side of sautéed mushrooms and spicy potatoes. Ambience nice too. The waiter Tolga was lovely and very efficient - checking in on us.

Love the food here. The atmosphere is nice and quite quiet but its only because everytime I've eaten here there aren't many people around. The staff are attentive and fantastic at recommending dishes to try. Location is good not far from Dalston Kingsland Overground station.

name: Aziziye Restaurant
address: 117-119 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BU, UK

reviews.text:
We visited this restaurant today and ordered the lamb beyti, lahmachun, and a portion of baklava. The lahmachun was nice and the lamb beyti, though quite expensive and not the biggest portion, was delicious, with a lovely pepper sauce that sets it apart from any other lamb beyti I have tasted. The service was also excellent, providing us with extra yoghurt when requested.

However, the baklava was poor. In the portion were 4 very small pieces that were dry and had a bitter taste at the end. I have honestly had better baklava from my local newsagents, and to top this off, it costed us £6.50. In other HMC Turkish restaurants (Hilal, Sultan) they give similar small pieces for free. This was a disappointing end to the meal.

Food was absolutely amazing! I got the jumbo platter and lahmacun, and the only disappointment was at myself and my family for not being able to finish the food in one seating LOL (was given containers to take away).

Yilmaz was an amazing host and tended to our every need with utmost care. He gave us complimentary Turkish tea and baklava which was made in-house and not one of of those overly sweet ones that come in a confectionary box.

10/10 service!

Brilliant upstairs atmosphere with loads of cooking happening with the guys! Yilmas our server was so attentive and keep the vibe going. We had the sharing platter, potentially 2-3 people and finished with the classic baklava 😍 which was soo good! Probably one of the best sweet treats on the dalston stokey mile!
The food and atmosphere were fantastic! Yilmaz took great care of us, providing excellent service along with complimentary dessert and Turkish tea. I’d highly recommend visiting this place.

There is simply not enough words to describe my feelings for this place. The food is delicious every time I come here, the service is very polite and timed well, as well as hospitality. The atmosphere is an unbelievable experience for me, the authentic tables, private seating areas are brilliant for anyone who comes here as a couple or a busy family.

Definitely would be on the top of the list of places I would advise for people to enjoy their meals.

❤️I am incredibly excited and happy because the restaurant has been taken over by someone who has managed a chain of restaurants of all sizes in the UK! I order online every night and usually eat at the restaurant every Sunday. All new menu and new flavors! Perfect! ❤️ The food is 10/10, 100% authentic Vietnamese flavor, the customer service is excellent, friendly, enthusiastic, attentive, and especially clean and tidy!! I highly recommend you come and experience it! 5 stars for quality ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🙏

The absolute best bone broth in London.

I always get the Vegetable & Tofu with meat broth.

The noodle re glossy and perfect, not as sticky and starchy as other places, lighter.

Always the MOST veg compared to others.

A sweet delicate nutritious broth.

They were kind enough to give me a free dessert today because an I’m a regular. The sweetest family. Wonderful service and energy.

Best Vietnamese in Hackney BY FAR ✨✨✨

THANK YOU I LOVE YOU 🫶🏼

I used to come to eat in this restaurant very often a few years back. Since the manager has changed the price has gone up and the food quality has gone down.  I've just ordered a vegetarian tofu soup and the tofu  tastes like it's gone off, so I'm left to picking it out of the bowl. I've tried to call the restaurant but it sounds like the number isn't active anymore.  This is why I'm writing a review.  I would have preferred to talk to someone and explain the situation and stop them serving out of date tofu to other customers. I think this will be my last time I go to this  restaurant

So yummyy. We've been craving Vietnamese food as the weather got so cold. Nothing beats a hot steaming bowl of Pho pair with a strong Vietnamese coffee on the side. We took Takeaway home as well and its still tasted so delicious. Highly recommend if you're in Hackney!

I was really impressed with the mixed starter, it had great variety and was delicious. The half duck however was incredibly dry and we had to keep asking for more sauce. No prawn crackers was disappointing too.

Service was great and so was the atmosphere.

name: Alanya turkish
address: 510A Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5ES, UK

reviews.text: A great place in Tower Hamlets Roman Road if you looking for Turkish food or a place to eat or break fast with friends. We booked a table for 6 people for Iftar. Manager confirmed he would check on our booking a few days before which they did. Asked if we wanted individual platters of a large platter to share. We went for 2 large sharing platters. On arrival staff were very welcoming. We were shown to our table and all tables were booked which is a good sign. Water and dates in containers were ready to break fast. Bread, salad and sauces arrived afterwards and our main platter. We told waiter to leave in kitchen until after prayers. We broke fast and had some bread and salad and went to the local mosque across the road to pray. Salad and bread were fresh tasty and nice sauces. When we returned the salad and bread were top up. Drinks order was taken and the platters arrived. The platter food tasted great, good spices and cooked to perfection. Meat on chicken wings, chops and ribs just came off the bone tender and tasty. Staff always came and checked up on us. They even allowed an extra chair to fit a late comer unannounced to the table. Everyone in our group of 6 completed the food, service, atmosphere and decor. A beautiful restaurant with great interior design, good ambiance and mood lighting in restaurant. Even though the restaurant wasn’t serving tea the staff young man by the name of Sulli went and made us normal tea on the house which was very lovely from him and the manager. The price was fair for what we got and eat and everyone left happy at the end of the evening. Will visit again with family and recommend to friends and family.

The food in this place was absolutely delicious. I love Turkish food and this restaurant did not disappoint. Food was filling too.  Customer Service honestly was 10/10. I love the fact they had nasheeds on instead of music. The only reason for not hitting that 5 star rating for me was because there were no desserts or Turkish tea on offer which I think make any meal the perfect finish to any Turkish cuisine.
I’m hopeful they will put it on their menu soon InshaAllah.

We decided to try Alanya Turkish Fusion and didn’t realise we needed a reservation, but the owners were incredibly accommodating and found us a table right away. The place was fairly busy, which was a good sign!

There were five of us, and we ordered a platter for four, a couple of lahmacuns, and some chips. They brought out complimentary bread and salad — honestly, that could have been a meal on its own. Both were absolutely delicious!

The lahmacun was nice, and when the main platter arrived, they actually split it into two because it was so big. The lamb chops and ribs were the standouts — perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The wings could have used a bit more char for that smoky touch, and the Adana kebab had a bit more of a “fusion” spice twist than expected, but still enjoyable.

We noticed afterward that there wasn’t any doner on the platter, but perhaps that’s just not something they include. Portions were generous — we had plenty to take home!

The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the owners and staff were genuinely hospitable. Overall, a really lovely experience. Would definitely recommend Alanya Turkish Fusion to anyone looking to enjoy great food and friendly service.

Visited Alanya during Ramadan for iftar to break my fast. The restaurant was very packed and busy, and the tables were very close to each other, which made it a little uncomfortable.
The food was okay, nothing particularly impressive like I had expected based on what I had seen online. We received the bread first, but it arrived cold. The Ramadan platter, which we had ordered beforehand via phone, arrived lukewarm.
The salad was nice, and we were given a bottle of water and dates to break our fast with, which was appreciated. For dessert, we were served milk cake, but it was a shame we didn’t get to choose the flavour.
Personally, I would stick to going to a more traditional Turkish restaurant, as this fusion place wasn’t really for me. The high rating I’m giving is mainly because of the service, the staff members were very nice, accommodating, and understanding, especially considering they were fasting too.

Went with my colleagues it was flavoursome and loved the Asian fusion - staff were friendly - was a bit small with space yet understandable as we went during the Iftar rush - I tried the Hazelnut Milkcake was yummy - not a caramel fan but my colleagues liked that option the best along with Oreo and the biscoff option

We had a really nice meal here. I ordered the wings with rice and my partner had the mixed chicken shish and doner with rice. Both dishes were very tasty and cooked really well. The bread was very soft and had a lovely flavour. The salad and condiments were fresh and complemented the meal nicely. Overall, everything tasted great and we really enjoyed our visit. Would definitely come back again.

Top two and it’s not two ~ Hands down the best Turkish restaurant in Hackney!

Fresh quality food and staff who clearly take pride in the place. It’s me and my partner’s go to spot, we love the mixed shish platter.

( the toilets are always spotless too which says a lot about a restaurant)

A local gem for sure
This was the best Turkish food I’ve had in london! We had a sharing platter and added the lamb chops. Juicy, fresh, delicious. Will definitely come again ✨

Nothing special but good enough to come back. We wanted a Turkish dinner and went to this one next to us. Food was well prepared and fresh. They were preparing loads of online orders so that’s a good sign. Got a complimentary hummus and pita bread. Halloumi was pretty cool as well as the salad and the chicken. Turkish pizza was really good as well.

Price was good, around £20 each of us.

Atmosphere was pretty good and service was great.

I love coming here and will keep coming back - both for eating in and take-out. It's such a lovely energy in there, maybe a family run grill? The vegetarian Sebzeli Kebab is amazing, and very generous portions with lots of sides included

name: Flat Earth Pizzas - Restaurant Bethnal Green
address: 288 Cambridge Heath Rd, Cambridge Heath, London E2 9DA, UK

reviews.text:
I've avoided going here despite passing by frequently and the 4.8 rating on Google because it's vegetarian/vegan but looks like I've been missing out!
The 2 pizzas that we got were fantastic. The burrata pizza was really nice and creamy and the KFM Korean-style oyster mushroom pizza had amazing flavours never before experienced on a pizza!
Would definitely come here again in the future when I'm in the neighbourhood.
Also came around 1900 on a Saturday and just walked in without a reservation.

We visited Flat Earth Pizzeria because we were really drawn to the sustainable concept and the great reviews. We were especially impressed by how many vegan options were available.

My vegan pizza was outstanding. Possibly the best vegan pizza I have ever had in a restaurant. Whatever the vegan mozzarella was made of, it was absolutely amazing. Truly unbelievably delicious. 🍕 🍕 🍕

My partner’s non vegan pizza was also incredibly tasty. We would definitely come back if we visit London again. Simply fantastic. Keep up the great work.

Great desserts especially their autumnal apple and rhubarb crumble paired perfectly with their fab coffees. Also, they're in the top 10 sustainable businesses in London, as well as best pizzas list in London - Rich is a pro!!!

Coupled with lovely warm hospitality from Sarah, Rich and Annabel @flatearthpizzas . 💚🤗

Sustainable businesses | Autumnal desserts | Best pizzas in London

#FlatEarthPizza #bethnalgreen

Me and a friend popped here randomly after a visit to the Viktor Wynd museum and we did not regret it.

We shared a mushroom garlic pizza because it was huge. The quality of dough was so good and had a nice bit to it. I liked that the pizza base didn't get all mushy and hard to eat when it's all sloppy (FYI, I eat pizza with my hands so I need to be able to hold it properly🌝). We also didn't feel heavy or gross after eating it which I normally do with pizza. We were so hungry we forgot to take pics of the pizza and salad.

The cesar gem lettuce salad was so simple and tasty. There was toasted croutons on top which added texture and gave it more crunch.

And OMG the apple crumble with vanilla once cream was a dream - I could have eaten another portion if I didn't have to wake up early for gym & work 😭

The atmosphere was super chilled and relaxing. It wasn't too busy (which was nice because it wasn't loud) but we did go on a Tuesday evening. The staff were really welcoming and lovely hosts too so thank you❤️ I will be back again!

We ordered the Kimchi and KFM. The dough is really good. The toppings are definitely unusual and interesting, however they didn’t live up to the more traditional flavors. Still, I think I would have it again.

The food was delicious! We tried the lemongrass & coconut cream curry and the slow-braised claypot which both had their own unique flavours. The iced Vietnamese coffee was also a highlight - we had to order it twice. Highly recommend visiting this restaurant

Amazing food. Their salad collection is amazing- full of flavour and unique Asian flavours! Do also try their pancakes which are out of thos world! Service was fast and toilets were very clean.
They also serve freshly squeezed juices.
Highly recommended.

Really good Bún thịt nướng and extra char on the pork belly
Quiet around 6pm on a Tuesday and went for a a solo dinner - good ambiance and environment

Another nice meal. Thank you.

I like this spot. Always good food but do know that sometimes if it says “grilled” fish it was pan fried. But the food is always nice

Delicious Vietnamese food! Lots of vegan items on the menu (main menu and lunch menu), as well as most things being gluten-free (they use NGF to indicate where things are not gluten-free). Salt and pepper crispy tofu, and tofu sizzling lemongrass dishes were particularly phenomenal

We attended Yori Sushi once again for a birthday iftaar.
Munni assisted us with so much care and made sure that our food was ready on time for iftaar. She is a star 🌟

My favourite is the dragon roll. So delicious and full of flavour and is a must try dish here. We also love the rice dishes.
Portions are very good and filling using the finest and freshest of ingredients.

Once again the food was absolutely delicious, every dish we ordered was received with professionalism and care decorated beautifully.

The ambience is always so nice and peaceful.

I would highly recommend this place if you are after delicious food and excellent service.

Munni was very kind and took lovely pictures creating beautiful memories for us.

Looking forward to visiting this gem of a place again soon InshaAllah

Thank you ❤️

Perfect. I’m very picky with food I eat but this place actually so good I wanted to try everything and it was great I got so full though. But definitely recommend. The staff aswell very nice, very welcoming and you’ll never know what you get at the end of it.

Really cute restaurant, lovely service, but the food was ... spectacular.

We loved the dragon roll the most. The bao buns were also perfection. The food came quickly and presented beautifully. I noticed several local customers coming in to order takeaway. My new favorite sushi place in hackney and I'll definitely be back and ordering again soon.

such a good sushi spot! i had a wonderful experience here. munni was so kind and attentive, and made us feel so welcome. the food was amazing, the dragon roll was fresh and flavorful, and the pad Thai was just as delicious. great service and great food, definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to!
Great service great food, big thank you too affa helping me pick out a meal, first time trying it hoping to be back soon to try another dish.

name: CheMen Cafe & Restaurant
address: 85 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8AA, UK

reviews.text: I love this restaurant! Everything from the people to the special coffees and fresh food. The menu has a great range of breakfast, brunch and lunch or dinner items, all reasonably priced and with very fresh, colorful veggies. Every time I have gone, I'm greeted warmly and have had wonderful service. I love to sit outside because it feels like an oasis with the plant boxes and lights. This is truly a gem of a place! I look forward to trying the breakfast next time I'm in town. Highly recommend!

Excellent brunch spot. Friendly and efficient service. Plenty of room between tables. We enjoyed our food choices. There is a covered outside space but it was too windy to go out the day we were there!

Was walking pass this restaurant and my gut feeling told me give it a try. Ordered the full English breakfast. Didnt not have to wait long, 8 minutes tops. The staff were very welcoming.
Breakfast was cooked just the way I liked it especially the eggs over easy. There were 2 sausages which were split in half so looks like 4. Not bad for £10 with any hot drink. Would I come again? Absolutely yes.

Just had a week-day lunch and it was perfect. The hardest was to choose amongst the extensive menu! The food was delicious, very generous portion, super fresh and flavoursome. Friendly welcome, beautiful surroundings, can’t fault!

Delicious burger and very attentive service.
Beautiful, spacious restaurant to unwind.
We hung out in here for 4 hours, was offered Turkish tea and water refills multiple times(with ice too). Thankyou for the staff that served us.

Affordable cost for an all-round great experience. Rare to find! Looking forward to come back:)

name: Chef Restaurant
address: 273 Kingsland Rd, Whitmore Estate, London E2 8AS, UK

reviews.text:
Excellent Turkish cuisine, don’t let the understated looking exterior put you off.

The food is delicious and generous in portion. I had the mixed grill. All of it was cooked to perfection (not overcooked) and delicious.

Great value relative to portion size. Service was fast & efficient.

We had Mediterranean breakfast and it was very delicious. Highly recommend.
I then have their homemade baklava (mum made the night before) was absolute delight.
Would love to go there again when around.

This has been the second time I went to the Chef Restaurant.

My TLDR rating is: Really tasty kebab, great salad and amazing bread with fair prices and a friendly atmosphere.

Now to get a bit more in depth:

I ordered the kebab plate (large) for 12£ as well as the Sucuk from the hot starters menu for 6£.

What you get with what is marked on the pictures.

The Meat on the Kebab plate is awesome. Perfectly seasoned, crispy but not dry at all. The salad is fresh, the blue cabbage was really crunchy and fresh. Everything on the salad plate was lightly seasoned. With the kebab plate I was asked what kind of sauces I want. I can definitely recommend the homemade garlic sauce! Only nitpick with the kebab plate is, that the fries were not or only really lightly salted. Not a big deal as I just grabbed a salt shaker and salted them myself to my liking. I’d say the value for the kebab plate is great. Definitely not holding back on the meat which I really appreciate.

Regarding the Sucuk, you get really nice grilled Sucuk with the star of the show here being the homemade flatbread they have. Which is the most tasty thing. Although the value is not half as good as the kebab plate, the bread you get with the Sucuk is definitely is worth it!

All in all I’d recommend and also would come again!

I thought this place was a cafe but they had a whole selection of Mediterranean meals and all tastes so good. They were very accommodating. The meals a very good portion and reasonable price. It’s a hidden gem. However, the bathroom could do more cleaning and some heating on. Nevertheless I would definitely go again.

Went for dinner on my friend's recommendation, so glad we came here, we ordered the chicken wings, the best I've had in London, it also comes with salad and meze, all were delicious. I also had the baklava and rice pudding with Turkish tea, they were so fresh and delicious. On top of that price is reasonable and the staff are so welcoming. I would definitely recommend this hidden gem and as a neighbour I will be coming here regularly.

Food was good but service below par on this occasion. Took a long time waiting for the bill and then had to go up and ask to pay. If someone tells you the service wasn’t good you should also offer to take the service charge off the bill.

This is my favorite Vietnamese restaurant. The food here was amazing, very cheap price compared to other Vietnamese restaurants I used to eat. The handsome waiter explained how to eat them properly really well to me. Especially beef pho and Hue beef noodle soup here are really excellent compared to Green Papaya restaurant. I will definitely come back in the future. A great experience.

We had a quick dinner on a Tuesday before going to a gig in the nearby Moth club. It was quite, only a few customers . The atmosphere was somewhat unremarkable, with a generic interior that lacked character, but the dining experience was still pleasant, and the food was delicious. We tried the pork skewers with satay sauce , the prawn spring rolls, and the special noodles. The skewers took 10 minutes to arrive, but they were cooked to perfection. The spring rolls were bursting with flavour, filled with succulent prawns and fresh vegetables. These two dishes overshadowed the noodles, which didn't seem as flavorful. Generally, Hanoi pho was a pleasant surprise.  I will definitely revisit and get some more of their skewers.  The service was excellent, attentive, and polite throughout.

This is my new favourite place for Vietnamese in London!!! No frills, lovely service and absolutely delicious, authentic food.  The beef stew was gelatinous, hearty and super aromatic.  The pork & spring roll bun was the best I’ve had, with lots of herbs snd pickled veg.

I usually hate writing reviews…but this place really deserves it.  I’ve been to
SO many more average Vietnamese in the area who have much higher ratings.  Come here - it really is the best!!!

We’ll be back very soon!

Thank you 🙏

Best affordable and authentic Vietnamese food. A bowl of pho is only roughly £10 which is v cheap for what you get. Great service with v charismatic waiter! I come here regularly and would say it's the best food compared to its competitors on mare street. Fyi, the pho has more Northern tastes (less sweet than Southern).

name: EartH Kitchen
address: 13 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BH, UK

reviews.text: A big and nice place with good vibe for food and drinks in Dalston. We had roast chicken and salad, it tastes exactly what you expected. Salad is fresh.

I've had two Fantastic meals at EartH. We visited with a group of six and the dishes were so delicious we had to share, I must have tasted half the menu and everything was cooked perfectly. I especially recommend the Jerk Ox heart. I've already been back for dinner for two with my partner and it did not disappoint.
I really like the atmosphere the place always feels buzzing and the music is excellent. The staff are super friendly and we will definitely be back soon.

Great place for casual hangouts with friends if you find yourself in Hackney - spacious and filled with natural light. Good vegetarian food with decent portion sizes for their brunch menu. Just wished that they also served the desserts alongside their brunch menu on the weekends!

The restaurant part is on the upper level, the event space / cafe space on the lower level, but note that the whole venue is on the 1st floor.

The food was OK but nothing really special the issue is that, as a relaxing place for dinner, THE MUSIC IS WAY TOO LOUD. There were 6 of us at our table but we could only really converse in twos without SHOUTING across the table. Honestly, if you want to have a nice dinner with friends (as we did) go somewhere else because for £50 per head (which we paid) you can do better than this

Great place, but average food. Price for food is not very good.. £14 to have chicken with lentils.
Staff were very friendly!
Definitely would come back for a coffee or some beers! But for not having dinner again...

long-time customer of this underrated restaurant, staff’s very friendly and always serves fresh hot food. i personally love their kofte and garlic sauce

(we got lamb kofte this time, will try ribs next time)

location’s very convenient, right in the heart of hackney central

Long term customer here, multiple years with weekly visits.

Recently brought in the gourmet burger.
I've had my fair share of these and this is by far the highest quality I've ever tasted.

My first of many in this takeaway. ❤️

I was greeted by the wonderful bubbly personality that is radhika who kindly ran through the menu for me. After selecting lamb ribs they sectioned off a whole section of their grill and added complementary grilled veg to my order. They topped it off with the beautiful presentation by the chef/artiste that is (tari/leri/laki)

Very friendly with customers. It was my first time here but i've seen it before many times. I recommend going here for many reasons, one to name is their thorough and detailled breakdown of the menu. Additionally, the interior and quality of the food was very well done.

We ate Loaded Döner @ price of £6.99 per person.

Fantastic.

My first time ordering a take away kebab from bbq xpress and gladly surprised !
They have even proper tables inside so it is not just a typical takeaway place.
I also was very surprised with the professionalism of the staff. Super fast and super correct. Not very often one can say that…)
I haven’t tried the ones that are just next to them but to be honest, I don’t think I am going to give them a go!
Meat and vegetables were fresh and tasted superb! I will definitely come back!

name: Soju Korean Restaurant
address: Soju, 282 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9DA, UK

reviews.text: Awesome food, lovely staff, fast service and terrific atmosphere. Place is clean, service is top class. Highly recommended.

Stumbled across this place whilst searching for Korean restaurants for my daughters birthday. We came here lovely small restaurant everyone of the staff were very friendly and this made us feel very welcome. The food portion sizes were very good. My favourite thing that we had were the amazing honey garlic sticky wings. The crunch, size, taste amazing. This was my first time and not my last thank you team for amazing service.

Website states it is open on Sunday. It is not. Wasted 15 minute walk from Bethnal Green. Three of the other tables in flat earth pizza next door were people who had meant to go to soju. Well done guys.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
Fantastic Korean Food & Great Vibes!
Soju Korean Restaurant offers delicious, authentic dishes with bold flavors and generous portions. The staff are friendly, the atmosphere is warm, and the Korean BBQ and soju selection are top-notch. Highly recommend for anyone craving quality Korean cuisine!
Unsure if permanently closed or just has the incorrect hours for a Monday on Google. Walked here at 8:30pm and it had the shutters down even though Google hours stated it was open

Still licking my chops! Delicious food. The Lamb Bhuna was very tasty, albeit spicy. Pilau rice, fluffy and fragrant. Butter naan, a little crispier than I'm used to but tasty nonetheless. The mixed tandoori grill was a sizzling feast of meats and onions. The starter came within 10 minutes, and the main meal about 7 mins after. Very generous portions. The music was loud but set the atmosphere and we didn't have to shout to make ourselves heard. Will definitely return to try other dishes on the menu as we enjoyed every one we ate.

Wow just had an awesome meal at Raos!! The food was tasty & looked appertizijg too. The girl serving was lovely & welcoming. It's a cute little find. The butter chicken with garlic naan was delicious! I'll be back! ;)

Really nice to find somewhere that does decent indo-chinese food. The chicken 65, lamb croquettes and chicken lollipops were all really good. Service was really friendly too - will definitely be returning!
I ate here today with my girlfriend. Excellent value for money. Delicious dishes for a fair price, and a very sweet waitress. I would recommend the piri-piri chicken. We'll definitely be back.

The food here was so damn good and the staff were super attentive and helpful.  Good serving sizes as well.  I came early in the night so the place was empty but I’m sure the atmosphere gets quite fun in here when it fills up.

Went there as a large group for a mates birthday. The food was amazing but the service was slow and some of the dishes took ages to come out. Maybe it was just a busy night! Would go there again one day. Cheers

I came here by chance, feeling absolutely exhausted after a long day... I ordered the Pho soup and jasmine tea – and it was exactly what I needed! The soup was full of flavor, warm and comforting, with lots of fresh herbs and greens – it truly lifted me up 💛 I also had a juicy, fresh orange for a refreshing finish – just perfect.

It's a very cozy place with a super friendly staff – I felt really welcomed and taken care of.
I highly recommend this spot – the food, atmosphere, and service were all amazing. I’ll definitely be coming back! 😊

i sat down at mien tay expecting great food and those expectations were still surpassed. me and my dad came in here starving and i haven't needed to eat for two days - it is very filling, the portion sizes are of incredible value.. you have been warned! the service was..how to say.. Minimal.... by which i mean very straight to the point, you're here for a delicious meal not for small talk with your waiter. had to call staff over rather than them coming to us but we didn't mind. starters were as good as we had heard, my dish (ginger duck + rice) was wonderful, flavourful, and hearty. it seems there is a lot of love going into this cooking.

This is your spot for great authentic Vietnamese food. The food is really amazing and most of the visitors are asian what for me is a great sign. The place isn't the most romantic but if you want to impress with food give this a go.

Real disappointment.

We have been coming here for years and came here to eat on a Sunday.

The Banh Xeo was stale and tasteless - like it had been prepared the day before and filling microwaved.

The other meals (chow mein, curry, and something else unmemorable) were also not great.. bad flavours, not fresh... especially considering how much time it took to have everything served.

Parts of the meal were forgotten and plenty of items were not available. 😕

Service was so so so much worse than anything we'd previously had here... this used to be 5 stars but if I could give 0 this time, I would.

I didn't mind paying the prices previously as the food used to be worth it.. now, it's really not worth the price tag.

It was an okay experience here but I can't say it was good. No problem with the staff or customer service they were all lovely but the food wasn't it. Croquettes tasted really dry and it only made it nearly good with the sauce next to the croquette, however the chicken was really nice. Just dont think the blue cheese dressing was a good fit for the chicken.

I was recommended this spot by a friend and I've just had a wonderful lunch here. The burger is DELICIOUS and I couldn't recommend it enough. They offered me some hot sauce with my meal which I later found out was home made by the owner!  It was amazing! What a touch! Really lovely staff, quick service and very nice vibe. (p.s. they sell the hot sauce in house...I bought two bottles)

I had a coffee on the patio and the staff we had was not very friendly at all. It felt like he was annoyed that we were asking for service. He was inpatient with us when we took a second to respond to what we wanted. He got us to pay right when he brought us the drinks which was totally fine. We asked to each get our own bills and he was visibly annoyed to do so. I got my bill and the total was written and there was a line that added an OPTIONAL service charge. The menu had stated that the tip was discretionary. Given the level of service I decided to give a 10% tip , which I still think is generous given the service I received, instead of the 20% it suggested on the bill given the attitude we got from the waiter. I gave him the money. Then the server came back and forced me to pay the full discretionary tip which I thought was soooo unprofessional and rude. When it said it was optional to pay that amount! I would never return here or recommend anyone to do the same. I also say him sternly telling other people off for moving the patio chairs to be in the sun. The whole situation just put me off. There are plenty of other places around and I would suggest going to any  other cute cafe.

A staple of the community. Market Cafe is one of those places that truly gets everything right. The service is consistently top tier — warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming.

I’m always a little hesitant now that we’re travelling with our four-month-old baba into social settings. Not all London restaurants are accommodating when it comes to little ones, but these guys get it right every single time. The demographic of the cafe is a testament to that.

People meeting parents. People on dates. People with babies. Girls’ lunches that have started with their first Prosecco. It’s all here at Market Cafe. They cater to the community in a way that feels genuinely unique — and uniquely Hackney.

The menu is varied, the quality of the food is outstanding, and the price point is incredibly reasonable for the area. And if you’re into a boozy brunch, their cocktails are delicious.

The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, making it a true neighbourhood favourite and a key part of Broadway Market and London Fields. Couldn’t recommend it more.

Horrible attitude from staff, this place is everything wrong with what Hackney has become. No sense of community, respect or kindness. So many better places in the area, spend your ££ at other (cheaper) venues w better vibes, better food & no 20% service charge for horrible service lol

Very tasty food. They have an entire vegan menu and were able to customise a vegetarian  dish to make it vegan. Restaurant including toilet was super clean too.
And I love that there’s no fee for BYOB

BEST FOOD IN LONDON THUS FAR! This place is excellent in every way possible. The service was impeccable & food was mindblowing. We might have to stop by for an additional experience before going home to LA. Thank you!

We had a great experience! The samosa chaat was a very generous portion, and the lamb biriyani was the highlight! The atmosphere was beautiful and the service was great, highly recommend! Food was really yummy!

I just have to give a huge shout-out to Tunu, who genuinely gave us the best customer service I’ve ever experienced. From the moment we walked in, he made us feel completely at home — so warm, kind, and sincere.

He went above and beyond in every way: made us tea, gave us chocolates, and even kindly offered us a quiet space to perform our prayers (Salah), which meant so much to us. That level of thoughtfulness and respect is rare and truly appreciated.

On top of that, the food was incredible — the butter chicken and naan were absolutely amazing. Everything about the experience felt special, and a big part of that was thanks to Tunu’s genuine care and hospitality.

We’ll definitely be coming back, and I really hope he gets the recognition he deserves. An absolute gem — big him up! 🌟

A big shout for the staff. So friendly and accommodating. The food was wonderful. Full of flavour, every bite delightfully yummy. We hqd vegan options. No compromise on taste. And ther lime pickel. I want that in a bottle to take home. They accept BYOB too.

name: Pepper & Spice Restaurant London
address: 40 Balls Pond Rd, London N1 4AU, UK

reviews.text:
Went here for lunch The girl that served me was so nice — all the staff are really friendly seems they enjoy working there.

It’s my third time going, and I love it every time. I got their stew and rice, and it was really good — full of that real Jamaican flavour. Feels like a little taste of Jamaica right dessooo.

Prices are good for what you get .

This is really good, proper portions n all.

Probably the best Carribbean place I've been, always a queue (fast moving) and well known locally and beyond. We used to come here from Cally Rd years ago as we knew it would we the best.

A Hackney gem — and one of the best Caribbean restaurants I’ve ever been to
I discovered Peppers and Spice about five or six years ago, and it has never once let me down. Having grown up in South London and lived in Hackney for 15 years, I know good food and this place is something special.
There’s sometimes an unspoken intimidation around certain Caribbean restaurants, but Peppers and Spice has none of that. From the moment you walk in, the warmth is genuine.

The staff are friendly, efficient, and professional with every single customer no favouritism, no cliques. And you can feel it in the atmosphere too; the other customers tend to reflect that same warmth back. Whether that’s an East London thing or simply the tone this place sets, I’m not sure, but it works beautifully.

The food is consistently delicious and always tastes fresh I genuinely don’t know how they maintain that standard, but they do. Portions are generous, the menu is regularly updated and refreshed, and the restaurant itself is immaculate. They redecorated recently and it looks wonderful. This is a place that clearly takes pride in every detail.

This morning I treated myself I went in intending to get saltfish and ackee with dumplings, and came out having also tried the steamed fish stew with cabbage, plus some plantain. Everything was outstanding, and the whole lot came to £20. That is exceptional value.

Peppers and Spice is a true treasure of Dalston. Customer service is 100 out of 10. Highest possible recommendation.

Well if you are ever in Dalston in fact even if you are not,  this place is definitely worth a visit. It’s literally one of the best and most authentic Caribbean takeaway you will ever find.

This place used to be on the main road but for whatever reason it moved onto balls pond road just by the junction. I can’t tell you enough how good the food is. It’s one of the few takeaways that you will be standing in the queue in the street on a daily basis alongside every type of race of people who simply just want the food.

On this visit I bought a fried dumpling and fried fish along with three patties. One vegetarian, one salt fish, and one chicken. No words needed on the quality I’ve literally been buying food from these people for over twenty years and it only gets better. The staff are always rushed off their feet never a moment to chat because the customers are endless. On this visit I just stood outside and looked at the verify of people who waited in line for their turn. From a middle aged Caribbean man to a teenager with her mother and then a young English guy alongside a middle aged English guy to a construction worker. Truly amazing to see the appeal. I really recommend this place for the quality of food and the speed of service and most of all the value for money.

A staple for over 20 years. Old enough to review now. Great food and drink. Also pleasant staff. Get a callaloo patty when you're there. As a pescaterian, I always get one or two in addition to my food when I'm there. The food is consistently good.

I come here for lunch and food is always tasty and freshly made.
The portions are fair and filling.
Highlight is the staff is friendly and very generous.
The tables are cleaned after every customer and nice environment, standard chip shop atmosphere, nothing over done or fancy so gave 4/5.

Brought yesterday from Uber Eats place is a joke spent £32 it was a complete rip off got a large mix doner £16 and it was a small and 2 pieces of chicken and chips £7 only gave little chips what the hell seriously why would give me small im a child?! Specially this economy these days everything gone up anyway I will period not very happy i hope u go out of business u clearly don't care about customers only money 🤷🏻‍♂️🤷🏻‍♂️🤷🏻‍♂️🔥🔥🔥💷💷💷💷 P.S. the salad 🥗 was disgusting and it stinks as well only few tomatoes and etc and half eaten pickle looks like serving that to me shame on you.

I used to always go to this place and take my kids to eat. Not sure if it has changed owners. But the portion sizes are smaller than small. When you order large it's actually smaller than small. Not sure what's going on here. But I won't be going back there. When I eat I expect to be full. Not feeling hungry afterwards. And still want to eat . And when I questioned about this upon paying. The guy literally laughed in my face and said everything is standard size. Not sure what he meant by this. But anyway. There's plenty of places to eat in Hackney. So I don't recommend this place at all. Unless your looking for an overpriced snack.

the best and my favourite kebab shop, the kebab is always fresh and very delicious!! 🥰 Huseyin is amazing and he always remembers my order, everybody that works here is very polite, warm and welcoming ❤️ love eating from here and coming here because i always leave very happy 🫶🏽

Britanni is genuinely my favourite kebab spot to go to the kebabs there are top knotch and definitely one of if not the best kebab i have ever had in my life and it is full if flavour especially the peppers that burst with flavour and juices

An outstanding brunch experience!
From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcome with their warm and friendly service. The pancakes were perfectly fresh, the beef burger was bursting with flavour and the coffee was rich and smooth. The Full English Breakfast was cooked to perfection. Every detail was thoughtfully done. Highly recommended!

I was walking in the area for quite a while and wanted somewhere to chill, chat and drink hot chocolate. The staff convinced me that he makes the best hot chocolate in bethnal green and I have to admit, it was good 😊
This place has a mixture of items you can buy from hot drinks, salads and mains.
If you're in the area and want to kick back and relax then come to this wonderful place.

Great cafe-style eatery with a very chill atmosphere.
Route offers a menu with a health-centric POV, including many plant based options.
This restaurant makes for an ideal relaxed bite to eat while catching up with a friend or even to simply have a coffee and pastry.

I come here for my morning tea’s and a croissant (currently working locally). The gentleman behind the counter (I’m assuming who is the owner) is very polite and greets everyone, whether they are a regular or not. On my first visit, a homeless man came and asked if he could get something to eat. To his surprise, the gentleman gave him something to eat out of good will. I’m not saying it’s a service they provide, but it was very nice to see people like that are still around. They treat everyone with the upmost respect.

As we walked passed the cafe, the very fresh and interesting looking salads and cakes caught our eyes. We couldn’t resist buying some. We chose 5 different salads and 3 cakes. They were all so tasty.
I was particularly impressed with their beet root and avocado chocolate cake. It was surprisingly moist.

name: Arepa & Co Venezuelan Restaurant - Haggerston
address: 58A De Beauvoir Cres, London N1 5TZ, UK

reviews.text:
Went here for a late lunch and really enjoyed it.
The food was very tasty - we got buñuelos, tequeños and then some of the bowls to share and everything was really good.
Not to mention the tres leches cake, which was delicious.

The service was very friendly and the guy who served us made the experience even better.

Also, the location is very pleasant with the view on the canal.

Highly recommended if you are looking for something different to try.

As we were walkin by the canal, we run into yhis gem. Venezuela's arepas at its very best. We have the Pabellon del campo arepas and Toston Avocado. Absolutely delicious. Coffee quality second to none. Great service. If you want a treat go for it

Delicious little event as well in lunch spot. had the arepa and caca and the two top flavors and the caca definitely easier to handle. you don't have to use your hands and very balanced and has a crisp and also good flavors and the arena is more meaty but both are excellent. would recommend and affordable

The authentic food experience from Venezuela. My kids love the black beens and I enjoyed the diversity in flavours.
Good service
Good music

Yum. Good food, great service. Thanks!

Breakfast reina was spectacular. You certainly won’t leave hungry, I was so full. A bit pricey but you are so full so it’s worth it.

This Turkish restaurant is definitely a good spot to eat, whether dining in or taking away. I’ve eaten here many times and it’s been a hit each and every time. The Kebabs are juicy and perfectly seasoned, and the Chips were a perfect mix of crispy and fluffy.

Most recently I ordered the Adana wrap, I don’t like lamb but Adana’s taste so good and they don’t even taste like lamb. Unfortunately I didn’t get any photos of the food that I’ve eaten here.

Staff were super friendly and welcoming, and the service was quick even for takeaway. I definitely recommend coming here if you want a quick Turkish take away.

Food, service and atmosphere all 5/5. Dropped in on a rainy Saturday afternoon and went for the Nazar Special, a selection of meats (lamb, chicken and doner) served on a bed of rice. It’s more than enough for two people and a complimentary salad was also included. Super tasty and filling, couldn’t recommend enough - £40 for this and some soft drinks.
Lovely family owned restaurant where father and son provided me amazing fresh food chicken shish with rice and salad. Authentic Turkish food , great people and great Turkish Tea.

These guys are absolute legends. We almost eat from there every two days. Their soup, chicken shish, and classic meat on chips are a generous portion full of flavour well cooked. They deliver to us always very quickly and friendly staff. Highly reccomend their food. Love them!!!
Unreal flavours. So clean and fresh. Honestly this place is amazing. You won’t be disappointed.

name: Med Bistro Restaurant
address: 115 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text:
My friend and I have  never been in Dalston and we just happen to come into this restaurant for dinner. Very very polite waiters have greeted us and looked after our comfort throughout the evening. Ok there were some dishes not to my taste, but all the starters are so delicious and freshly made salad. The avocado smoothie not to be missed.
Such nice waiters in here. Don’t ever change 😊

I’ve been coming here since it was the Red Art Cafe and it remains my favourite place on Dalston. The staff are kind, thoughtful and attentive, whilst the generous bread and olive accompaniments with their hearty lentil soup are food for the soul.

Although they offer a lot and could condense the menu into the best items, the service and kindness of staff is amazing and delicious salad selection. It’s nice to have staff that really care about the service and want to make sure the customer is happy and satisfied:)

This place is pricey for the area!
But it's also very welcoming with great food.
Service was fast and friendly and the hummus came with plenty of bread to dip. Our shared mixed grill platter was well prepared and delicious, if a bit mild for my taste.

fantastic gozleme!! we got the spinach and cheese and it was MASSIVE! really good value for money. service staff were so kind too, they gave us a free cake which was also so yummy! looking forward to going back :))

name: Cafe Route - Dalston
address: Gaumont Tower, Dalston Square, London E8 3BQ, UK

reviews.text:
This place specializes in Mediterranean cuisine — refined but not flashy. Every dish is super substantial, made with quality ingredients. After eating, I felt incredibly healthy, like even my skin was glowing!

Plus, they offer a lunch set: a main dish + two kinds of salad as a meal deal, all for just a little over a tenner — feels like a great deal!

This place is honestly so lovely , the food options, the amazing coffee. I loved it all. They also have outdoor seating. All staff are always so kind. Melissa makes me feel so welcomed. Her smile was lovely and she makes my experience 10 times better every time and this is why I will continue to come back. Definitely recommend this cafe!!

Great brunch spot in Dalston — perfect for work, chill, and a surprisingly good peach salad!

Discovered this Cafe Route location in Dalston Square and it quickly became one of my go-to spots for a relaxed brunch or a casual work session. The space is bright and calm, with plenty of tables (some with sockets!) so you’ll often see people working or studying here — great atmosphere for it.

I tried the peach salad for the first time and it was honestly amazing! Super refreshing, with a lovely balance of sweet and tangy, paired with cheese and toasted nuts. It gave off a light Mediterranean vibe and was the perfect summer pick.

Really like the vibeh here, it feels so chill and perfect for a casual hangout with friends. I’d recommend the Parmesan Chicken and the Baked Salmon. The salmon has a sweet chili flavor with great seasoning, and the fish tastes really fresh. The grilled chicken skewers are super tender, juicy, and flavorful.

Absolutely loved this spot! 💛 Perfect for a hot summer day in London — the menu is super refreshing and full of flavour. I tried the Chicken Skewer with Peach (£14) and was pleasantly surprised — the peach starter was actually fresh peach, not a gimmick! Juicy, tangy and paired perfectly with the chicken. Super satisfying.

The Meatball Skewer with Roasted Sweet Potato (£14) was also great — the meatballs were decent, but the roasted sweet potato totally stole the show. Soft, cool and naturally sweet — not your usual fries. I ended up stealing the last few bites from my friend 😆
my first time . Oh my me . incredible Every bite and taste just got better. Def returning, Ill try evening menu next time . This burger goes into No.1 spot

Very good meaty Sunday feast in Hoxton! We had the Mixed Grill Feast* (£30 per person). Serving a huge plate of grilled beef sirloin, lamb leg and pork loin chops - comes with sides of Greek salad, Hummus, Roasted Beetroot Labneh, toasted bread and chips.

The cuts of meat were decent, portion size was huge (especially for the grilled feast). The bread was very good! Service was good. Great taste, decently priced and very worth it. Would definitely come back for the grill feast, and would highly recommend!

*Unlimited Brunch Feast until 6PM (Saturday and Sunday)

Impromptu pop in for a Sunday evening meal, and we immensely enjoyed our shared our palatable prawn savoury starter,  my magnificent medium steak with skin on chips, delectable carrots and my wife's delicious fall off the bone duck on a luscious lentil base.
More food than I could handle so I got to takeaway to enjoy 2moro. It had more flavour than any other restaurant on Hoxton street.

It is all duty to drop in and enjoy the engaging conversation, serene service and delectable infusions of this 20 plus years Hoxton favourite.

We went as a group of 5 on a Saturday afternoon that lasted until the evening. Nobody left hungry or disappointed!

The food is generous, unfussy & tasty, the service is gentle & unhurried, and it’s a lovely place to catch up with friends.

We all loved it & I wish this was my local!

What an absolute delight of a meal! Our visit to Hoxton for the Mixed Grill Feast at £30 per person was an incredible experience. The substantial platter boasted grilled beef sirloin, lamb leg, and pork loin chops, accompanied by Greek salad, Hummus, Roasted Beetroot Labneh, toasted bread, and baked potatoes, evoking a sense of home.

The experience was truly worth it. I'm keen on returning for the grill feast and would enthusiastically recommend it. The staff's warmth and friendliness added to the enjoyment. And remember, don't overlook the Unlimited Brunch Feast available until 6 PM on Saturdays and Sundays!

The Pho was absolutely amazing!! 😍🍜

I brought a friend to Song Que Cafe as he was preparing for a trip to Vietnam and wanted a taste of the cuisine beforehand, and this spot definitely delivered.

We ordered a great spread: the pho with combo beef (rare steak, flank, tendon, tripe) was easily the highlight, deep, rich broth with beautifully balanced flavours that felt authentic and comforting. The banh xeo (crispy pancake with prawns and chicken) was golden, light, and packed with flavour, pairing well with the fresh herbs and dipping sauce. We also had the mì xao bo (beef stir-fried noodles), which were well-seasoned and satisfying, and the gà nướng (lemongrass chicken), which was juicy, aromatic, and perfectly cooked.

The vibe inside was busy but relaxed, and the service was fast and friendly. Food arrived quickly, and the staff were attentive throughout.

The only slightly awkward part was at the entrance, each time we entered, we were asked where we were going. Not sure if it was for security or just routine, but it felt a bit overbearing, especially when I had to pop out briefly to move the car and was questioned again right after needing to attend a phonecall.

Still, the food speaks for itself. If you're after bold, classic Vietnamese flavours in London, Song Que remains one of the best spots.

Went there early on a Saturday just as they opened and the place filled up quickly. Certainly is a popular place based on its deserved reputation for good quality Vietnamese fare. Portions are generous and food is quite possibly the best of its kind in London. A must-have is the beef pho with all the different cuts (even the tripe). My partner had the spicy bun noodles and it was perfectly spicy and a little sour (just as it should be). Our waiter was friendly and efficient. Chap who initially showed us in wasn’t so…

The food is very good and we didn’t have to wait long. In my personal taste, the Stewed Caramelised Fish was a little salty but everything else was delicious. The iced coffee was also good. The staff were friendly and service was excellent. It’s a place I will definitely come back. I had a great Vietnamese meal today.

This Bun Thit Nuong is such a refreshing bowl of delicate noodles and perfectly grilled pork. The chargrilled pork is very tasty,  tender and savoury… I can say delicious and delicious in every mouthful…I love pickled vegetables and their nuoc cham. Service is super friendly and helpful. This is probably the best Vietnamese on Kingsland..

The service is good. We were sat on the same table as these two ladies who were very loud though which made it hard to enjoy our experience here. Waiters were super nice and food didn’t take too long. Had the pho with chicken and beef - it was lacking in flavour, chicken and meat had no taste also quite dry … even with the addition of sriracha it just felt like a bowl of hot water with noodles; as opposed to a flavourful warm broth . Tried the spring rolls which were crunchy and very tasty, ordered more but the second batch was oilier than expected. Everything on the menu does look tasty, would probably not get the pho again though. Pho - £16
Spring rolls - £8

One of the most exciting menus we’ve seen in a while. @cafe.kowloon has just opened and it’s dishing up a menu of killer, no-filler creative Cantonese dishes.

Inspired by Hong Kong’s dai pai dong vendors, dim sum houses and cocktail bars, this London Fields spot is the newest opening from hospo group 6 of 1, the team behind Mr Bao, Daddy Bao, Good Measure and Master Bao.

From glass noodles tangled around scallops to prawn toast served with crispy heads, plus pickles alongside Alfonso margs, burnt lemon highballs and field-blend chilled reds. It’s fun AF.

We went for the soft launch, and everything was delicious! We really liked the interiors and how they had done up the railway arch. It all felt very HK, reminded me a lot of places like Ho Lee Fook but minimalist.

The wontons and prawn toast were my favourites. The drinks also looked interesting, so would come back for cocktails!

The staff were definitely the highlight though - everyone was so friendly and helpful and it made the whole night feel extra lovely.

Pleasantly surprised. I didn’t have too many expectations going into this, as someone who is of Hong Kong ethnicity and knows the cuisine very well. But Cafe Kowloon brings nostalgia, authenticity and modern day together seamlessly.

Each dish was reminiscent of the original from the first bite with an added contemporary twist. Often times contemporary Cantonese is doused with soy sauce and covered with hoisin, but not here.

The curry fish ball was a clear winner, very nostalgic to Hong Kong, with a bouncy toothsome bite that even the HK aunties and uncles would approve of. Char siu was excellent - tasted like the familiar char siu flavours except made with the most tender pieces of pork. The prawn toast was very generous with ample amount of prawn taste and a very crispy cracker-like, toast base. Definitely the best I’ve ever had. Choy sum was clean, thankfully to cut the rich dishes as often times the vegetable sides are covered with too much sauce.

Value is excellent, cocktail, several starters mains and desserts shared among 3 came to ~£40

Design of the space is also very well thought out, from the outside sign that glows Cafe Kowloon at night and hides during the day to disguise as Wonton Charlie’s is a nice touch. I appreciated the familiar chopsticks, the small bowls and of course the neon glowing sign.

Congrats on the opening! I will be back.

I had a fantastic dinner at Cafe Kowloon earlier this week. From the moment the food arrived, I was impressed. The curry fish balls were bursting with flavour. The scallops with glass noodles in XO sauce were a highlight too, delicate yet rich, and beautifully balanced. And the prawn toast? Honestly the best I’ve ever had, perfectly crisp with a wonderful texture and flavour that really stood out!

I was also really happy with the non-alcoholic drink options too. The pear chrysanthemum soda was refreshing and full of delicate floral notes.

The open kitchen added such a great energy, watching the chefs at work while lovely music played made the whole experience feel special from start to finish. Service was friendly and attentive without ever feeling rushed, and overall this felt like one of the best new restaurants to open in the area.

If you’re into bold Cantonese flavours and a warm, inviting setting, this is a place you shouldn’t miss!

We ordered the cucumber, prawn toast, wontons, typhoon shelter tofu, Buddha’s delight and some jasmine rice. All of the food was good, also the complementary pickles at the beginning are amazing!

Our server was really nice, you can tell they are all new and still getting used to things. But he was never too far away which is good.

The atmosphere was also amazing. So can’t fault it on that!

Lovely Georgian place, with all the traditional delicacies!!
Very tasty food and friendly staff!
The do not sell alcohol, but you can by lovely Georgian wines from across the street!!
Great value for money!!!

My veggie friend & I shared the Khachapuri, the mezze board and aubergine rolls, all of which were delicious!! Especially the cheese bread. We also had the honey cake as a dessert which is a must if you visit. BYOB is also a nice touch.

The team here were also really lovely and accommodating. Looking forward to visit again and trying some of the meat options!

I recommend booking as the restaurant was super busy and they had to turn away several walk ins whilst we were there.

Just to set the scene I came at 9:45pm, 15 minutes late for the last reservation on a gloomy Wednesday evening, the staff were more than kind enough to still serve us; And serve us they did. Me and my boyfriend agreed it was one of the best meals of our lives. From the produce to the skill and love put in to the food, it’s clear this establishment will deliver rain or shine. If you are reading this review and deciding whether you want to go an eat here the answer is yes and everything on the menu

Outstanding and authentic Georgian food. They have all the main dishes like hachapuri, khinkali, lobio, and also some of the more meat-based. The place is small and operates well for walk-ins. Bring your own bottle (BYOB)

Great food.  Good value.  The Haggerston branch is BYO with an off licence across the street that stocks Georgian wine.  There is a corkage charge of £5 per bottle.  Quiet, civilised atmosphere for a BYO on our visit.  Pretty panelled room results in good acoustics.  Upstairs is a small room, with tables close together enough to follow neighbouring conversations.  Booking by telephone recommended because it is very popular.

We started with the rich open cheese boat bread.  Until we watched the slavic speakers at the next table we didn’t realize you are meant to stir the runny egg and melted cheese together before tearing apart the flakey loaf.  The roast aubergine salad with walnuts and pomegranate seeds as well as the chopped mushroom and onion starters were both terrific accompaniments.

We shared one main of the pork and beef dumplings.  Large and and somwhat doughy due to their size.  Tasty, and containing a little broth inside along with the meat but I think I prefer daintier Chinese shiao long bao.  We didn’t finish the dumplings and it was no problem getting a takeaway box as well as instructions for best warming up the leftovers.

We definitely plan to return to try more of the menu.  A light dinner for two was £70.

Lovely food with amazing flavour and generous portion size.

We tried the Beef Pad Kra Prao and Chicken Pad Kee Mao. Both were amazing. Both are quite spicy so be warned.

Food tasted fresh, good portion size and nice presentation. Definitely recommend.

First time trying Tia Food and honestly it did not disappoint Portion size was really generous they did not disappoint. Will be back soon. portion size was really generous they did not disappoint. Will be back soon. We’re both lovely. They were also lovely workers both have positive energy and big smiles on their face. Yo
We had the Goong Tung and it was just delicious !! Unfortunately the portions are too small. Three corns, a little bit of prawns and mussels. Would have loved a little bit more for two.

I visited Pad Thai Cafe at Camden Market and was pleasantly surprised. The place is very clean and inviting, with a cosy atmosphere that makes it perfect for sitting in and enjoying your meal. The food was fresh and full of flavour, clearly made with high-quality ingredients. I tried the Pad Thai, and it was excellent – perfectly cooked noodles, fresh vegetables, and a well-balanced sauce. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Highly recommended for anyone looking for tasty, freshly prepared Thai food in a comfortable setting.

Such amazing food! We ordered the spicy Thai wings, Gai Bai Tuey, Pad Kra Prao and the Chicken Pad Thai. All the dishes were 10/10. My personal favs was the Gai Bai Tuey and the Pad Kra Prao. Will definitely be going back. Also the staff are soo sweet🫶🏼

Quite an underwhelming meal — the pumpkin soup lacked flavour and it was the spice overshadowed the natural subtle, sweet taste of the pumpkin itself.
The Bolognese was so sweet that it was weird. The service and atmosphere was okay, but the meal wasn’t great .

One of the worst meals I had in a very long time at a Hackney price. A carrot chicken soup that was extremely oily flavor less topped with some 1 week old (the minimun) croutons that almost broke my tooth (literally). Impossible to chew. Asked for a long black they brought me a white americano. Brunch finishes at 1 for some reason even though they are serving bacon and eggs and then you are forced to a lunch restaurant type menu. Such a cool location in such a special spot i would rip the whole frizzante apart and make a new cafe there and serve some decent food and coffees. Prices not cheap either. Underwhelming. Felt I had to share. Sorry x

My son and I visited the farm and then stopped over for lunch after an afternoon in the rain.One couldn't imagine this obscure spot in the heart of London. For lunch we had pumpkin soup and for pudding, caramalised apple cake. The business is family run and the staff are friendly, attentive and helped with a phone charger when my battery was running out. It was busy but not so much as to put you off. The restaurant has plenty of character - walls are adorned with used pans as decor, and evocative art. The music complemented the calm atmosphere. We also bought the bread, which one of the members of the staff told us was a family recipe which was  passed down for generations.
The food is decent and it’s next to the Hackney City Farm. They are kids and pets friendly too.
Lovely place next to the Hackney City Farm. Very friendly staff and delicious italian food. I have really enjoyed mushroom and truffle risotto.

Got to have dinner here tonight with a friend.
The food is nice, nothing to write home about, but honestly not bad.
However… the staff was very blasé and uninterested. After waiting for a “while” (much longer than any other restaurant I’ve been to, and I’ve had my large share of dining out), we had to keep calling someone to come and take our orders. After we ordered, tap water came to the table and the waitress giving us the water spilled quite a bit on my leg, didn’t even apologise. It’s not particularly warm anymore (ha), but I didn’t appreciate it either way. After we ate, we kept looking for, again, anyone who’d come to give us the bill and, again, it was a long wait. I don’t know if the staff was eager to just finish work (two young girls) and leave, but it didn’t feel professional.

I have been coming to Hanoi Cafe for years - whenever I am in the area, I choose this place every time!  I love the family and woman who runs the restaurant, she is wonderful! The food is great and the staff are lovely and accommodating.  I feel welcome every time - thank you for all the wonderful food you make and for the warm atmosphere you welcome your customers with, it's like eating at home :)

Do not eat here. It was absolutely terrible and overpriced. First, they didn’t bring me what I ordered, and when the food finally arrived, it was awful. I only had a couple of bites, yet when we got home, we ended up with food poisoning
soooo tasty!! i got the tofu bun bowl and they did not skimp on the tofu (rare). the veg dumplings were also tasty and the pho got good reviews also. would return to try some bahn mi!!
