Banging salad, I always rate a place where staff are nice to walkins before you even order and how good simple dishes are - and on both counts this place gets top marks for me. I was in a mad rush to eat something Light quickly - they made several good suggestions. I settled on the spicy beef salad and it was absolutely delicious so fresh & just the right amount of spice really good size, good amount of beef. Very chill music playing in the background some nice incense burning, I’m definitely going back their menu looks amazing.and they allow dogs 🐶 xx

Just visited Green Papaya — a cosy spot serving incredible dishes packed with flavour.

🍜 Beef Phở — Slow-simmered for 24 hours, rich, aromatic and full of depth. The beef? Tender, juicy, perfection.
• 🥟 Pork & Seafood Spring Roll — Crispy on the outside, packed with flavour inside — a must-order.
• 🌿 BBQ Pork Belly Vermicelli Noodles — Crispy edges with a juicy centre, paired with nuoc cham dressing, fresh herbs, lettuce, cucumber & carrots — chef’s kiss.
• 🦀 Salt & Chilli Soft Shell Crab — Light, crispy, flavourful — addictive 😍
🍗 Salt & Chilli Chicken Wings — The perfect seasoned starter.
• 🥗 Green Papaya Salad — Light, citrusy, refreshing and fragrant with kaffir lime and a touch of honey.
• ☕🍹 Vietnamese Coffee — Sweet, strong, and the perfect way to end the meal.

Super friendly staff, generous portions, great prices.

My friend and I went to this Viennese restaurant in a rainy evening and we really like this place. Good food for example, Pho, especially suitable for friends after work. The atmosphere was great and the staff were friendly. It’s also located not far from overground station. Overall I’d recommend it to anyone who wants to experience authentic Vietnamese food.

We visited this Vietnamese restaurant today with the family and were delighted to see they’ve added barbecue to the menu. The food was excellent—our kids especially enjoyed the beef pho, salt and pepper squid, and the barbecue dishes. The service was outstanding, with staff always attentive and quick to clear the table. It was a truly pleasant dining experience, and we highly recommend everyone give it a try!

Really good value for money, and the portions are bigger than expected. The pho was the standout for me, the broth tasted clean and natural, without that heavy, salty vibe some places have.

I also enjoyed their salt & chilli BBQ dishes. The aubergine and soft-shell crab were full of flavour and great for sharing.

The team there were lovely and made the meal even better.

A real hidden gem in East London! Green Papaya instantly transports you to a cosy Hanoi eatery — warm lights, wooden tables, and the gentle scent of lemongrass in the air. The grilled pork and seafood vermicelli is my favourite — smoky, fresh, and perfectly balanced with fish sauce and herbs. The soft-shell crab is crispy perfection, and the pho tastes clean, comforting, and deeply satisfying. Everything feels homemade and full of heart. Friendly staff, fair prices, and truly delicious food — easily one of my go-to spots in Hackney!

Lovely spot - had brunch here and enjoyed the selections they had. Affordable as well which is a great feature. Smoked salmon was fantastic and got the pistachio cookie, highly recommend. Was busy when we got there around the early afternoon but wasn’t too long of a wait. We did have to sit out in the cold for a bit prior to having seats available inside. More available seating opened up around mid afternoon. Would come back again.

Cute cafe with more space for tables than one would assume standing outside their door! We were served by a really nice lady, everyone greeted us when we entered. We ordered lunch and the portion sizes were absolutely fitting. Good prices as well. Thank you!

Visited for my friends birthday and we were very impressed!
The staff were incredibly attentive and friendly, they even surprised us with a complementary cake.
The food was sooo good (the hash browns!). Everything was cooked perfectly and packed with flavour. The presentation was also beautiful.
We sat outside which created a really nice atmosphere. Overall a fantastic spot for brunch.

The customer service is excellent! Elif was great - kind, helpful and friendly. She explained the menu and made great recommendations on what to eat. I will recommend this cafe to my friends and will be returning. The vegan breakfast is delicious, especially the hash browns. The food came very quickly.
We had the most beautiful breakfast here! We are from Melbourne and this is one of the best coffees we have had!!! The med eggs 10/10 and the staff were so lovely! A must visit

name: Mae + Harvey
address: 414 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5LU, UK

reviews.text:
I had the most wonderful experience at Mae + Harvey. The food was absolutely unbelievable! fresh, flavourful, and beautifully presented. The corn fritters with egg were cooked to perfection, full of texture and flavour, while the pancakes were on another level. They were light, fluffy, and topped with the most delicious berry compote, clotted cream and toasted hazelnuts. Every bite was a treat.

The service was just as impressive as the food. The team were so friendly, warm, and attentive, creating such a welcoming atmosphere that made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

Mae + Harvey is the kind of place that makes you want to linger, enjoy good company, and savour every dish. I’ll definitely be coming back! highly recommend

Such a gem of a place! We got here around 11 on a Saturday and luckily didn't have to wait long to be seated, but this place does get busy and there was a queue outside by the time we left. I can see why though! The menu is small but amazing. I got the garlic eggs with sourdough toast while my husband got the chicken sarnie. Pretty big portions and everything was delicious and tasted fresh. Later in the week on a WFH day we got 2 chicken sarnies to go, if I'm back in the area I'd come back here in a heartbeat!
Great coffee shop! The cappuccino was delicious and the croissant was great. The food looks quite good as well but i did not order any. Nothing over the top but a great cafe with even better service.

Mae + Harvey was one of the places that stayed with me the most during my time in East London.
Even on the morning I left the city, I made a point to return for their chicken sandwich, which had become something of a personal favorite by then.
The food is excellent, but what truly makes this place special is the people.
There’s a quiet, genuine warmth in the way they move through the space kind, energetic, and thoughtfully present.
Being there doesn’t feel like just visiting a café. It feels like stepping into something familiar, something cared for.
It’s the kind of place you hope to come across again someday, and I truly hope I do.

Lovely breakfasts!
You’ve got to try the pancakes – they’re absolutely delicious, the kind you want to come back for again and again. The atmosphere is really charming, with nice people around and a beautifully done interior.
All in all, a solid 10 out of 10.

Narrow Kitchen is a wonderful café. The food was amazing, original plants adds such a fresh and unique touch. The avocado toast was absolutely delicious, and the Chilli Labneh was equally fantastic, full of flavor. The service was also excellent: friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Highly recommended!

My suggestion? Run, don’t walk to it. Seriously the best sandwich in London. The focaccia sandwiches?!?! Are you kidding me?!?! They are so delicious. We had the Milano and the Hot Napoli, and I am still thinking of them.
Don’t sleep on the banana bread with maple butter. It is hidden in the menu, but it is 100% worth it.
The coffees were great, we had a mocha and a latte and they were brilliant.
Lastly, the team were lovely, and the vibe was great.
Planning a return visit soon!

One of the best and freshest breakfasts I’ve had in London! The Chili Labneh Eggs were absolutely amazing. They were so flavorful and the homemade focaccia that comes with was fluffy and perfectly toasted. 10/10 would recommend and I will definitely be coming back when I’m in town!

I forgot to take a photo of my n’duja and eggs because it was so good I couldn’t restrain myself but my girlfriend remembered because she’s the brain of the operation. Absolutely cracking plate, perfectly balanced flavours and what a calm and friendly environment they’ve fostered. Compliments to the chef!
Y’all. Drop everything and come here for brunch. This is hands down the best chili labneh eggs I have ever had. Wonderful service, chill vibes. I’m coming back!
The LAMB BIRIYANI is top drawer and the peri peri fries are an incredible accompaniment. 10/10 recommend
The food was delicious, all freshly prepared, and the service was excellent！They even kindly lent me a charger when my phone ran out of battery! I'll definitely be coming back here again.

I recently had the pleasure of visiting Lime Cafe & Restaurant (T.W.), and I must say, it was a fantastic experience! The menu offers an impressive range of dishes to satisfy any craving, from hearty mains to delicious sides. I decided to try their pizza, taking advantage of their "Buy One, Get One" offer, and it did not disappoint. The pizzas were freshly made, with a perfect balance of flavors and a crispy crust that was simply irresistible. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. If you're looking for a great place with diverse food options, I highly recommend Lime Cafe & Restaurant for a satisfying meal!

I don't know who gives this place high ratings. Long wait times, even if you're the only customer, incorrect orders, and terrible food. We gave this place a chance four times, but this was the last time.
The food is really nice and good value for money.  The lunch I bought would be okay for two people to share comfortably. The staff is pleasant.

We loved 'Mess Cafe', just the place we were seeking for breakfast during our visit to Hackney.  We all agreed that the breakfasts were delicious, generous, well cooked & presented with excellent service & fairly priced. The staff were friendly & efficient. A nice atmosphere & lovely interior, a well deserved 10/10. We'll definately return.

(A caveat, 'Mess Cafe' serves Halal options & I need to make clear as a warning to others but there's plenty of options to avoid it!)

I've been coming to Mess Café for years and it has been consistently good quality. It gets very busy so you may be expected to share a table. The staff do their best to fit all customers in if they're able to. There are imitations in the area but none come close to Mess Café!

Food served quickly, and it was hot and delicious. Pancakes were especially tasty, I could tell they were freshly made. My husband's burger looked and smelt delicious. Perfect lunch on a chilly Autumn day!

Lovely, friendly staff, I ordered a halal breakfast the turkey bacon was lovely as well as everything else.

Portion size was very generous, warm, welcoming and friendly atmosphere.

Shared tables encourage people to talk to each other somewhat which I found quite nice.

A friend recommended Mess Cafe to me, and I can say with certainty that our friendship has been elevated as a result. There is not a single aspect of this establishment I could criticise. The interior is intimate and elegantly cosy, the staff are unfailingly attentive and gracious, and the food is of such quality that it feels almost transportive. The menu is so enticing that we spent a considerable amount of time simply debating our choices, as every dish appeared worthy of selection. With only around twenty five tables in total, advance booking is highly advisable. I fully intend to return and explore more of what this exceptional kitchen has to offer.

Great great restaurant!

The food was top tier and the prices were so good for how much we had! So many options which meant we both were able to order exactly what we wanted eventhough we wanted different food options!

The staff members were nice and helpful and we enjoyed our time there.

Scrambled eggs were fantastic, they were cooked well and not dry. I added some hash brown, and it was just right!

Staff were friendly.

Lovely place but the food is not good. Asked for a plain porridge, looked amazing but the oats were raw still. My mom asked for a veggie brekkie and the poached egg was fully cooked. Coffee tasted burnt.

We had coffee and lunch. The coffee was average, the lunch was really good the shakshuka was great and the crepes and avocado smash as well. The service was friendly and fast, no complaints. Could do a bit better with the coffee to go one level up.
Amazing experience in this cute little café! The barista Kat was the best, she made me the most delicious chai latte. It's a really cozy bar to chill with your friends:)
Lovely food and kind servers! Great costumer service. Busy, but it was peak time and manage to find a table without waiting. Tables inside a bit to close but I didn’t mind.

name: Look Left by YUGU | Cafe & Wine bar

reviews.text:
I think this is the first place I’ve been to with such a wide range of matcha options.
The new egg mayo is my current favourite!
The interior is beautiful, and you can also enjoy wine and small dishes in the evening, which I highly recommend.

Oh and the oden bar🍢 every Thursday night… honestly, I don’t know whose idea it was, but it’s so hard to find this kind of vibe in East London. I’ll definitely be coming back more often.

Such a lovely cafe you must visit! The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming. I loved their carrot, peas & vegan cheese sandwich and the matcha tiramisu - both were delicious! 😋 Also, don’t forget to go downstairs — you’ll find hidden gems from Korean designers there. I’d def come back again.💙

I celebrated my birthday dinner at Look Left Yugu and couldn’t have picked a better spot!

The team were so lovely and really made the evening special. From small details like customised menus to the candle in the matcha tiramisu.

The food itself was delicious and the vibe and ambience was incredible. Would highly recommend.

So disappointed. The only reason it is matcha croffle is just matcha powder on the top which taste nothing and this was too hard to cut it like a brick. Instead of knife, we should’ve had a hammer. Matcha latte tastes like green milk. We waited for too long to be served. I won’t come back this place.
First visit after they renew the store. The wine selection was great and not overpriced. The food was so fresh and delicious as well - especially homemade doenjang hummus was amazing.

Such a lovely spot! The atmosphere at Ladybug’s Coffee is amazing – feels just like home. The hospitality is top-notch, and the staff are so welcoming. The space is super clean and quiet, which makes it perfect for relaxing or working. Plus, the music is always on point. Highly recommend visiting if you’re in the area! Plus, as a pet lover, it’s awesome that they’re so pet-friendly

Came around 11am and it was quiet. Gradually got more busy as we ate. Service was very quick and the lady who runs the cafe was lovely. We both ordered the House Special, on sourdough toast. Lovely runny egg, excellent mushrooms and avocado with zingy, sweet pomegranate. Lovely brunch and the sweet treats were good too. If in the area, would happily revisit.

Came to try their French toast - where is it?

This cafe has something they call ‘banana French toast’ made with banana bread.

Where is the French toast part? It’s just banana bread with typical English French toast toppings.

Don’t get me wrong, it tastes fine. Even good. Just don’t call it French toast cuz it’s not.

Such a lovely little café! The food was so delicious, the coffee perfect, and the atmosphere so cozy, it even had a bit of a Twilight vibe. The owner was incredibly kind. Highly recommend! Dankeschön! :)

A wonderful women-run gem in Hoxton! The atmosphere is warm, intimate and full of charm. You can really feel the love and care that goes into every plate and every cup. The coffee was rich and perfectly made. A beautifully run café with heart, highly recommend!

Not enough words to show how amazing this cafe is, staff are incredibly kind and helpful food came with fast delivery for eat in and looks and tastes delicious!! Best açai bowl I’ve had in a while. I’ve known the chef for years and he’s watched me grow up!! There’s a large variety of options and they cater to not only fresh or hot or English or Turkish breakfasts but also cold like the açai bowl I got and they do smoothies , their crumble cookies look amazing!!! Definitely coming here with friends and family there’s really comfy seats and the atmosphere is calm and peaceful

This cafe is truly a fantastic place for coffee lovers! The coffees are delicious, especially the filter coffee and latte, which are definitely worth trying. The beans are fresh and the experience is very enjoyable. The atmosphere is calm, and the staff are friendly and attentive. The prices are also quite reasonable considering the quality. I would definitely like to come again. I recommend it to anyone who wants to enjoy a relaxing coffee.

Fast and friendly service with fresh and high quality ingredients. Keen to try the rest of the menu especially the Turkish food. I had the Caesar salad and it had a very generous portion of chicken (which is rare in Hackney). I wish it had more variety in the salad and there were no anchovies but I would definitely have it again - for £11 the value was good for the area and lettuce was fresh.

The white chocolate mocha was also delicious!

New gem of the area

We had a lovely time at Zoha Cafe with our family and guests visiting from Belgium. Our visitors were thoroughly impressed with the quality and atmosphere.
The service was warm and the food was delicious. It was the perfect spot to host our international friends. We’ll definitely be back

Today, while staying in London, I went to ZoHa for breakfast and I couldn’t be happier!
A very cosy, clean, and chic place where you instantly feel comfortable.
The coffee is absolutely delicious ☕✨
Whether for a coffee break or lunch, don’t hesitate!
I’ll definitely be coming back with pleasure.

name: Bake Street
address: 58 Evering Rd, Lower Clapton, London N16 7SR, UK

reviews.text: Exceptional burgers, tacos, bakes and soft serves. Excellent coffees and interesting homemade soft drinks.

This is a very popular brunch venue for its burgers, buns, cookies & desserts. We went highly recommended & must say we were’t disappointed. We had a smash burger, a fish cutter burger, Yangyeom Bun, Crème Brûlée cookie &  Horchata custard bun, all specials of this unique local cafe. Food was as delicious as we had expected. We even found seatings in the limited outdoor space. All in all, great little joint for take aways or casual brunch.

Love, love, love this place- makes you want to return over and over! Everything here is good, I don’t think you can really go wrong. The Nashville Hot chicken is a particular favourite!  We were lucky to get the jaw a collab in august, it was delicious! All the bakes we’ve tried have been awesome.
Stunning, I'd come here every single day if I lived closer by, everything is perfect, cheap as well.

Absolutely lived up to its hype! The fish filay and Nashville chicken buns were delightful, pillowy buns and everything perfectly fried. Would also highly recommend getting some tater tots on the side. Can't wait to return and try everything else on the menu!

The place was nice staff were lovely but the food was a bit meh. I checked their page for food photos before ordering the granola, and it was soooo much smaller than advertised and barely any yoghurt, I actually had to ask for more because there was nothing in the bowl.

My friend got the French toast which was so nice but it made us both really sick after eating it.
This is the best breakfast I've ever had in London. Amazing presentation of food too. Very friendly and helpful staff. If you're in the area, make a stop here :)

Had brunch here with friends. One of us had the eggs Benedict — the hollandaise tasted like it may have been pre-made. My partner enjoyed his vegetarian breakfast. I ordered the Mediterranean breakfast but didn’t realise it wasn’t vegetarian, so I skipped the meat. The food was okay overall but not the best quality. The space is large, dog friendly, and the service was good. I wouldn’t return though — the food needs to be better to justify a revisit.

Well, when you are in Heaven you do not need to use much words.
Walking about Shoreditch I popped in quite hungry and left astonished at.
This gorgeous 60s styled cafe is perfectly clean, well maintained and very relaxed (I love the playlist in background).
The staff is very kind, professional and friendly without being pushy.
The service is so quick and the food is so delicious!
I ordered the usual: some poached eggs with avocado. I literally melted like them.
Also, almost all their dishes are accompanied by a delicious, healthy, pot of mixed salad already - and perfectly - dressed. I am very impressed!
We all know how important is to start the day at the very best and this is the perfect place where to do so!
I will be happy for the rest of my day, despite my day-to-day challenges.
You did save the day Superheroes! Thank you.
If you want to experience the best, dear followers, do step by this cafe.
Well done to you all and I’ll see you later 👏

We have been experienced their Mediterranean and Hackney Road breakfast and we found ourselves the following week at the same place! The things that I loved about to place is no need reservations, waiting time is not that long, service is extremely good, the breakfast plates are tasty and coffee is very well done! It is a big place and no need squeeze and you can have a proper conversation with your friends without limiting time. You may see me next weekend at the same spot!

Tay Do serves some of the most authentic and flavorful Vietnamese food around. The bun thit nuong, banh xeo, bun cha, pho and Hai Nam Chicken Rice are all top-notch. The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, and the owner’s passion shines through in both the food and the warm, welcoming atmosphere. A true hidden gem — we’ll definitely be back!

The food is cheap and banging
1️⃣bun rieu
soup base is sour and slightly sweet, the crab meatball is even bigger than my spoon😂crazy!!!
And it is packed with flavour and super juicy
Staff are friendly and always smiling
2️⃣Summer rolls(Pork and Prawns)
Authentic and yummy
Dipping sauce - I can’t taste any peanut in it , it is like only hoisin sauce

Honestly, it tastes like something straight out of a Vietnamese home kitchen.
Definitely coming back!

We were curious about this place as it's been advertised on social media a lot, but it was a disappointment. Food looked better than it tasted. Very plain and tastless Pho, same as the traditional Vietnamese soup we ordered. Service could be a bit nicer too, not very welcoming...

a Loyal customer，but treated with clear discrimination and disrespect！

I have been coming to this restaurant regularly for a long time, easily more than ten times. To be honest, the service has never been good, but I accepted it because it is extremely close to my home and the prices are cheap. The food is average, nothing special, but convenient and affordable, so I kept coming back.

Usually the service is poor but tolerable. I have noticed clear differences in how Asian customers, Black customers, foreign white customers and local British customers are treated. There is one older gentleman who is always polite and kind, and he is honestly the only reason I still return.

However, my last visit was deeply upsetting.

There were plenty of empty tables, yet the older woman who I believe is the owner insisted I sit by the door where someone had hung their coat on the chair. I explained at least three times, but she ignored me and spoke in a very unpleasant, commanding tone. Eventually she moved us to another table without any apology.

We have supported this restaurant many times, sometimes spending up to £80 in one visit, and even recommended it to friends. I do not understand how regular customers can be treated this way.

From the moment we sat down, we were rushed constantly. During a 40 minute visit, we were asked to leave and had our plates taken away at least five times, even though we were still eating. Finally, the same woman came over and said “I need this table.” No “please”, no “sorry”, no smile, no thank you. Just rude and dismissive.

We were eating for around 30 minutes, which is completely normal. If we had stayed an unreasonable amount of time, I would understand. But being pressured and rushed like this was extremely uncomfortable, especially when the nearby table of three local white customers was being chatted with and treated warmly. As an Asian customer, this felt like clear discrimination.

I grew up in an Asian family in Dublin. My parents always taught me to treat everyone with the same respect, regardless of race, background or status. They worked their way up in professional fields such as law and accounting by being fair, honest and respectful to every client. That is how we earned our place in this society, and that is why I was able to study for a Master’s and now a PhD.

Seeing someone from the same background behave with such unfairness and bias towards others is honestly heartbreaking.

This experience was disappointing and upsetting. I will still return if the kind older gentleman is working, but if that woman is there, I will turn around and leave. I will also no longer recommend this restaurant to friends.

Respect costs nothing, but it makes all the difference.

as a local this is where we go as group and is our food spot. The food, the portion, the people, the interior just makes you feel like you’re eating home cooked food in grandparents kitchen with friends. Good for the soul. Highly recommend !

name: Pavilion Cafe Victoria Park
address: Victoria Park, Old Ford Rd., London E9 7DE, UK

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience here! I was met with the nicest server of my life (Ruva♥️), who treated me extremely kindly. Coming from Belgium and having just moved to London for university, despite it not seeming like much her kindness meant a great deal to me.
Will definitely come back!😁

Adding to this review, I had another amazing experience with Seven, who was incredibly kind and friendly! I look forward to coming back and strongly recommend the Cafe😁

The venue is amazing, Victoria Park with the lake at the front. Many tables outside, delicious fresh food and coffees with large range of choice. The guys are very friendly and smiling, they definitely let you feel welcome. Well done to everyone!

This was a lovely stop. What an amazing cafe to stop by when you're having a stroll in the park. I had the cheese and kimchi toasty and it was perfect. Gooey salty melted cheese on a crispy sourdough bread, all balanced out with some sour kimchi to the side. Exactly what i wanted.

We also got some baked goods. The Chocolate au pain, chocolate chip cookie and a cinnamon roll. All baked perfectly to my liking. Airy soft au pain, chewy dens cinnamon roll and soft and chewy chocolate cookies.

Personally i liked the vibe a lot, especially with some nice reggae music to accompany my lunch.

Thank you so much!
We love this place! Every time we come, the service is always friendly and welcoming. Sam is especially very smiley and kind  he always provides great service. We really enjoy coming here.

💖Banging sri lankan chai (made with kittul). Banging turmeric bun. Lucky to have got bench to sit with the sun on my face, facing the lake! And super ✨️ thanks to Sam, he made my day. Il be back for a proper brunch at some point

name: Cafe Z Bar.
address: 58 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 7PB, UK

reviews.text:
I just love the warm and charming atmosphere here. I usually come here for their amazing carrot cake, but today I decided to try breakfast and it was absolutely brilliant!
I had the crushed avocado, salmon and scrambled egg on sourdough toast and I have to say I loved every bite. The portion was generous and really satisfying too. A big thanks for this lovely Tuesday morning treat, can’t wait to come back again!

I love these little places, they are real gems and stand out from the crowd. I entered by chance, on a rainy Monday while I was waiting for my motorbike to be serviced. The place is large, welcoming and the background music creates an atmosphere from another era. A working Monday morning but excellent, I think even on the weekend, I was tempted by a delicious turmeric latte accompanied by a ham and cheese croissant. The service is friendly, without frenzy. It reminds me of a university café in Bologna Italy. I recommend it.

This is a go to cafe and for once feels worth the money!!

They had so many options on the menu - I went for a southern style breakfast and lemonade with mint and was very impressed!

Generous portions (the lemonade comes with its own small jug so you get at least a few refills out of it)

Lovely fresh produce it was an absolute banquet with a selection of jams and delicious bread.

We also had excellent service from Jessie who was extremely patient and lovely to our group of 6!

Also seems to be a very popular spot for people to do work on their laptops

Good food, great location, varied menu , nice coffee. Nice atmosphere- I’ve been to this cafe various times of day and on weekends and weekdays . During the week it’s a nice balance of parents with young kids, groups of adults and people working quietly. And during the weekend it’s a lot louder and fast paced with families and friends meeting for breakfast and brunch. They have lots of books for kids to read

This is my favourite cafe in the area. Good decently
Priced food, and nice vibe to work in

I wish they'd bring back salads they had on the old menu!! I go there to work in the afternoons, and the salad bar is often half empty / finished by the time i get there .

It also used to be open late, which gave it an edge over the other cafes in the area, but recently it's been closing early - hopefully that's temporary?

Absolutely loved this place! We ordered the Margherita pizza, homemade lemonade, and pistachio tiramisu—every single thing was outstanding. The pizza was perfectly balanced with fresh ingredients, the lemonade was refreshing and clearly homemade, and the pistachio tiramisu was hands down one of the best desserts I’ve had in a long time. You can really taste the care and quality in everything. Can’t wait to come back!

It is the most delicious pizza I have ever had in London! I would recommend to everyone who likes a slice of deliciousness 🫠 my favourite was the Puttanesca and it was so good! They also have great vegetarian options ;)
Best pizza in Dalston (and I’m Italian!). Cosy atmosphere and great service. Very reasonable prices (hope they stay like this now!!). Very recommended!!

I love this place so much!!! Such a lovely independent restaurant with so much charm in the heart of busy Dalston. You can smell the pizzas from all the way down the high street. Definitely pop in for a pizza Diavola and a Tiramisu

Delicious pizza, good choice of toppings, including vegan options. Cosy restaurant, with a lively atmosphere, it's very popular so if you're going weekends, it's probably best to book a table.
We had a few issues trying to get our drinks order, but was sorted after a couple of visits to the bar.

Myself and friends loved our trip here for pizza! We tried a selection and all of them were wonderful. The staff were extremely friendly and the environment was so comfortable that we stayed for hours. The tiramisu was to die for! Would definitely visit again. ☺️

Happened upon this little gem while staying in Hackney. These guys know how to do pizza right. Some of the most delicious pizza I’ve had anywhere. They obviously use the best ingredients and know how to cook them. The service is great. Our server Jason was amazing. Offered us the best options for value and sorted out a mistake we made in ordering with total grace and ease. Also lots of halal and veg options!
Great food, really nice server — thank you Bill and team for an amazing dinner.

Brilliant pizza and wonderful staff. Had ordered pizza with a friend and there was a mistake we made yet they were quick to help us and super accommodating. Pizza is great and the place is open late which rocks

We went there with my friends and their 2 years old on Sunday the 17th September, and the person who was serving and making the pizza made us feel so welcomed and happy! He even made a little pizza shaped like a rabbit 😍 the pizzas were very tasty and there were vegan/gluten free options. The spicy sausage one was a favourite!! I'm definitely going back there next time I'm in the area!!

name: Caloroso Neapolitan Pizza & Bar (Hackney)
address: 71 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text:
What a great experience at Caloroso! It was not busy which was great and the service was impeccable!
They have a good amount of options and interesting mix of ingredients for pizza 🍕 plus, the tiramisù is homemade and you can actually taste that!
Shout out to Viktor who was very nice to us :)

Really enjoyed this cute restaurant with very delicious pizzas. As a celiac I was surprised that every dish could be ordered gluten free. The staff was very helpful explaining the risk of possible cross contamination. Nevertheless I enjoyed a delicious pizza and still had a great night! Would recommend this restaurant to others for its delicious food and welcoming and helpful staff!

The food was very good, and the interior was lovely. The staff were also very friendly. The music and the Italian walking tour video playing on the TV made me feel closer to Italy than I thought was possible! A great dining experience.

We made a special trip only for the purpose of trying this pizza and it did not disappoint at all! True Neapolitan delicious pizza, which satisfied our Italian standard. Also, they were a finalist in a UK tiramisù contest and we could understand why. Tiramisù was also properly made to the appropriate standard and very good portion as well! Service was also good and friendly. Overall, hat to the team. Keep up the great work!

By far the best garlic pizza bread I have ever had in my life. I think there was like even blue cheese melted into it, it was insane. If you want great pizzas and good food then this is your place. The house white wine was splendid, the pizzas, lasagna, just everything was so so good 😍😍 I really am coming here again. The staff can’t doing anything more for you 🫶🏼 proper beautiful Italian place.

Tried this pizza spot recently and overall it was a solid experience. The pizza had a great crispy base and the toppings tasted fresh. Everything was cooked nicely, and the crust had a satisfying crunch.

That said, it was just a touch lacking in flavour – maybe a bit more seasoning or sauce would help bring it all together. Also, it could’ve used a more generous amount of cheese to really hit the mark. Still, a good option if you’re after a decent bite.

This is the 4th time I am ordering for takeaway collection and the food is perfect every time! Great taste and very clean place!
Highly recommend to all,  perfect for a take away night in. The pizza and the calzone’s tastes pretty good! 👍
And great friendly staff to welcome you when you order! 10/10!!

You can't go wrong at the Funky Olive.
Handmade traditional thin crust pizza beautifully cooked.
At the momement the build you own deal, 12" pizza for a fiver amazing, will happily pay full price when deal finishes, last time had a pizza this good was at my favourite pizzeria in La Napoule (South of France), base was crispy, sauce seasoned perfectly and lovely flavour from the cheese, side order of garlic bread, huge,
Staff are friendly and helpful.
If you like pizza don't miss out.

Seriously, I didn't know amazing food could be so quick. Lovely thin and soft chewy base with just a touch of charring to the crust, a rich but not overpowering tomato sauce with melted stringy cheese with a mild flavour, creating a perfect base for the toppings which come through very well. Great definition of fresh delicious pizza.

B'S HONEST REVIEW ♡
In my top 10 halal eats in east london ♡

Location ♡
Funky olive is a Halal family run business s located in kenworthy Road E9. The premises is located on a busy road, there are bus stops in the surrounding area so public transport is easy to get by & places to park by the shops.

Food ♡
I have been to funky olive a handleful of times. They never fails to disapoint because the pizza is so fresh and delicious , the dough isn't too thick and the toppings aren't too much .

Worth a visit !

food came fast, and tasted 10/10.  every bite i took felt like heaven it was SO good. i don’t know why the shop was empty it needs to be packed with customers with their food tasting THIS good. would 100% recommend and would 100% go again. gonna tell my family to buy it as well cos it’s tewwww good. oh and also the music was good too which is a plus.

Ghost burgers was a great experience. Best spot to take a lunch break peacefully. I had lunch offer ghost burger and sticky wings, both were fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly.. The taste is on the spot and loved their signature house sauce. The strawberry mojito was refreshing and balanced, a perfect pairing with the food. Service was quick, portions were solid, and the vibe was chill. Definitely worth stopping by and I’d come back again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely Incredible — Ghost Burger Hoxton is a Hidden Gem!

From the moment you walk into Ghost Burger Hoxton, you know you’re in for something special. The vibe is effortlessly cool — neon lights, hip-hop beats, and that perfect Hoxton edge that makes you feel like you’ve discovered London’s best-kept secret.

But let’s talk about the food… WOW.
The burgers are next-level — juicy, smoky, perfectly seasoned, and stacked just right. You can tell they use top-quality ingredients because every bite bursts with flavour. The signature Ghost Burger is a masterpiece — the kind of burger that actually makes you pause mid-bite just to appreciate what’s happening. The smashed patties have that perfect crispy edge, and the sauces? Unreal. Whoever created those flavour combos deserves a medal.

The fries are golden perfection, the loaded sides are dangerously addictive, and the milkshakes? Straight-up dessert heaven. Thick, creamy, and beautifully presented.

The staff were genuinely friendly and clearly passionate about what they do. You can feel that energy from the kitchen to the counter — everyone’s just proud to be part of something great.

Whether you’re a burger lover, foodie, or just someone who appreciates quality done right, Ghost Burger Hoxton is an absolute must-visit. I’ve eaten burgers all over London, and this one easily makes the Top 3 — maybe even No.1.

🔥 Final verdict: Ghost Burger Hoxton isn’t just good… it’s legendary.
You don’t just eat here — you experience it.

Overall, it’s very expensive for what you get. Burgers start at around £12 without fries, and if you want a menu with fries and a drink, it’s an extra £5, which feels steep considering the taste and price are better at other burger spots nearby.

I tried the Mac & Cheese (from the secret menu), which was okay but very oily. The sides are small, yet again priced at a premium for what is essentially a standard portion elsewhere.

Atmosphere: Nothing special. The air conditioning wasn’t working (or wasn’t on), making it uncomfortably warm inside. You have to get up to order at the counter, and there’s no QR code ordering option, which felt a bit behind for a casual burger place. On the plus side, the food arrived promptly.

Other notes: The merchandise wasn’t fully stocked at the Shoreditch location, and it’s not something you’d go out of your way to buy anyway.

Overall, Ghost Burgers is nothing you’d miss if you skipped it. Decent enough if you’re desperate for a burger, but for the price, you’ll get better quality, portions, and comfort elsewhere.

The food was absolutely amazing, but what really stood out was the samir who served us. he was incredibly polite, attentive and friendly throughout our visit. He made sure we were comfortable and took great care of everything without us having to ask. His positive attitude truly enhanced our dining experience. Excellent service like this makes a big difference highly appreciated!!!

Have to agree with a similar review - went there last week food was bland and tasteless most of it was thrown in the bin. Not good at all - rice had no flavour at, I literally could have been eating boiled rice. Sweet and sour was not sweet and souring, honestly it was really bad. Shame as it used to be alright.

I was really excited to have a lovely Chinese meal. Read the reviews and did the whole cash only, searching for an ATM thing. The customer service on the phone and in person was great. The sweet and sour chick looked like shredded cuts of chicken in lots of batter stuck together..I couldn't taste the chicken. I was so disappointed with the price and forced myself to eat it so to not waste money. The rice was fresh. No prawn crackers unless you spend over £25. The chips were burnt or overly crispy and deeply fried and oily. Would I go again? Sadly no. But on the service front they were lovely people..but please improve your sweet and sour chicken.

Have ordered from Golden Crown for the past couple of years and have done nothing but give them great reviews. Until now. My partner dished some of his sweet and sour chicken into a bowl and began eating and after two mouthfuls came across this!! Totally UNACCEPTABLE!!!!! Lots of hair sorry but this is not ok at all, it's disgusting!!!
Everything you need from a local Chinese - quick, cheap, filling. All dishes had different flavours and none too greasy. Amazing salt and pepper wings. Note it’s cash only!

ABSOLUTELY ONE OF THE BEST CHINESE RESTAURANT IN THE WORLD!!! 😋😋 😋

Hill is a great woman, she has the best customer service in the world !!!!

Thank you so much Golden Crown staff!!!

Much love!!! ❤️💞

God bless ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

I've first came across this little Turkish takeaway hotspot when I was exploring the areas near my internship workplace. I decided to come in one day for some iconic Turkish cuisine for my lunch and was not let down.
+Proffessional and welcoming customer-service
+All items you would expect a Turkish takeaway to have, maybe a few different bits and bobs
+Reasonable prices that you can't go wrong with
+Outer and interior decor is flashy, modern and enginuative

Really good had really good service and its a welcoming place with banging wraps and burgers even the wings were good the chips were really good seasoned and the fat bread was amazing and fresh I really recommend it

Very bad service, rude staff, the chicken is cold and oily and there's hair over the counter, no gloves no hairnet or apron,no health and safety at all!! Very slow,they were making their own meals while serving the customers.
I don't recommend to eat from this place.
Just got my self a large Adana kebab salad chilli sauce and Ayran drink very nice good service fresh food my regular kebab take away paid £15 large Adana and ayran

banging wrap!
EDIT had it a second time. so good here ! falafel halloumi wrap super fresh and good

name: Yard Sale Pizza
address: 105 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text: The crust was perfectly crisp on the outside but soft and chewy inside — exactly how it should be. The sauce had a nice tang with just the right amount of sweetness, and the cheese was gooey and flavorful without being greasy. I tried the margherita and the pepperoni — both were fresh and loaded with toppings. Staff were friendly, service was quick, and the whole place had a great, cozy vibe. Definitely my new go-to spot for pizza night

Easily one of the best pizza spots around – highly recommend.

On top of that the staff are always friendly and welcoming, which makes the whole experience even better. It’s the kind of place you keep coming back to because you know it won’t disappoint.

Yard sale do the BEST pizzas. Perfect crust every time and they don’t scrimp on the toppings - the Unholy Pepperoni absolutely delicious and positively slathered in pepperoni. Great value for what you get
Came in tonight for a pizza and both the ladies working were suberp! Big shout out to Beth and Toni. Everyone was super friendly, helpful and the food matched with its excellent quality!
The customer service and food was excellent. Will definitely order again. Keep up the good work team, thank you for making my experience so special.

I’ve ordered from Great Wall Chinese takeout many times but my most recent experience was extremely upsetting. When my sister’s order was taken incorrectly we tried to clarify the issue but the staff were very rude and dismissive. There seemed to be a big communication barrier and instead of trying to understand what we were saying or helping us find a solution we were met with shouting and hostility.

They also refused to correct my sister’s order saying the food had already been made. I called back only about two minutes after my sister placed the order so I personally found it hard to believe it could have been cooked that quickly. It made me feel like the food might not be freshly prepared at least based on my experience. If freshness is important to you, you may want to consider another shop.

Instead of resolving the mistake we were told to “find another shop” and never order again. As a regular customer I was really disappointed by how the situation was handled. I left feeling uncomfortable and upset. Unfortunately I no longer feel able to order from them.
If you’re someone who prefers calm and respectful customer service this might not be the right place for you based on my experience. I now have to look for a new spot because this one just isn’t okay for me anymore.
I love Singapore rice noodles - but have recently wanted to only have this style or noodle flavour with just chicken. They made it for me no questions asked. It also tasted great ❤️

Ordered some food, everything was good apart from the prawn toast which was dripping with oil! I am a regular customer and rang up to see what options I have and I was told next time ask for less oil 😐.. the woman didnt care at all and was even laughing to another worker about it.. I am totally put off now 😒
When I ordered online the guy was slightly sarcastic, however food is at a good price. For really good quality. I would order again. They except card payment delivery’s

First used this takeaway in 1982 lol
Moved back to the area 8 years ago and pleased to say still good quality and value for money compared to others,
May take a few trys to place a phone / delivery order but worth the effort, usually delivered within half an hour nice and hot.
Portions a good size, rice is always cooked well,  noodles are not greasy and decent cuts of meat in mains.
Also tasty vegetarian options available, I would definitely have tou fu / bean curn dishes again.
If you like Chinese food you can't go wrong here.

name: Wngz Clapton
address: 187 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EG, UK

reviews.text: This place was clean, however the customer service wasn’t the best, the guy seemed really tired and needed to smile more. The food however was really good 👍 it is on the pricy side but worth it as a treat now and then. There is seating in this place, however parking round the area is very difficult to find so the best way to get to this place is via public transport.

Ordered a burger meal, for £7.90 and got a tiny sachet of ketchup and mayo, the prices are not justified. Or at least give enough sauce for the chips. And by the way chips are as ordinary as my Hi-Vis.

Place amazing, the lady who attended me where incredibly nice, she explained me all about the business and the food which I appreciate.
The food was pretty nice I wouldn't change anything about it the sauces taste good and fresh and the chicken too, I enjoyed every single wing.
The only con I would give it to the place it's that is pretty cool as even if the door it's close the wind still pass through and of want to sit down to eat it might be a little inconvenience if it's pretty windy or cold, apart from that excellent place for students or a simple meal.

👍👍Visited for the first time and I was amazed to see how busy they are . Ordered Burger and served in very short time. Outstanding customer service and really good quality food. Keep it up guys. Highly recommended.  You will love it 👌👌

bad customer service. i was given raw food and the manager refused to take accountability. he said the food was not raw when i clearly showed him it was. the food made me sick and i asked for a refund and he said they don’t give refunds without a receipt which i clearly didn’t have as it was the previous day and i wasn’t expecting to need it or that my food was going to be raw inside and make me sick. he gave me a £2 refund in the end after arguing for a while however my food was not £2. very disappointing as i am a regular customer and come everyday. photos do not do it justice the videos show it properly but i wasn’t able to insert them

Right let’s get this straight, you walk in not expecting much. This humble appearance is just masking one of the best places in the area. Quality pizza, thin crust amazing dough perfectly cooked… open till really late, perfect for a late night pizza. The guy running it was an absolute gem, super nice and I’m still thinking about how good it was today!

Probably one of the worst pizzas i’ve ever tried. Absolutely terrible.

I live 10mins from the place and it took over an hour to come. It really wasn’t worth the wait.
DO NOT waste your time or money.
Honestly surprised the funghi pizza was delicious, ingredients tasted fresh and high quality, dough is crispy how I like it, fair priced
Honestly fantastic - great pizza and a solid range of sides, open late and brilliant quality. Would hugely recommend!
Very nice Pizza 🍕 delicious 😋 and customer services was exceptional

Cleanest food place in hackney, fight me. Outside is clear, its a chicken shop with amazing deals outside and inside. Inside doesnt have any seating but its a fast food restaurant- you get ur food and go. Next is the food, omds people have it so wrong. The chicken wings are very crunchy and juicy, with sauce goes unbeatable. The chips could be better but with sauce again its lovely. The burgers are amazing, filling u up halfway through it. The sauces are like heaven to ur mouth. The service is nice. They know me for a long time so they chat to me everytime im there. The atmosphere is fine. Its a small space buts its still amazing how they fit all that in a small space. The deals are go to.

I come here quite often as my office is quite close to this place. The staff are very friendly, the food is great and they are very efficient with their service. Even when it’s busy, the wait isn’t bad at all. They take pride in delivering a good service. Their chicken is always fresh and it’s a decent size too. It’s not the tiny wings that could be compared to a tooth pick that you very commonly see in chicken shops nowadays. But yes, the experience coming here is always a good one!

The best !!
Great customer service and amazing food all the time.

A very very high quality chicken store indeed. I am impressed with the staff working here always smiling & happy to serve you. The shop is kept in tiptop condition & I am very satisfied with the hygiene quality & service levels here.
They take pride in preparing their food, in which you can taste the difference immediately once taking a bite. Very large chicken/chips portions & very sensible pricing too.
I would highly recommend this store Hackney Fried Chicken for my friends, family & local community.
I would love to see in house seating being reintroduced in the future.

Kind Regards,
John T

Absolutely Disgusting – Avoid at All Costs

This was one of the worst food experiences I’ve ever had. The mayonnaise was off and gloopy, the chicken in the burger was foul-smelling and crumbled like dust completely inedible. The chips were hard and stale, and most of my order was missing on delivery. I even ended up vomiting after eating this, that’s how bad it was. The place clearly ignores order notes, serves dangerously low quality food, and to top it off, appears to be using fake bot reviews to boost their ratings. Do not trust the hype and reviews this place is a health hazard.

name: Good Pizza
address: 99 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 8EL, UK

reviews.text:
Got two pizzas. Mushroom.and pepperoni, and another one with a white sauce, garlic spinach, and ricotta.
Both where lovely.
I've seen that some people said that the food was cold - and our pizza was cold(ish) on arrival....however it was from deliveroo, so Im not knocking a star off for what could have been a slow delivery
One of the best pizza ever i had. Highly recommended 👌🏻

Although the place has been serving me 'good pizzas' for a good few years, it's not been the case for the last couple of times I have been there. I have to say that it's not always run by the same people. These new guys are nice and all but I have made the mistake twice of ordering a pizza and then collecting it a few minutes later without checking it before leaving. The first time the pizza was burned all over the crust and I thought it was a one off and forgot about it. The second time I made the same mistake of not checking the pizza until I got home to find it  carbonised all over the crust and overcooked under; it looked more like an Oreo than a pizza. This second pizza went straight to the bin because it wasn't worth eating. I couldn't bother to walk 10 minutes back to the place to complaint as it was late and I was tired. Today I was walking by and I stepped in to tell them that if they burn a pizza they should put it in the bin and make another instead of selling it for 'good' to a paying customer. The guy apologised by saying that 'it can happen' but, since he must have seen that the pizza was burnt when boxing it and considering that is not the first time, the apologies didn't do it for me. He should have offered me a replacement pizza for free!... but he didn't and I didn't ask. Needless to say: this pizza place is out of my list of takeaways for good.

I used to go to Good Pizza in Stoke Newington every time I traveled to London because I loved it — it was one of my favorite pizza places. But this last time I was really disappointed. It seems like they changed the chefs or the ingredients, because the pizza was terrible. The taste was completely different, and you could tell the ingredients were low quality. I went there so excited, but I left really disappointed. Unfortunately, I won’t be coming back.

Fantastic pizza place. Had a great experience here recently. The pizza was lovely, thin and not greasy like most mainstream American pizza joints. The toppings were high quality. Service was fast and friendly. I would definitely recommend. Fully halal menu.

name: Tasty Chicken
address: 233 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EG, UK

reviews.text: Came late at night and they were so welcoming. Partner wanted something out of menu that the lady cooked for him and gave him extra chicken for free. I got buns, big and excellent. Could be more satisfied 🥰
I was well impressed with the mega burger meal. Filled me up for £5.50! Will pop back if I’m in need of a late night chicken burger.

Poor customer service to begin with, the shop is dirty and makes you want to moonwalk right out it. The pizza was dry and they're miserly with the toppings, one supposedly had extra cheese but you'd never know. The chicken looked a bit under cooked, the only thing positive I can say is the fried were okay. Previous management were very different, I suspect most of the positive ratings were from then.
Food was fine but this was the second time they messed up my order. I ordered 4 boxes of wings and was only give 3.
Honestly these best fried chicken in Hackney hands down! The staff are always awesome and super friendly.  Prices are excellent too. A must try if your in this area!

name: Swift Caribbean Delights Takeaway
address: 27 Homerton High St, London E9 6JP, UK

reviews.text:
First time eating here and absolutely blown away by the taste! I enjoyed every mouthful and would happily go back but I feel like I wouldn't stop! Definitely a must try, I will be going back again. Great customer service from The Hulk serving the food, chatty and engaging whilst waiting for the food. A* in my book. Looking forward to my next visit.

My food is mixed, chicken pasta, callaloo and pumpkin...? I forgot. But will definitely have them again!

I see this restaurant often and I am always happy to see them open. I have never used them personally but this store is usually busy, when open. Very good sign. I also wish they had another location so that I could park and maybe sit inside when they are open. This store is endorsed by uniformed persons..very often. I do hope they continue the good work- that they do. Well-done!!

Used to visit here frequently, and it’s gone very downhill since. Went in on a Thursday evening around 6:30pm - most dishes out of stock. Had to repeat myself 3 times because the guy taking my order wasn’t listening, even though I was the only customer there. Ordered BBQ chicken, completely inedible. Literally a portion of bone and grizzle, no edible meat - full thing went in the bin. Rice and peas were decent, but this doesn’t make a full meal. Really disappointing, will be looking for a new local.

Three of us were looking for curry in the middle of the afternoon.  Most restaurants were closed.  We came upon Swift thankfully.  The music, the aromas, the beautiful smile and reception were a blessing.  We love caribbean food and we were not disappointed.  Yummy curry goat, chicken and pumpkin stew!  We're from Montreal and will look forward to this place the next time in London.  chhers!

Went before Tottenham's champions league match with my sons, the food was fantastic had the jerk chicken and rice with Guinness Punch,  BBQ chicken wings and curry goat  both with rice.friendly atmosphere and attentive service.

Had a super great time here with my boyfriend on a lunch date. Staff are super friendly and attentive! Michelle was our waitress and made us feel very welcome. Franco manco is always a pizza place favourite for me

"I recently took part in the Franco Manca 'Map a Run' promotion, and my experience at this branch was fantastic! After finishing my run, I headed to the shop where the manager, Viktorija, was incredibly welcoming. She was so enthusiastic, congratulated me on the run, and even helped me pick out the perfect pizza. She went above and beyond by personally bringing the pizza out to me while I waited outside. I’m so happy with the service—I highly recommend this branch!"

We did our three-year-old’s pizza making birthday party at Franco Manca and Victoria was absolutely phenomenal. She helped 12 kids make pizzas while handling everything else that was needed with her lovely colleagues. They were endlessly patient through all the chaos.
The parties take place in the back room of the restaurant - it’s a great space for a dozen young children and adults - so it’s nice and private.

Distracted staff talking in the back rather than taking orders/ serving ; took us 45 minutes just to order drinks ! Pizzas were quick once we were able to order. Wish the Amatriciana had a bit more sauce as it was on the dry side, but otherwise good.

I had a great experience at Franco Manca in Broadway Market, largely thanks to Ayat’s excellent service. From the moment we were seated, Ayat was friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome. She was knowledgeable about the menu, happy to answer questions, and checked in at just the right moments without being intrusive. Her warm and professional attitude really enhanced the overall experience and made the visit even more enjoyable. Outstanding service like this truly makes a difference — thank you, Ayat!

name: Zingo Chicken & Pizza
address: 203 Homerton High St, London E9 6BB, UK

reviews.text:
Zingo is a spot, while my time at the hospital had a walk over to here to get dinner. Let me tell you the food is so on point, absolutely delicious and the portions are heavy.

The staff were really accommodating to my customisations and requests and their energy, customer service and synergy was noticeable and of a high standard.

Being in the hospitality business and keeping that upbeat energy until 11:00PM is no easy feat, big shout out to boss man and boss lady for great service.

You need to come and try this place it is a Hackney hidden gem.

I have ordered from Zingo more than 10 times.

Firstly their burgers are absolutely minuscule. do not be fooled by their nice pictures and varied burger menu it's all just dehydrated fillet burgers with different sauces in a mini bun. Chips are also kids meal sized.

Absolutely minuscule portions with a high price tag.

Not only is this place a rip off that will leave you extremely disappointed, I ordered a 15 inch pizza and received a burned pizza with the wrong toppings on what I can only describe as a bitter unintentionally 'sourdough' tasting dough base. Very unpleasant, really I cannot emphasise this in words.

The pizza was delivered to me with the wrong drink & the slices were upside down in the box.

I had to call the restaurant to tell them I was giving this review as UberEats denied me a refund even though I followed their procedure & uploaded pictures. My hard earned money is disrespected by both Zingo & UberEats, not the best way to spend your weekend dinner.

Avoid, Avoid Avoid. You will thank me. Don't be fooled with their silly promotions on UberEats.

0 stars well earned.

Was going to be five star, friendly girl clean professional store.

I ordered the chicken wrap and a veggie burger. The vegie burgers pattie was cold, not defrosted properly or fried enough such that it could not be eaten - was thrown away.

Chicken wrap was delicious. It may have been a one off incident I really do not know but it ruined half of my order.

I've lived in the area for about a year and Zingo is my standard go to for pizza and chips. Always friendly, hard working, delicious food and great prices. I'm a vegetarian and haven't had their chicken, but I know it's good too because everybody gets it when I go to pick up, highly recommended!
I ordered on uber eats , the pizza had hair on it and also it wasn't cooked as If they slapped dough and cheese.  Also they said they'd call us the next day and they haven't called us for a week.

name: Oriental
address: Oriental Chinese Take Away, 444 Kingsland Rd, London E8 4AE, UK

reviews.text:
Multiple trips to China and even living in China, nothing consumed while in China was tastier than this. The best Chinese ever.

Love it so much my partner and I got the address tattooed on ourselves.

My partners been going here since he was a baby.  His nan has lived over the road for 30+ years. Cannot recommend it enough.

I ordered the Sweet and Sour chicken with boiled rice. It came part of combo for around £7 with some prawn crackers on the side. The Sweet and Sour had no pineapple, onion or peppers and the chicken was stale and so was the boiled rice. Absolutely revolting! The prawn crackers were not cooked fresh but pre prepared or maybe even bought. The worst Chinese take away I’ve ever had.
Food was beyond excellent! large portions and full of flavour. Was passing by accident and thank god i found this place 🔥 (please deliver on JustEat if possible please!)

Second time ordering from them first time was in 2024 was very nice this time round sweet sour chicken balls was dry and tasteless , salt and pepper chips was soft and soggy not crispy at all , I must say the curry sauce nice , the chicken chow mein and special fried nice was tasty
I deliberately come from Tottenham to get this food. It's great. Service is quick, server was polite, and most importantly the food is amazing

Wow. The service and staff behaviour is amazing. They are friendly and the food is fantastics especially the small fies.
I Confirm you that its worthy to pay gor tge food. Tge quantity of food they giving is unbelievable.

I had a splendid experience here at fried & grilled. My food was a 10/10, service was 11/10 and the kind server even gave me a free chicken wing to try. Man was it delish. The prices here are incredible and I will be back very soon.

If you’re a wing lover, this place is a must. The wings are a solid 10/10 — perfectly cooked, juicy on the inside with that ideal crisp on the outside. Whether you go fried or grilled, the flavour is unreal and clearly seasoned with care, not rushed or bland like many spots.

On top of the food, the boys working there are genuinely professional and very friendly. You’re welcomed properly, service is quick, and they make you feel comfortable every time — which honestly makes the whole experience even better.

The sauces hit hard without overpowering the chicken, portions are generous, and everything comes out hot and fresh.

Overall, Fried and Grilled Hackney delivers top-tier wings with top-tier service. Highly recommended if you want proper comfort food done right 🔥🍗
There food is exquisite and tasty i must say it is a Was the best chicken shop than every other millions of chicken shops on that road fried and grilled on top!!

Food is perfect and so affordable as well as the service top tier and food comes fresh but one thing that puts me off is the atmosphere of the place its forever untidy and sauces are all over the place

name: Silver Star Cambridgeheath
address: 489 Cambridge Heath Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text:
£7.50 for this amount of pork??? Crazy, I could barely fit it all in a bowl. And look at the sear on the skin!!
Staff working there are also always friendly and they've got some wicked fish in their tank.

Best Chinese takeout joint in the area!

Rubbish food
Expected much more since there are barely any chinese spots in the area.
Gives stomach aches

Whatever you do guys , DO NOT EAT FROM HERE!  I have had dioreah for the past 3 days I have never had food poisoning so bad , I went in to the restaurant to buy , it’s not like it was delivered , and the food was stale the prawns were stale the sweet and sour chicken was stale all of it was TERRIBLE it tasted like plastic I can’t believe that they tried to tell me they were the best Chinese food in the area , DO NOT EAT FROM HERE!
20.05.2025

Ordered at 6.30pm, food finally arrived at 8.50pm. Called the restaurant twice and on both occasions was told the driver was on his way.
The food was cold, greasy and it appeared it had been thrown together in a hurry.
It's such a shame because we have used the restaurant before and have always been satisfied.
But at £55 for cold, greasy and rubbery food, we will most certainly NEVER use this restaurant again!!!
Shocking service!!

I have been a customer of the Silver Star for 24 years. Tonight, yet again, its shut for some reason that goes against running a financially viable business, what seems to be an unprofessional filming. The establishment/family have obviously become arrogant with their customers, so they deserve to be out of business.
Good bye - I will never order anything from you again.

Had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The food was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. The ambiance was warm and inviting, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy a great meal.

A special thanks to Parag kaushal for the excellent service — friendly, attentive, and truly professional. His hospitality made our visit even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended, and we’ll definitely be back!

Edit 02.11.25- They sent me a leaving present!! The samosas are literally to die for!

I ordered food from this restaurant for the first time today and I was so pleasantly surprised by the quality of food. When I called to ask a few questions, they were extremely helpful and friendly and even suggested their speciality items. For the cost, it was well worth it, plus they have offers on Uber eats!
I had the chicken tikka masala, pataka wings and the garlic naan. It was yummy and the wings were a standout! I also got the mini samosas which were really cute and tasty. They even gave me a complimentary dessert and salad! Definitely going to be a staple delivery place for me from now! Thanks a ton!

It's all in the name! Great food in a modern and laid-back setting, with options for vegetarians and vegans. I got the Samosa Chole Chaat and the Jackfruit Biryani. Both were seasoned exquisitely, and rich in flavor. The chole chaat had offered a nice contrast with it's use of chutney, while the biryani was laden with spices. I thought I'd never learn to like jackfruit, but there's a first for everything! Would come back again on my next visit to London.

We honestly cannot say enough good things about Great Indian Food.

We first visited in 2024 while travelling from Liverpool to London and stopped by on a bit of a whim, expecting nothing more than a quick pit stop before heading out. Instead, it turned into one of the most memorable food experiences we’ve ever had — and something my partner and I have talked about constantly ever since.

The food was some of the most flavourful, exciting Indian food we’ve ever eaten. Every bite felt like a new flavour experience, and it completely blew us away. On top of that, the atmosphere made us feel instantly at home — the smell of incense, relaxed R&B playing, and such a warm, welcoming vibe. The staff were genuinely lovely, friendly, and made us feel so comfortable. Ever since that visit, we’ve always said how much we wished we lived closer.

Fast forward to December 2025, when I asked my partner what he’d love most for his birthday. Without hesitation, he said: dinner at Great Indian Food. So we booked a coach from Liverpool to London purely to come back for his birthday meal.

I contacted the restaurant beforehand just to make sure we could be seated, and they were unbelievably kind. Not only did they set a table aside for us, but they made us feel so welcomed from the moment we arrived. The food was even better than we remembered — somehow exceeding the hype we’d built up in our heads for over a year. To top it all off, the staff surprised my boyfriend with a birthday cake, which was such a thoughtful and touching gesture.

The whole experience was incredible, and we genuinely can’t recommend this place enough. We’ll be visiting every single time we’re in London — it’s become a must. Thank you for creating such a special place
Lovely tasting food, favourites were roast lamb tacos, gunpowder wings and the pork belly sliders. Service was great too. Only downside was Chef Jolly wasn't there, will be back for sure!

So good we visited twice... Great value, excellent food, much better than the well known big brand.

Guy serving (owner?) worked flat out to ensure a speedy service, kept customers happy, was very efficient, and put in a lot of effort.

Better deals than the peace treaties and sound staff.
One of the best chicken shops in Hackney, top proximity with pubs, ideal for a pre-scran or a life saviour one.
Compliments to the chef

Randomly run over mare street , suddenly saw Original PFC ,Just for check out the food quality orsder Smash burger , Chiken wings with chips:

Wings: I think I have oredered best wings , what a delicious wings , Top notch flavour and extra ordinarily make which is more tasty.

Burger : This a traditional food ever I have taste , Really hatts off their  making procces and outstanding tast.

overall, I'd highly recommended this resturent for thwir food quality , Hygiene , and Good family environment

Original pfc is a hot spot in hackney its where i have seen alot of school kids hang out and when i went there to eat i deeply understood why it really captures the flavours and essence of fried chicken that is sometimes forgotten when chicken and chip joints forget to highlight it as a whol it is a 10/10 chicken joint i loved it and im sure you would too
Very tasty food. Great customer service and clean restaurant.

name: Best Kebab Cambridge Heath
address: 503 Cambridge Heath Rd, Cambridge Heath, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text:
Our local favourite kebab shop, they do the best meat & chips.
This time I ordered chicken shish, lamb meat & chips, chicken wings.
Food always tastes great and service is good.

Literally inedible.

Bought on uber eats and was unfortunately very very bad.

I had to throw away the large lamb döner I ordered. It lacked flavour, it was cold, had a plasticky texture. It’s a shame. The salad that came with it was underwhelming. The house chilli sauce didn’t taste anything expect acidic

Best kebab, really?? Should read 'the WORST kebab'. What kind of meat is this, plastic, rubber, pure greasy meat that doesn't taste like meat. If I never had a kebab before, I'll say great, but this place serves disgusting food, unbelievable. Don't waste your money here, mate. This place brings shame to all the other decent kebab shops.

Food is good and can be better
donnor not really appealing
try the 1/4 pounder meal very nice and filling

Ordered a chicken kebab and chicken shish with salad x2 man charged me £28.

Thats 1 chicken shish kebab another 4 cube peices of chicken  and salad and a small pitta bread no drink he charged me £14 lmao this shops prices are 5 star Michelin prices in East london 🤣  portion was not that big to be honest if I was full up after that otnwould have been OK. But I was still hungry. Extortion prices

name: German Doner & Grand Chips
address: Unit 1B, Kingsland Shopping Centre, Kingsland High St, London E8 2LX, UK

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at German Donner and  Grand Chips with my friends, and I can honestly say it was an exceptional experience. The restaurant offers a warm and inviting atmosphere that immediately makes you feel at home. The staff, particularly one of the servers named SYED, went above and beyond to ensure we had a memorable evening.

SYED'S level of service was truly outstanding. Despite any challenges, he was attentive, courteous, and genuinely dedicated to making our experience special. His willingness to go out of his way to accommodate us and ensure everything was perfect did not go unnoticed. It’s rare to encounter such dedication and kindness, and SYED'S exceptional service deserves recognition.

The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and served promptly, complementing the wonderful service we received. Overall it's  a fantastic dining spot with passionate staff who genuinely care about their guests. I highly recommend it and especially want to highlight SYED'S outstanding efforts he truly made our visit memorable. Definitely a place that deserves acknowledgment for their excellent customer service!

Really good experience here. The food was fresh, hot and full of flavour, and the portion sizes were solid for the price. Staff were friendly and quick with service even when it was busy. The place itself was clean and had a nice atmosphere. Definitely one of the better doner spots I’ve been to — would come back again.

The service was good, everything was good, the atmosphere was also nice, but the food was just terrible. I am a regular customer there, but today I went there, a cashier there asked me a lot of questions, I repeated them all, he gave me wrong answers, I ordered a piece of döner chips, the chicken was not cooked, I asked for it not to be spicy, there was a lot of garlic sauce in it, but it was very little, the cashier did not treat me well, he spat on me while talking to me, so I told him to slow down, I had a card like this, they give you a card to get free drinks and free food, I told him to give me a free drink, he did not, then he said there were student discounts, he said could you do that, he did not, I said to him, why am I a student, he said no, I do not believe you, he said, I am a regular customer here, I come here all the time, you are a new soldier, please call someone else to take care of me, he said to me, no, I am taking care of this place right now, he said, I do not believe you, he said, I am 15 years old, they ate raw chicken right now, I cannot eat that, I have a spicy allergy, so when you go there, you really should Speak well, really, until someone understands you. I said I was good, I said you were talking to me, but I guess they didn't understand me or didn't want to understand me. I'm eating all the raw chicken right now. I mean, if you want to get food poisoning, I'll go eat raw chicken.
Grand chips staff really deliver the most amazing customer service and the best fires around, 10/10 food (especially their fries and meat box!!) packed with flavour and sauce 😋😋😋😋
amazing food! the staff are so nice and welcoming and the food tasted fresh and warm, very good service

name: Joy PO Hackney
address: 73 Mare St, Cambridge Heath Rd, London E8 4RG, UK

reviews.text: I was food poisoned from this place! I knew something was off with it but I was so hungry I continue to eat it and now I have green diarrhoea and bad belly pains for 3days now :( the pork ribs was dry and when I bit into it you can see it wasn’t fresh as it had that grey hard stale colour , the rice was old and the prawns was dry and chewy , I should of threw it away instantly but I didn’t and now I’m suffering from it :( just to note I have always brought my Chinese from here but never again!!

Order was delivered extremely quickly which is always a bit of a red flag. The food was awful, all of it was tasteless and dry, it looked as though it had been sat around for days. The highlight was probably some mediocre prawn crackers. I'd recommend avoiding at all costs.

Resturant is TAKE AWAY & CASH ONLY - just a heads up!

Lovely lil gem, Joy Po is our go to Chinese and is the best around imo

Shop is always clean/staff are always hygeinc when I visit on top of good customer service and great food.

You can call ahead and place your order if you don't want to wait in line.

Thank you to all staff at Joy Po who always provides us with an amazing meal and a smile! : )

I used to buy from this restaurant and quite enjoyed their food, but Joy Po's Food Standards Agency hygiene rating has dropped from 3, which isn't great, down to 2 out of 5, so until their rating improves, I cannot buy from this restaurant....
Had Chinese from there last night really enjoyed it dish’s was great and great price

Absolutely recommend this place! Every sushi is made fresh to order (apart from the rice, of course), so it’s not the kind of spot where food flies out instantly, but trust me, the wait is completely worth it. When our Salmon Lover Set arrived, we were blown away by the generous, beautifully presented sashimi. It instantly brought us back to Japan’s quaint little sushi bars run by old masters, imperfectly cut yet perfectly portioned.

When we came for dinner, the whole place was being run by just one person, Mr. Md Nazrul Islam. He did it all, welcomed us at the door, made the food, and still managed to be super friendly and warm throughout. The service and quality made the whole experience memorable.
