We couldn’t finish our set and took the rest home (no complaints there!). Definitely a place worth visiting. We’re already looking forward to going back and trying the hot meals next.

By far, the best sushi I've had! And the fact that it's all halal is even better. My favourite thing to get are the dragon rolls (as you can tell from my photo), but I have also tried other stuff from their menu. The staff are always so friendly and welcoming. I would highly recommend!
Best in Hackney! The service is amazing and the staff are very friendly. Both the quality and quantity of the food are perfect. Highly recommended!
Had the katsu chicken bowl and veg dumplings. Chicken was nice and crispy, curry sauce was warm and savoury. Would come again.

I ordered from this takeaway few days ago and honestly wish I hadn’t bothered. The food was late 60 minutes and was barely warm.

The beef in black bean sauce was chewy and tasteless, and the noodles were swimming in oil. The salt and pepper chicken was more batter than chicken, and it all tasted reheated i own a take away...I KNOW

To make matters worse, the order was missing the curry sauce I paid extra for, and when I called to ask about it, the person on the phone just said, “We’re busy, come to shop" and hunged up. Not exactly great customer service.

Honestly, I’ve had better off with ready meals. Won’t be ordering from here again.

name: New Noodle Bar (big Bowl Soup Noodle)(大碗麵）

reviews.text:
Location:
This place is next to the Tesco Superstore which makes parking very easy.  Hackney Central Station is also a stone throw away too.

Service:
The shop is run by a couple who are nice and friendly.

Food:
I ordered a 干炒叉烧河粉 (Roast BBQ Pork Fried Ho Fan), it was epic.  The Ho Fan was not too dry but it was not oily.  It tastes much better than those served in China Town even better than Wong Kee's quality.

The food is good but the price is excellent too.  I paid £7.80 for this lovely dish and I was not disappointed for both quality and value.

Conclusion:
I will visit again, most likely solo as this place is not for a Romantic Date or Business Lunch.

A great spot for “cheap & cheerful” Chinese fast food; good value, good portions & fast!

There’s also seating & they now accept card payments too!

Been here plenty of times over the years for dine in & take out.

Particularly like coming here when i’m in the need for no-nonsense tasty & plentiful food in a hurry.

ps. Have only had the odd issue with orders but if communicated well, they’re always supercool at sorting it out.

pps. My only complaint is that they don’t offer the traditional Chinese staff food to customers lol, which you see them having during breaks or near closing time; looks bloody delicious!

Tasty, cheap and super quick is usually the priority (and business model) of your typical Chinese takeaway and here is no different 🥡🥢

Not many takeaways have tables, so despite the lacklustre surrounds it’s amazing you can dine on takeaway prices vs a more expensive Chinese restaurant experience somewhere else.

If only they would fix the door that doesn’t close properly every time someone walks through (i.e. every three minutes!).

A great late night stop when you’re in a hurry.

If my review or photos were helpful, please leave a thumbs up 👍 Thanks!

Excellent food and service. The portions are enormous and the food itself is very well prepared and from the fresh ingredients. I have extremely sensitive stomach when the food is not perfectly fresh but I had no issues whatsoever after eating at the new noodle bar. Variety of dishes is also very good. Prices are more than reasonable.

First time trying the place, and the call to place an order didn't go well. The guy who picked was very impatient and dismissive. You're not rendering a free service, so be more receptive towards people. Never going to order from them afterall.
One of our fave Indian meals we’ve had!!! Every dish tasted so fresh and flavourful and the experience was made even better by Huq. Can’t wait to be back! Thank you :)

Actually can’t believe it took us so long to find this winner. Was our third visit last night, Friday night, after two takeaway. Vibe didn’t disappoint. Was packed by the time our mains came - and what mains! A tikka masala made with a tomato and coconut paste that wasn’t drenched in cream as most places. A wonderful paneer korma, and veggie vindaloo, and a lime pickle based curry that also really felt novel. Huq and team so kind and in the know with their curry bases. And to top it off - it’s BYOB so tip well and order generously! Such a great place.

★★★★★ 5/5 stars

Leads Eatery Indian Restaurant is a true gem hidden away in Hackney – we couldn’t be happier to have found it!

From the moment we got in touch to when we finished our meal, the service was exceptional. General Manager Haq was so helpful and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the start.

The samosas are particularly outstanding – very delicious with loads of flavour. The rest of the starters were fresh and bursting with taste too. Both the lamb and chicken vindaloos were absolutely delicious, with perfectly balanced spice and tang, and we were impressed by the generous portion sizes – great value for money all round. We’ll definitely be returning soon! 😊

This place is 10/10, from food to service, leads eatery is the best Indian cuisine I’ve eaten. The onion Baji is soft on the inside and crispy on the out, the perfect texture and consistency. The meat is all slow cooked throughout the day so all of the meat (ESPECIALLY THE LAMB) is so juicy and succulent. Never regret trying something new on the menu as it all delivers to the highest quality. Last time I had the meat platter, just look at how perfect this meat is, packed full of flavour! The manager is so sweet too and gives 10/10 service with a smile and friendly conversation. You must go. Best BYOB around!!!!!!!

I went here on a quiet night and the chef and staff were very friendly and chatted with me whilst the food was being prepared. The onion bahji were fine shreds fried almost crisp like - quite amazing that there was none of the usual huge chunks of onion in there - by far the best I've ever had. Curry was good. Naan break was the freshest and fluffiest and has no doubt spoiled me for life. Highly recommended.

name: Goodfellas La Grande
address: Unit 8, Regent Studios, Andrews Rd, London E8 4QN, UK

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing chicken biryani from Goodfellas La Grande! Generous portion, packed with flavor, and the pickle & raita were perfect. Loved the surprise free dessert too! Highly recommend!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I recently ordered chicken biryani from here and I must say, it was absolutely amazing! The portion size was generous, and the quality was top-notch. The biryani itself was flavorful, fragrant, and cooked to perfection — definitely the best I've had in London so far. Along with the biryani, I was also gifted medu vada, which was just as delicious! The texture was perfect, and it tasted incredibly fresh. Everything about my experience with them was wonderful, from the food to the quality. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for great food. Will definitely order again!
Ordered kerala chicken biryani. Had the traditional taste. Would have liked a bit more masala though. Would still recommend!
Have tried this hidden gem last week and have to say was the best Kerala biriyani I have had in London.

I recently ordered takeaway from Goodfellas La Grande, and I was blown away by their diverse menu! As a foodie, I love trying new cuisines, and Goodfellas La Grande exceeded my expectations.
I opted for a mix of Italian and Indian dishes. The Italian food was authentic and delicious But what really surprised me was the Indian food!
The portions were generous, and the prices were very reasonable. I'm so impressed with Goodfellas La Grande takeaway! The quality of food, combined with excellent service, makes them a must-try for food lovers.
Wasn’t a fan of the food here. Wings were really greasy and I was shocked that they had no chilli sauce.
Raw meat. The chips were good atleast
Guys if you don't want to serve fish and chips just say it.  Dont serve chicken burger to everyone. Also the chicken was just like eating a cardboard.

Paid for £10 hot wings which is 20 wings they only give me 16 wings and I call them to inform them that they have taken the right money in to my account but they didn't give me the right wings the man just hung up the phone. Customer service is very poor asked them for burger sauce they said don't have but I can see it on the counter I will never go there anymore wings is old and not nice

Very rude customer service. Especially the oldest man working there. I asked for mayonnaise. The old guy said that he did not have any mayonnaise and I can see another staff member refilling the mayonnaise bottle. It was my usual chicken shop as I live in Haggerston , but I stopped going there due to the customer service.  Now I go to another chicken shop in Haggerston. Just dissapointing.

Great service and atmosphere. The restaurant had a warm, relaxed vibe that made it a pleasure to dine in. The service was excellent, Temi was especially friendly, attentive, and professional, making sure everything ran smoothly from start to finish. A really enjoyable experience overall.

Usually have a good experience dining in at various Pizza Express locations but had a terrible deliveroo this evening. Paid over £50 for two entirely cold pizzas, 4 measly chicken goujons (which cost £9.50!!) which look nothing like the photo and are clearly cooked from frozen, and a salad. Plus, I received the wrong dips. The order kept getting pushed back despite my rider waiting at the restaurant for ages. Really disappointed.

Very enjoyable pizza - the American Hot Romana base is apparently Marcus Wareing’s favourite so I had to try it. Pizza Express app had an offer on if you sign up- for buy one get one for £1 on classics (or £2.95 Romana) and tbh this seemed like a great deal. Service was good, place is stylish. Handy location opposite Hackney Empire for events. Budget friendly and tasty dinner which is what I wanted.

Priya served me today she was so welcoming and helped me to choose the best pizza ever. The food was so good and delicious. After my fasting she really helped to had a nice food, special thanks to her and my kids really liked her

Not really impressed with what we had.
I could taste MSG as part of seasoning chicken wings.

Local pizzeria is much better!

Everything was too ordinary and a bit too greasy.

I won’t choose this place again.

The floor staff must have been a student part - time worker. Looked a bit inexperienced, but attended a table well.

name: Super Kebab
address: 54 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XB, UK

reviews.text:
Best Donner I've had ,you can tell and taste the difference in meat quality and it's good value as well pretty big portions, they have own butcher's next door so you know it's it will be good
will definitely be back for another visit when I'm visiting London next
To try the other stuff on menu

Must mention the outstanding chilli sauce. has a kick, but is clearly made by someone with a palate. Really tasty and adds to the taste, rather than being a test of heat tolerance to prove I'm a man. Lovely stuff.
My mixed lamb and chicken doner was soft and moist, but also with a bit of minimal charring. Pretty much perfect. Salad and food and fries all very well separately packaged as i had someone collect for me. They clearly care about what they give to customers. Pitta breads not cut 2/3rds of way up like some places, so I could cut along the top seam as I like. Ideal. All in all my only disappointment is I'm a miserable sod and there's nothing to moan about! Highly recommended.

Went in for a quick bite and was really impressed. The doner was fresh and flavorful, not greasy, and the portion was generous. The place is simple but clean, and the staff were friendly and the food arrived quickly.

01/08/25 - Ordered a large mixed doner and chips on super kebab app. The mixed doner came in a small container (1st pic) same size as the salad (2nd pic) food is nice but it doesn’t represent value for money.
Contacted them via their mobile app, but no reply.

Update 31/08/2025:
No reply on here or from message sent via app.
Guess they don’t care!

By far the best doner kebab in London, if not the UK. Authentically Turkish, and they have won awards for how good the kebab is. Lots of variety on the menu and reasonable price. Clean and fully HMC certified. Highly recommended!

Ive eaten here a few times before and ordered online, and it was great. Until this occasion . I decided to take my mother here for lunch, we both fancied cod and chips. On arrival the restaurant was completely empty ?!
We waited to be seated, there was just one person working! He was both frying and serving. We ordered cod and chips for two and a couple of coke’s. The server/ cook took the menus away. We had to wait approximately 30 minutes for him to return with our orders, which I thought was extremely long ! As there were no other customers at all. And it only takes 10 minutes to fry cod and chips. I can only assume he was waiting for the oil to heat up! On a quiet day. The cod we were served wasn’t fresh  fish ! In fact the fish was dry and soft inside of the crisp batter!
I could easily tell this was poor quality and not fresh and very small to boot. The chips were not made from Maris piper. I could tell because of the high sugar content of the potatoes used. The chips had browned
And this due to the sugar content of the potato with high heat this happens.
We couldn’t enjoy the chips ! And the fish we ate because we were both very hungry.
I don’t recommend ! And definitely not return.

my top 1 vegan fish and chips! from what my lover said, it tastes like the real thing ahaha. the restaurant was pretty quiet for a sunday evening but it was perfect! the fries and the curry sauce were delicious too:)
the staff was nice and patient, we’ll definitely be back !

The vegan fish made of banana blossom was very interesting and tasted good, but that was the only good thing about the place. The guys at the kitchen weren’t wearing anything to prevent their hair/beard to fall on the food, the smell inside was the same as if I was the one frying the fish. Ah, also their burger was really bad.

A really delicious eat in meal 🍴 of vegan banana 🍌 blossom fish and chips, vegan jumbo sausage and vegan mushy peas. Lovely and crispy chips, and the vegan banana blossom fish was very yummy with an incredible taste, texture and batter. Well worth the visit for any vegans if you are in London.

Update: another visit with photos added, super delicious, generous portions, crunchy and amazing service and flavours. Highly recommended for all vegans in London and visiting London for delicious vegan fish and chips, mushy peas sausage and tartare sauce.

A little more expensive than the average chippy but worth it, also because there’s a nice seating area and not just a takeaway place. Big portions, fresh fish and yummy chips. And if you somehow have room for more… a fried mars bar to top it all off. I’ve never eaten off their vegan menu but am also very impressed with their offerings!

name: Best Mangal
address: 13 Chatsworth Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0LH, UK

reviews.text: I bought a chicken doner from Best Mangal on Chatsworth Road today and had a really bad experience. The person preparing my order took some precooked meat, put it on the griddle, basically fried it, and served it to me like that. The taste was honestly awful, nothing like proper doner at all. For the price, I expected something fresh and decent, but this was really disappointing. I won’t be going back.

Do not eat here. I went in and saw the staff picking his hands in my food whilst sharing my chips out in the container, then he ate from my food before giving it to me. I also saw the other man picking his hand in my lamb doner and eating a piece of it before serving it to me in my container.

It’s just unprofessional and dirty. I don’t know where your hands have been. Do not pick your hands in people foods and eat their food , then serve it to them.
Turkish take away open late to satisfy that late night kebab and chips food craving.  Good grill chef, makes a tasty quarter pounder also good portion size.  Chilli sauce is a little lumpy.
Ordered chicken donor and chips when I got home and opened my food it was lamb donor and it was DRY even with the sauces. I won’t recommend anyone to eat here.

Absolutely disgusting, alarm bells when I walked in as doner meat was dark brown and grill not turned on but I was starving and other two kebab places shut. Got home, meat was disgusting! Tasted like how a burning car tyre would smell and taste, meat was also crispy and hard I'm guessing it was from night before. £24 for three kebabs, I've eaten some rotten kebabs late night, but this was Sunday afternoon. Don't even think of eating from there!!

name: Shah's Halal Food Cambridge Heath Hackney
address: 297 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9HA, UK

reviews.text: The portion is large enough, healthy, compared to what I normally eat, overall I liked it, only thing I didn’t like is rice wasn’t hot enough. but the guys there were really nice and provided me with great customer service.
Amazing and healthy food and the service is brilliant iam regular customer but I can't stop eating for my lunch break

This is the second time I’ve ordered through UberEats at this branch and they have messed up my order. They NEVER ADD SAUCE to the food when ordering online. It’s so frustrating because the food is EXTREMELY dry without it. I am so upset that this has happened again. I won’t be ordering again, ever.

All I can say is thank you so much, This specific shah’s halal food never skimps out on portions and we always have great banter when ordering online. They treat me well and always make sure I get it extra spicy like how I specify it in the notes. They are legends who ever makes the platter it explodes with flavour. Keep doing what you’re doing lads you’re amazing. - Tristen 💪

I always come here after working out and oh my goodness it’s so good GENUINELY 1000000/10 everything about the food is amazing. It’s right next to the train station too making it so convenient. I got the chip platters and tried both chicken AND lamb, it’s so good. I really recommend it to anyone who’s just craving for some good food that’s £10 and under.

Food is very good especially considering the price, the couple that run the place as polite and friendly. Normally order Singapore fried noodles with vegetable spring rolls or special fried rice with fried beef with green pepper in chilli & black bean sauce.  The place seems clean and the food isn't greasy like some other places I've been.

I never write reviews but this is the best Chinese by far in London and I've had many ... this one is the best!!! So fresh all tastes amazing salt pepper prawns lovely cooked perfect, duck perfect sweetcorn soup perfect!!!

Yes it's new owners and food is bit different but I've had nothing but good meals,athe prices on some of my regular choices have gone down considerably but the portion size hasn't,try the chicken sate,the meal or the skewers but the meal is my favourite, can't speak English but always service with a smile Recommended.

Never had the chance to order food under the old management. Food we had was excellent quality and value with big portions. Very good crispy duck and ribs. Only complaint is we found a hair in the veg. Hair nets maybe?
Very good Chinese food is excellent quality service is second to none great people who run this great take away thank you very much

I would never go back to this Chinese restaurant. The food was too spicy, and I couldn't eat it. It wasn't marked as spicy in the menu, and I forgot to mention I don't want spicy food. The staff seemed busy, so I didn't say anything, and she didn't ask me either. How can food be this spicy?

Favourite Chinese hands down.

Every time I order, the food arrives hot, fresh, and delicious. Supachef nails consistency, portions, flavour, price and delivery speed - it’s rare to find a place this reliable. Cannot recommend this place enough.

Special shout out cause they even delivered a free calendar with our last order. They go above and beyond for their returning customers.

Found a hair in my food twice from here the first time I let it slide although this should not happen it sometimes does but to find a hair n another order is absolutely vile. Avoid!!! Will not be using again £40 order in the bin!!

Absolute Disgrace. Used Just Eat for this company. Ordered online. Paid through PayPal. Card charged. No order. Then try to get through to "Live Chat" only to be told by a damn ROBOT "I can only help with orders in the last 24 hours" Had that been some people I know they would have used that last bit of money and have had to starve that night thank to just eat taking money for something they're not providing. Utter Disgrace. And can you contact them ? Don't even try. Which ones the thief ?

Beware! This restaurant clearly doesn’t care about customers or their allergies. I asked for no mushrooms and still got food full of mushrooms. My curry was 80% uncooked rice, the food arrived barely warm, and I waited over an hour—only to be told it hadn’t even been cooked yet. Totally unacceptable.

name: Pizza Pizza Cambridge Heath
address: 479 Cambridge Heath Rd, Cambridge Heath, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text: Honestly one of the worst food experiences I’ve had. The chips tasted like they were made from the cheapest potatoes they could find and had been cooked more than once. The burgers came out burnt, completely charred, and inedible. As for the chicken… I wouldn’t even call it chicken. The quality was so bad it makes you wonder if it was actually pigeon. Definitely not somewhere I’d recommend eating.

Our local favourite pizza place. Pizza tastes good and they always have buy one get one free offer for take away orders.
Good service and friendly staff.
Reasonable prices.

decent back in the days.
just wasnt as good as other pizzas in east london but worth a try

Horrific experience... not only did my food come late but my pizza was burnt so bad I threw it away after 1 slice, the chips were also overcooked greatly,

I feel like this shop has cheated me
First time trying out here the service was ok, overall pizza was nice and hot therefore il give it a three star.

name: KFC Dalston - Kingsland High Street
address: 126 Kingsland High St, London E8 2NS, UK

reviews.text: The taste was really unpleasant, and it seemed like the food was from two days ago. Absolutely horrible.

I ordered 3 portions of fries and 10 wings and only one  chips arrived, 2 were left behind.
The entire order was cold.
It’s obvious that the chicken wings are not fresh at all, they were just reheated.
It’s a shame that in 2025 food is served with such carelessness!!!
The staff was rude and did not use basic manners such as saying sorry, thank you, or please. Take ages to prepare the food.

​I recently went to a KFC, and it was probably the worst fast-food experience I've had. The wait was way too long – like 20 or even 30 minutes – and they still were trying to figure out my order.
​To make it worse, when I got home, the burger was totally wrong – no sauce or anything, just empty. Overall, just a really terrible experience.

The only reason they get even one star it’s because J Hus was playing on there radio other then that BRO I ordered 2x the 6 Bucket & Chips family bucket, when I got home why did it look like it was a freaking kids meal 😂 the service was alright, the cleanliness was a unbelievable, food was too small. Please improve by Having more staff, keeping the inside of the store clean.

Ordered a few times from here.  Last night ordered a take away and food was awful & inedible !! Called to complain and was told to complain to uber!! Never again. Disappointed in their service. Posted pics of pale prawns, over soya sauced rice,  apparently the prawns aren’t cooked in the rice … they’re placed on top… absolutely tasteless…..undercooked chicken balls & vegetable spring rolls, and  dry ribs as lid wasn’t on properly and honey spilled out everywhere.

Unbelievable, I guess quality and risk management aren’t part of their business plans. Ordered chicken chow mein that came out tasteless and plain. Chicken soup that was clearly microwaved; the rest was completely tasteless but I guess I should have figured it out since it took them 2minutes to make the food. No hospitality or reality check or actual capacity to deliver. They are clearly counting on the main road appeal to make up their sales, to say no efforts is made on the food whatsoever or anywhere else. Never to go back, the reviews actually speak for themselves should have checked before going.

The food was COMPLETELY bland and tasteless and basically just microwaved.
If I could leave 0 stars I would.
Me and my partner ordered at the shop and once we got home and tried the food it was literally inedible, luckily we live close by so just went back to the shop and got the money refunded as we weren’t just gonna let it slide. (Not received the money back yet)
There was no apology or reaction from the man behind the counter whatsoever.
Terrible food,terrible service.

I had a very disappointing and unsafe experience with this takeaway. I ordered prawns but received nothing but flour – not a single prawn in the dish. The rest of the food was inedible and made me feel unwell. When I called to complain and request a refund, the customer service was extremely poor and unhelpful. I would strongly advise others not to order from here. I need to have this restaurant takeaway. They need to be reported to trading standards for health and safety reasons.I don't understand why this hasn't been reported.Or they've not been shut down. How are these reports identified by the right department?

I have to give a star, but I would have given 0 out of 5

Boyfriend has moved to the area, so we decided to try our local last week. We got the classic lemon chicken and noodles with a 1/4 duck to share, and it was absolutely lovely! With the level of business they had on the evening, we were thoroughly impressed with the service and hand-on-heart were only sat in there for about 10 minutes waiting for our food. It was an overall pleasant experience and we will be coming back for absolute sure. The girl working behind the till (on her own, no less!) was so friendly, efficient and made our evening. Kudos to her, will be coming back so hope I can solidify my status as a regular!

Ordered on Uber eats, everything was bad. Ordered 2 massaman curries, 3 prawns in each curry (containers were about 1/5th full). Chicken satay advertised as 4 pieces (received 3). Prawn tempura described as 7 pieces (received 5). Would not recommend for the price you’re paying whatsoever

Absolutely delicious Thai food!
I ordered from here for the first time and was really impressed. The food arrived hot, fresh, and full of flavour  you can tell it’s made with care. The pad thai was perfectly balanced with just the right amount of sweetness and tang, and the green curry was creamy and aromatic without being too spicy. Portions were generous, and everything was beautifully presented even for takeaway.
The delivery was quick, and the staff were polite and friendly when I called to ask about allergens. Definitely my new go to for Thai  highly recommend!

I got take away today the food was ok however, my only issue as when I opened my container there were hardly any chicken and prawns. I counted 3 prawns and 4 small bits of chicken. I was very disappointing as I was better off going to my local Chinese. If you want to waste your money come here.

I placed an order at 6:28 pm. At 7:30 pm, I contacted the restaurant to enquire about the delay, and I was informed that the driver was only two minutes away. However, my order tracker stated that the driver is at the restaurant and it will be 21 minutes.. When I pointed this out, the restaurant lied that the driver is 2 minutes away on their system. Immediately after the call, the tracker suddenly updated, showing that the driver was “on the way".

The driver eventually arrived at 7:44 pm. When I asked about the delay, he pretended not to understand English, but he understood English when he asked me for the delivery code. He looked Polish. I had already included a tip with my order, which, I was so annoyed about as I couldnt get the tip back.

Upon opening the delivery bag, I discovered that the drink had leaked due to not being sealed properly, spilling into my hot food and soaking the bags.

So my advice - do not order from here and if you must, definitely do not give tip to the drivers beforehand.

Fantastic Thai food every time!
This place never disappoints. The flavours are spot on  rich, fragrant, and just the right amount of heat. The red curry was incredible, packed with fresh vegetables and tender chicken, and the jasmine rice was perfectly cooked. I also tried the spring rolls this time super crispy and full of flavour.
Everything was well-packed, arrived quickly, and still piping hot. You can really taste the quality and freshness in every dish. Easily one of the best Thai takeaways around!

name: Lee How
address: 77 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 8EL, UK

reviews.text:
⭐ 1 Star – Worst Chinese Takeaway Experience Ever
This Chinese takeaway is an absolute disaster. I waited over 2 hours for food that never showed up. I had to cancel the order myself because their so-called “customer service” is non-existent.
ill have to wait 3 days for a refund,  no apology, nothing. The staff I did manage to speak to were shockingly rude and clearly don’t care about customers at all.
This place is a total joke. Save yourself the frustration — avoid this takeaway at all costs.
love getting salt and pepper anything from here, curry sauce is great and the women who works there is sooooooooooo lovely , Lee how 4 lyf

For sure NOT the best Chinese in Town.
I ordered a basic Vegetarian Rice and Spring rolls. Both ended in the bin. In store isn't possible to pay with card (???) Only cash. Maybe it was just a bad night, but... But for me it's a not anymore.

I mean, it was amazing! This is probably going to be my go to Chinese take out place from now on. I got Egg Fried Rice which was light but seasoned despite it’s pale appearance. The Beancurd in Green Pepper and Black Bean Sauce which was fresh and really good. The Chips were thick and perfectly done. The Plain Chow Mein was just what I wanted. Being able to eat big fat Vege Spring Rolls that tasted good from the top to bottom was tasty. Not to mention when it came here it was piping hot despite it being like 3 degrees outside! Great food and great service! I will be ordering again.

Went to Lee how out of chance because my local Chinese was closed and I’m so happy I did!! Egg fried rice and beef curry was so nice and fresh even the spice was there 😁 beef chow main was so good flavour and fresh. Will definitely choose this place over my local now I’ve found it

The 1st pic is , Double pepperoni , and the 2nd pic is just standard pepperoni , they almost look identical , does not like double pepperoni , would have been better off getting a different topping.

Pizza is ok
Terrible pizza — completely undercooked and a total waste of money. Do yourself a favor and pick a different pizza shop.
Great pizza and great service. Never had a bad pizza from here

I have been ordering pizza every Wednesday around 2 am and it’s consistently get delivered by 2.30 warm and hot always . Impressive services. Recently i noticed from last 3 4 weeks . The taste has became very good .. please keep this quality going . The pizza was delicious.
We had an issue with Uber delivery and the staff were really helpful and obliging to get it resolved. Really appreciated the service. Tasty pizza and VERY generous portions. Order direct from them!

name: The Kingfisher
address: 147 Homerton High St, London E9 6AS, UK

reviews.text:
This.is a great chippy, with loads of vegan options. The owner takes great pride in the food she serves;  consequently everything I have ever bought here has been delicious. (And I've been a customer for over 10 years!)
Prices are good too.

This is the best vegan fish n chips you can get. It literally brought tears to my eyes. I have never left a google review before, but I needed to leave one here because the food is so good. Fish n chips was one of my favorite foods before I went vegan, and I used to work in a pub and have eaten many fish n chips. I thought I would never get to enjoy it again, until today at the Kingfisher. This was it. Large portion, includes mushy peas, and the homemade vegan tartar sauce is amazing. Thank you Kingfisher for making this available and being so accommodating!

Such a wonderful experience. From the outside it may look like a regular chippy but it is so much more than that! The owner is absolutely hilarious and really works hard to run this place. The prices are definitely reasonable as for the food itself I've tried the entire vegan menu by now and honestly everything is made to perfection.
If I am able to add more photos later I shall only taken photos of the vegan fish and chips so far which my partner loves and he's half Japanese so it's a big deal to find fish he actually enjoys!

Amazing vegan fish and chips! I visited yesterday after reading some great reviews online and was not disappointed. There clearly has been a lot of care and attention into developing the dishes on the vegan menu and the owner took the time to explain the process in which she had developed the fish substitute, which was fantastic! Impossible for food to be bad when so much passion goes into cooking. Thank you for a great meal and highly recommended.
Fantastic quality food.  Chicken wings are exceptional.  Fish is fresh and cooked to perfection.  Definitely one of the best chippy’s in London.
Just had an exquisite veggie roll. Good prices. Can sit outside @ a picnic table. J'adore. Defo recommend.

Ordered from the hackney branch. Very very dissapointing. Avocado is rotten in half of the sushi. Also covered up with mayo, so the customer wont see it. Mushy rice.
Tuna sushi looks weird and never in my life I’ve seen such dull piece off fish in the sushi. Clearly going off. If we have food poisoning, we know which place to blame.

We order almost every week.  The food is consistently excellent.  We have never been disappointed.  My wife has an allergy, they care about it and make adjustments to accommodate her needs.  The staff is always helpful and kind.  We are lucky to have this spot close to us.
I am by no means a sushi expert, nor am I one to proselytise about food, but this place is absolutely sensational. Enjoy it!
Ordered takeaway and they were so helpful with my intolerances (onion and garlic) walked me through what I could eat and wrote notes for me too. Great portion sizes and so yum! Definitely recommend!

This chicken & chips shop across my place is honestly one of the best in the area. The food is always fresh, hot and delicious. Prices are very reasonable, and the staff are always friendly and welcoming. Great customer service and great value for money, highly recommend. Shop allowed customers to use the toilet.

Chicken was freshly cooked when I ordered and chips fried to order. My quarter pounder was cooked on a gas barbecue grill and tasted chargrilled deliciousness. Only problem didn’t toast my bun . I forgive ! On my latest visit 24/03/23 . I enjoyed a smash burger and some barbecue wings! Which is part of the new additions to menu . My favourite takeaway food. Just wanted to add to my review that the peri peri chicken I ordered on the 12/04/24 was excellent and a very close flavour to Nando’s ! The man that served me offered a house special hot sauce to make it extraordinarily delicious and hot ! A must try for hot foodies and I believe 1 of only 2 fried chicken shops in Hackney with a 5 star hygiene rating ! It’s just come to my notice that this pfc was used for the adidas glitch ad just before 2021 check out the photos

I am working as a Security in this area from couple of days. Went there twice and wasted my money and harmed my tastebuds as well. I bought Fillet Burger meal everytime but the butger patty was cold and chewy. After esting first time, today I went there again and asked the staff that last time it was cold and chewy, I could not eat. He said its fresh and then turned to other costumer ignoring me cuase I was complaining. I hoped that it must be fresh and atleast eatable. After taking first bite, I had to remove a part of chicken from the patty because I was unable to chew it as it was a long cold chewy chicken strip. I took out many of these chewy bite and attached the oictures too. Trust me guys, If you want to eat something there are also some Arab Doner shops or other Halal chicken shops nearby at Hackney Central. Don't waste money or eat unhealthy to buy from this guy at cheap price. Our health must be our priority, pay more but eat healthy and fresh.
I don't usually give feedback, but I always guve feedback and tell others if someone is selling awful food to save others money, time and health.
I am not going there again after trying it twice and strongly not recommended, you'll regret.
Chicken fillet burger was quite thin but it was good, chips were a bit oily. The wings had good flavour. Extra star for the nice server
Really good chicken shop. The food is always fresg,portions are big, and the price are fair. Toilet avaliable for custumers strongly recomend.

name: Garbo's Pizza X La Cantina Sociale
address: Garbos pizza, Railway Arch, 300 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9HA, UK

reviews.text: We got a table on a Saturday night without booking. It was pretty empty but the staff were really nice, thank you for that. There was lack of drinks and the fries were extremely salty. Despite that we had a great time and I would want to revisit. It has an outdoor seating too which is quite nice

Best pizza I've tried in a while. I spent my day visiting the surrounding museums with my partner and this was the best way of ending the day with a lovely dinner. Not only the pizzas are great, but I also recommend the wine and the coffee. And the staff is lovely and friendly! 10/10

I don’t even know where to start from.

A friend of us organised a New Year’s Eve dinner here for our group of Italian living in London. We had two different menu: one vegetarian and one fish based.

People paid £45-£55 for the two different menus.

The place was awful. There were not enough seats for everybody so this means the owner which is very not skilled for this job overbooked the restaurant and the people had to wait one hour to be seated. After that we had to stay very narrow and uncomfortable. There was no space even to walk out the door in case of emergency.

The staff was terrible, not mannered waiter, very unpolite, kidding the customers , not aware of what was in the dishes so customers ate things that waiter was not aware of what it was.

Not mentioning the food. It was terrible . It’s a shame for all the Italian people that work with passion bringing ahead Italian cuisine and culture.  The food on the menu never arrived entirely, what has been prepared was the worst food I have ever eaten. I ordered a fish menu. The tartare was quite acceptable but very cold because kept in the fridge for hours (I am not sure if the salmon was good I felt very sick on 1st January and threw out salmon). The “lobster linguine” didn’t have lobster and neither tomato sauce enough. They were terrible, cold, overcooked. A friend of us took “orecchiette with cime di rape” had basically the entire plant in it only warm and not cooked well. Terrible. The bruschetta for vegetarian menu had a raw aubergine deep fried (should have been) on a “fresella” and actually the menu had written “bruschetta” on it.

I don’t want to continue about the food . Nothing was good. 70+ people in a space with capacity of 35max people . Terrible.

Everyone was upset and complaining about bad service and bad food. The owner is arrogant and haughty. He claimed also some bottles of water to be paid and the service charge (when by law this is not mandatory at all!!! ) and he has not clue about how it works.

The sooner he closes the restaurant better it is for people and Italian in general to not be ashamed by this guy.

If I could have put -1000 stars I would have done. Awful. Terrible. Arrogant

I have been to la Cantina Sociale for a quick lunch break and I had a delicious puccia with octopus, it was simply delicious. What a like about this place is that they really make food in the Italian way and use first quality products, the octopus was super tasty and fresh. The waiter and the owner are very friendly, too. Will definately go back for pizza and a nice aperitif in the terrace. Highly recommended !!!
Super delicious, authentic Italian food - highly recommended. Pizzas are amazing, and looking at the chefs cooking in front of you makes you want to try all the dishes they prepare!

Disappointed. I have been recommended this restaurant for a long time and my local Asian restaurant has been unexpectedly closed, so I spent a score on some, the ribs were to fatty and lacked flavour, not dry enough. The rice was bland, so was the noodles. Couldn’t taste any seasoning and then there was no sweet and sour sauce/crackers which usually comes with the meal. This is not my first time there so maybe it was a off day but I was looking forward to some Chinese it’s a shame

I recently ordered from Chan’s Noodle Bar for a cozy night in, and overall, it was a very good experience. The food was hot and packed with flavor. We order Sweet and Sour Chicken, Special Fried Rice, Meat (Chicken) Spring Roll, Vegetable Spring Roll, and Fried Vermicelli with Vegetables.

The Sweet and Sour Chicken was well cooked, with a nice balance of tangy and sweet flavors, and the Pineapples pieces were lovely and sweet. The Fried Vermicelli with Vegetables, Chicken Spring Rolls and Special Fried Rice was delicious and not overly greasy.

The portion sizes were reasonable, and I felt the prices were fair for the quality and quantity of the food. The Vegetable Spring Rolls weren’t great but my partner enjoyed them. Personally they didn’t taste right but the Chicken Spring Rolls were amazing.

Everything was neatly packed, and the wait time was short, 10 minutes. This is the best Chinese spot I’ve ever had. Highly recommended for a reliable, quick and tasty Chinese takeaway.

Food is great. Fresh, clean. Have been the same people all these years. Same lady. I used to sit in as it was a restaurant many years ago before lockdown.  This is a no frills take away. If you want the frills, go eat a Roka in canary wharf. If you want good, clean, fast Chinese food in hackney. Come here. They also take card.

The best price to quality ratio! It was my first Chinese takeaway since I moved to London and I go there regularly. The food is like an older ford focus, not the best but will do the job well! When you have a rough day, it’s the best comfort food!

I am happy we gave this takeaway a try and we enjoyed there food .
The food was delicious and fresh.
Our food arrived on time and piping hot.

We will be calling up for a takeaway again and be recommending Chan's Noodle Bar.

name: Best Kebab
address: 166 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7HD, UK

reviews.text: The hygiene in this building is definitely an issue, stopped by as I had some work in the local area. I ignored the greasy look as its a kebab shop but then realised it was very dirty. My burger had hard pieces inside it which nearly broke my tooth. The sauce tastes off. Definitely would not be back and neither would my colleagues. This place needs some big time upgrading and change the quality of their food.
This place has been selling my 14 yo daughter duty free cigarettes. This is illegal and stipping our country from the tax it needs to run
Fresh tasty kebab. Friendly staff and decent prices. My favourite local!

There is no home made doner kebab the buy it in, the prices on Uber Eats and just eat are are lie. I asked in shop. The lamb doner is factory made. NOT Home made. The excuse they used is they ran out and was using factory made doner. But they didn’t take this off the app menu and on the app they don’t show home made vs machine made doner

Go Pinar Kebab or Super Kebab instead

Look at the replies to the comments they insult and charge £25 for a doner and chips, that is factory made!!!!
ordered Lamb Donner and chips...both tasted good with excellent service...

name: Hoxton Best Kebab
address: St Leonards Mews, 241 Hoxton St, London N1 5LG, UK

reviews.text:
In March, I went to this Kebab shop (after the flower market), having passed it earlier.

I don't often have kebabs, but the lunchtime offers on window posters caught my attention, and to the point - for what I paid, the value was superb! I had this fries & lamb kebab mix, with jalapeños to lettuce, cucumber, etc, and altogether (with sauces), I still had plenty left. The fries were hot and crispy, while the kebab meat was succulent and fully of flavour. For what I paid (just over £5), the dish was tied well together, and the shop's now also known by the name the 'Greedy Cow'.

I was recommended to come here to have their Lahmacun, and it didn't disappoint. Tasty and reasonably priced and easy to eat on the go - cest bon! Can't comment on any other parts of the menu but I would have the Lahmacun's again
The perfectly named Hoxton best kebab is indeed hoxton’s best kebab, my go to for the last year, great service and particularly recommend the lahmacun with mix doner
Nice kebab but a bit over priced for what you get, especially in this location but nevertheless, nice.
Had a delicious lahmacun with doner in a wrap. Cost £9 and very good size. £4 for a straight lahmacun without doner meat. Definitely recommend it. No seats so takeaway or stand and eat.

name: The Best Turkish Kebab
address: 125 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BT, UK

reviews.text:
So I went to The BEST Kebab. First time. Literally today, I was served by a guy forget his name..he had mafia style hairstyle slicked back , really cool! Let me tell you the service was out of this world, I said extra chillies, no issues, not 2 but 5..salad fresh ice cold! The kebab is the best I ever had. No wonder it's a celeb spot!!!

Amazing place, people and more importantly food!!!

Defo coming again when in the area, the small felt like a large.

A++++++++++

Hands down one of the best kebab takeaways around! The food was absolutely delicious — perfectly seasoned meat, fresh salad, and soft, warm bread that held everything together beautifully. You can really taste the quality and freshness in every bite…
The portions were generous, great value for money, and everything was prepared quickly without compromising on taste. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and made the whole experience even better with their excellent service.
If you’re craving a proper, flavour-packed kebab, this is the place to go. I’ll definitely be coming back again and again. Highly recommended!!!

You know how some tastes just stick with you? That's what happened after I stumbled upon what I can only describe as the best Turkish kebab. It was years ago, with my uncle, and I've been chasing that flavour ever since. I've tried kebabs all over the world, but nothing compares to the memory of that first bite.

The kebab itself was a masterpiece. The meat was wonderfully fatty and rich, with a texture that was incredibly soft. Each bite was a melt-in-your-mouth experience, a perfect symphony of flavour. They had a great selection of spices, creating a taste that was complex and deeply satisfying without being overpowering. This kebab didn't need any frills; a squeeze of fresh lemon juice was all it took to elevate it to perfection.

This isn't just a meal—it's a revelation. For years, the memory of this kebab has lingered, a benchmark against which all others fail. This is the one you dream about, the one you'll travel for. If you're looking for an authentic, unforgettable kebab experience, you've found it.

this kebab shop is nothing short of holy ground. after a long night of dancing, when your feet hurt, your eyeliner is questionable, and your soul is begging for comfort. you must make the pilgrimage here.

they serve the BEST turkish kebab I’ve ever had. no exaggeration. these people are masters of their craft, filling your stomach with warm, juicy, perfectly spiced goodness that feels like a blessing from above.

If you know, you know. and if you don’t… go. Let them do what they do best. your post night out self will thank you.

I had the “Side by Side” large option and it was incredibly abundant! The staff were very welcoming, the place spotless, and the taste was amazing. No overcomplicated flavors — just good quality meat that really hits the spot. Finished with a rice pudding, which was the perfect sweet ending to a great meal.

name: Sing way
address: 399 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5QS, UK

reviews.text: Theyre putting fake chicken in the food. I got chicken balls and it had chunks of so called chicken that were too big to come from a chicken. Looks the part smells the part but FAKE.  Im used to live on a farm where we raised our own cjockend. Its common sebse anywats. Never buying there again.

Regularly get food from Sing way and it's always been fab. And reasonably priced!  Faves are the Singapore vermicelli noodles. The batter on the S&S chicken balls is decent, good batter to meat ratio. Nice staff and food is always ready quickly. Atmosphere marked down because it's a waiting room but that's all!
Needed a new local Chinese takeaway and glad I decided to come here. Delicious and affordable, will definitely be back

Hi. It was my first time
Trying this food. And
Will not be my last
Good. Food
Good portions

We always have amazing service from Sing Way! They're happy to help with our dietary requirements and the food is delicious. Quick as well. Especially love the tofu dishes with black bean sauce and mixed vegetables.

The bottomless brunch was absolutely worth it! The buttermilk chicken was perfectly crunchy on the outside and juicy on the inside, and the breaded shrimp were delicious and the plantain fried to a perfect golden brown. The drinks kept flowing, I tried the Berry’s Alive, Guava Oxtail, and Apple & Lime mocktail, and each one was excellent.
The staff and bartender were fantastic, taking the next order as soon as I was finishing the last round, and the food came out steadily without long waits. Overall, great food, great service, and a great vibe. Highly recommended!

Daniel kept the drinks topped up throughout our bottomless brunch. They do not skimp on the alcohol! We enjoyed everything, especially the truffle honey mustard fried wings! We will definitely be back! Great value for money and the customer service was awesome.

This was hands down one of the top 3 brunches I’ve ever experienced. The food, the atmosphere, everything was spot on but what truly made it exceptional was the service. Huge shout out to Alan and Ray for going above and beyond and making the whole experience unforgettable for my family. Their attention to detail and warm hospitality really stood out. I’m already looking forward to coming back. Highly recommend!

Absolute aesthetic joy. Food excellent, drinks/cocktails so worth of pricing. A bit loud as there was a big group of young people but this didn't make my acode down. Bar men, waitress Precious were great hosts and caring team. Definitely place to comeback 💥❤️❤️❤️❤️🎉🙌

Came here on a spontaneous kind of night with my sister, and this place absolutely served! Firstly, thank you endlessly to our server, Gray who served us drinks on drinks every time we needed them, good conversation and good vibe. Food was amazing, perfect portion. I will see you guys again soon - trust me 💋!

name: KEFIL FOOD UYGHUR CUISINE 维吾尔餐厅
address: 151 Homerton High St, London E9 6AS, UK

reviews.text: Went for lunch on a Saturday, there was just another two tables so it was a little quiet on the atmosphere front, but don't let that put you off! I had the hand pulled noodles in soup with the beef and it was DELICIOUS. Just what I needed on this cold day. Super filling and good value for money. Prior to the noodles, I was given some bread and pickled carrots that came with the meal. The lady who was running the place was super nice and service was great, especially considering that she was managing the tables and cooking too! Highly recommend, will also be back when I'm in the area.

Having been to Xinjiang recently, the food here was very heartwarming and brought back fond memories of my trip. The restaurant owners are very hospitable and the effort they have put into preparing and making the food authentic and true to Uyghur cuisine is highly commendable. If you want to try Uyghur cuisine, this is as authentic and tasty as you can get in London; best Uyghur restaurant I’ve tried here in the last decade.

I popped into this restaurant on a whim and I'm so glad I did. I had the beef noodle soup and it was utterly delicious. The broth was flavourful and savoury, the beef was tender and the noodles were springy and fresh. It was honestly faultless and I'll be back to try some more from the menu when I'm back in London. The lady who was serving me was so sweet and friendly and the prices were very reasonable, especially considering the quality of the food. Thank you!

Such a gem of a find. the man who served us was so kind and friendly. we ordered a variety of food and it was all banging. would 100% come again if i’m in the area! the home made hand pulled beef noodles were great!

I got the beef noodle soup which was so delicious. Had to pause for a second after my first bite of beef because it was so much more flavorful than I expected. Came with a lovely salad and some fresh steaming flatbread. First time trying Uyghur food but certainly not my last!

name: Love Shack
address: Arch 298, 299 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9HA, UK

reviews.text:
I don’t often write reviews, but this experience genuinely deserved one.
We arrived late one evening absolutely starving, simply hoping to find somewhere serving vegan food — good or bad, we weren’t fussy at that point. Unfortunately, the kitchen had already closed, which was a real blow given how hungry we were.
However, what happened next completely changed the evening.
Both the chef, Jamie, and our host, James, went out of their way to look after us. Despite the kitchen being shut, they made the effort to prepare food rather than turn us away. What could have been a disappointing end to the night turned into one of the best meals I’ve had in recent times.
The food was exceptional — creative, flavourful and beautifully prepared. Hats off to Jamie for his culinary skill and generosity. And special thanks to James, who brought everything together and made us feel genuinely welcome — more like family than customers.
Outstanding service, outstanding food, and a level of care that’s increasingly rare. We’ll absolutely be back.

I absolutely loved the vegan food at Love Shack! The dishes were so creative and delicious, and the vibe of the place was fun and relaxed. The staff were friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. I highly recommend this spot to anyone looking for great plant‑based food and a lovely atmosphere in London

This is a very cute and welcoming place. The atmosphere is relaxed, the furnishing is cosy and unique, and staff is very nice. I had the Eggs Benedict and this dish was delicious. Highly recommend visiting. The place also organises events.
Loved our group meal at Love Shack. The restaurant was very accommodating, the platters were fantastic and varied, and we all left full and satisfied! A must-visit for vegans in London!

Love Shack is a cocoon of calm, unhurried in the best possible way, filled with genuinely delightful interactions. The drinks are excellent, and the vegan cheeseburger is among the best I’ve had. The staff are wonderful, from the owner James to the whole team, Max, Abi, Caroline, and everyone else whose name I may be forgetting. For my crew and I, it’s a must-go whenever we want to truly unwind.

Amazing! Our first time here and really enjoyed all the dishes, and service is attentive and prompt. Good price for tasting menu and a lot of thought has gone into the food / menu, really good quality tasting menu. And importantly for us it is dog friendly!!

Highlights were ravioli and focaccia (made in-house, so chewy and nice crunchy crust, perfect for wiping up all the sauces)

We will definitely be back again!

Angelina is, at its heart, an enoteca — and that spirit shapes the entire experience. A simple restaurant built around seasonality, an extensive and intelligent wine list, and a quiet confidence in letting ingredients speak. The food moves between Italy and Japan, not as a gimmick but as a conversation, gently challenging the idea of rigid authenticity.

We chose the set menu, which translated beautifully across these influences. Service was exceptional, allowing the evening to unfold at its own pace.

One of the best value meals I’ve had in London.

Japanese & Italian fusion with fresh and clean flavours.

Friendly and attentive staff and great interactions with the kitchen throughout service.

Highly recommended

Amazing to find this gem tucked away in Dalston. Blown away by the creativity and service. Love the simplicity of having the tasting menu on offer and nothing else. Very happy to recommend this place.

What can I say? Ignore the negative reviews here, cuz this might be a new addition to one of my favorites on London!

This Italian-Japanese fusion restaurant offers a 6 course tasting menu with 13 dishes, prices at £68pp. From the amuse bouche to the desserts, everything was well thought-through and creative, using a wide variety of ingredients, bringing out the best of both Italian and Japanese cuisine. A few dishes that stood out were the scallops on tapioca crisp tart in the amuse bouche, mushroom egg yolk truffle ravioli, and the veal tongue.

In terms of ambience, the interior design was minimalistic, with ample bar and dining table seats to choose from. Noise level was also low despite being lunchtime.

name: Lucky & Joy
address: 95 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text:
Haven’t been amazed by restaurant food like this ever in this country. From starter to main dish, everything was beyond expectations.

Everything served very quickly as well.

We even ordered pork belly twice to the table even though we were full, just couldn’t get over the superb flavor of it.

All the staff were super nice as well.

Cosy atmosphere, perfect music volume too.

Top!!

so nice !!!!! really good meal, staff are lovely too. my solo meal was 37 pound including tip but i came away with enough food in a box for another meal. would have the soft turnip with egg every single day maybe . and the sweet noodles !

Good vibes only! The music was top tier and we were the last ones out! Wish we could have had a lock in. The chefs paid special attention to my sister’s severe carrot allergy, even checking the stock. Isabella was an attentive server and was very patient in rearranging our seating. I’ll definitely be going back.

january 2025 // dinner 🇬🇧

i actually thought a lot of the appetiser dishes people said were good didn't quite hit the spot; however the mains we've tried were all very solid choices. The chasiu pork chop, clean steamed fish (a classic catonese favourite 🇭🇰). If they put the house chilli crunch with the peanut & sesame noodles i think that will rly round the dish up as the cold noodles were missing a hit of that background heat to it and texture wasn't very aldente/chewy in which I would've expected from a cold noodle dish as such. lo bak go (radish cake) is missing the structure you would get from steaming and panfrying the cakes hence the softness of it was not what i expected from it..

A variety of canto/chinese dishes, bits of everything the chefs found and liked on their travels. some were good some weren't 🤷‍♀️ but kudos to the chasiu and steamed fish which i thought was very nicely served and cooked. cute space decorated like a chachaanteng serving actual iced cold pints 😋🍺. Missing some classic cantonese oldies (80-00s) to really jazz the place up

- cucumber, tofu skin, guizhou chilli dressing ✨
- peanut & sesame noodles
- smoked duck + crispy noodle salad
- bbq hispi cabbage w/ house chilli crunch ✨
- turnip cake w/ soft egg
- wok'd aubergine
- barbecued clams ✨
- kung pao chicken
- xi'an beef soup w/ cat ear noodles
- chasiu pork chop ✨
- steamed sea bass ✨
- rice
- custard tart
- oolong soft serve ✨

would revisit: yes
reservations: walk-ins only
price range: £70 pp

This was so YUM!! All of the dishes were so so flavourful (esp the kale and aubergine), cocktails were also v unique and delish, and vibes were great!! I think this has become one of my faves in London
fast service nice food
Good service  and good food highly recommended
Burger is soo satisfying. Wings and chips is so freshly made. And the service is also amazing fast and appealing.
Hi the wings was the best I had for years best wings you will find in Dalston better than Dixys and Morley’s!
I was very pleased, the food was superb and the service was impeccable, everything was wonderful, thank you.

name: Mexican Seoul
address: Bow Wharf, 221 Grove Rd., London E3 5SN, UK

reviews.text:
We had an amazing meal at Mexican Seoul in Victoria Park and honestly couldn’t fault a thing. We ordered everything on the menu and every single dish delivered.
The Tuna Tostada was a real standout — super fresh, beautifully balanced and packed with flavour. Both tacos were incredible too. The Spicy Pork Belly was rich and perfectly cooked with just the right kick, and the Bulgogi Beef was so tender and full of that deep, sweet soy flavour. Proper flavour bombs.
The wings definitely deserve their awards — especially the Honey Buffalo and Gochu-Gang. Even the Korean Fried Cauli Bites were crispy and packed with flavour. The Elote Ribs and Choriquezo were indulgent and delicious.

Anna looked after us and she was amazing — friendly, attentive and made the whole experience even better.
The restaurant itself is spacious but still has a lovely cosy vibe. Great atmosphere all round. We’ll definitely be back!

The best! A fantastic Mexican–Korean fusion experience with incredibly delicious food. We had the bulgogi tacos, elote, chips with elote dip, and the wings. All absolutely to die for. Every dish was packed with flavor.
The service was superb, and the overall experience was outstanding. Thank you, Mexican Seoul, for such a great dining experience. We will definitely be back!

We had a fantastic Saturday lunch at Mexican Seoul. We arrived at opening with our 1 year old and were seated straight away and offered a high chair. Food arrived promptly and the buffanero wings were a highlight, beautifully zingy but still crunchy and not overly hot just for the sake of it. They were also accommodating by served the corn ribs without the usual chilli flakes and miso mayo for our baby. Service was very friendly overall so we'd definitely come again.

Where do i start… the vibe, the food and the staff were all 10/10!!
Best buffalo wings I’ve had in a while - they are not kidding when they say they are spicy!
We tried all the chicken wings but our favourite was the buffalo, can’t go wrong with them. Also get the corn ribs they were a great starter and super tasty😊

The only let down was the spicy margarita is im honest, it tasted a bit weird in my opinion.
But nonetheless great restaurant and great food. Will go again

Such a nice place, lovely vibes, good music, great service and super nice staff 🙏❤️🙏
Food was great, cocktail was amazing!
Felt gloomy, came here and it brightened up my day 🫶
Thank you

I ordered the beef pho and claypot eggplant. The eggplant was very tasty and pairs well with plain rice. The pho broth was good but lack a depth of flavour. The service from the staff was extremely good and definitely elevated the experience.
Excellent Vietnamese food, fesh & tasty, affordable prices, nice staff and good vibes.

This spot is a dependable choice for quality Thai seafood in London. The whole fried fish is well-executed, with a crisp skin and moist meat that isn't weighed down by grease. The accompanying lime and chili dressing provides a clean, sharp balance to the dish.
The soft shell crab is equally solid, featuring a light, peppery batter rather than a heavy coating. It’s simple, authentic cooking that focuses on fresh ingredients and proper technique. If you're looking for a satisfying, fuss-free meal, it definitely hits the mark.

We stopped here for dinner after a bushy cold day in London. The food was good.  Not exceptional, but very good. Very cleanly prepared and nicely plated.

There were four of us and everyone was very satisfied.  This is really good comfort food.

The soups are excellent. Try the pancake.  I’m not a fan of tofu, but fried in the pancake it was good.

I really enjoyed my lemon grass chicken, it was cleanly prepared, had some light heat, and was tasty.  The clear soup as an ending was perfect.

This is the third time I came back, mostly for the hot coffee, it’s a must try for people to come here.

About the food, I would highly recommend grilled meat, Bun Cha and grilled lemongrass pork more than the noddle soups (one of the best grilled meat).

Honestly, the staffs today when I visit were friendly. Gave us some recommendations, we felt really welcome. I hope them have a good Lunar New Year. Will visit again.

Overall, fantastic authentic Thai food. Having lived in Chiang Mai for 7 years, this is the closest I have had to real Thai food outside of Thailand. Location is a few footsteps from London Fields Station. Small branch with only 8 tables or so. Staff all polite and helpful but unfortunately understaffed. Only 2 slight negatives, kitchen is right by the tables so you will leave smelling of food, not a real issue, and quite pricey. Albeit the portions are huge, and I mean huge, our meal cost £93 for 2. Prawn crackers were delicious, very large portion and realistically enough for 4 person as a light starter snack. Satay was ok, but not exceptional. Thai squid was delicious, light batter with a salt/pepper/chilli coat, a must get starter. Pad Thai portion was huge! It only comes as a main meal, would be ideal if there was a small side plate version but absolutely delicious nonetheless. Penang curry was also fantastic and also the morning glory is another must order (although the leaf from the vegetable was removed which is the best part). Star of the show for me was the Thai holy Basil pork belly, exceptional taste, and spicy as it should be!! Although the pork belly would be crispy when ordered in Thailand, the meat was incredibly soft so it was just as good. Overall I would recommend Rosa’s however, do not over order ad the portions are huge and the bill will also be the same!!

good food and friendly service. drinks were great too (the lychee spritz is amazing).
it was SO cold inside the restaurant tho :(

Got the lunch special today and my taste buds exploded with all the flavors! 🤯😍✨ Incredible food, great and very friendly service and although the dip sauce for the corn fritters is apparently not listed in their cookbook (secret recipe 😭) I will buy it! 😁
Highly recommend you come here and taste your way through the menu!
I‘ll definitely be back soon 🤩🙏

I placed an order and what arrived was an absolute mess. The curry containers leaked badly, soaking through the paper bags and dripping everywhere (on my hands, the floor, and the kitchen counter). The bag was so drenched it was falling apart at the bottom from the moment the delivery guy wanted to hand it over to me.

What’s frustrating is the complete lack of thought that went into the packaging. You don’t pack food for delivery the same way you do for someone picking it up and going for a stroll. Delivery requires extra care: sturdier packaging, double-bagging, leak-proof containers, or at least a protective layer to contain any spills. None of that was done here.

To the store manager: I’m upset by this experience! You’ve failed big time, shown carelessness and a disregard for how food traveled from your kitchen to me as your customer. I spent so much time cleaning up my kitchen and the hallway, whilst trying to save as much food as possible. As such, I lost appetite because it’s hard to enjoy a meal when it arrives in such chaos. I won’t trust your place ever again!

A real gem!

Situated in the railway arches under London Fields station this place was a great find.

The humble surroundings hide a fantastic kitchen which serves up authentic Thai dishes served hot and fast.

We decided immediately on leaving that we are going back in the next few days....

name: Its All Greek to Me Shoreditch
address: Pod 1, The Oval, London E2 9DT, UK

reviews.text: Absolutely 10/10 food and service . Portions are larger than most and taste way better . Now my regular 👊🏼

Great food! Ordered from ubereats and it arrived warm. All dishes were DELICIOUS and they even left us a dessert on the house (which was great).
Thank you and we will absolutely order from you again!
Excellent as per usual. Tasty, on time and absolutely delicious! My fave place to order takeaway from and always giving the loukoumades as extra. Sending love to these amazing people

Myself and a friend made a quick visit to London and we decided to try out some greek food. Staff were accommodating and went out of their way to make sure our food was nut free. They were understanding of our allergies so I'm giving it a 10/10! Overall a great experience! Will be coming back again!
Ordered chicken lovers platter and the make your own platter. Chicken was delicious juicy and cooked well. Loads of fresh salads and pita bread. Free deserts on top. Recommend the place

name: My Neighbours the Dumplings - Clapton
address: 165 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EQ, UK

reviews.text: my favourite place in London! (As almost Londoner) - the staff are so lovely, the food is absolutely insane - feels like travelling to a different world, a yummy fantasy  - the duck special is absolutely insane. All dumplings are so good! And very pretty! ✨🩷🥟🥟🥟🥟

the pork belly is really crispy and tender, well cooked! and the prawn fried dumplings has this unique green seafood sauce, quite unique but surprisingly works well. its not you usual traditional dumplings.

The food was lovely — everything we ordered was really well done and full of flavour.

A small point, but our table felt quite cramped. We were 3 people on a table really designed for 2, up against the kitchen wall. Dishes were placed down wherever there was space and things felt a little squeezed in, which took away slightly from what could have felt like a more special experience. Given that most of the dishes are sharing, and we had booked in advance so they knew the size of our party, it felt very tight.

More importantly, when we arrived we were told there was a time limit on the table. That in itself is absolutely fine, but when I told our waitress that this should be made clear before at the time of booking - as we only found out about the time limit after we booked - she told us quite firmly that this information had been made clear beforehand. It actually isn’t and only appeared after we had entered our card details to secure the reservation - so too late to cancel without a penalty. It wasn’t visible prior to that - but she wouldn’t believe us.

As it happened, we were able to stay a little longer, which we really appreciated as we were meeting a friend visiting London whom we hadn’t seen in a year. But the initial insistence that we had been informed — when we hadn’t — wasn’t handled particularly well.

Just something to be mindful of: there is a 1 hour 45 minute table limit, which will suit most people, but if you’re planning a longer catch-up, it’s worth being aware in advance.

This place has been on my list for a while and I happened to be in the area yesterday so finally visited. The menu is very extensive with a lot of great things and new things to try. The waiter was so friendly and informative regarding the menu as my friend has an allergy and he knew straight away everything that she could and couldn’t eat which is so refreshing to see. The food itself was amazing, everything we ate was so delicious and great value for money. I’d definitely come back just for those lamb noodles!

I’ve visited this restaurant several times since it first opened, but this was the first time we were given a time limit (about 90 minutes).

The time limit itself wasn’t an issue. However, given that constraint, I felt the food took far too long to arrive. When the dishes finally came out, they were all slightly cold. As a result, we had to finish many of the dishes in the last 30–40 minutes, which felt rushed and didn’t pair well with the cocktail we had ordered at the beginning of the meal.

The pork dish served at the end was also too large, and we ended up leaving some of it. I wish the staff had offered a bit of guidance when we placed the order. In terms of both flavor and texture, it’s a dish that likely divides opinion, and unfortunately it wasn’t to my taste.

Although we were told toward the end that we didn’t need to worry about the time, it didn’t fully erase the frustration of waiting so long for the food earlier in the meal.

Having visited several times over the years, I would say that two things remain unchanged: the shrimp shumai wrappers are still not quite right, while the Madame Butterfly cocktail continues to be excellent.

Food was great, we got tower burger,grilled  quarter pounder burger and 6wings & chips.
The tower burger was flavourful, the chicken and hash brown was soft and cooked to perfection and the sauces made it juicy and flavourful.
The grilled quarter pounder was great too and the wings was nice and crispy. Overall food was great.
Service was great too, delivered on time.
We also got kinder bueno milkshake which was yum.

This shop should just change their logo to the colour pink, because thats how they serve their chicken. This shop better pray to allah i dont get food poisoning or they will be expecting a visit from health inspection.

Hardly any chicken in the burgers now seems to be getting smaller but costing more. Wings are dry and crispy like they have been sitting on the side for days. It has happen three times now will use another shop. Only thing they get right is the chips which are great.

CLOSED!

Although it looked like a fresh concept with young energy and a unique style, unfortunately this place was nothing more than a cheap chicken shop. Every time I walked past it, the place was empty and when I wanted to give it a try (actually 3 tries) the place was closing 2 hours before their advertised opening hours or was just completely closed in the afternoon or weekend lunch time.
Also lots of fake reviews: over 100 of them posted a week even before the place opened.
Probably the best value for money I've come across. The batter on the chicken burgers were great, real friendly staff too.

name: Escudo de Cuba
address: 20 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XN, UK

reviews.text:
Honestly this place used to be a hidden gem but now I’ll never visit again.

Had the misfortune of spending a close friends thirtieth here and despite booking a table in the main venue for 15 people we ended up in the adjacent pizza restaurant where the atmosphere was a mere fraction of the main building that we’ve been in on every other visit in previous years.

We did order food and the servers just dropped plates on our table and they couldn’t even tell us what some plates were. This wasn’t just reserved for food, this occurred for drinks too..

There used to be a DJ and a dance room but that has been relegated to a mere playlist.

Finally the night ended with the servers arguing over unpaid items on the bill. The servers charged us for items on demand and landed us with a bill at the end. Please just be consistent. All this deliberating ruined the night for the majority of the party.

Also please see the photo of the toilets. As a male I am generally used to a abysmal situations but I genuinely feel for any women that has to experience this!

To summarise, the impression you get is that the soul has been ripped out of this once gem for corporate profit - a real shame.

Amazing food and drinks which are unfortunately overshadowed by poor service.
I booked a table for 2 for a Sunday evening and when we arrived there was nobody present to greet us, so we had to approach the bartender who pointed us to a table. Once we sat down and ordered drinks, the short waitress with glasses immediately tried to take payment on the card machine, which really confused me as we were seated and about to order dinner. I explained this to her, but again this did not make sense, as we had booked for dinner and we were seated at a table after only recently arriving.
The drinks were amazing and fairly priced as they had the 2 for £10 offer on, so we had the basil mojito and pineapple daiquiri, both of which were soooo tasty and refreshing!
We ordered the 6 tapas dishes, the empanadas starter and plantain side. All of the food came very quickly and absolutely everything that we tasted was genuinely 10/10 - I can’t even say one bad thing about the food! We were so full after grazing at the food for a while, and we even had enough food to take a takeaway box. Our favourites were the chicken skewers, the wings and the plantain. Next time I will have to try the tacos as they looked really nice too!
Now onto the unfortunate side of the review… after our meal we ordered 2 pina coladas with another woman who was very nice. The pina coladas were so tasty, we decided to order 2 more with our original waitress, the shorter lady with glasses.
After the drinks arrived, for some reason she brought our bill over, which we never asked for. Prior to this, she had approached us asking us if we wanted the bill, and we told her no as we were still thinking of getting more drinks, and we were even debating getting a dessert. When she brought us the bill, I was very confused and asked her if they were closing, to which she said no. It honestly felt like she wanted us to hurry up and leave, which made no sense because we were still ordering and actively drinking our drinks. I have worked in hospitality for over a decade and it’s very much common knowledge to never bring a guest their bill without them asking for it, because you’re essentially telling them to leave, which can come across very rude and unwelcoming.
Due to this, we were a bit frustrated and felt unwelcome, so even though we wanted a dessert and more drinks, we decided to pay our bill and leave.
I honestly hate that I’m writing something negative because the food was UNREAL and if it wasn’t for the poor service, it would be 5 stars all round.
