But I just can’t ignore the fact that we felt like we were being pushed out of the venue, even though there wasn’t people waiting for a table, and we were not just sitting there not buying anything.
I hope that next time I come, the service will improve, as the food is SO WORTH IT!

Used to be a great authentic night with amazing customer service. Not sure what has happened with the change in management but after the awful experience tonight I will NEVER visit again. Booked a table 6 weeks ago and when I arrived they had no idea about it despite 2 phone calls to confirm. When ordering the food the staff had no idea what they were bringing to the table or what each dish was - what if we had severe food allergies.

Downstairs in the club room there was no DJ present despite there being 4 CDJs in the DJ booth when I asked about the music they said it was on a playlist for the night, on a SATURDAY night?! There used to be a DJ and the music was great.

All that to say I used to love this place but after tonight I will never be going back.

Finally visited after spotting it a while back, and wasn't disappointed.

Clearly popular, we got one of the last outdoor tables.

Service was generally good, although one of our drinks orders took over 20 mins to turn up, hence the 4/5 star rating. I'll put that down to them being busy.

Drinks reasonably priced - especially 2 for £10 cocktails. Food was delicious - choice of some authentic Cuban dishes but also pizza/pasta for anyone less adventurous.

Don't live local but will 100% be back next time I'm up that way!

We dined at Escudo de Cuba last night, and while the food and drinks were great, the service was an absolute circus. The restaurant was so overstaffed that it felt like we were being tag-teamed by a never-ending rotation of waiters.

When we arrived, we informed a waiter that we had a booking for five people. Instead of being shown to our table, we were passed from one waiter to another—I had to say we have a table booked for five people at least 10 times to different waiters—until we finally reached the manager, who seemed completely lost about where to seat us.

Once seated, we were waiting for two more guests, but that didn’t stop five different waiters from approaching us one after the other to take our drink orders. When our full party finally arrived, another wave of waiters swooped in immediately to take our food order. We had to tell different staff members at least four times that we needed more time.

Throughout the meal, multiple waiters kept trying to clear our plates before we were finished. Instead of feeling looked after, we felt constantly interrupted.

The food and drinks were genuinely enjoyable, but the chaotic and excessive service completely ruined the experience. If they could manage their staff better and give diners some breathing room, it would make for a much more pleasant experience.

The Ropa Vieja A La Havana was 10/10.
The barbecue wings and burger is so nice I wish I can have 1000
Juicy, cheesy, and full of flavor. Double smash burger did not disappoint!

Very disappointing experience. The grill food was not cooked properly from the inside and was still raw. On top of that, we had to wait far too long for the order. This is not acceptable for a restaurant. I will not be coming back.

Update: I've bought from them a few times now and on 2 occasions, ive had chicken that smelt off once biten into it. For that reason, I have to drop the stars from 4 to 3.

It's been a while since I had a decent sized chicken wing....all the other shops seems to have gone bonkers with their sizes and prices. I won't be buying from anywhere else. It was big and tasty, just how I like em 😋 😜 😏

Was charged £25.09 for 3 wings by knowing smiling staff... Witnessed cross contamination and extremely  poor hygiene practices check your receipts and your food ...

Really gone down hill after re brand. / New ownership such a shame I won't ever have trust to eat here again

name: JFB Jerk Grill
address: 181 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, Pond E5 8EQ, UK

reviews.text:
Really good spot for Jamaican food. The aesthetics of the shop is really nice, I especially like the outline of Jamaica with different writing inside of it using the Jamaican colours. The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting.

We ordered Jerk chicken with rice and peas, jerk chicken pasta, festival and a portion of plantain. Just a quick FYI they’ve jerk chicken pasta is pepper. Definitely went a bit overboard with the spice as it did not need that much. There was so much spice it was hard to taste the food.

The jerk chicken was flavourful and the rice and peas were cooked well. The festival and plantain were amazing, really tasty. I’m definitely coming back for them, especially the festival it was so sweet.

The only small downside was that a couple of items on the menu were not in stock. The price was not bad but the portion sizes are on the smaller side. Staff were really welcoming. Packaging was neat and the food stayed hot.

I’ll definitely be coming back to try more dishes. Such as the stuffed dumplings, Macaroni and cheese, and patty.
Honestly I don’t really go to small or family restaurants but this place might have made me rethink. Service was amazing, prices were ok but the food was AMAZING. Best mac and cheese ever.

This is the first time iv been here, I came with 2 friends. Iv got mix feeling about this restaurant, the staff are great and friendly here.
The reason iv given 3 star's for the food is because, I believe they can improve on the food. This is why iv given 3 stars, as I would like them to be one of the best carabean restaurants.
The jerk chicken was great
The planting is good
The fruit punch is nice
The rice and pea needed more flavour and moist.
The fried chicken was dry and needed more flavour
The curry goat was tender but needed more flavour
The jerk source was sweet not a fan of that jerk source should be all about scotch bonnets
The fried dumpling was average.
The coleslaw was disappointing to me it's not coleslaw, more like carnage.

The food is price up reasonable. Like I said I think you can be the best as you two ladys are great, il be happy to discuss this with you in more detail if you like.

I would be back for the jerk chicken.

Usually I put, if you think Im talking rubbish I would challenge eny of your chefs. But in your case I'm happy to help.
I hope you keep improving

Olgun Hilmi
Olgunhilmi72@hotmail.com

Been a few times now. Usually just get the dumpling with chicken and plantain which always bangs (also in my opinion has to be a contender for best value lunch in london).

Branched out and tried a few other things last time and everything was delicious. Curry mutton in particular was perfectly seasoned and cooked, left on the bone with tasty bits of fat cooked out enough to be nicely rendered and delicious along with the meat.

Also the lady that runs the place is very sweet and welcoming. Makes it feel like youre an invited dinner guest more than a restaurant patron in the best way.

All in all absolutely would recommend. Great value, delicious food, very welcoming vibe.

We really enjoyed your cooking. Really good food. I have never in my life had jerk chicken pasta and it was banging.The crunchy red peppers! And pasta not overcook. Festival crunchy outside and fluffy inside. Jerk chicken on point. Chicken soup was nice actual generous bits of chicken in it. And the curry goat was perfect. We were blown away.

We came for our anniversary dinner and had the best time. Unreal food and cocktails - honestly everything was perfect. Balance of flavours, fresh exciting ingredients and very friendly service (esp the lovely Caitlin!) They even wrote us a card signed by the restaurant. Would reccomend this to anyone that loves food and great vibes.

what a fantastic experience this place was - I came here for my birthday, and the first thing you notice is how attentive and friendly the staff are. the people serving our table were so lovely and talked us through everything from the set menu to the best wine pairings.

The atmosphere was very cosy, warm and welcoming, and the food was so so good! their cocktails were also outstanding and they were happy to make classics that were not on the menu.

10/10 all around for experience, food, drinks and atmosphere.

We came to Rogues. to celebrate our 6 month anniversary and what a superb evening!

Aurore was our server and particularly stood out as kind, engaging and attentive while not being at all intrusive. She really helped to take our experience above and beyond.

We had the light set menu which was delicious and very reasonable at 47£ pp. We were allocated the table for just over 2 hours and the service did not feel rushed at all, each dish came at the perfect time. The potato and thyme sourdough and day boat fish (cod) were the standouts for us but all of the food was beautifully presented and super tasty.

We also had a few cocktails and some wine all of which were delicious and very standard London prices.

Such a special evening and will definitely be back! Thank you Rogues for such a special evening (and the sweetest card, what a touch!)

Rogue is about taste and starting with the sweetness of their staff is already initiating something great.
The Negroni served in a French Duralex glass got me straight away. So many memories from childhood (when I could not drink alcohol obviously!!).

We took the set menu and the whole service went like a breeze.

For appetizers, the canapés were very nice. Then the prawn cocktail is an interesting one. The idea behind this weird British dish is fun but I would say that the taste needs more thoughts. It was the dish that surprised me the most by the look but was disappointing with the taste. Maybe it is not really meant to be "fine dining" but felt an outsider compared to other dishes. Fish was superb, only to be eclipsed by the salad with a demoniac ricotta salad. I would buy it from the restaurant it self !! The beef cheek was probably my highlight of the night. So many textures, tastes, that dish alone manage to bring some memories about a French dish called Parmentier. Big Bravo on this one.

The desserts were very nice, not being a sweet tooth, it felt not to heavy after all the prior dishes and ended that lovely journey.

Thank you Rogue, to all the staff, you hold a great story that will surely keep getting better and better. I cannot wait to come again for another chapter !

Ps : Pedro, I guess you know one of my relatives! Thanks for the Negroni !

This is the perfect spot for a easy but elated dinner. We went with the set menu ( full ) and every dish was amazing. We had a wonderful time, the people were amazing and the atmosphere was cozy. Highly recommend this place and we will be back as I was told their menu changes seasonally.

name: Zer Middle East Kitchen
address: 13 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BH, UK

reviews.text:
This restaurant is just great. I have been so many times both on my own and with various friends. And I am actually missing it right now as it’s yummy delish!

Make sure you go with a bunch of friends as it’s all about sharing the various cold and hot starter meze platters as well as the main dishes. This way you can try the different tastes and flavours from all over Middle East to explore and make up your own combo.

My pics are from two different occasions and show my favourite combinations. My all favourite and the staff knows is their signature dish: chicken in yogurt, pumpkin in yogurt, mixed pickles and rice. Although right now I wouldn’t say no to their tender  lamb tagine with rice, pickles and tabbouleh salad. It’s not all about meat as half of their menu is actually vegetarian and vegan dishes.

If you like cocktails then I suggest their spicy margarita or the zer signature cocktail. And I can assure you that one leads to another …

Enjoy your journey in this cosy little spot in London Dalston - Stoky where it’s all freshly made everyday. When a dish is finished then it’s finished for the day.

Dropped in before a gig at the Earth Theatre next door and instantly loved the place. The menu was refreshingly unique, with each dish clearly labelled by its country of origin—such a fun touch. There were plenty of delicious vegetarian options, which was a huge bonus. Service was fast, the staff were genuinely warm and welcoming, and the prices were very reasonable. All in all, a fantastic find. I’d absolutely come back again!

SOOOOO GOOD! The sautéed prawns And Aubergine were my favorites… the fish stew also very good and the bulgar and white rioja. Thanks for much!!!! They gave us a birthday cake on the house and some bread which was so sweet.. just really nice.. thanks again!

Decided to wait and eat here while waiting for a concert. I ordered the vegetarian option and I was not disappointed. I ordered something I usually wouldn’t eat, and it was fantastic. The ambiance was great.

a beautiful meal! food was super tasty and the service was 5 star. the lady that served us was very friendly and welcoming. we had 3 different meals, all of which were top quality and a great price too!

name: Jambay Kitchen
address: 171 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BP, UK

reviews.text:
From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was wonderful—cozy, inviting, and topped with beautiful, light greenery. It was the perfect setting for a relaxed and memorable meal.

The food was simply incredible! We indulged in tender Oxtail and Rice & Peas and succulent, smoky Jerk Chicken, complemented by perfectly fried Plantain and delightfully Fried Dumplings. Every dish was packed with authentic flavor and prepared with care.

Beyond the amazing food, the service truly made our night. Our waiter, Jay, was absolutely fantastic—attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely warm. The highlight of our evening was meeting the chef, Sophie, who was so kind and welcoming. We had a great conversation with her, which made the whole experience feel so much more personal.

If you’re looking for a spot with a wonderful atmosphere, standout food, and staff like Jay and Sophie who treat you like family, this is the place. Highly recommend!

We had some lovely jerk chicken, wings and festival bread! The service was spectacular, food finger-licking good and music stupendous.

Will deffo pay another visit!

I had an amazing time there, the staff is very welcoming and makes you feel at home, and the food was incredible ! I had a goat meat sandwich & plantains on the side, both were really good and perfectly seasoned.
I definitely recommend ❤️

We informed the staff that we wanted to try Jamaican food for the first time, and they kindly recommended the oxtail dish, which was amazing. It was full of rich flavors. The hospitality was excellent, and they really made us feel welcomed!

Ordered my food on Ubereats, and, again they forgot something. Usually it's the plantain, this time it was the very nice coleslaw. Hardly any gravy on the rice as I had asked for, so really needed the coleslaw. Food is very nice, but you need to pay more attention.

I don’t know who taught these cooks, but I’m pretty sure it was a Michelin chef. This is the best Korean food I’ve tasted in a while…

I wasn’t that hungry so only ordered fried chicken and rice, and even took some home bc it was a good portion. I wasn’t sceptical of the menu because theres SO much to choose from, normally this means the quality isn’t nice but here… it’s the opposite. WOW. Would 100% come again just to try other things.

Only tip I’ll give is: There was One Direction playing the whole night 😂 Not sure if that’s standard but I always like to hear Korean music or just a mix with pop. Also: couldn’t order a shot of soju, only the whole bottle. And it was me by myself so that felt a little too much. If you put shots on the menu for Soju Bombs for example I think it would sell!

Most kind staff too ! Thanks so much

Great tasting kfc, crispy dumplings were crunchy and good. Had the steak bab (chicken option over egg fried rice) which came on a sizzling hot plate, making the rice on the bottom crunchy and delicious. Service was a bit slow, but there were only two people working front of house, so no issues, and we weren’t in a rush. Also the amount of delivery orders they were pushing out may have had an impact on our service.
Will come here again next time I’m out east, lots of other menu options that I’d like to try..
such a lovely place. their lunch specials are amazing! you should definitely try the bbq as well. 10/10. thank you!

Lovely atmosphere, especially on a summer evening. The interior is nice and the staff were very welcoming, which made for a pleasant experience overall.

That said, it didn’t quite feel like an authentic Korean restaurant. The food wasn’t terrible, but it also wasn’t great. The kimchi pancake, Korean fried chicken, and chicken katsu were all quite oily and tasted like they had been cooked in old oil, which was a bit disappointing.

My main, the beef with black beans, was actually quite nice, but unfortunately not memorable.

I really wanted to like this place, but overall it was pretty disappointing. The service was just okay since we had to constantly flag staff down instead of them checking in.

Food-wise, the only dish worth recommending is the fried chicken, which was solid. Everything else fell short. The beef bulgogi was cut way too thick, the japchae portion was tiny, and the tteokbokki serving was just as small with an overcooked, gray egg on top. The BBQ did not feel authentic at all, and basics that should have been included came with extra charges. They did not even provide something as simple as an onion to season the grill. Also it's so dark that it's hard to see if the food is even cooked!

The last gripe is the floors are insanely slippery.
For the price, it is just not worth it. If you go, stick to the fried chicken, but I would not recommend much else.

​The cheese cauliflower paratha and potatoes were definitely a highlight, they are a staple while the rest of the menu changes regularly. For mains, the whole sea bream was delicious. We tried a few of their cocktails and especially enjoyed their unique takes on the margarita (with butter) and Negroni. It's a great spot for a date, and the staff is very nice. I definitely plan on returning soon to try more of their parathas. It's also reasonably priced.

Haven’t rated a restaurant 5/5 in a while but Shankeys definitely deserved it.
The service was great, attentive quick and friendly.
The food was exceptional, we ordered everything on the menu as it was 5 of us and have to say the lamb paratha, the chicken and the fish were the highlight.
The dessert was too sweet and heavy, I would have served it with a sorbet as a opposed to a cream!

Shankeys never misses! I have been twice this year and would definitely say it is my top restaurant in 2025. The cauli cheese is out of this world! The service is also amazing with the staff being super attentive and always ensuring you are enjoying your meal. Prices are super reasonable and not overpriced even tho it is a small plates restaurant - which is super rare in London!

The only thing I did not enjoy the last 2 times I have been are the potatoes- they don’t take my fancy but that is just a personal preference!

I will be back soon!

Don't be put off by the exterior - this is a really great little restaurant frequented by the people that know what a really chilled eating experience should be. The small plates are exceptionally good. A brilliant venue for a sharing meal with family or friends.
Great service in that special Irish way. They're happy to faff about with the menu to cater for gluten free people like me too.

I was out with my niece for a chat and drinks.  Always passed this place for many
years, just thought it was a type of cafe. We popped in not realising it was a booking system.  They allowed us in, and we had an amazing experience. Service was excellent, food was very delicious even though we just had snacking plates. Drinks 🍸 were tops I will definitely, returning as I live 2mins away. Have to take my sister think she would like it. I tried oysters for the first time it was a lovely explosion of flavours.
A gem restaurant on my doorstep.

Came for the soft launch of the new menu. We’ve been a few times before just for drinks and LOVE their cocktails. Great vibes, especially in the summer. Staff are always very kind and accommodating.

All the food was delicious, but what stood out was the desserts! The warm cookie with ice cream was one of the best things I’ve had in London. The pineapple fosters was also fab. Of the food, okonomiyaki and the Kiev nuggets were our favs.

A great brunch venue. Big open restaurant with large wooden tables foe big groups or sharing.

Food is good. We have market breakfast and croissant with salmon and eggs. Coffee is very good.

This place is so lovely, the food was delicious and the staff are great. We were served by Stephanie who was so attentive!
We all shared a few plates and especially loved the padron peppers and arancini. The flavour of the cauliflower wings was yum too!
The desserts are huge so I recommend sharing them!
Good atmosphere. Quite busy and lively. Excellent service even though they were busy. Family and pet friendly. Really enjoyed the place.

We discovered this place about 5 months ago and have visited numerous times with family and friends. We've eaten in the beautiful chandelier room, had drinks at the bar and outside, coffees at the deli, bought vinyl from the record store and even ordered a wedding bouquet at Rebel Rebel for my son's wedding. We met here for drinks on the morning of the wedding too. We would love to return to experience the night time atmosphere when the dj is in. It's light, spacious, beautifully designed, relaxed and seems to attract a diverse market, where people can work, socialise or just chill. Would highly recommend a visit

name: Caldera
address: Unit 8, Monohaus, 143 Mare St, London E8 3FW, UK

reviews.text:
Had a lovely time with my friends! The food was not too heavy but still filling. The mushroom tacos were really good, would definitely recommend.
Mar provided really good service and the ambient is perfect for a relaxing lunch

Really good food and great vibes. The pork tacos were amazing and the cocktails were on point. Big shout-out to the staff, especially Fra, who made the experience even better. Will definitely be back!

Food is great. Pork croquettes, pork tacos were good. Slow cooked rib was amazing, but the burrito was below average. Very poor service but I dont blame the stewardess since I believe that it is a managerial flop.  Only one staff was serving to 5 tables at the same time. She was also preparing the take away orders too. What is she? Superwoman.? Come on....!!!!

small portions, one prawn per taco? The sauce was spicy and a bit too much, took over the flavour palette and overwhelmed the tase of the black pepper prawn and guacamole. Otherwise okay. We came before 6 without reservations and were told we only had 30 minutes to eat. At that time restaurant was fully empty so I guess it fills up a little later. Great ambience. Got wings also, pretty great but one was rather burnt. Food is decent but portion sizes are relatively small for the price. The meat tacos are more generous but could have used more sauce.
reviews.author_name: Ngai Ning Yu - Fine Art Painter

reviews.text:
Francesca is bloody fantastic service she had great recommendations

Tacos are lovely

The dry age beef were so good we ordered twice

Will we be back Forsure

name: Corrochio's
address: 70-74 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XB, UK

reviews.text:
All of the food was amazing!
The taco with the bone marrow extra was expensive but worth trying.
The Tortas was my favourite and an absolute must!

Staff were super friendly, I didn’t get his name but the guy serving us (Aussie fella) really helped breakdown which options to choose an everyone we had serving us after were really friendly.

One we will be coming back to and recommending to others!

Gorgeous restaurant with delicious Mexican food and vibes! Loved it so much! Went for a friend’s bday, the service was nice and quick, food was nice, margharita was good, overall experience is amazing! I also liked the vibes, you can have lunch, dinner or enjoy the clubbing downstairs! In means of pricing, it is reasonably, good for groups, big and small or solo. Definitely a go!
Great food (Take it from a Mexican). Really recommend this place, specially the Taco Califa. Everything we had was super tasty. Also, they have a cantina downstairs Friday and Saturday!

This was a restaurant that I saw on TikTok and became intrigued because it was titled the “best place for Mexican food in London”. I hope this isn’t the case. Not because the food or service was appalling but because the place was only decent.

The best meal of the night for me was La Mexa and the Vampirios, Pork Carnitas (not pictured). These were the tastiest but only because everything else was under-seasoned. My partner and I regularly found ourselves reaching for the shakers and hot sauce.

I wanted to give a shout out to our waitress, Tiana, who is the only reason why I’m rating my overall experience 4 out of 5. She was hospitable, friendly and knowledgeable. Thanks again!

Amazing Mexican spot in Dalston!
Great atmosphere with cozy lighting, super warm and dog-friendly (inside and outside seating).
The food was full of flavour — spices perfectly balanced and great options at reasonable prices.
Drinks super on point too!
Service was outstanding, especially our lovely waiter Lucy who made the experience even better.
Definitely coming back!

Quite a good experience across the board. The space is decorated simply but there it at least some minimal spacing between the tables. The staff were nice. The menu was quite simple without any outstanding options yet everything was tasty: the flatbread with small plates, Jerusalem mix grill, pork chop were all good. Maybe I would recommend accompanying the pork chop with some potatoes as the side. The portion sizes were reasonable. I can definitely recommend this place as nice a small plates option

This is my favorite restaurant in Hackney. I've been here many times, and it never disappoints. It's a great spot whether I'm celebrating a birthday with friends or having a meal with my partner. The food is always amazing, with creative dishes that really stand out. The Jerusalem pitta is a definite must-have! In the summer, don't miss the fantastic gazpacho and the cherry salad. Their mezze and bread are always a good choice, and the wine selection is excellent. The the ambience is so cozy and always impecable. The staff are lovely and very accommodating, don't miss it!

Oren is a truly lovely place. Came there to celebrate our anniversary…. warm, welcoming, and calm, with a quiet atmosphere.
It’s a perfect example of how a restaurant can gain popularity and even Michelin recognition while still staying grounded. The prices remain very reasonable, portions are generous (mix starter on the picture, highly recommended), and the quality of the food is consistently high. Everything feels thoughtfully balanced: price, taste, quality, and the space itself. A rare kind of restaurant that proves great food doesn’t have to come with pretension or inflated prices.

This is a must try spot in east London. Dalston is not where you'd expect to go for exquisite middle eastern Mediterranean food but you will not be disappointed you made the trip. Try the dip combo to start with a fantastic selection of spreads and veggies with delicious hot bread. You'll want to order extra bread. The plates are good to share and they are delicious. The sardine flatbread was exceptional. Fish was perfection. Menu is pescatarean heavy but there's some meat on the menu. I would gladly return here.

Went for our anniversary dinner. Food was amazing. The staff made us feel so welcome and advised us extremely well on what to order. Special shoutout to Stan and Adam! The octopus was one of the best bites of food I have had in London

The food was tasty, we might come back in a few months on a quieter day. Didn't get to try the desserts we were looking forward to.

We arrived just after opening and we're the 2nd table sat. Over the next 5-10 minutes, 3 more tables came in after us. We, and the table sat after us, weren't asked our order (despite trying to give it) until 35 minutes after after we had arrived... Which was after the 4th and 5th tables to arrive had not only ordered, but already had their food.

There were a couple who arrived after 6 who had their food before we had gotten a single dish. Those tables who arrived after us had already eaten, paid, and left by the time we got one of our dishes, and once we got the first, it was almost 20 minutes until we finally got the 3rd.

The manager took my drink off after I asked for for the service charge to be taken off, which was nice. But we still had to go get some other food on the way home after how hungry we still were.
Absolutely loved it, lived up to the hype. Unlike other reviewers we had really nice, speedy service. The scallion pancake in particular was amazing. Will definitely be back.
amazing spot. i want to try everything on the menu. i really enjoyed the dan dan noodles and chongqing cauliflower, absolutely lovely

Thanks a lot for being so welcoming and nice making the experience of having dinner more enjoyable. We loved the food so much, you can tell is made from fresh ingredients and with love. Tasting and powerful flavours. Also we loved the cocktails! We I’ll be returning for sure.

This has got to be my current fav Chinese restaurant in London! Excellent food and so much variety. Only downside is that some dishes can be oily but everything was tasty nevertheless.
Recommend the scallion pancake, crispy cauliflower, stir fry cabbage, and dan dan noodles

I visited Mangal 1 yesterday and absolutely loved it. The food is consistently delicious, full of flavour, and very satisfying, especially considering how reasonably priced everything is. One of the best things is that you can bring your own wine and they don’t charge any corkage, which is incredibly rare and such a treat. The restaurant is always busy and there’s almost always a queue, so be prepared to wait, but it’s 100% worth it. The atmosphere is lively, the value for money is excellent, and it’s the kind of place you’ll want to come back to again and again. Highly recommended.

Got a walk in table for 2 Friday night, loved how quick the service was, the quality of the food and the atmosphere. I have no issue with tables being close together when there’s such a good loud atmosphere as you can’t hear other people’s conversations. BYOB is fantastic too, a bottle of white goes so well with all of the food here.

Would recommend: Adana kebab, Sarma and humus. The free bread is a nice touch too.

Definitely coming back in the future.
We got the Mangal Plater (for 2) and it was absolutely delicious! All of the meats- chicken and lamb were all juicy and tender. It’s definitely my favorite Turkish grill in London!
The kebab itself was delicious; however, compared to the area, the starters and meze were slightly below average. The price is affordable, and the quality of the kebabs is good.

I can't believe I have not Don a review for this kebab place.
Iv been eating here on and of 40 years, the decor has changed but not the food, the kebabs are great here. But the addana kefde is the best in England, all the kebabs are good here and good portions and very reasonable price up, but the addana kefde is exceptional. This time I had a mix. Aubergine salad was excellent. Turkish salad was great, I think you know what I'm saying if you want kebabs this is the place.

Mr Olgun hilmi
The International chef

had the BEST experience at morito on saturday for my friends bday!! im vegan and often have a bit of a tricky time at non-vegan restaurants with a big group but morito went above and beyond to make sure i was extremely well fed, being given a very generous alternative to every course that i wasnt able to eat! and everything was so fresh and delicious and the servers were so kind and considerate and lovely and yeah it was just amazing!!! happy birthday to minnie and thank you to morito for such a special evening xxxxx

I’ve been visiting this restaurant for several years and it never disappoints. Recently, I went to celebrate my anniversary with my partner, and everything—from the service to the food—was perfect. The menu is delicious, the staff are lovely, and the place itself is great. Special congratulations to the kitchen team working in view of the dining area, who bring such brilliant energy. I recommend everyone to try it because it’s undoubtedly one of the best options in East London.

A pretty exquisite meal in a cool restaurant. We were able to walk-in with relative ease for a counter table on a Friday night. Menu is quite extensive, would highly recommend the hummus, tortilla and lamb chops. The suelovivo bottle of red was also delightful. Will be returning.

My partner and I went here on a Saturday night. We booked with ease through open table and secured a reservation for 7pm. On arrival we were greeted by a lovely lady who showed us to our table. Restaurant was quite cramped as people kept brushing off my partner.
Food was good- however pricey. Portion sizes could be more generous however very tasty. We had the bread basket, houmous, labneh, beef, octopus and chocolate mouse. My partner had a half pint (the only option available) and I stuck to tap water. The total came to approx £90, which again was on the pricier side.
Dessert was disappointing, we shared a chocolate olive oil mousse which lacked flavour.
Service was good and staff were attentive.
Overall it was still a pleasant experience with a good atmosphere!!

Came here today for my birthday with my mum for the first time, it was amazing! Our waitress was so knowledgable and shared so many lovely stories about the wines (I didn’t catch her name!) and the food was perfect. Patatas Bravas especially, the best I’ve ever had. Thank you for a lovely evening!

name: Del74 Tacos
address: 129 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text: Came here around 18 months ago and had a really good experience. Recently came back and tried the bottomless tacos & drinks - really nice flavours and really tasty. Drinks were great, portion sizes were good! Leona served us, she was really accommodating, knowledgeable about the menu, really friendly, smiley and went above and beyond. Really great experience, great east London spot, would recommend 💯

Lovely vibe, music, and.... Food! (I'm vegetarian and the cauliflower taco is out of this world!) Enrique the owner seems more interested in making friends with you than making money. Will absolutely come again!
Had a great experience at Del Tacos, the waitress was very attentive and kind. The food was amazing and so were the cocktails, will definitely come back! Affordable too!

Really great experience, delicious food and really friendly owner. Service only a little down because we had to wait a while before we ordered and were actively looking around for someone a few times - it was busy though! The tacos were delicious, I think we pretty much tried them all. Atmosphere is fun and vibey but loud, so just be prepared for high energy if it’s a busy time as the tables are close together!

Great night at Delta74! The music, vibe and food was so good especially the steak quasadias and the bean dip. Drinks are delicious. The tahini dusting on the rim of the mango margarita is everything you need after the food. I will definitely come back.

We had a dinner party facilitated by David’s amazing team (Vy, Julio, and their amazing chef) The first time we solicited professionals for an elevated experience and unsure if the costs would merit.

Suffice to say, we were BLOWN away by Bistrotheques food, service and exceptional vision. They curated an entire *experience*, from canapés, to drinks to mains and dessert. Every guest left with glowing reviews.

If you’re looking for a premium experience then I recommend these fine people heartily. It’s worth an investment if you truly want something memorable.

Faultless service and a chic open kitchen bistro ambience. The highlights of our meal were definitely the steak tartare and the ginger sticky toffee pudding (that caramel sauce was insane). The burger was a bit overcooked and a bit of a letdown. Pleasantly surprised to find a chilled red by the glass.

The food here is lovely, a carefully curated menu that is executed perfectly! Everything we had was fresh and tasted amazing - please bring back the leek fondue pie as we couldn’t try it and I had so been looking forward to it. The service was absolutely lovely as well, everyone was very friendly and attentive - also the cocktails were fab and came out insanely fast! Only one thing I’d change, a bit of music would have made the atmosphere even better. But overall can’t wait to come back!!

We’ve been going to Bistrotheque for years and it’s become a real favourite of ours. It’s the place we bring friends and family, celebrate birthdays, and where we’ve spent New Year’s Day six years in a row. The food never disappoints, the service is consistently welcoming, and it somehow manages to feel both special and relaxed every time. We honestly couldn’t recommend it enough.

Everything we tried was great and interesting. Their staff were incredibly friendly as well. I’d recommend coming with a bigger group so you can try more from their menu, but their atmosphere is also great for couples. Will definitely come again!

Came in with my mum and I ordered the Nutella pancakes and she ordered a smash burger. We were both left thoroughly impressed by not only the food but the warm, inviting atmosphere and excellent customer service. The burger and house made sauces were delicious. The fruit that came with my Nutella pancakes is locally sourced and organic which is amazing and rare to see! The lattes we ordered were also excellent, and came with beautiful latte art. Overall I can confidently recommend for any occasion and person, as the menu is extensive and all menu items are freshly prepared and come plated beautifully.

Absolutely fantastic! Could not be happier with my meal or the service. I have never been so happy to eat, beautifully presented, fresh and amazing quality and delicious. Will 100% be back! (Update, I’ve now been 3 times)

Great new eatery in Hoxton Market tried it out on a friends recommendation and wasn't disappointed friendly welcoming staff nice decor and an extensive food selection for all day eating.
I tried the Calamari for starters which was cooked perfectly and then on the Chefs advice I tried the Chefs signature Burger which came with curly fries and a coleslaw and was delicious.
All in all a real nice late lunch and I cant wait to go back and work my way through the menu.
Keep up the great work team.

Stopped by Breeze Bistro and Lounge today and it was such a lovely find. Great coffee, delicious food and really reasonable prices. The staff were genuinely friendly and welcoming, the interior is bright and inviting, and it’s got a really nice vibe. Such a lovely addition to the area. We’ll definitely be back.

The evening at Breeze was wonderful! The food was excellent and cooked with a lot of passion. The atmosphere is cosy and inviting. You can sit outside or inside. Both the chef and the staff were extremely friendly and attentive.
The price was also more than fair for such delicious food.
Definitely worth a visit! We'll be back and will try the breakfast too! Thank you very much! :)

name: Melody Brunch & Bistro
address: 483 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text:
I recently visited Melody Brunch & Bristo, and it was such a lovely experience! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere felt warm, welcoming, and beautifully set up.

The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish was presented so nicely and tasted just as good as it looked. The flavors were fresh, well-balanced, and clearly made with care. Whether you're going for something sweet or savory, there are great options to choose from.

Thank you Irem and your family for your wonderful service!!!

Mamma’s Brunch – The Trio (twice a month, regulars!)
Three friends have been brunching every other week for a few years, trying different spots across East London. About six months ago, we discovered this place—and we haven’t been anywhere else since.
The vibe is super chilled and cozy. Zaynab and Hasan are amazing: incredibly friendly, welcoming, and they often treat us to free cheesecake, which is always a win.
We’ve tried almost all the breakfast items and every single one has been delicious. The Turkish dishes are especially authentic and full of flavour.
My go-to dish is the chicken and waffles—the chicken is cooked to perfection and the waffles are spot on.
For drinks, I highly recommend the pistachio latte and the Spanish latte.
Overall: fantastic service, a warm and inviting atmosphere, and consistently delicious food. A true brunch favourite.
My favourite breakfast spot. The best food and service and such a lovely family owned restaurant. Can’t wait to return already. Recommend the Mediterranean breakfast and the French toast!

Absolutely incredible brunch!! Everything was so delicious and really generous portions ! Staff are super friendly and even bought out some cake for my brothers bday on the house! This place should have a queue that goes all the way down the street.

Amazing food, great service, family friendly atmosphere, a must visit if in the area. Not at all near where we are staying, but we were in the area and the menu looked amazing. It absolutely did not disappoint! So glad we stopped in! My girls loved the food as well, which you can't argue with. My wife and I (dishes pictured) have had many similar dishes, but these were truly spiced to perfection. Feels very "home made." The service is very laid back, in the best way possible. Kid friendly and accommodating. Worth the visit if you can make it. It's no wonder it had a nearly 5 star rating. Happy to contribute to it!
New gem in Dalston, good quality and friendly staff.
A fantastic find in Dalston!
Hi I have ordered the duck meal and it was amazing!!! Five star rating and value for money
Ordered a Penne Pasta Mushroom with Chargrilled Chicken, Chicken was good, fresh and a nice char without making the chicken dry, Pasta was soft and a very good portion

Excellent find! While in London, I discovered this restaurant and was pleasantly surprised by this French bistro, which offers very tasty dishes at affordable prices. I 100% recommend it. The staff is very welcoming. You can come with family or friends; you won't be disappointed! Thanks again, see you soon! 👌🏼

Came here for some lunch, and got carrot soup and a lemonade as a meal deal for 7£. The soup was delicious and our server was super nice and friendly. Few people and relaxing atmosphere. There was a piano which they said we could play on but I didn't dare to because I'd ruin the jazz music in the background

They have an amazong lunch menu comes with a can of drink and sandvich. We followed with tea and coffee and both came with gingerbread. It is a cozy space, easy to focus, read or study. Team is also lovely!

Visited at 4pm and the kitchen was already closed. But after the chef heard that we were here for the brunch, she re-opened the kitchen just for us and even kindly recommend us a fabulous dish which we really enjoyed. Everything was perfect, and planning to revisit!

This cafe was such a lovely surprise! The smell of freshly baked bread draws you in, and while it seems like just a coffee shop at first, there’s actually an Italian food and drink menu. The dinner I tried was delicious, and the service from Sam and George was fantastic - they created such a warm, welcoming atmosphere and really bring the place to life. I can’t wait to come back and try more from the menu!

The service is good, the pastry’s generally delicious, and the coffee well-made. I've been a few times and whether its take away or I'm sitting for a bit and reading, its become a reliable spot for me.

name: Ayva
address: 197 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EG, UK

reviews.text: Really lovely place, lot bigger than I thought, with a lovely area at the back. Went here for a local birthday brunch. Staff were very friendly & the food was plenty & good. My friend even got a complimentary slice of cake for her birthday.

Super sweet people putting love and care into the food and service. A little gem in Hackney.

Cheesecake is Devine made in house.

Food comes with sides, pickles, bread, spice.

Every detail is cared for.

Visited this cafe with my friends today.The food was great! We ordered panini, bang bang prawns, burger and pancakes. Had a hot drink on the side. The staff are very friendly and accommodating. The atmosphere inside was cosy, clean and warm. We sat in the garden at first. They have heaters and blankets outside. Then we moved inside which was much warmer and felt like we were at home. Overall we had a lovely time and I will definitely be visiting again.
Fabulous breakfasts’s served food was delicious great portions. Tea on point. Lovely family run cafe. Highly recommend

I was staying in Clapton with my family for 5 days and every single day we went to get breakfast here, and I’ll tell you what..IT WAS AMAZING!! The food was absolutely delicious, everything was fresh, cooked perfectly overall amazing. We felt welcome when we were there, the staff were so friendly and polite 💕 the atmosphere made our days better. I would recommend going there and trying the food because it’s just delicious, they also have reasonable prices which is a huge plus! In summary dining there was a great experience, would totally go back when we visit 🥰
First! 🔥
Second!

We took a day off work to try Teal and we weren’t disappointed! We loved the location, not being locals, it was good to discover a new part of London. The restaurant feels like it’s been there for years and felt very homely. The menu was explained well to us and was full of choice. The dish of snails and bone marrow was a must try and was delicious and the asparagus tart was full of flavour. The lamb and haunch of deer were beautifully cooked. The desserts were fabulous. We marvelled at the lightness of the marmalade ice cream sandwich and I was delighted with the raspberry teacake. It was the perfect way to spend time together. Thank you to Sally and the team for making us feel so welcome; we will be back!

I remember Sally Abe’ cooking from the Harwood Arms days, and she is really good. This new venture confirms her incredible skills in treating the ingredients she chooses respectfully, letting the dishes speak for themselves. I ordered 2 starters, the bone marrow with the snails, and the knife and fork bacon, followed by the haunch of deer. With the starters I had a glass of the Josep Grau Granit, the perfect white wine to pair with both of them. When the haunch of deer arrived I followed again the waitress suggestion for the pairing, and went for the La Brune Pinot noir, another great wine that was faultless and perfectly paired with my main course. I ended the meal with the penny lick and the rhubarb jubilee. The food is fantastic; I loved the knife and fork bacon starter, it was earthy, punchy, astonishingly good. I did not like the bone marrow with snails as much as the bacon starter. Don’t get me wrong, this is still a good dish, but it is not as sublime as the bacon. The main course, the haunch of deer, was stratospherically good, the cavolo nero together with that meaty morsel and that sauce it came with, was one of the best dishes I had in the last 34 years of my London life. The penny lick is a cute idea, but  the temperature of the ice cream was a bit too cold and the ice cream inside was not quite as good as I was hoping it to be. The Rhubarb Jubilee, however, was delightful, one of the  best desserts I had in a very long time. I will definitely go back to sample the rest of the menu. The service was also really good. Thank you guys, I will definitely come back ASAP.

I live locally and was delighted to hear of the opening of Teal - my friends booked us in and it really is a gem of a restaurant - whilst small, I think they’ve optimised the space well . The food is fantastic and at times spectacular - check out the ‘savouries’ and Asparagus tartlet - great wine and warm , attentive, knowledgeable service without being stuffy. The other diners all seemed to be relishing the experience as much as we were which made for a collective joyous evening !

name: The Bourbon
address: 387 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5QR, UK

reviews.text:
What a great place. Went there on a Friday evening for dinner, having heard so much about this. It was lovely but not crowded. People there were very friendly and service was fast, despite there being only two people working there (at one point they were literally running).

Didn't get to sample any bourbon, but a couple of Pabst Blue Ribbon. We also had their signature burger, which comes with old bay fries. Both were really good. We also got the jalapeño poppers, which were ok, but not our favorite thing there

Would definitely go there again, maybe try their chicken wings next time.

I went to The Bourbon on a Saturday evening in January. The bar was full which played into the US dive bar vibes, which was cool. Was plenty of space elsewhere to sit.

I went for ‘The Philly’ burger, which is their house smash burger + steak, cheese & jalapeños. The burger was reaaaally good, great flavours and loved the bun.

I wasn’t a fan of the Old Bay seasoned fries to be honest. Also had some chicken tenders & tater tots which were alright!

If I’m in the area I’d definitely come back for pints + a burger!

Great place to come and drink bourbon (obviously). We came on a Friday night after dinner. The place was busy but there were a couple of tables free. We asked the barman for bourbon recommendations and his recs were great. He was very knowledgeable on the different bourbons and could explain what made them special. They have a good looking cocktail menu too. We will definitely come back!

The reviews you will read on here do not lie. My husband and I just moved into the area and we are so happy we found this place . The burger I had tonight was one of the best burgers I have ever had! You will also find a very authentic American dive bar experience with a bartender who makes amazing cocktails. You must go here !

Love this place and visit frequently. Dom (the owner) is a fantastic host/mixologist always making us feel very welcome and catering to what we like. Food is great, love the chicken burger and the classic! Highly recommend, don’t miss out on a hidden gem ☺️

name: Hand of Glory
address: 240 Amhurst Rd, Lower Clapton, London E8 2BS, UK

reviews.text:
Incredible pub, I come here almost everyday! Delicious roasts, the pork belly actually had crispy crackling. Bar staff are so cute, fun and kind. Always fun to have a boogie! Will the loo roll holders ever be fixed?! Probably not, but I don’t even care.
Legendary pub all round

Really great, cozy neighborhood pub.  I wanted to get hammered but I ate a huge Italian meal before hand and just was able to knock down only one IPA.

Well, I’m going back for more.  Next time I’m going to dive into the 12 quid shot menu.  Three shots for twelve quid. I’m in!
Very enjoyable experience with my mates, food was slow and could’ve been better vfm however very good pint prices and good df

Booked a table for a birthday for 6pm. It was gonna be 10/12 of us but we booked one table only precisely because we didn’t want to get in the way of business. We arrive at 6pm and they inform us they had double booked themselves because “bigger” parties booked, so we will have no table come 8pm. Now, I can accept the mishap, except that EVERY booking they had was overblown - a party of 5 booking for 12 to have two tables, a party of 20 booking for 40 to have 6 tables. Instead of kicking us out, they could have recognised their mistake and asked one of these overblown bookings to give up one table and we could have all enjoyed our night without kicking anyone out. Ridiculous, and will make sure I never set foot here again.

Had the best festive meet up here, great decorations, lovely live folk jam session and one of the best burgers I’ve had this year! The food from meat stop is unreal and worth a visit here alone. Come for the food stay for the vibes!

name: The Hawke Pub
address: 235 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7HD, UK

reviews.text: Possibly the best Sunday roast we've had in a very very long time! Everything was absolutely delicious, cooked to perfection and so tasty. Great and attentive service too, we'll definitely be back now that we've discovered this gem. Highly recommend.

Best roast I’ve ever had! Smokey chicken unlike anything I’ve had before, with beautiful charred veggies. Out of this world! If I was being picky, the Yorkshire was a little crispy and a few beers weren’t being served which was a shame. All in all ridiculously good though!
A really lovely cosy spot half way between a restaurant and a pub. Incredible food, lovely staff and nice buzz. Little garden out the back and phenomenal Sunday roast. Highly recommend.

Banging food, incredible roast. Place was too busy for them to handle, bit of a shit show from start to finish. Winning absolves all sins, go for great food but expect chaos and confusion as a side dish.

Equivalent to the most expensive roasts I’ve had (Hawksmoor) and the least amount of food. £28 shoulder of lamb with three slices, three potatoes and a Yorkshire hiding some cabbage. No salt and pepper or sauces offered. The big carrot was fine, but I was waiting for some seasonal veg to arrive. A small and very expensive portion that reminded me why I like the expensive but reliable places. Shoulder of lamb is certainly a little misleading on the menu. Service a little rushed but I understand that. Asked for a bottle of red and was brought two glasses and then a bottle on top with no acknowledgment of the mix up, an expensive visit.

I came here by myself the other night and sat at the bar & WOW, just WOW.

I felt so welcomed by the staff especially the bartenders! Shoutout Johnny and I didn’t get the name of the other bartender, but they truly made the experience.
Now for the food…I ordered the Caesar salad, which was I think the best Caesar salad I’ve ever had. I then got the steak n frites, blown away. I will def be returning.
Ive been coming to this bar since day one, they now have a chef back in the kitchen and the food is incredible. Looking forward to coming back for the next menu. Drinks as always impeccable.

Each member behind has invented their own cocktail. This isn't just some gimmick, the drinks are genuinely good. I've only had 2 but I want to go back and try more

Place was buzzing with clientele

I felt very cool sitting on the bar

Excellent establishment
Feels like your neighborhood bar while being a very good cocktail bar. I absolutely loved my drink. I got the Fern. Really good vibe.
Cracking martini and some delicious steak. Couldn’t ask for much more. Every member of staff was lovely, too. Coming back for sure.

This place is an absolute gem — the food, wine, beer, everything is top-notch! Ever since I discovered it, I’ve been coming here twice a week. The owner is incredibly friendly, and the tapas are honestly some of the best I’ve had. I’d say it’s easily one of the top bars in Dalston. Highly recommended!

Have popped in a couple times now and honestly Tee is the most wonderful and hospitable owner and host you could get! I popped by one night searching out bars in Dalston to host my 30th and thought the setup of hers would be perfect and I couldn’t recommend enough! We had over 20 of us sit down for food before and then an additional 50 evening guests for the party and her and her team really went above and beyond for us all! I loved the cocktail she made for me for the evening and she even decorated for my theme - so sweet! Drinks and vibes were great, plus my friends felt the same - she even chased out the odd gatecrasher who wanted to join the party haha . Thank you Tee and team!!! ❤️❤️

Spending Friday night at Teez was the perfect way to unwind from the week. The food was delicious, the drinks were made with so much care, and the atmosphere was excellent! Highly recommend! Thank you Tee!!
Amazing food and tee is a very lovely person very talkative and very kind and the food is the best and drink this place this one of the best places

I hired this place for my mans 40th and it was  perfect!! Very beautiful place. Has lots of room. Great sound system and most of all a great owner who was so helpful and accommodating to us all night.
Will definitely be using this space again.

Staff are very friendly the food was lovely. I had the buffet food wasn't sure when I ordered it if it would be enough but there was plenty & loads left over. The hall we had was good overall we all had a very good night celebrating my son's 18th birthday. They allowed me in earlier so I could decorate! We had the room 5pm -12 am . We had a drinks package beers and aperol spritz they were there as we arrived & the food was brought up at the time we set .
I would recommend having a party @the Crown pub.

It is my new favorite Sunday roast in the west end/mile end/Victoria park area. We came around 1pm on a Sunday and were able to score a table on the terrasse. The food was ready in about 15 mins which helped a lot since we were in a hurry this time. We go to lunches often in the area and overall this is the best we had this year. I marked the place as my fav to go for a beef roast. The meat was tender and juicy, the trimmings were perfectly roasted and the amount of gravy and horseradish was just right. Compliments to the chefs! The dining areas were full of people eating so the locals know this is the place to eat lunch on a Sunday. They also do chicken, pork and veggie options for roast. Service was friendly and attentive. The pub is just south of Victoria park close to Regent's Canal. We will be regulars from now on.

We had a brilliant time at The Crown for a 30th birthday. We hired the top floor and it was absolutely perfect. Incredible food which we pre-ordered, very friendly, lovely staff and a really great atmosphere!

Unfortunately didn’t think much of the food here - we had the 2 course set menu but was extremely disappointed with my steak and chips. Steak was tiny and pretty much just a plate of chips. And the chips were overdone too. Not the greatest for the price.

Lovely pub just outside of Victoria Park. The food was tasty, the staff was friendly and the atmosphere was good. I had the fish and chips, and my friend had the cheeseburger and both dishes were very enjoyable. We sat outside on their Terrace area which was perfect on a sunny day.

Nice environment, we had a cosy little table upstairs which was lovely. While the wine we picked was nice, unfortunately the food experience was pretty underwhelming. We found it quite basic — and expensive for what it was.

I definitely see potential in this place but would highly recommend revisiting the menu and provide either more elevated dishes, or drastically bring down the prices.

Definitely a hidden gem. A Japanese Izakaya. An outstanding wine bar. Strongly recommend ordering the whole menu if you are staying for two or three bottles. Will definitely come back to have more Roch Yuki-San:)

I visited this restaurant after a recommendation from a friend. The drinks were beautifully presented and genuinely lovely — that was definitely the highlight of the experience.

Unfortunately, I found the food quite underwhelming. The dishes were very simple and honestly felt like something I could easily prepare at home. The portion sizes are extremely small, which makes it even harder to justify the exceptionally high prices. Overall, it really didn’t feel like good value for money.

Having spent a lot of time in Japan, I know how exciting and refined this cuisine can be. There’s so much potential to elevate the menu with more depth of flavour, more thoughtful sauces, and more creativity.

I would recommend coming here for drinks, but personally I wouldn’t return for the food unless the menu and pricing were reconsidered £7 pounds for two boiled eggs crazy money

Never wrote a review but felt I should for this place so ppl can decide if they actually wanna go here after reading about our experience. First impressions was nice, a small cosy place which was just what we liked.
We had our first bottle with a few starter and ngl the food was underwhelming, not terrible but with the price they’re charging I’d expect better quality.
Right after finishing our first round of food, waiter came trying to take everything off the table, which was a bit awkward cos with any izakaya I’ve been to its all about a few rounds of food to go with the drinks. Anyways we told them we’re gonna get some more food and drinks.
Then came the time when we wanna get a 2nd bottle. They seem to have no clue about their wine at all, recommended a red thats super acidic when our only request was low acidity. Fine, taste is subjective so we said its cool. Since our 2nd bottle tho, we’ve been asked multiple times if we’re finished (we finished our 2nd round of food but still have 1/3 of a bottle left) and right after we finished pouring from the bottle, we were handed the bill without us requesting. I’d understand if there were ppl waiting but there clearly wasnt on the day and it was more than an hour till their closing time so I dont really understand whats going on.
I really wanted to like this place but its everything a wine bar is/ should not. You cant relax and talk, the food mediocre, wine blah and overpriced and worst of all you will be rushed to leave. When you pay almost 100 quid per head there are plenty of better options.
Great food that pairs with wine well. Good service, cozy atmosphere.

My wife and I hired the venue for our ten year anniversary, with about 40 people. The venue is awesome, with good drinks at reasonable prices. Josh was very helpful in setting up/organising, and the staff were great and very accommodating. Highly recommended.

Discovered The Dalston Lounge through a happy accident when another venue cancelled on me for a party I was throwing and then my friend introduced me to Josh and his amazing venue. It was WAY better than the first venue and Josh is just the best! The whole experience was so smooth and easy from start to finish. Josh is so helpful and so much fun and the party was a hit! 10/10 would recommend!

An intimate restaurant that serves amazing cocktails and is 'Home of the Frozen Cocktail Club'. They serve food; we selected different nibbles (mac n cheese balls, lollipop chicken, prawn gambas, cod fish cakes & salt n pepper squid) which arrived separately but were freshly cooked and delicious. We also tried 3 of their cocktails...wow!

Have used The Lounge for birthdays, work events and even a baby shower.
The food is great value and delicious and Josh and Sianca are always a pleasure to do business with.
Highly recommend this small business for your party needs.

Came here to perform for the “Free Minds” poetry night they do. The atmosphere was brilliant and the host for the evening was welcoming, charismatic and nurtured an atmosphere of encouragement that made the night special.

Beers were a fiver, the performances were great and I left feeling optimistic and inspired

Cheers!!
Amazing after-work gathering spot with friends! Perfect pizza, great selection of drinks, and the best place to play chess. Highly recommended!
Lovely place with friendly bartenders and security. Parfect to watch football and tasty Sunday roast. Also happy hour all day on Sunday 🍸🥳🍹

BEST PLACE IN THE WORLD.
A very special bar with very special staff - the best I've been to in a long time. Dimitar and Serkan take such good care of their customers and the doorman Ramsay always has your back.
They're so friendly, the staff are so attentive, and the happy hour is top tier.
We've had some very beautiful times at The Speakeasy. Thank you guys so much for everything - as soon as I'm back in London, I'll be back like a shot. ❤️

Ticked the 2 most common things one would look out for in a bar, which are good atmosphere and services. Greeted by a polite member of staff who then pointed us to a nice table and ensured someone came to take our order. The atmosphere was amazing. It had a sliding roof top, so you don't worry if the weather isn't too great. There are also heaters to keep you warm. A large screen showing popular sports. It was a good experience. Nice hangout spot for a group of friends 😉. Budget friendly. No reservations or tickets are needed.
Lovely people and vibes. Good prices on drinks and open til a good time. Would recommend for a casual one or a group

name: The Lauriston
address: 162 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7JN, UK

reviews.text:
A very unassuming pub with some of the best pizza we’ve ever had! Great service great food and very reasonably priced

Would totally recommend when in the area.

Came by on two occasions, for a quick drink and for dining in. It was a very pleasant experience both times. I live in the area and often on weekends and evenings it’s difficult to get a seat because it’s such a popular spot, and for good reason! Staff is very friendly, food and drinks come out quick (and with good quality) and the area itself is very pleasant. Definitely recommend!

Lovely little boozer. Open 11am on Sundays. Pricey pint of Deya but where isn't it expensive these days. Looked like the whole place was booked out so clearly a popular spot - if you're going on a weekend I'd recommend booking. Nice people, good vibes, will return.

Lauriston Road Nisa Local has completely transformed, the new refurbishment is honestly the BEST in the area. The moment you walk in, you can see how much thought and care has gone into every detail. It feels modern, fresh, and incredibly well-designed. The whole store looks and feels like a premium shopping space while still being a friendly local convenience store.

The range is brilliant: from fresh produce to chilled, food-to-go, everyday essentials and treats: everything is beautifully presented and fully stocked. The team are always welcoming, helpful and genuinely take pride in their work.

This store has set a new standard for what a neighbourhood convenience shop should be. A real asset to the community and an absolute pleasure to shop in. Highly recommended!

Our favourite local pub for pizza and drinks. The best pizza I’ve had in London so far. We come here nearly every week to get the spicy salami pizza and a cocktail or pint. Great vibe, staff’s lovely and outdoor seating area is great. My friends love the vegan options.

this is probably one of the best meals I’ve had in London so far. The vibe just felt right, good music in the background, but not so loud that you’re shouting across the table. You can actually relax and talk.

The artichoke orzo and the picanha meat were the standout for me, I’d go back just for those.

I’m usually a bit sceptical about small plates because sometimes you end up paying a lot for very little, but that wasn’t the case here. The portions were generous enough and the pricing felt fair.

The staff were genuinely warm and welcoming, and the whole place is beautifully done: cosy, elegant, and thoughtful without feeling try-hard.

It’s the kind of spot you leave already planning to return to.

I’ve been meaning to try Bambi for a really long time. Finally went with a group of friends it was such an incredible dinner. The atmosphere is so good and the DJ was great !About the food, I would honestly give it a solid 9 out of 10. the fries were life changing and the barbecued broccoli stole the show. The cocktails are extremely good and creative and the bartender is lovely. All the staff were extremely kind and helpful and the food came in a very timely manner for such a busy night will definitely be coming back and sending people here.

Omg the food here is genuinely so so good. Went with my girlfriends on a Thursday night and the vibes were amazing with the DJ playing and a packed restaurant. We were expecting another overdone London small plates concept with mediocre food and unreasonably stingy portions, but we were totally wrong.

Whipped goat cheese dip was a must order. Best dish is the mushroom orzo - 8 out of 10 times when I eat a pasta dish at a restaurant I’m pretty sure I could reverse engineer it and make it myself (maybe I’m delusional), but it was truly unbelievable, definitely the best dish we tried and was all our favourites!
Bread from E5 bake house was yummy but it was just good bread. Peri prawns were flavourful and huge. We were super satisfied with 5 plates between 3 of us.

We’ll definitely be back for a weekend boogie🕺🏻

The drinks here are always so delicious and creative! Really great selection of unique natural wines. Live djs playing vinyl which makes the vibe super special ✨✨✨ once you’ve had a few too many pickle martinis they’ll move the tables so you can get dancing

Bambi, Hackney. Overall good. Lively room, DJ at the right volume, friendly team. Menu is simple and hits clean flavors; the small plates and fries are the keepers, portions fair, wine list decent. Bar seating along the wall is a bit tight, so book a table if you can. Not trying to reinvent anything, just a solid neighbourhood hang for drinks and plates that actually land.

name: The Spread Eagle
address: 224 Homerton High St, London E9 6AS, UK

reviews.text:
🚇 Homerton
🍺 £6.70 Pillars Pilsner

The Spread Eagle is located on Homerton High Street in Hackney, East London. The nearest station is Homerton.

This pub has a history stretching back to 1752. The pub you see today was built in the late 19th century. Originally called The Jackdaw & Stump, It was renamed The Jackdaw & Star in 2014. Following a refurbishment in 2018, the pub was renamed The Spread Eagle.

This is a good-sized, one-bar pub with traditional decor and a few contemporary, funky touches. A large island servery with a copper counter dominates the bar area, with seating at the front, right, and back. There are stools and a drinking ledge on the left. Off the back of the main bar is a pool room, and at the rear there is a cosy, leafy beer garden.

The decor consists of a boarded and tiled floors, petrol blue walls, an eclectic mix of framed photos, a simple ornate fireplace, and an eagle mural. The pool room is superb and acts as a shrine to music legend Prince. The area is bathed in purple UV light, has “Prince” wallpaper, and even a glass cabinet dedicated to him.

The beer selection is all on keg and features a range of local independent brews, plus Guinness. I decided on a Pillars Pilsner, my pint was excellent, price point was above average. The food menu is vegan, the pub prides itself on being London’s first fully vegan pub. The kitchen runs a seasonal menu, working directly with foragers and local producers to recreate pub classics.

I arrived at 5pm on a bright late afternoon in February. The pub was busy throughout, with a good mix of punters, most were imbibing, a few were enjoying some food.. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, so settling in was very easy. The service was friendly, and the team member who served me was upbeat and courteous

To be fair, I expected a food-led vegan gastropub and was pleasantly surprised to find a fantastic, elegant local with an excellent beer range that simply happens to serve food. I thoroughly enjoyed my time here — I love that pool room.

📅 28th February 2026
Amazing pub with a fantastic atmosphere and super friendly staff. Great to see it so busy on a sunday. Food was absolutely top dollar. And the hot chocolate was soooooo flavoursome.

Went for a Sunday roast and it was spectacular. Beet Wellington was umami and a perfect centrepiece, the roasties were crispy, the veg were cooked perfectly, and the gravy was plentiful. Shared a side of cheesy leek gratin which was unctuous and I would heartily recommend.
Also shared a bottle of red wine
Staff are all happy, friendly and helpful. Amazing vegan pub.

Had an amazing roast dinner here. We both got the nut roast which was so yummy and the roast potatoes were cooked to perfection! They have generous servings and the meal was very filling. We were served by Danielle who was super lovely.

It's a cute vibe, bartenders are really helpful and kind. Will definitely come back again for a chilled evening. Unfortunately we missed out on Karaoke and the 2 for 1 happy hour! We had to meet some more friends elsewhere. However we've all said we will return for another evening.
The food was quite mid, me and my friend ordered a beef burger to share which was incredibly underwhelming, however the chips where absolutely amazing! Played some pool while we waited for food, had a few drinks. Overall a good pre-drink.

Really great food and friendly team. Fantastic à la carte as well as set menu option (standard/veggie), great cocktails and a decent wine selection. Buzzing atmosphere and really popular. Highly recommend, food is delicious with bold flavours and generous portion sizes.

delectable BBQ from Morocco's and has all the stuff like the hummus and the hummus was really delicious and smooth. most tantalizing Moroccan BBQ restaurant had really good hummus that was smooth and creamy also had the hot wings and it was cooked to perfection with a beautiful char on the outside and really tasty. I also had them mixed meat and that was really good. some of it was had this really honey glaze on the outside which is delicious but the portion was big so I would definitely recommend to share between two people. the drinks were the probably the best part. they were delicious. the spritzes are surprisingly delicious and we also had the margarita which was also good. Even the venue is shaped like the oven in which that all the Smoky deliciousness comes from amazing. oh, and one funny note was they give you this bowl of water to wash your hands in after you eat the wings which is surprisingly helpful

Our dinner at “Berber & Q” was an absolute disappointment, and unfortunately was one of the few restaurants I’ve been to that were a complete let down. The night missed the mark on multiple fronts and I would definitely not recommend this.
Firstly, the food. Very disappointing. The lamb was fatty, the chicken was dry and bony, and so was the fish. The only good thing we had were the dips and the bread. What made things worse was the timings, the lamb dishes came our fairly quickly, and the chicken and fish were probably forgotten because they both came about 40 minutes later. Overall, the kitchen was struggling. When they finally did come, they were inedible.

We complained about the service and the food, and the staff was generally unfazed… They said a sorry and continued as normal. Overall, not value for money and genuinely one of the last places you should visit if you’re in the area with so many places around.

We were blown away how Hood the starters were. The beetroot salad and the north African kimchi with the char grilled bread were outstanding. But then we decided to get the mixed grill which supposedly was to share, and it had 3 pieces of pork belly,  1 chicken drum, one other tiny piece of chicken and 3 cremated meatballs.
It was sad, the pickles, the aubergine cream all delicious but the rest of the platter was so disappointing. Also sharing for 2 and u don't even get to pieces of meat each....well...

The lamb with the flat bread was delicious. The cumin salt complimented it so well.
In the mixed grill, the chicken was very well cooked. Super moist as well. The keftes were flavorful but wayyy too salty for me. The pork belly was cooked well but wished it had more flavor to it.
Loved the cauliflower and the dressings go very well together.

name: The Star By Hackney Downs
address: 35 Queensdown Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8JQ, UK

reviews.text: One of the best Sunday roasts I’ve had in london. Beef brisket £25 was smokey, incredibly tender. Pork £22 was also delicious although skin could be more crispy. Yorkshire pudding was also perfectly cooked and flavoursome. Veg and and gravy were great. Portions were good and felt very satisfied. Seating available inside and outside. Recommend booking on a Sunday lunchtime

Fantastic memorable venue for my 40th birthday. I had an excellent party in the top room / karaoke room on Saturday. A great time was had by all, staff were so helpful + the bartender was absolutely brilliant - we even had a little boogie with him! It was a really great celebration for me, Thankyou . Highly recommend 👌

Great Sunday lunch here in January. Perfectly cooked beef, really crispy potatoes and delicious veg. Plenty of gravy and a gigantic Yorkshire pudding. Service was excellent. Will definitely be back. Would have been nice to see a slightly more interesting selection of beer and wine but other than that it was perfect. Roast beef around £21 plus drinks and extras. Worth contacting directly for info on wheelchair accessibility which may well be possible and tables well spaced. Calm buzzy atmosphere.

I would rate this somewhere between 3.5-4 out of 5. Nice pub with good service and atmosphere.

Came for the Sunday roast after seeing it top the latest Timeout hit list. Average - good roast, would recommend if I was in the area but definitely wouldn’t travel for. Wouldn’t recommend the cauliflower cheese. Good selection of meats, tried both the brisket and the beef.

The place looks run-down, but it contributes to the vintage vibes—a lovely, spacious venue. We celebrated a friend's birthday in one of the rooms on the first floor. We had a bar up there with bottled beers and spirits (draughts and more options available at the bar downstairs). We had loads of fun and a lot to drink, and, to my surprise, the food was incredibly good! While my friends got burgers, I got the loaded beef brisket fries, which were divine! I definitely recommend it and don't miss the chance to taste the pub’s kitchen. The staff was friendly and welcoming. The bathrooms fairly clean.

The Empress is hands down one of my favourite pubs… it’s the perfect mix of relaxed, welcoming, and full of character. I love that it’s dog friendly, my dog absolutely loves coming here and always gets so much attention from the lovely staff and regulars.

The food is incredible every single time. I always go for the steak, it’s cooked to perfection, full of flavour, and easily one of the best around. And I can never resist one of their Bloody Marys! They make them just right, perfectly balanced and packed with flavour.

The atmosphere is always spot on, whether it’s a lazy afternoon or a busy evening. It feels like a proper local gem, friendly faces, great service, and a lovely buzz.

Lovely big family pub. Really enjoyed the roast, the beef was cooked really well and was of high quality. Veggies were also cooked perfectly. Friend’s vegan nut roast also hit the spot. Not as good as mum’s, but the sticky toddy pudding was delicious ;-) Would definitely come back with the extended family.
