We arrived at the pub at noon when it just opened. It was spacious, clean, and very beautiful. Greeted by the lovely hostess, we sat by the window and took our time admiring the atmosphere. Nice selection of drinks. Food was great we had the padron pepper, steak, and cod.

Last night we celebrated a birthday and honestly, it was perfect. Our table was big and private enough for our party, but we still felt part of the buzzing, cosy atmosphere the place offers!

I have lived in the area for years, The Empress never fails.

The food was absolutely next-level. From starters to desserts, everything was executed beautifully. The chateaubriand was unbelievable and all the other dishes we had on the table were just super tasty, well seasoned etc.. absolutely no negative comment to report.

Service was amazing,  they were quick to swap cutlery and glasses and cleared empties (We had a lot of different bottles).

Everything ran so smoothly! it honestly made the night feel effortless. Great food and great service, that's literally all we wanted.

A massive shoutout to Becca, who was an absolute star. Ten out of ten, will definitely be back!

We booked The Empress for our wedding reception last week. Michael and his team were incredible. The staff at The Empress are so welcoming from the get go and nothing is too much trouble. We cannot thank them enough and would have no hesitation in recommending The Empress for any event whether that be for drinks, dinner or a special occasion - we are sure you will get the same incredible service every time. So we’d love to say a massive THANK YOU TO MICHAEL AND ALL THE EMPRESS TEAM 😘

name: The Hemingway
address: 84 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7JL, UK

reviews.text:
Not a good table!
It was good in that the food is good and the service was attentive. However I booked a week ahead and confirmed the day before only to be seated on a squished table for 2 opposite the gents toilet. Other,  nicer,  tables were free the whole time we were there. So no benefit to booking in advance…better to just turn up and choose your own table.  The waitress also took my wine glass before I had finished (I only had one as was driving) even though we called out…she didn’t hear us. We decided to move to another pub. I don’t want to complain and kill the vibe or be difficult (ask to move tables etc) and I always pay the service charge. I would just consider these things when looking for a Sunday lunch venue in the future.

I recently visited for supper and absolutely loved the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere of the pub. I chose the burger, which was genuinely delicious and beautifully cooked. The staff couldn’t have been better.

The only, very minor, downside was the lack of cask ale options, but that’s purely personal, as I’m a sucker for a Sussex Best. Overall, it was a fantastic visit and I’ll definitely be returning once they sort out the lack of Ales!

The service was great
The pub is very nice and it was quiet
We had a good time
We would go back

We went here for lunch before a festival at Victoria park.
Staff are very attentive, food is of a very good standard and plenty to choose from at the bar.
They specialise in handmade scotch eggs which are awesome.
Highly recommend this place.

The Sunday Roast was amazing and great value for money. Particularly the meats were high quality. Such a nice London pub that could be improved by the service. I tried to make a reservation for 1:00 pm but was offered 12:00 instead which is no big deal. Although I really don’t know why the staff have to say “We need the table back by 1:30” , it’s very annoying and an unprofessional and unwelcoming attitude in the hospitality business. Particularly as the next “reservation” according to the sign was for 3:00 pm and not for 1:30 anyway. At the end of the meal we were well fed and couldn’t manage a dessert which I think would probably be pretty good considering the high standard of the mains. We asked for Irish coffee and were told that the pub doesn’t do hot drinks? A pub not doing hot drinks? All in all the service wasn’t great but the food was amazing.

We had the roast brill and duck parfait with salad — both were absolutely delicious. The balance of flavors was perfect, the execution flawless. This is exactly what a great neighbourhood restaurant should be: honest food, impeccably made, nothing unnecessary. Highly recommend.

My partner and I had our wedding reception at Marksman and I can’t recommend it enough for a private event! Jessy and the whole team went above and beyond to make this day so special for us and our 60 guests. We had incredible service, amazing food and drinks and flexibility in accommodating all our needs. Everyone had a wonderful time. Thank you!!

This is the Marksman, a classy venue, even down to the script used for the signage.

The white and green paint job stands it out yet more, as does the small roof terrace with its parasols and cupola.

A large white glazed free hanging lamp adds to a very definite upmarket appearance.

It wasn't always so though. If you search google images hard enough you'll find the same pub with heavy blue signage. The paint job was white all over, but in need of a pressure wash and there was a huge advert board on the side. As time passed the curve of the outside upper floor wall received a mural of a long ago battle, no doubt giving rise to the pub's name.

Even older pictures show a brick facade with pillars and Vesy's Brewery emblazoned across the front.

Others show the pub was selling Everards and Godsons beers, and the older windows seem to have been replaced by upvc.

The year 1865 is carved into the pub's frontage, it's seen so much change since then. Was there a golden era here I wonder?

Indoors the current iteration of the pub is understated, traditional and altogether pleasant. There's still a curtain around the door, most of the chairs match and there's wood panelling throughout.

The beers are good with Lost and Grounded, Kernel, Five Points, Deya and Lucky Saint on offer. Prices range from £6 to £7.75.

All in, a lovely pub with some real history over the years. I bet the drinking style, punters and the conversation have changed over time as much as the appearance. I'd love to have visited for a bev in those earlier days.
Very good shared plates in a locley atmosphere! The upstairs had very different vibe to the downstairs through interior design. Overall, lovely location with excellent food! Would visit again.

I rarely link pub food with good food, but Marksman Hackney delivered a solid night. The curried lamb bun was the standout, and the chicken pie nailed comfort whist the rib was average and dessert felt ready for an upgrade. The cosy pub vibe and warm crowd made it a great place to linger with friends.

super decent Sunday roast actually. well seasoned slices of meat. all well. seasoned with good roasted vegetables and very savory, had sirloin which tastes great and tender and would say that the only criticism would be that the potatoes were a bit tough for no reason. otherwise everything was pretty perfect and I would request sharper knives as we use butter knives to cut. otherwise everything was well recommended

No idea why the rating is low but the food is soooo good and service is wonderful. Went tonight and just really happy after!

Specials are always a good shout and the menu constantly changes. Make a reservation if you can as gets busy!

Update: pies are soooo yummy!! Can just get the one for 2 and not even need sides, really filling!! And amazing service as usual xxx

I went here for lunch on Saturday, a reccomendation from a friend. It was absolutely outstanding. We had meatballs with grilled taleggio cheese and the beef tartar to start. My friend had the Skate and I had the guinea fowl. We had to roll out of there - Brilliant food, brilliant service and brilliant vibes all round. We will be back!

Pretty outstanding experience. Everything you want from a pub: excellent food (the menu changes every day, they employ a head-->toe ethic so there's always something intriguing, new & delicious), lovely front of house staff with some unique cocktail options and good drafts, and a good, busy social atmosphere. Would not hesitate to recommend this place for a quick drink or a longer meal. 10/10

We arranged family gathering and daughter booked for us as she lives local. Great looking old style pub and ambiance. We ordered a selection of dishes, which I would describe a expensive tapas. Flavours all good and no real complaints other than I resent paying £14.00 for a few sliced up bits of salami and some small Cornichons. Meatball were great but again could have done with a few more. The small cod dish we ordered again tasty but for £28.00 no so sure it was value for money.
We ordered some chips to fill us up and i think maybe they had been given a triple helping of salt. They all got eaten but sure our blood pressure must have hit the roof during the experience. Luckily we had a great pint of Guinness to wash them down. Next time we visit we will drop in for a few pints as the Guinness was that good! but probably hit the street market if we are feeling hungry. Overall, a lovely meet up, and as I say food tasted pretty good but we all agreed a tad overpriced for the amount of food on offer. Staff we polite and attentive.

Police staff, clean environment very good atmosphere with indoor and outdoor seating area. Food served and cooked to order coming up very hot and fresh. Pricing very good and good comes up very generous. Not tight with vinegar and sauces. Will be returning soon! Have added  photo but only after I have tucked in as it was so food! Fish bites were lovely and crispy with nice amount of meat inside
It has been a few years since I was last here. We had a friend in town who wanted fish and chips, and I'm very glad to say that we came here.........AS GOOD AS IT EVER WAS!!!!! 👍
I love this place for gozleme and lentil soup. The fish and chips is also good.
great place! they have giant falafel portions and vegan lahmacun 👏
Quick pit stop ... first time ... good value for money .. just had small cod pieces... these were freshly cooked. You get 5

e just celebrated our wedding anniversary here. It surpassed all expectations! Just fantastic! The manager, Ibu and the team organised everything from welcoming drinks and cocktails, to the most incredible banquet with hot and cold mezze to clearing a space for a dance floor! All of our guests were saying how delicious the food was. the staff were warm, incredibly professional and nothing was too much trouble! (They even decorated the place with our old wedding photos and projected our wedding video) thank you guys for the BEST night. We'll be back to eat Soon! I can't recommend this place highly enough!

It was such a gorgeous, sunny Saturday, and after wandering around the street market, I really needed to find a chill spot to sit down, away from the crowds but still in the middle of the action. I stumbled across One Broadway Market, and just as I passed by, a table outside opened up—perfect timing!

One of the staff greeted me right away with a friendly smile and made sure I was all set. I ordered a mimosa and their Spanish sausages with poached eggs, and just relaxed in the sun while waiting for my food. (I did sneak a look inside, and it’s super cool—lots of plants and a really fresh vibe.)

The food was amazing, and the staff was so attentive. Honestly, if I didn’t have plans after, I would’ve totally had a second mimosa. It’s such a cute brunch spot, and I’ll definitely be back—and recommending it to everyone!

Nice little spot which I believe used to be a Portuguese or Spanish Tapas place. Ethereal interiors, friendly staff. Margarita could have been less sickly sweet and calamari batter browned off a bit more, but will definitely go again.

Beautifully decorated - takes indoor greenery to another level! For sure 5* for ambiance and in general was surprisingly quiet inside given it was packed.

We went for brunch at midday Sunday, admittedly the busiest point of the week, but the service was frantic. Whilst not too slow, they forgot part of our order yet at the end of the meal the skipped dishes where on the bill. I’d have a lot more sympathy if they’d been forgotten entirely, but to try charge us for something we didn’t have is just bad form. Particularly as is was already overpriced…
Brunch was nice - could have done with some greenery, was all a bit beige. Bloody Mary close to being too spicy, I enjoyed it but my partner nearly cried when she tried.
I’ll probably go back, but not in a rush to.

Amazing cocktails, delicious food and a great environment to dine.  All meals were served with care and great hospitality.  Definitely my favorite place in Broadway Market. I highly recommend this place if you're feeling tired from noisy pubs and need a place with your friends where you can hear each other without shouting.

Shoutout to Rob and Laura for making this unexpected dinner an absolute vibe !!
the drinks were top notch as was the food!! my top top top top fav tho was the mango ceviche tostada i was like omg i haven’t had so many flavours and textures in my mouth in a while x

wish i stayed for a tequila/mezcal flight but it was a quite one this weekend… it’s pending though

will be back 💖

forgot to mention the best churros i’ve ever had in my life btw, better than winter wonderland lool

Nice bar serving mezcal driven cocktails, and a small Mexican food menu. I enjoyed the mirror margarita quite a bit. As for food, I tried the carne asada tacos but they need to work on the consistency of their tortillas- both of mine fell apart.

Overall, a good place to get some drinks and grub in Dalston.

Superb tacos and cocktails, dog friendly too which is so great as well. Liked the mirror with tequila more than the mirror with mezcal personally, but tastes a very personal. The birria beef is to die for!

Fun and fascinating agave bar. The mirror margarita is their classic and has a well-deserved reputation, but their house Negroni variation with the mezcal and the Melonade was absolutely amazing and I have spent much time trying to replicate it at home.
Service was very friendly and helpful.
Excellent guac too…

We booked for 15 people to celebrate my partners 30th at Hacha and everything about it was perfect.

The staff were attentive and happy.

The drinks were fabulous.

The food slapped.

And there was a really fun atmosphere in the room.

Thanks so much to the staff that helped us organise and the staff working on the day. We had a really special evening.

Had a lovely Sunday roast — everything was cooked perfectly and full of flavour. The service really made the experience though. Evelyn and Ed were both fantastic: welcoming, attentive, and genuinely friendly without being overbearing. They made us feel well looked after from start to finish. Will definitely be back for another roast!

A gem in the middle of Mare street Hackney.
I can’t believe I’ve lived in Hackney for many years and have never visited this fabulous establishment.
What a wonderful place to meet for drinks ,warm and inviting, off the main road with a nice seating area outside . The staff were amazing especially Christobell . This lady was very knowledgeable , polite and professional. Christobell made our first experience of this public house a very memorable one , we will return.
We had a snack of halloumi fries they were delicious and they came with a lovely sauce. I’m looking forward to sampling some more from the menu, the kitchen area looked very clean.
This will definitely be my go to pub when visiting the Empire next door, or when meeting friends in the area .Highly recommended. Card only .

Fancied a roast so popped in here - was disappointed by the size, for £21 I expected more than two roast potatoes! It was nice, but nothing spectacular. The food was just generally a little bit lacklustre, but to be fair to them it was the end of a Sunday shift. Nice gravy. I would have said something because I was disappointed with the price versus the quality of the food, however the waitress didn't come to check on my meal, and it was busy at the bar so didn't want to go up and then leave my food to get cold. Overall atmosphere was nice and cozy though!

Stayed in the hotel as seeing a show at the Empire. Only got 10 rooms and its a narrow quirky hotel with winding staircases. Room was on second floor and nicely set out, with tea and coffee. Bathroom had over bath shower, which, for me, was difficult to access, no shower curtain or hand rails so water all over the floor after shower.
Bar had a lovely vibe and hotel guests were given discount on food and drinks. Staff very friendly and helpful. Would definitely book again, good value for money.

Came here to celebrate my birthday last Saturday night pre-MOTH club and had an amazing time! Despite having less staff than usual, Saffy and Rupert worked tirelessly to make sure we were looked after and made the evening really special. Huge thanks to the kitchen team as well, who went out of their way past their closing time to provide us with food. A great pub with exceptional service.

Can't fault this place. Met a friend for some drinks and a burger as I've wanted to try the burgers here for a long time and I wasnt disappointed. The burger was juicy, succulent and very well seasoned. Perfectly toasted bun and the the toppings really "topped" it off. The skin on fries were also very well seasoned and very very moreish. I wish I ordered the loaded fries or a side of chicken as I was still hungry after. Another option would be to double up the burgers to make it a bit more filling. Maybe I'm just greedy. Either way the burger was delicious. The atmosphere in the pub was electric due to the rugby on the TV. Also the football was on another. The daily happy hour was a nice touch aswell between 6 and 7pm every day where selective drinks are a little cheaper. I would definitely go back to try a different burger and the loaded fries

Spectacular chicken burger and crispy potatoes from in-house Lagom team here!! Came for the quiz, which is super busy (and buzzing), didn't expect such delicious food. I'll be back for more another day...

Beautiful place full of good vibes. The staff are amazing and very welcoming.
Fabio made our experience unique with his energetic and smiling personality.
Recommend to everyone to try this pub.

First time here and the goal was  trying out eatlagom, menu  was relatively small compared to  some other burger spots ive been to but to no fault of there own as i could see that the kitchen was quite small so having rotating menu was the best option in terms of what there working with.

im only going to talk about the burgers though the potatos are good.

the lamb burger was cooked as it should be was nice tender and flavourful with a mix medally of flavours with the sauces and peppers used it really cam across as an elevated kebab in a bun.

the fish burger was also great no fish o fillet vibes  here just a nice tenders almost melty fish in your mouth witha crunchy batter and great tartar sauce that pushed everything up a notch with out just being carried by the sauce.

I hope to return again when they have the spice bag and brisket.

4.5 burgers out of 5 only a half star off due to no mention of the rotating menu id recommend having the days/weeks options mentioned somewhere either by instagram announcement. or some variation of the qr code menu with actively being at location.

My favourite pub / bar in Hackney and hold on, in London - heck maybe the world. I love this place, the staff always say hello when you come in and it has a cosy yet exciting vibe if you're there on the weekends. If you're looking for a perfect pub don't miss 3C!

If you are looking to host an event, party or celebration then I highly recommend the private room at brilliant corners. The room has great vibes and lighting and feels intimate but is near the bar and main room as well. The food was delicious and loved the choice of music too. Service was great and the staff and booking team were all so nice and accommodating.
Worth to travel all the way from West. True East London hipster vibe with variety of unique people inside. Foods were absolutely pleasant- not typical not stingy. Love the live DJ music as well.

Came here for date night. Really cool vibe and delicious food. The mushrooms in particular and vegan sushi were amazing. Staff very kind and attentive.

The only reason it's not 5 stars is because we ordered a bottle of white wine and it came out room temperature. White wine should always be served very cold, or at least put in an ice bucket to get cold. So that was an oversight but everything else was brilliant - would recommend!

I liked this place a lot on my first visit. It's an interesting and dark space and the waiters and bar staff were relaxed and friendly. I love the idea of the tables being cleared so that people can dance at the end of service, and would have happily stayed as the music was good. The drinks were good, though not the best I've had but, the food was excellent.

Happened upon this place and had the set menus, which were a really good amount of food for the price (rare for Japanese food in London). The starter in the vegan set was pretty bad, however, the regular set was great. Would be nice to possibly have a variety of tempura instead of all prawn. Cocktails were good and had an interesting twist on recognisable classics. Great ambience and atmosphere, making it feel quite private despite the large room.

name: Lavang Spice
address: 231 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7HD, UK

reviews.text: A little restaurant that holds about 35 people , basic maroon and black decor , clean and very presentable. The food was tasty and edible - the mild was not spicy at all . Very tasty and colourful food we had chicken tikka biryani which comes with a vegetable curry / sauce  and we also had Balti lamb and peshwari naan, for starters we had meat samosa and onion bhajias poisons and a tray of dips . Raita , mango chutney, pickle and cucumber salad- sadly they rake these dips away which I think they should as they are great accompaniments to the dishes

We had a lovely time having dinner at Lavang. It was such a great surprise on all levels; food was very tasty, generous portions, service was friendly and attentive and atmosphere intimate and overall relaxed and warm.

We can't wait to come back as were both impressed by our experience! Thank you to Sobur Ahmed, Shabbir Ahmed and Chef Rajon!

Ordered Chicken Korma from here which is usually spot on, but today wasn't the same.. The chicken was undercooked.. contacted them to be hung up on, called back for them to say they cook the chicken beforehand for 2 hours so it can't be undercooked.. they sent out another and collected the previous they sent out - the 2nd was also undercooked (chicken was very pink). If ordering from here please check your meat unless you want food poisoning.
Went here yesterday with a date, we ordered way too much but what we did eat was absolutely delicious!! Loved it and the staff were so friendly :))
Came here recently and tried their starters and main. Everything was tasty and had good flavours. Great service too, even at a busy time.

I ordered a biriyani through one of my friend’s recommendation, and I’m honestly so glad as I had this kind of amazing biryani over there .The portion size was generous, the price was very reasonable.Most significantly,the taste was outstanding. The rice was perfectly cooked, full of flavour, and the chicken was tender, well-marinated, and delicious right down to the bone. You can tell it’s made with care and proper spices, not rushed or bland like a home made foods of many takeaways. For the quality and taste you get at this price, it’s amazing value for money. This place has definitely become one of my go-to spots for biriyani, and I’ll be recommending it to others without hesitation to go there and try their authentic Indian foods. However, the young boy who took my order was polite, friendly, and humble . He made the ordering process smooth and welcoming, which added to the overall great experience.Therefore, I would like to recommend everyone at least once you can go there to try their foods.

Never again. Bit like a takeaway from the olden days, but I was fooled by the attractive website. A centimetre layer of oil covered the chicken vindaloo and the dish had far too much potato and not enough chicken. Tasted ok but with the oiliness and lacklustre presentation the dish was just not appetising. Same the fish pakora. Pakora should be dry and a little crisp but the pieces were soggy with oil. I ate one piece and couldn't face the rest. The daal was tasty but lukewarm and the garlic naan heavy and tough so I binned it after a few bites. The delivery was also 45 minutes late with the claim of inundation it being new year's day - but I had to call to find this out and the line "just coming off the heat now" sounded glib and over-used. I'd have overlooked the delay if the food was better, but the whole thing was just so miserable. Some free poppadoms as a goodwill gesture maybe? No. The best thing was the raita but I made that. No doubt "The Black Cardamon team" will reply with the usual regret at my disappointment but they needn't bother.First and last time.

Absolutely delicious!
Just had one of the best Indian takeaways I’ve tried in a long time. The chicken jalfrezi was packed with flavour and had the perfect kick of heat, while the chicken bhuna was rich, aromatic, and beautifully cooked. The peshwari naan was soft, sweet, and fresh—easily one of the highlights. And the fish pakora was crispy, tender, and bursting with flavour.

Impressed we got flyers in the house from them and were curious to try it. I have tried to order online but not successfully so I gave them a call the gentleman I spoke to said to give couple of minutes to ensure that order didn't went trough to don't pay twice!! They care about customers top❤️❤️ when I gave them call later they were very polite was able to order over phone!🤩 Couple of minutes later I had call to double check and inform that delivery is on the way!! Food delicious, advice about food as well as I wanted vegan but chosen vegetarian so I was correcting informed in advance!! Food delicious rich flavours, yummy.Portions very generous, definitely great for the price you pay! Food arrived fast and piping hot which didn't happen with food deliveries for long.Definitely we will order again.Guys keep it up great job!! The chef thank you for delicious dinne

I ordered from this Indian takeaway last night and was really impressed. The food arrived on time, still piping hot, and the portions were generous. The chicken tikka masala was rich and full of flavour, with just the right amount of spice. The garlic naan was soft and fluffy, perfect for scooping up the sauce, and the lamb biryani was fragrant without being too oily.

What stood out most was the balance of spices – bold and aromatic but not overwhelming. You can tell they use fresh ingredients. The service was friendly, and they even included some complimentary poppadoms with chutneys, which was a nice touch.

Overall, excellent value for money and easily one of the best takeaways I’ve had in the area. I’ll definitely be ordering again soon!

name: Indian Greedy Cow
address: IndianGreedyCow, Favorite Cafe, 310 Hackney Rd, Bethnal Green, London E2 7SJ, UK

reviews.text:
I’m not one to leave bad reviews, I ordered chicken tikka biryani , fragrance was nice but they out shatkora or something in side it for some reason which really overpowered the flavours and taste and I could only taste bitterness , I couldn’t even tell how the rest of the food was as everything tasted bitter after the first bite, naga chicken curry fragrance was their but due to the bitterness it ruined it for me, got 2 wings and chips was their only thing as a starter I tasted which was decent. Veg curry was as expected.
Kinda disappointed honestly. Expected much more
The wings were delicious, the naga pickle added the perfect kick, and the extra fries were a nice treat! Everything was fresh, tasty, and well-packed. Will definitely order again.

I’m no Indian food expert but I really enjoy their food. Have tried the pistachio masala and pasanda both of which are great, creamy and up to my taste! Really happy for the half price deal as I now will want to try many more. The ‘boss’ who was serving me is also kind and good to talk to.

I felt very welcome from the moment I arrived. The staff were kind, patient, and gave me plenty of time to think about my order without any pressure.

The food was immaculate — beautifully presented and absolutely delicious.

The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant, making the whole experience even better.

Overall, a fantastic visit. Highly recommend!

First Indian Takeaway I’ve ordered up here so was very much going in blind. Saw the pistachio paneer masala and thought that was a bit of me.

Really, really enjoyed it. Got a couple of popadoms thrown in as well! Will definitely be returning. Cheers guys

name: Ranna (Dalston)
address: 15 Balls Pond Rd, London N1 4AX, UK

reviews.text: First time ordering from here and I am DELIGHTED! Nicest food I’ve had in a long time. We had a meal each and all the trimmings for about £20 each with a code and it was delivered in under 30 mins. Also called up to ask about allergens and they were very knowledgable and helpful. They also found my flat with no bother (deliveroo could never) Will be back soon!

After over 5 years of loyal, regular custom from our Islington address, we had an unfortunate experience on Friday 28th when I called about a rare instance of a late order to our new Hackney address.

The person on the phone was rude, unprofessional, and accusatory. They were not suited to a customer service role. This was a surprise as we had always dealt with familiar, friendly, and courteous drivers before.

The experience has left us no longer feeling comfortable ordering from Ranna, despite the many years of good service prior to this.

I passed this restaurant/take away on Balls Pond Rd, on route home and thought it'd be nice to try. Yesterday we walked in with the intentions to eat in. We started to look over the menu, then heard someone in the kitchen hock a loogie.....
We walked straight back out the door!!!
Best Indian restaurant and take away in the area I mean 10 out of 10 you have to eat to understand how amazing this food is here plus it is sooooo clean!!!!

Really great food at very reasonable prices.
Bring your appetite with you.
The portions are huge!
Any of the biryani's are amazing.
Highly recommend.
You can eat in, or takeaway and they deliver too.

name: Spice Hut 457 Roman Road
address: 457 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5LX, UK

reviews.text: Spice Hut on Roman Road offers tasty hot wings and a good range of grilled fast food. They accept both card and cash. Tables are stocked with plenty of sauce bottles — I prefer the red and burger sauce. Chips are a letdown though, too skinny for my liking.

We always pop in when we are
In the area. The gentleman is so kind.

Currently our go to order is
The kids meal (wings & chips)

Best wishes to everyone at
Spice Hut 457 Roman Road.

Service was slow. Drinks weren't cold. Out of all the Spice Hut branches, this one serves the smallest portions. Normally Spice Hut portions are generous.

Avoid going to this one, there are loads more nearby.
Worst pfc I have had! No flavour to the chips, wings had some light curry powder flavour.  They need to invest properly in their kitchen staff!
Food came swimming in oil, completely disgusting not to mention waited over 30 minutes for it- all of that for the fish to still be undercooked. Dirty place too avoid at all costs

name: Chilli Garlic Indian Restaurant & Take Away 🇮🇳
address: 501 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5LX, UK

reviews.text: I am happy to report that I just enjoyed the most DELICIOUS paneer tikka chilli masala with the greatest pilau rice in London. And it was a great portion. Will also fuel your brain and gut with happiness! Visit and eat authentic Indian food in this modest but delicious establishment. The chefs have extensive knowledge of their respective cuisines.

No nonsense great Indian food. Unassuming from the outside but all the food was superb, very good on the bone biryani, chicken chat puri and lamb curry. Swift service and we had a proper feast for a very reasonable price.

I visited here 2 weeks ago and it’s one of the best take aways out there. The lamb was really good as well as the chicken dupiaza. We also tried the chicken tikka garlic aswell which was amazing. Overall 5 stars!

Delicious food, fair prices and good service!!! I had the butter chicken with rice. Was really saucy and flavourful. My partner had the chilli garlic Tikka with lamb. Super nice flavours. Very fresh and fluffy naan bread. Would definitely come again and try more from their menu! 👍👍👍👍

They are the tastiest tandoori I had, excellent service, if you don't try them your missing out. The restaurant is a lovely clean place to dine in also.

Regards,

Saif.

I ordered a mixed tikka kebab, and lamb dhansak as well as a chicken tikka biryanis! The tikka was just bland ! No flavour of anything! No garlic,ginger,yogurt,lemon juice! Just red dye ! And no flavour! And brown lettuce 1 slice of cucumber for salad ?! The tikka biryani wasn’t freshly cooked and the chicken tikka pieces were overcooked dry and hard.
My lamb dhansak was ok in flavour but the so called lamb! Was actually mutton meat !
Dry hard and chewy! I don’t recommend this place ! But I was fooled by the 9,999 reviews on just eat !
Never again! DONT BE FOOLED!

I ordered food today through Uber Eats and Deliveroo, and it was a complete mess.

First, the food came very late, much after the expected delivery time. When it finally arrived, it was not worth the wait at all.

The food was stale and badly cooked. The lamb pieces were hard and not cooked properly, the rice was half-boiled, and the garlic naan was so hard it was difficult to eat — and there was no garlic on it at all.

I had also ordered a paneer curry, and the box was labeled “paneer,” but inside was a non-veg curry. That’s not just careless — it’s unacceptable.

The chicken and lamb didn’t taste fresh either. Everything about this order felt wrong. Honestly, there were so many issues I can’t even list them all here.

When I tried to speak to the restaurant about it, they were very rude and didn’t care at all. They refused to accept their mistake and offered no solution.

I’m extremely disappointed. Please don’t waste your money here just trust the other negative ratings. I’ll definitely never order from or visit this place again.

I ordered x2 paneer dishes on Uber eats.
Instead of paneer tikka masala I received CHICKEN tikka masala. I only realised after biting into it.
The other dish was very good, but I just don't feel I can provide a high score given this error.

The lamb chops were horrible very smelly and clearly not fresh.
It seemed like they were 2–3 days old.

Takeaway order experience: on Just Eat they advertised 30-45 mins delivery estimate. In reality it took over 2 hours to deliver. Got a text message saying "delayed" after 50 minutes, then silence. Requested updates through site and called multiple times, they didn't answer their phone. Was beginning the complaint/cancellation process when driver arrived with no excuses. "It's a busy night". So what - if you're too busy then give an honest extimate or don't take the order. Better still, plan ahead.
Lentil dahl was bland tasteless watered-down slop, it went straight in the bin. Curries were cold & had leaked from the containers. What an unpleasant experience, and what a disgraceful way to run a business.

name: Three Bowls
address: Three Bowls, 68 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0RN, UK

reviews.text:
We came here for some authentic Hainanese food and overall it was a great experience. The sharing platter was good — although it says for 3–4 people, it’s really just right for three. If you want a more satisfying meal, it’s worth ordering a few extra dishes.

We added half a portion of white-cut chicken, which was excellent — very smooth and tender with perfectly crisp skin, showing great control of the cooking time. It would be even better if the broth and surface were cleaned a little more thoroughly.

The mixed rice noodles were delicious, and the green glutinous rice balls with coconut filling were a pleasant surprise — chewy and fragrant. The fried shrimp and chive cakes were tasty too, just a bit oily.

The place is very popular, so expect a queue, and sometimes you might be asked to change tables or share with others. But overall, the food quality makes it worth it.

By the end of our clay pot we actually bit into a cigarette butt.
It wasn’t something we noticed at the start – we only found it after finishing almost the whole dish.
Even worse, one of us mistook it for bamboo shoot and actually chewed it twice. It was genuinely revolting 🤮🤮🤮

This is something that had clearly been in someone else’s mouth… we honestly don’t want to think about what saliva or bacteria could have been on it.

When we asked the manager to come over, the first thing she did was quickly take the cigarette butt away. She then told us:
“We can only take this dish off your bill.”
A cigarette butt in our food and only that dish removed? It felt unbelievable.

We explained how unacceptable this was and spoke with her for more than ten minutes, yet she still insisted:
“At most we can give you 50% off.”

We weren’t asking for compensation — just the very basic courtesy of not being charged for the meal. Even that wasn’t offered.

We had also noticed a strange smell from the table as soon as we sat down. At the time we thought it might be a minor issue, but after what happened, we can’t help but wonder about the overall cleanliness.

For the sake of others’ wellbeing, we genuinely recommend avoiding this place.

I’m really sad to give this place a bad review, but my partner and I did not have a good experience at all.

We got sat in a corner table which was practically inaccessible by the servers, which is okay because it was busy so we didn’t think anything about it.

But after being seated we waited and waited, we weren’t given the menus or water for at least 20 mins. People who came after us were given water, menus and had their order taken.

When the server came with the menu, we told him we already know what we want, but he went back to retrieve a notepad and water - and again we waited 10+ mins before my partner went to ask for water.

Once we ordered, our plates were passed over the next table, interrupting the people dining next to us every time.

The food was decent, nothing special for the £44 pounds we paid. But the mango coconut drink was good.

After dining we again waited for 15+ mins for our bill to come.

The service is really slow it kinda ruined my dining experience. I won’t be going back.

One star is far too kind.

Chilli sauce left wide open, complete with a fly — food safety clearly optional. The lone server ignored us from start to finish: no greeting, no menus, just us doing it all ourselves. When they finally appeared, it was only to spill sauce into our plates and lecture us on spoon usage. One dish took half an hour, with nothing more than a shrug and “we’ll make it now.”

The place doubled as a karaoke lounge — flashing lights, shouting, singing — while the server pretended not to notice. Refuse the service charge, and suddenly they’re deaf. The chef’s attitude was acceptable, but the restaurant is obviously understaffed, and with service like this, the one server might as well not exist.

A night so dreadful it’s almost impressive.

The atmosphere here is so cosy and calm — it’s small, but it wasn’t too crowded or loud and the music is a good volume. The service was swift, polite and professional. In our experience the vegetarian food was better than the one meat dish my friend ordered, but everything was well-portioned, well-seasoned and full of flavour. The sizzling mapo tofu in particular was delicious. We’ll definitely come back!

name: Jiāonest
address: 230 Kingsland Rd, Whitmore Estate, London E2 8AX, UK

reviews.text:
We absolutely loved everything about our experience this evening.

First, the coziness of the space and the very thoughtful decor really set the scene. We loved the little story book on the table that we read as we got settled in. It felt like we were being welcomed into the chef’s home kitchen and it was the perfect way to start the evening.

Second, the service was lovely. Both servers were attentive, friendly and timely with all aspects of serving us.

And finally, the FOOD! Wow. We had 5 dishes off the menu and each one of them blew us away. Started with the spiced house salad which had a kick to it but was so well balanced both in flavour and in texture. We then had the fried chicken which we loved as well as the duck duck rice toast. Both flavours so well balanced - really enjoyed all these appetizers.

For our mains we ordered the short ribs and the tofu. Both were absolutely amazing. Just perfect.

And then we topped it off with the ice cream which was such a great palate cleanser.

All in all we had an amazing evening and we’re so thrilled to see this place full of people - as it should be.

Thank you again to the chef and to the serving team!

Absolutely amazing food, get the salmon ceviche, ribs, and mushroom/pork belly dishes for sure!! Ice cream is amazing too. The staff was so kind as well and even  provided a cake for my birthday!! So so sweet will definitely come again!

Well done Jiaonest! The food was absolutely delicious, every dish packed with flavour and clearly made with care. The space is cosy and welcoming, perfect for lingering over a meal with friends. They also have a really thoughtful wine list that pairs beautifully with the food. Service was attentive and friendly without ever being overbearing. A restaurant that I’d happily come back to again and again x

Since it’s so brand new I have mixed feedback but I expect the place to improve over time hence the higher score.

Food: quality of ingredients felt good but the mapo tofu felt a little lacking - spice was in the right direction but it didn’t have depth. Potentially umami? The minced beef within didn’t seem flavoursome nor enough of it. Beef short rib was nice and tender, although could’ve been warmer.

Service: unfortunately a significant area for improvement. Definitely need more staff as was only 2 overall, FOH and in the kitchen. Maybe I went on a day that someone didn’t show up but the FOH staff member was out of his depth. Would like to go back and experience it with a staff member who seems more comfortable.

Atmosphere: cosy candlelit basement vibes.

Overall it’s a welcome addition to the area. They’ve done a nice job with the space. The vision for the food makes sense. Some tweaks and it could be special. Would encourage others to support a small business and hopefully they take on some of the feedback and adapt as time goes on.

I’ve always struggled to find a truly good, authentic Chinese restaurant in London. Most places are okay, but not quite something I’d rave about to my friends. Finally, Jiāonest. Every bite takes me straight home. What more could you ask for? It’s also a great spot for a date or catching up with friends — nice vibe, delicious food, and friendly people. Absolutely worth a visit, and I’ll definitely recommend it to my friends.

name: Baba Tang 鄧廚小館 - Chinese Takeaway, Dalston
address: 44 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XJ, UK

reviews.text: Food looked excellent and plenty of it! My main issue is that the sweet and sour chicken was probably made up of popcorn chicken, sauce was very minimal so slightly on the dry side. But overall it was tasty and well presented!

Had an amazing meal at Baba Tang! I tried the Dan Dan noodles and spicy chicken — both were absolutely delicious with just the right amount of heat and flavor. The portions were generous too, definitely worth the price.
Although the seating is limited, it's quite cozy and comfortable. I also love that they offer a loyalty card program — I'm definitely going to collect all the stamps as soon as I can. Highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Chinese food and dim sum!

Great for quick bite, just a few seats in the window. All in all it was nicely cooked, tasted fresh looked very appealing. Nice staff.  The broth comes I. A separate cup to add to taste.  All very well packaged. Will order takeaway in the near future.

Tried here for the very first time. Absolutely delicious fresh food. I loved that it wasn't all dripping in oil which made it more healthy for me.  I ordered through Deliveroo so with my subscription discounts, and money off offers made it more affordable for me, I will definitely be ordering again. It arrived well packed and piping hot to my door.  My only disappointment was I wished the vegetable Hot and Sour soup was bigger because it was so tasty I really wanted more.

Had to leave a review after ordering a takeaway from them late last night. WOW. These are the best dumplings in North and East London. Xiao Long Bao are hard to make well and often do not travel well for take out. These arrived plump and the soup fully sealed. Absolutely delicious. The prawn dumplings equally plump and tasty! Can’t wait to try the rest of the menu - well done Baba Tang 🙌

got the beef udon noodles today and i’ve always walked past this place so many times but never tried it but they will be seeing me again all the time as it is so local, and this was so yummy! i enjoyed it so much and the quantity you get is so good too! staff were so friendly!!

Enjoyed our visit to seaweed. No thrills tasty food, good prices. Kept it simple and ordered noodles, rice and prawns, came quick, freshly cooked, no fuss. Friendly staff made for an enjoyable
Visit.

Me and my friends come here once a week after school to grab some food — it’s become a bit of a tradition for us. My absolute favourite is the special fried rice. I’m honestly obsessed! It’s packed with so many different flavours and every bite hits just right.

As for the price, the meals we’ve had range from around £6.50 to £12, which we think is pretty reasonable for the portion sizes and quality. Based on everything we’ve tried so far, I’d definitely recommend this place. Great food, good value, and the perfect spot to chill after a long day

Wonderful people and really good food, the wings were a bit cold, but is fine! You should
Get wet wipes cause the wings are full of sauce

First time trying this place. We were pleasantly surprised at how tasty our food was and the staff were friendly and helpful. Only things lacking was more of an atmosphere, but it is a small place, not a busy restaurant. Also, as stated below, there are accessibility issues though they have provided a table outside. All in all we had a tasty, relaxed birthday lunch for my Mum and all enjoyed the food.

name: Roman Empire
address: 485 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5LX, UK

reviews.text: Can you please chicken and chips shops please hot food  chicken chips everyday people please  hot food  chicken chips everyday  opening chicken chips everyday  24 hours 7 hours  Muslims please halal  roman road chicken chips shops please lunch time  dinner time    cleaning everyday in the morning in the afternoon in the night

I see how the reviews look, to anyone who sees them, yes, sometimes it takes a while. Keep in mind though they deliver in house, I work in food too, having to spare someone for 30 minutes can be rough. But I’ve ordered from them at least a dozen times, and not once has my food just vanished. Slow? Maybe, I can wait. But the food has never been bad, it’s always been tasty and they’ve come through for me when it’s mattered more than once.
They can through for me especially so a couple days ago so this is for that.

Used to love this place even though delivery was always on the slow side. However they falsely marked themselves as permanently closed on here to avoid further bad reviews and last night I had the worst experience with them they already gave me an extremely long delivery time, but were later than even that. When I checked my delivery, most of it was missing, we are talking two appetisers, three main courses and fried rice. Only noodles and crispy seaweed were there. Of course they conveniently sent the order out so late that they were closed by the time it was delivered. Either they deliberately only delivered these few items or they carelessly left 75% of my order on the side and didn't give it to the delivery driver. Either way it is not good.  I was a loyal customer who has been ordering from them for two years. Thankfully I was able to get a full refund from Just Eat but I will never order from Roman Empire again.

I ordered this today and very disappointed
I told them I don’t wanna it spice and they add spicy and chicken is like from another day. Awful place

While the food is edible it's not great. If your HUNGRY, you might actually enjoy it but in general it's subpar, just about passable. Now the service? Wouldn't havent a clue as the number has been switched off so no one can call and check on their order. I'd say pretty damn terrible customer service, they don't even have the decency to have a phone when a lot of the customers are online. Now last but not least I've ordered 3 times from here in the past 6 month (I used to LOVE THIS PLACE) first time the food was abysmal at best, just about edible. Chicken rubbery, noodles soggy and the rice looked like it had been through the flames of hell itself. Second order.....just never came (i wanted to give it another go as again I used to LOVE this place) and me being me though hey I'll try one more time as it might have been a fluke. Nope.....no fluke, food never came AGAIN. This place is nothing but a scam now for money laundering or something cause its done nothing but go down hill in the last few years. This used to be my only Chinese shop. Never again. One more loyal customer lost.

name: Hackney Garden
address: 357A Wick Rd, Eastway, London E9 5DH, UK

reviews.text:
This place is false advertising. Pictures on uber eats is a lie. Ordered 1/4 duck, thai green curry and wonton soup. Came out to be £35. For £35, everything seemed like it was chucked into hot coloured water with no flavour and bland. Actually inedible. Duck was dry and harder than a rock. Thai green curry is just green water with some soggy veg and frozen prawns that had a sour taste. The powder from the wonton soup is still
left in the container. Save yourself the hassle and money and AVOID!!!

Ordered through Uber Eats, though they seem to go by different names on the app. It’s a pretty decent place overall, but the delivery time was very long.
They often have special offers, for example a buy-one-get-one-free chow mein deal for £17. When you split the cost, it’s reasonably priced. Overall, not a bad place to order from.

Ordered from Just Eat. This is possibly the worst Chinese food I’ve ever eaten. The prawn balls - dough was undercooked and bland. The rice was old and greasy. The chow mein was all oil. The beef with spring onions was bland and watery. The whole thing was crazily expensive.
And the driver had the audacity to ask us to give a 5 star review when he delivered the food!!
I made the mistake of thinking that the review average of 5 stars on Just Eat was to be trusted which is clearly not the case.

With the prices they charge you should be getting high quality Chinese food whereas this place tastes like one of those dodgy places where you go after a night out and you’re too drunk to care what you’re eating. Can’t even eat the leftovers it’s so bad.

Never change your chicken balls, chips or curry sauce. I have waited 5 years in London to get a Chinese chicken ball and chips combo that matches the standards from back home (Ireland) and tonight your food met the bar I had set. Thanks! I’ll be back x

Ordered through uber eats and I’m so disappointed. I ordered the “dumplings” which showed a nice picture of steamed dumplings and of course I knew it wouldn’t look exactly like the picture, but it was nothing like dumplings at all, see for yourself! And I paid £8 for it??? Insane. False advertisement should be illegal. And worse thing is uber eats can’t do anything about it since it’s sort of independent.

Appalling company. Ordered from here for a special family meal via just eat and the food was over an hour late, absolutely abysmal - fried, dripping in oil and fat, and half the items barely resembled what they should have. Just deep brown shapes. The singapore noodles were atrocious, and we have had to throw it away. It is inedible .

Not to mention the VERY disrespectful way they have dealt with me on the telephone when I rang to ask where our food was.

We placed the order at 6.55pm. The just eat site said our food would arrive 740pm - 8pm. it had not arrived by 8pm, so I rang to find out where it was because it has not arrived and we couldn't track the order..  The male I spoke to was called WilmerJan was unable to speak clearly and refused to answer any questions, stating "busy busy" and he hung up on me mid conversation twice.  The next time I spoke to him he made a lot of excuses such as we were "far away" (less than 3 miles) and that they only had 1 driver and it was not his problem. When I suggested they should not have accepted our order, he then hung up on me again

I called back to find out whether our food had been cancelled by him or whether we could still expect it to arrive here, he said to complain to "just eat," because it was nothing to do with him, that he was "nothing." When I asked if that was some kind of joke he hung up on me again!

This is extremely disappointing and very rude service and I am shocked Just Eat has this company on their website.

Our food eventually arrived at 8.35pm, yet just eat sent me a message claiming the food had arrived at 825pm (it hadnt)
and due to the very rude way I have been dealt with, as well as the disgusting food, I have requested a full refund onto my payment card because this is unacceptable, disappointing and not fair.

AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST.
I ordered delivery from this restaurant and it was a complete nightmare. My food never showed up—not late, not delayed, just never arrived at all. After waiting far past the estimated delivery window, I called the restaurant to figure out what was going on.

The staff couldn’t have cared less. No apology, no effort to check on the order, nothing. I was talked over, put on hold without warning, and eventually told, in the most uninterested tone possible, that they “didn’t know” what happened and that I’d have to “figure it out” with the delivery app myself. Zero responsibility, zero concern, zero customer service.

AVOID FOR YOUR OWN HEALTH
Food with visible signs of mould or decay!
Ordered few times but quality of food is got worse than ever, with taste of bad state and vegetables visibly gone bad. It’s cheap but not worth risking your health. This place should be investigated…

DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE
RUDE STAFF WHO SNAP AND SHOUT AT YOU THEN HANG UP. THEY DONT DELIVER YOUR FOOD LEAVE YOU WAITING OVER AN HOUR TELL YOU TO WAIT MORE AND THEN SHOUT AT YOU,HANG UP AND CANCEL YOUR ORDER. GLAD IN A WAY AS EVERYONE SAYS THEY ARE DISGUSTING AND WITH A HYGIENE RATING OF 3. DISGUSTING AND SHOULD BE SHUT DOWN!!!
Order never arrived but was marked as delivered. Does not answer calls either.  Terrible.
Food was really good dont know why it's rated so poorly but honestly the food is very nice so deserves some more good reviews.  Had sweet and sour chicken and egg fried rice would recommend 100%

Terrible customer service I ordered from these guys on uber eats and try to fix a delivery complication an instead of trying to be helpful they tried to demand extra money from me instead of trying to come to a solution when it would have been close enough to amend or cancel the order instead I had to repeatedly call and was met with unhelpful unfriendly communication and the calls were ended from their side on multiple occasions. The food was not even worth the hassle I would never recommend these guys fix your customer service!

The only thing that was actually okay was the water. Everything else looked nothing like the photos. I was feeling sick and just wanted something healthy, so it’s frustrating to be tricked by the pictures.

I had 2 bad experiences from ordering from this terrible place.

1st Bad experience: I ordered ribs and rice and the rice was missing....the shop was closed by the time I realised.

2nd Bad experience: after I placed my order....I immediately forgot that I didn't add prawn crackers to my order & I asked the lady can I please add prawn crackers to my order & she took the money and aggressively slammed the change which consisted of coins into my hand. I was very upset about this and I will never go back there...I'm pretty sure that had something to do with racism.
Wow, I experienced an amazing takeaway dish. As a visitor to Hackney for a week I just wish I had tried this place before. Outstanding.

name: My Neighbours the Dumplings - Victoria Park
address: 178-180 Victoria Park Rd, London E9 7HD, UK

reviews.text:
Really wanted to like this place but it was just disappointing all-around. My group of 6 came here for a farewell dinner for one of our friends, and we were seated at a table with benches and no back rests, despite 5/6 of our group being fairly large-sized men. To say it was an uncomfortable squeeze is an understatement!

The food took ages to arrive, we waited maybe 15-25 minutes in between our starters (dumplings) and the hot plates. Dumplings are ok, but not amazing – we had the har gao, chicken, chives and prawn dumplings and siew mai. Drinks came at the same time and were extortionate for what they were (£4 for 300ml of coca cola!)

We had the lamb noodles, miso chicken thigh with rice and pork belly for mains. The portion sizes were small for how much they cost, my friend had to order 2 portions of lamb noodles and jasmine rice, and another friend had 2 portions of the pork belly. Thankfully, food was relatively tasty.

Service staff were pleasant but lacked initiative. We were provided only 1 bottle of water shared among the 6 of us, and we would have to constantly request the bottle be refilled as a full bottle was not even enough to fill one round of our glasses. We definitely expected better, considering the service charge paid – what we experienced, in my opinion, did not meet bare minimum.

The best hidden gem by Victoria Park. Hands down the best Chinese restaurant in London—the cooking is on another level. I was sceptical about my husband's jackfruit dumplings, but oh my word… they were incredible. You have to try them—an absolute must. Every dish was packed with flavour and spot on.

Whoever the chef is, they know what they are doing, and the waiting staff were incredibly friendly and attentive—they even gave my dog treats, making it such a welcoming spot for all of us. It's one of the few dog-friendly Chinese spots in London, so definitely pop in next time you're around Victoria Park.

Went for the "£1 Dumpling 5pm to 6.30pm"
We arrived at 5pm and there wasn't anyone in the restaurant except the staff, not even 10 mins after group after group started coming in and very quickly there was a nice buzz of people.

The offer included the dumpling in the menu (pictured) though we had the special dumpling (Potato & Truffle Sui Gok (ve) crispy glutinous rice dumpling) which triggered a childhood memory

The spicy margarita is a classic twist off the classic, very well done and the sober wasabi sour, never had a drink with wasabi and would definitely work as a digestive

Chicken & Prawn Siu Mai Steamed in Dim Sum style (4 pc)

Prawn Har Gau Dumplings Steamed in Dim Sum style (4 pc)

Crab, Prawn & Chive Fried Dumplings
w/ green seafood sauce (3 pc)

Smokey Jackfruit Dumplings sauce
w/ mala sauce (4pc) (ve)

Crispy Fried Prawn Wonton
w/Sweet chilli Sweet chilli sauce (5 pc)

Pearl Meatballs
Spiced pork rolled in sticky rice
w/ peanut sauce & Thai basil (3 pc) (gf)

Extremely warm, well decorated place, a cozy and comfortable atmosphere to be in. Every food is a 10/10 the prawn dumplings were to die for, the crab dumplings had the perfect bite and the cilantro/green sauce that came with it was refreshing and delicious we drank it all. Ollie was an excellent server and the service was friendly, inviting and supportive. I would get the chocolate dumplings again JUST for the black tea ice cream, they should definitely sell it by itself. There is only one negative thing I would say is that the chocolate dumplings taste “burnt” whether that was how unsweetened the chocolate was or that the roll didnt suit the dish.

After a long-awaited visit to My Neighbours the Dumplings, I left disappointed. The decor is undeniably charming, but the atmosphere quickly turned claustrophobic when a divider was unnecessarily placed on my table—despite the restaurant being nearly empty. I had to ask for it to be removed.

Food-wise, the Pearl Meatballs (£6.90) were… interesting—pork mince wrapped in sticky rice. The peanut sauce was the only redeeming element. The Crispy Roasted Pork Belly (£14.90) was dry, bland, and came in a meagre portion with no sides. Steamed Jasmine Rice (£2.50) was overly sticky, not in a good way. And £3 for a tiny 200ml Coke? Borderline insulting.
Overly Expensive.

To top it off, the server’s response to my honest feedback—“it is what it is”—was the final nail in the coffin.

Left with an odd aftertaste and even worse impression. I won’t be returning, and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone sensible.
The guy is very stressed out all the time an cannot speak a word of English. The food is quite good but the shop looks like it is struggling
Food is always delicious and well priced. My fav place to go in hackney. Man who owns it is lovely chap!

This guy is very rude. He chooses to work alone.Doesn't want to employ anyone when you advise him.He shout when you order a few more food. He just want people to order small portion for maybe one or 2 otherwise he starts to shout.Rubbish communication and customer service

Been going here over 20 years.
Food is excellent and still reasonably priced.
Owner always asks after my family and friendly to me.
Can be very busy so be prepared to wait as he does all on his own . May even see Tommy Walsh from ground force queuing for food .
Been going there over a year now and so far I loved anything I tried! My wife from Hong Kong also approves. Owner is such a funny guy I always enjoy having a chat with him :)

Just popped in for lunch with my son who loves Italian food. We were not disappointed. But what makes this place special is not the home made pasta, delicious panna cotta or the lunchtime specials - all of which are wonderful- it’s the obvious passion for good honest food and warmth of the owners/chefs. Will be back very soon.

I was having a post Italian holiday depression moment. Trust me, it was horrible and blue. A very ugly shade of blue. Decided to take myself for a walk around the neighbourhood and drop the clothes I worn in my holiday to the dry cleaners when I came across this restaurant. I think I’ve seen it many times, but not really. I think I needed to go back to my most immediate happy place and asked the lovely owners to see the menu, to decide if I’d have lunch or starve myself till the evening. When I saw “Pana cotta”, my heart made the decision, I mean my heart-stomach. Ive ordered a starter, the arrabiata pasta and the most life fulfilling pana cotta. The place, the pictures, the people speaking Italian and the happy faces reminded me that how beautiful and important is to have places that feel warm in a city London like London. I’ll be back before the World Cup! I’ll bring my friends and myself over and over this gem in east London.
Can’t wait to try the entire menu and the specials!
This place has a heart and it’s delicious. Don’t miss out!!!
Muchas gracias!

Mo’ Mangio is a proper handmade pasta restaurant where quality and passion are evident in every detail. The pasta is freshly made, perfectly cooked, and full of character, with sauces that are balanced and comforting rather than overpowering. What really elevates the experience is the hospitality—Alessio, the owner, is a superb host who makes you feel genuinely welcome from the moment you arrive. There’s warmth, pride, and authenticity in both the food and the service. A place that celebrates real Italian cooking and heartfelt hospitality, and one I’d happily return to again and again.

Always a lovely experience with Mo Mangio - whether it’s a takeaway or dine in.

We have been ordering from Mo Mangio since they were in a tiny location near Dalston Junction station - food is amazing, perfectly seasoned and reasonably priced. We’ve probably tried every dish on the menu and haven’t found anything lacking, but the  carbonara, amatriciana and ragu are our go tos. The tiramisu is also a must - so fresh with the right balance of sweetness.

On top of the delicious food, the service is fantastic and so quintessentially Italian. The owner is passionate and enthusiastic about his food, with spot on recommendations. We’ve loved the experience so much it was our first date night post baby - and we can’t wait to go back again!

One of my new favourite neighbourhood places! Love the laid back ambiance, and the food is just delicious. It really feels like we are being served home cooked food - warm, generous, simple and tasty. The owners are lovely people, who do their best to make you feel at home. Love it!

name: LARDO
address: Unit 3, 201 Richmond Rd, London E8 3NJ, UK

reviews.text: Went to Lardo today for a late lunch and really enjoyed it. They have a ‘worker lunch’ option from 12-4. Really good value for money and generous portions. Service was excellent and dishes well presented and very tasty. I’d easily come back. My only comment would be the tiramisu, could be improved. Apart from that, everything was spotless.

It’s a really nice wine bar and restaurant, with a very cosy atmosphere. The pizzas were quite good for value and it’s a lovely place to relax and enjoy good food. As a French person, I found the wine good, though the lower-priced options on the menu were quite expensive for what they were and not necessarily the best, but of course, that probably doesn’t reflect the whole wine list. I’ve only been there once, but it’s definitely a great spot to enjoy a warm, welcoming ambiance and a tasty meal.

I had dinner there recently, and it was well worth it. The welcome was warm and genuine, the kind that makes you feel the place takes hospitality seriously. The industrial-style décor works nicely, metal, wood, soft lighting, nothing forced, just a cool, coherent atmosphere.

I started with the sea bass crudo, which was excellent: fresh, clean flavours and spot-on seasoning.
Then came the pasta with fennel sausage ragù, simply outstanding. Perfectly al dente, rich, honest flavours, the kind of dish that doesn’t need any tricks to shine.

And their orange wine was a real highlight: aromatic, lively, with just the right tension.

All in all, a thoroughly satisfying dinner. I’m glad I tried this place.

They are amazing! We went there with a toddler, so it was a bit challenging but the waiter and the servers helped us a lot, in managing the table and making our toddler entertained. They were so helpful, kind and polite. We, my friend and her baby had fun a lot although he made a bit of a mess around. The food was amazing, we ordered beetroot salad, pizza, red wine and tiramisu. It was so delicious! Especially we lived tiramisu because it tasted closer to the original recipe with almond liqueur. We sat outside, the weather was amazing and everything was perfect. I would recommend this place to everyone!

New Yorker/New Jerseyan here- this place. is. it.

The mafalde is absolutely delectable. It is the simplest meal made up of a handful of ingredients but oh my— the freshness?? unreal.

The margherita pizza STUNNED with a classic cheesy, greasy (in a good way) finish, you really can’t ask for more. Even the vegan pizza was delicious, and a quick ricotta sub (i took olives off my half) made it the perfect meal.

Excellent vibes, both indoor & outdoor, & excellent food. Cannot recommend it more! Will be back xx

Absolutely outstanding Lunch experience! The staff are wonderfully warm and make you feel instantly at home. The Lasagna Al Forno was exceptionally fresh, the Spaghetti di Mare was full of flavor, and the coffee—especially with the oat milk option—was rich and satisfying. Both the Panna Cotta and Tiramisu were perfectly done. A special shoutout to NAZ, who was incredibly welcoming, professional, friendly and attentive. Truly excellent all around!

Sandy is an absolute delight! The food was phenomenal but the service even better! Going to save as our new favourite local! Thanks so much!! And I lost my scarf and they came and found me and brought it to me - this is just amazing! Thank you again!!!
Brilliant Italian spot, excellent food and atmosphere, really cosy and welcoming. Service from everyone was 10/10, manager Sandy was lovely. Highly recommend for an Italian spot around Hackney.

Another great meal at Bella Vita in Broadway Market in Hackney. I had the vegetarian pizza pastore which includes two high-protein cheeses, making it worth the money. It was served by the friendly smiling Naz. She attended to my every need, magically only appearing just when I needed her!

Disappointed by the brunch, it looked very nice, but my eggs Benedict were quite average: too much salmon, too much sauce, and I couldn’t really taste of a real hollandaise sauce. The vegetarian English breakfast was okay. Super friendly staff and a clean restaurant though!

name: forno 22
address: 402 Old Ford Rd., Bow, London E3 5NR, UK

reviews.text: Excellent pizza and Italian food by Forno 22 hosted at my local pub The Lord Morpeth. Would recommend to everyone. Visiting or locals!!!!
Best pizza in bow! Get the hot honey pizza (yum)
Lovely pizza! Would recommend the capers.
Amazing pizza and service! I had the burrata and mortadella pizza, and it was the best I’ve had in London so far. There were plenty of toppings, including a whole burrata on top.

A restaurant rarely nails the aesthetics this well. The location, the decor, even the crockery everything is picture perfect. And the staff? So friendly and attentive and not to miss the sleeping cat 😬

The food was a bit of a surprise though. The gnudi was delicious, but both pasta dishes were under salted and we had to send the ragu back as the pasta was so overcooked it had clearly been to Italy and back. Maybe the kitchen was just having a busy day.

That said, I really liked the place. You almost forget you are in London. I will return and hopefully next time the food will be the talking point rather than the supporting cast.

Love this spot - the food is divine, the service is amazing and the vibe is cozy and homey. We loved the grilled calamari, the seafood pasta and the pasta with ragù. The tiramisu is out of this world. Lovely staff, and beautiful ambiance. Will definitely be back!

From the moment you step through the wooden doors of Campania, it feels like you’ve left London behind and walked straight into a rustic trattoria somewhere in southern Italy. The atmosphere is effortlessly charming ,warm brick walls, wooden tables, and the comforting hum of a place that feels lived in and loved.

I had the paccheri with mussels, and it was absolutely divine: the sauce rich and full of flavour, perfectly balanced with sweetness from the tomatoes and a touch of the sea from the mussels. It tasted like something your Italian nonna would make on a Sunday afternoon. Paired with a chilled glass of natural wine, it was perfection.

What makes Campania even more special is its soul, from the friendly staff to the little cat lounging quietly in a corner, every detail adds to its homely magic. It’s the kind of place that makes you slow down, savour, and smile.

If you’re looking for a spot that feels authentic, comforting, and just a little bit timeless — Campania is pure Italian poetry. 🇮🇹❤️

Super cozy spot, with amazing service, and excellent homemade food. We tried the calamari, the risotto and the ragu pasta and everything was 10/10. Staff super attentive and friendly. Would go back/recommend to anyone!

I visited with friends just before Xmas. Great atmosphere, food was ok - I had high expectations but while Ragu was very good, the pasta itself was undercooked (no, not intentionally) and the platter we ordered as a starter was just ok. They also forgot the negroni I ordered first. Still worth a visit, great atmosphere, lovely staff.

name: Tom's Pasta
address: Hackney Downs Studios, 17 Amhurst Terrace, Lower Clapton, London E8 2BT, UK

reviews.text:
Amazing food at such a great value!! I’ve wanted to try Toms since it opened but wasn’t sure if it was just an overhyped TikTok restaurant however I couldn’t have been more wrong.

The service was amazing despite how busy it was.  The Nduja + Beef Shin lasagna was incredible and the shower of Parmesan was delicious. They even gave my friend a candle for their birthday. The only thing I’d change was that my friends were disappointed with the sticky toffee soft serve sundae as it was a bit small. Everything else was perfect, will definitely be returning.

The bruschetta and burrito starters were gorgeous 10/10.  The mains, ninja beef shin lasagne 10/10. Italian sausage and greens rigatoni, pasta was a little bit too al dente, one specific herb, which we think was fennel, bit overpowering so this unfortunately scores 6/10.  The pudding Tirimisu, was very disappointing, it didn't taste fresh, think it had been frozen, we give it a 1/10!!    The staff and ambiance were on point,  couldn't fault them !

My first visit here was far better food wise than my 2nd visit. It suffers from consistency issues.

Bruschetta 8/10
Buratta 8/10
Lasagne 7/10
Beef shin ragu 5/10
Italian sausage 5/10
Wild mushroom 4/10
Tiramisu 6/10

I cannot reccomend a restaurant where the starters are far better than the mains.
There was almost medicinal taste to the Italian sausage and the wild mushroom pasta tasted overly sweet like a dessert.

The blood orange spritz was good 7/10

This is a pity as the service and atmosphere was really good.

Quintessential Br-Italian, generous portions, top service by Evie. I recommend the parmesan butter and tiramisu, whereas sprinkle of pepper on mortadella was not necessary. The beef lasagna was pretty good, ideal for meat lovers, little pasta to taste if I have to find a defect.

Quite hard to find booking slots, plan at least 2 weeks in advance and be flexible to dine on weekdays.

Such a cool ambience in this restaurant — great vibe and even better staff! The food was excellent. I’d definitely recommend the fan favourite, the beef shin lasagna, as well as the sausage and Brussels pasta. They do go a bit OTT with the Parmesan, which I found slightly overbearing at times, but it didn’t take away from the overall experience.

The bread with Parmesan butter and the olives are an absolute must to start with. I’ll definitely be making another visit!

A delicious lunch enjoyed in a beautiful and thoughtfully designed little restaurant - the real feel of a neighbourhood restaurant with all the high end qualities. The considered attention to detail across food and interior design alike was a great touch - this was the perfect setting for a belated valentines lunch.

Rarely these days does a meal out surprise you for the better, but this was happily the case at Dalla. The staff were wonderful and the food spectacular - I'm not sure how they produce such exquisite dishes from such a small kitchen. Some simple, some far more complex - both perfectly pleasing. Dalla punches way above its weight and I'd highly recommend you try it.

Dalla is the kind of restaurant that you almost hesitate to talk about too loudly because part of the pleasure is feeling like you have discovered something slightly under the radar. It sits quietly in Hackney and from the outside it does not try to impress you with anything dramatic. You walk in and immediately understand that the real focus here is the table, the food and the people sitting around it. The space is small and intimate, closer to someone’s living room than to a traditional restaurant dining room, and that creates a feeling that is rare in London where so many places try a little too hard to look important.

There is something very relaxed about the atmosphere. People are clearly enjoying themselves but nothing feels staged or overly polished. The room hums with conversations, glasses clink, plates move from the kitchen to the tables and everything happens with an easy rhythm that makes you want to slow down and stay for a while. It feels like the sort of place where dinner quietly turns into a long evening without anyone really noticing the time.

The food reflects that same philosophy. Italian at its core but interpreted with the confidence of a kitchen that understands that good ingredients do not need too much interference. The menu reads like a conversation between tradition and a modern London kitchen. Familiar ideas appear in slightly unexpected forms and everything is executed with a light touch. Pasta is clearly a point of pride here and it arrives exactly as you hope it will, with sauces that feel deep and layered but never heavy. Vegetables taste vibrant and seasonal, fish and meat are cooked with real attention and nothing feels overloaded or unnecessarily complicated. There is a sense of restraint that is surprisingly refreshing.

The wine list deserves a moment of appreciation because it feels like it has been assembled by people who actually drink wine with curiosity rather than by someone trying to show off the most famous labels. There are many European bottles with personality, wines that feel alive and expressive rather than predictable. It is the kind of list where you start with a glass out of curiosity and then slowly find yourself exploring another bottle simply because everything seems interesting.

What makes Dalla particularly memorable is that it manages to feel like a true neighbourhood restaurant while still belonging comfortably to London’s serious food scene. It is a place where you could drop in for a casual dinner yet end up having one of those evenings that stays with you long after you leave. By the time you step back into the street you realise that you have spent hours there without noticing, and that quiet ability to turn a simple dinner into a genuinely warm and memorable evening is probably the best compliment a restaurant can receive.

Dalla holds a special place in our hearts! We had an intimate wedding lunch here and our friends and family are still talking about how amazing the food was! From start to finish each course was a delight. We went to Puglia the day after and kept saying how nothing could beat Dalla’s standard of pasta. Super fresh and thoughtful food, very creative, gorgeous wine and the best tiramisu I’ve ever eaten.
