Special mention to Gianluca for his attentiveness and for making everything run so smoothly start to finish. Jess & Freddie :)

I loved this restaurant! Every detail was authentic from the subtle elegant design to the beautifully executed food. This chef understands Italian food to its core. It’s about letting ingredients sing without pretentious flourishes. I felt like I was transported to a discovered gem in Milano but happily for me  it’s in London.

The service is OK but the food is lacklustre. Was recommended the zucchini omelette with balsamic vinegar but if you're familiar with Southeast Asian omelette this dish basically just tastes like that... nothing special so just skip it (mine came with eggshells). Seasoning of the mains (fish and pork collar) was very unbalanced. Both were too salty. Desserts were the highlight. Unfortunately for the price and the expectations, I would not recommend this place.

name: Vicolo Romano
address: 420 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5LU, UK

reviews.text: Completely random stop for us but we were incredibly pleasantly surprised. The food is very good, but the service was beyond excellent, they were so nice and genuinely made our night. We are very thankful 🤗 I will definitely recommend to my friends!!

Came here on a Monday night and had the best experience. The pizza was amazing and the atmosphere was so relaxing, with italian music in the background, and everything made it an incredibly enjoyable evening. Big shoutout and many thanks to Muri, who was so attentive and friendly. He gave us top tier customer service, from the moment we walked in and took our coats to hang them on the wall, and then throughout dinner, making sure we had everything we needed, up until we left. If the evening was this amazing is largely also thanks to his incredible hospitality and attention to customers. Will definitely be back, thank you very much for the delicious food and fantastic service.

We were a group of 7. Service was very friendly and inviting. The pizzas were super tasty. The menu has good options. The group shared the Romanbella, Vicolo, Purple, Margherita and Meat Feast. Washed down with their chianti wine. We were lucky enough to get some lovely tiramisu on the house too. It was pretty light in terms of density and flavour - again tasty!

This is a small restaurant with enough seating for about 16-18(ish) people, it's a good, friendly, well priced, local spot in Bow and we will certainly be back. See you soon.

This pizza restaurant is the BEST in London!
We come here regularly and it never disappoints. The unusual toppings are fantastic.
The service and friendliness of the staff is incredible. Great with children especially!!!
My dad travels across London 1.5 hours to come to this pizza place, it’s that good!!!

My photos don’t do them justice but the pizzas here are hands down the best i’ve tried - at least in east london! Definitely feel that the ingredients are fresh and of great quality and the dough itself is just nice. The place is this small little nook on roman street which feels intimate. The chef is also very kind and friendly. Cannot say enough nice things about them!

name: Da Felice
address: 90 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0QR, UK

reviews.text: Worst pizzeria in London. The employee treated us badly and at the same time treated the drivers who came to collect the order badly. The guy with the hat, glasses, beard and mustache doesn't know what it means to be a humble person.

perfect restaurant for amazing food! came here 4 of us, we all ordered pizzas and it was delicious. there is such a peaceful, friendly and family vibe there, you feel so comfortable and the staff are so so so lovely. me and my friends were left so happy on sunday after reviewing great service and lovely lemonchello at the end. the homemade tiramisu is AMAZING!!!!!

Definitely best pizza in Clapton. Since I moved to London I became a regular to this place. The dough is great, the staff is extremely friendly and prices are pretty fair. My go to is Baronia, which is amazing, same as the tiramisu!

We order pizza from here and we have dined in twice since moving to Clapton. What can I say!? Their pizza is perfect. I add salt to everything but not at Da Felice. This pizza is full of flavor, plenty of cheese, and baked to perfection. The service has been excellent and the atmosphere is cozy. Consistently a good experience.

I tried the Felice’s pizza - with mozzarella di bufala, salami and aubergines - at this Sardinian pizzeria in London, and it was excellent! The crust was thin—sometimes it’s nice to have a change from the usual Neapolitan dough—and the texture and flavor were spot on. The dough itself was really well made, light yet satisfying. Overall, a great experience and definitely a place I’d recommend!

name: OMBRA
address: 1 Vyner St, Bethnal Green, London E2 9DG, UK

reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful Sunday lunch at Ombra. From the first snack through to dessert, every dish was authentic, beautifully prepared, and bursting with flavour — true Italian cooking at its best. The girolle mushroom tagliolini was delicate and full of depth, the monkfish main was perfectly cooked and full of flavour, and the apricot, mint and yoghurt dessert was a refreshing finish. Compliments to Chef Alessandro, whose skill and passion really shone through in every plate.
For drinks, we trusted our waiter Red, who paired each dish with the perfect wine recommendation. Each glass lifted the food even further, and it made the whole meal feel carefully curated.
We enjoyed it all out on the sunny terrace, where the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere made it a truly memorable family lunch. Ombra delivered on every level — excellent food, thoughtful service, and a beautiful setting. We’ll definitely be back!

I’ve been here a couple of times before but this was the first time in a few years even if I’ve eaten my body weight in maritozzi and semolina sourdough in their bakery opposite, Forno.

The whole afternoon was honestly lovely: plate after plate arrived and everything was exquisite: courgette flowers, prosciutto, aubergine caponata, the ravioli, the tagliatelli with girolles, etc. The marzipan semifreddo was genius and the only thing in the whole meal that didn’t quite hit the spot for us was the panna cotta which seemed heavier than I’m used to.

Service was super attentive throughout, requests for wine recommendations stayed at the top of the list rather than heading to the bottom and the interior is quirky and welcoming. Although by mid-October the canal is no longer that draw that it would be in June, it’s a great location.

In a city with a never ending supply of restaurants, all four of us agreed we’d be delighted to return here. Such good food, such lovely heart. 🥰 Thanks, all.

I took my parents here for lunch , it was their first time and only my second time. Absolutely impeccable! We had the chef’s menu for 3 with wine pairing. Big shoutout to Phil (certified sommelier) for perfectly pairing every unique dish.

**Oysters with blood orange and olive oil
**Olive oil, lemon mussels with fennel
**Grilled White asparagus with sardines
**Gnocco fritto (house staple!)
**Lamb’s heart on whipped feta (!!)
**Fresh pasta (made daily on-site) with beef shin ragù
**Basil & raspberry cake (mind-blowing flavourrrr)
**Tiramisu (rightly praised as London’s best.  My mum demolished it solo!)

The team at Ombra just get it- full of heart, bold flavours, and warming energy.

P.s.: the chefs menu changes with season as they source the freshest ingredients! worth going back!

(To the tune of oompa loompa)

Ombra loompa I am now fat
We got lots of plates now can you top that!!

Ombra loompa doo pa de de
We had a great time now listen to me!!

So myself and my wife came in as she had seen this spot when she visited the last Tuesday society. And oh how pleased I am she saw it.

Tonight we had the chefs menu and it was not only incredible value but an immersive culinary experience. The staff were very knowledgeable and very attentive but the food really was the winner of the evening. I never knew asparagus could taste soo good!!

The tasting menu allowed us to try food we would never usually choose such as the lambs heart but honestly it’s worth every bite.
Great Sunday lunch plenty of delicious and unusual dishes, lovely combination of flavours and attentive service, a must try.

A fantastic spot under the arches, tucked away. Cozy vibe with low lighting.
The pizzas were absolutely delicious - great portions, well prepared, and super tasty!
I chose the White Goat and couldn’t have chosen better. There’s also the option to have a gluten-free base.

The staff were incredibly friendly, accommodating, and approachable. I initially booked a table for 7 people and later had to add 3 more seats. I called in the evening, and they always answered and were happy to accommodate us. Highly recommend!

Visiting from Chicago… a pretty snobby pizza city. Excellent long fermentation sourdough pizza. We shared the Wicker Man, Green Salad, and Churros. Kernel table beer was excellent pairing. Loved the vibe of this place! Highly recommend.

I love the Sodo group. The food is always exceptional, great atmosphere whether you’re in a large group or by yourself. I had a wonderful experience last night in Bethnal Green, very relaxed. The highlight from last night was my server Greta, just made me feel welcome. Hard to find that in London when you dine on your own.

Always great pizza, it’s definitely the best in London. Gorgeous crust, lovely tomato, crisp base with fluffy crusts. You can taste it all. Perfect seasoning too.

You can always judge a place on how good the margherita is, and it’s fab!!! Lovely staff too!

Miss the salad, rain go away so it can grow!

Great food and lovely customer service. I had the white goat pizza and really enjoyed it- if you like a combination of sweet/savoury foods definitely check it out. The crust was light and the pizza was served fresh and hot. Service was quick and all the employees were very friendly and polite. The ambiance was lovely and cozy. Definitely worth a visit.

Everything about the Sugo82 dining experience was fantastic. Fresh, tasty food crafted with love, a nice dining atmosphere on La Terrazza, and amazing staff that made you feel at home. I was particularly impressed with the quality and range of antipasti and pasta types/sauces. There was something for everyone
Amazing home cooked food, felt like I had a nonna cooking for me 🥹! Best pesto I’ve ever had and a perfect array of foods. We were so full when we left! Great atmosphere. Lovely warm people.

We came here as a family and went for the set menu. It was a wonderful experience and we had a really great time! All the food was fresh, incredibly delicious and well prepared - the mushroom and truffle gnocchi were definitely a favourite. The service and atmosphere were also fantastic and made for a memorable evening - we would definitely recommend!

We had an absolutely fantastic experience at Sugo82. We went for the set menu option for my girlfriend’s birthday. The food was fantastic, and there was an enormous amount of food at such high quality. The staff were very friendly, attentive and enjoyed explaining the dishes - they made the whole experience very special. The setting is quaint and the feeling is intimate and personal. We can’t wait to go back!

We booked the set menu for a table of 4 on the upper terrace. The weather changed from a sunny afternoon to a thunderstorm during the meal, but we were well looked after throughout (and remained dry thanks to the shutters and heater!). The service was fantastic and there were so many dishes to try. Come hungry!

name: Symposium – Natural Wine Bar, Bottle Shop & Italian Kitchen
address: 363 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5QR, UK

reviews.text: I wanted to like this place, I really did - considering the atmosphere and staff were absolutely lovely. However, the food - it just wasn't good. The portions are really small for the price and the menu was pretty limited. The seafood ravoli didn't taste fresh, had no sauce and was super salty - and there were only about 10 pieces of ravioli on the plate. The venison was super chewy. Despite being local, I sadly wouldn't come again for food. But worth popping in for a glass of wine!
Lovely food and lovely hosting. With a beautiful campania anchovy to top the meal off - brought me back to my home! Amazing wine pairings too and very generous letting you try before you buy.

Wonderful bar and restaurant with an excellent, elegant and minimal Italian menu. Food is delicious and the drinks selection is fantastic and well curated. Great service, friendly and personal, and a quiet, relaxed ambience. Very good options for vegetarians/vegans as well.

Came here for lunch the other day - starters, mains, dessert, and a bottle of wine. Really tasty food. Some of the dishes were deceptively simple but all delicious. Extensive wine list from different regions across Italy. Also the  staff were so nice. I'll definitely come back.

We came here twice and the food was amazing! I cannot recommend the tiramisu enough, so tasty! The owners are absolutely adorable too and will go out of their way to be helpful, make recommendations and explain what's on the menu. The deli / street food takeaway is also fantastic. Such a wonderful local business :)

name: story deli
address: 515 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9BU, UK

reviews.text: Definitely one of the best pizzas I’ve ever had, maybe the best. Loved the crust and the texture of the pizzas, and the seasoning was just amazing. We had the Florentine, prawn, and Hackney Hoo, and honestly each one had its own unique seasoning and personality. The prawn pizza was my favourite, especially the mix of a little spice and vinegar, absolutely incredible. The lemon cheesecake was also unreal, loved the texture and the combo of lemon, ice cream (maybe?) and a bit of yogurt. Honestly, just speechless. Will definitely be back for more. The owners are super friendly and funny, a 12 out of 10 experience!😍

I think this might be my favourite find in London! Not only was the food incredible (and definitely recommend the coffee cheesecake), but the hosts were so lovely and the atmosphere and interior just felt really authentic and tranquil - the shared table vibe is really lovely. And can’t not mention Dottie and Freckle, the most gorgeous mummy and baby beagle duo! Will definitely be back!

Had an absolutely incredible experience at story deli. The cozy restaurant has caught our eyes every time we walk by on Cambridge Heath. We were not disappointed when we finally stopped in. Our hosts were so welcoming, the adorable dog sleeping on the sofa was so charming, and they went out of their way to make us feel at home. The pizzas we're delicious and so unique combinations of flavors. Must try.

Their precious takeaway packages was also charming, truly every moment with this place was a delight.

Such a unique experience in a quirky, crafty place. It felt like you were at a dining room of a country cottage, where vintage, handmade items were dotted around the space in poetic randomness. The owners were hospitable and friendly, the food was organic, beautiful, fresh and tasty, and the beagle was a plus. Even the leftover was packed like a gift. We were lucky to be the only guests for the whole evening. Will 10/10 be back when the fabled tiramisu is back on the menu!

Such a cute lil dreamy place and the pizza is sensational. You can taste the love from the owners Chris and his beautiful wife. The vibe, the food, the atmosphere and the warm welcoming from Chris literally soothed my day 🥹💕 10/10 recommended

name: Maa Pizza & Bar
address: 300 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9HA, UK

reviews.text: Lovely cosy Italian spot with friendly service and really impressive food. The pasta was exceptional — fresh, flavourful, and cooked perfectly. I also had a chai latte which was surprisingly delicious. Great atmosphere, great staff, and very reasonable prices. Definitely worth a visit!

We came here for a friend’s birthday and were welcomed with open arms. The service answered questions with patience and dealt with personal requests with grace.

The food itself: Faultless. Well made pizza, nice thin crust, generous toppings. Delicious pasta sauces with decent portions of pasta.

Will be coming back because Thomas made us feel very welcome.

One of those places where the decor is lowkey because the food is priority.

We were given a very warm welcome straight out the gate. The service was very kind!

The food was very tasty and extremely competitively priced. The drinks were priced a bit higher than I'd have liked, but that was made up for by the lower food price.

It's a bit hidden but extremely cosy. We were there during a really quiet evening and the atmosphere was stellar.

Food so good I had to go 2 days in a row! I really really recommend the seafood pasta, it was absolutely delicious.

The service was also amazing - super kind staff that recognised us when we came again and made really friendly conversation. Will be going as often as possible!

Maa Pizza & Bar is a really friendly, family run Italian-themed restaurant with delicious hot food and warm service. The fact that the restaurant is dog friendly, our little Jack Russel was been made very welcome!

The location is very good and handy for Cambridge Heath train station. The front facing exterior is a legacy of the railway arch setting and definitely worth making the steps across the decking to this almost hidden gem.

The kitchen team food is authentic Italian showing a love for Mediterranean cuisine. We have gone along to Maa for special occasions and when family have been visiting. We have always been delighted with the food and service and the prices are definitely value for money. We love it and looking forward dining there again! ❤️

name: Elephant Hackney
address: 43 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NS, UK

reviews.text: Really loved the vibe of this place super relaxing and chilled, restaurant lit by candlelight. Have a really nice variety on the menu and everything we got was delicious and packed with flavour. The staff were super friendly and helped us decide what to order, our favourite had to be the tomato pasta dish, we love a big bowl of tasty pasta and the bread and date butter was out of this world!! very reasonably priced cocktails that great. make sure you add this to your list and make sure you pre-booking before you go as they were quite busy.

Love it here so much! Been a few times and it’s always great service, great food and the best vibes. Cocktails are very good, get the dirty martini or just ask the staff what they recommend and they’ll bring you something delicious. We spent between £35-£55 pp each time and got wine for the table, 1-2 cocktails and shared plenty of food. If you want something affordable but high quality then I can’t recommend enough.

Wow… what an incredible restaurant! All the food was phenomenal, my favourites were the sea bass crudo, steak and the pizza (i mean everything else on the menu was superb). The atmosphere and vibe throughout the restaurant was so lovely & homey. Will definitely be back again soon.

Thank you to the whole team for making our evening so fabulous ❤️

Maybe it is unfair to review a place during their soft launch.  I am sure a lot of the front of house problems during our visit are teething issues that will get sorted out.  Staff seemed overwhelmed by how busy it was during the discounted soft launch period.  There was one waiter who was really good, and concerned about reporting problems to management or the kitchen.  But most of the girls were just indifferent to the customer experience.  We waited a long time standing beside the bar before anyone asked about our booking.  And I am on crutches because I had a knee operation a few weeks ago.  When a waitress brought my companion’s main she just plonked a wonky plate of fish served in broth on top of the empty salad bowl his starter had arrived in.  She had to be called back and persuaded to take away the salad bowl his main was balancing on.

Portion sizes are a little weird.  The protein based dishes seem to be very dainty, whereas as the carb heavy ones are really large.  I started with the octopus skewer which consisted of two pieces of octopus, maybe 3 cm square each for £10.  It was delicious and tasted of charcoal though, and came with salsa verde and grilled pepper.  I ordered the sea bream crudo which never arrived.  The neighbouring table had an order which looked quite small.  My companion’s fish of the day of lemon sole was small too. On the other hand, the portions of pizza and pasta arriving at other tables looked enormous.  I had a pizzette which was generously sized and tasty.  Unfortunately I could not discern any of the mussel pesto that was listed in the menu as one of the toppings.  I loved the thin but soft crust.  My companion's starter of summer salad would have been good if it hadn't been so salty as to be almost inedible.

When I complained about not getting the sea bream crudo, the waitress who took my order just shrugged and said she thought I had cancelled.  I complained again to the decent water who checked, noted it had arrived to the dining room but had been sent back and offered me a slice of complimentary tirami su by way of apology, seeing I hadn’t gotten much to eat. This was a very generous portion, like all of the carby dishes.  It was let down by the quality of the espresso used in it's construction, which was very sour.  This surprised me for a restaurant where the head chef is from Naples.  I mean, the espresso could have been an Americano boiled down to espresso strength--that's how sour it was.

After I got home I notice we had been charged for two pizzettas when we only had one.  So definitely check your bill before you leave.

Me and my partner dined here last week and had such a great meal! Stevie has designed this space really well making it a cosy and gorgeous place to eat, big highlight is the ceiling
All staff members were lovely and so knowledgeable too!
We chose the house pickles and a few starters (croquettes were ace) and then two pizzas (diavola and the one with anchovies yum) all so well seasoned and the dough has a great doughy texture with a good bite.
I’d been craving tiramisu for ages and this one hit the spot
Big up Elephant🐘
Ordered takeaway - salmon teriyaki, beef phad thai and shrimp khom kha. Food was delicious, generous portions as well. Next time I'll eat in

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Excellent japanese and thai restaurant with the best service.The sushi and overall japanese food are super fresh, the thai curries are full of flavor, and the katsu, tempura, and rice bowl options are all delicious. Highly recommend!❤️❤️

I loved the Pad thai ,
friendly staff, and nice space.
thai restaurant
Yummy breakfast, happy customer 🥰
Nice chicken katsu curry

name: UCHI
address: 144 Clarence Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8DY, UK

reviews.text: Great dinning experience ! The place is super aesthetics. Perfect for pics. The food is delicious as well and the service was perfect. I really want to try the cafe, tea house, inside the restaurant as well. But we just went for the dinner. It was on Monday so it was quiet. Perfect for a date or catching up with friends.

Sadly not as good as it used to be. Overpriced for quality of food and location. The restaurant is still pretty and staff were friendly. The robata items such as the pork belly and mackerel were beautiful but everything else was average at best. The tempura and karage batter were soft and chewy. The ‘yuzu cheesecake’ was a ball of cream cheese flavoured ice cream sitting on crumbs, which was too frozen to eat and cost £10! We had been excited to go back after a wonderful experience in 2020/2021 but unlikely to return now. Considering we spent £136 spent (only one beer) we were only there an hour. It was very quiet and the service felt rushed. We didn’t get much of a relaxing evening as it was over so fast!

We had a great time at Uchi, the sandwiches and matcha latte were absolutely amazing! Everything was tasty and surprisingly filling. You can tell the food is made with care.

That said, the cafe was very busy during our visit, and the atmosphere felt a bit hectic. The staff were clearly working hard and constantly on the move, but because the seating is quite close together and the walkways are narrow, it didn’t feel very relaxing.

If you’re looking for a calm, leisurely brunch, I’d recommend coming for a proper sit-down lunch instead of grabbing sandwiches like we did. Still, the food is definitely worth trying!
Very good food and an authentic Japanese experience. I would skip their appetisers and Seaweed salad though! Everything else was very good!

Nice little restaurant but be ware of their pricing strategy, I went there for a meal with friends, The staff and atmosphere were nice and clean.

We ordered a range of items on the menu, the stand out dishes are everything from the Robata however we found several items were pretty unreasonable priced, such as the unimaginative hijiki salad which was a size of a zensai cost 10£ while a plate of quite substantial grilled pork belly priced at 13£. The sushi platter (10pc for 27£)was creative and nicely curated, but four pieces of pale looking tuna and salmon set us £20. Desserts were the same, one scope of tiny cheesecake was 10£ while three scoops of beautifully made ice cream at £8.

I would check with the staff before ordering, overall, I can’t say it’s very value for money considering that the location is not even in central. I won’t be rushing back for sure. それは残念!

We had a fantastic meal at Tonkotsu East - Ramya and the whole team were so friendly and accommodating, happy to make small adjustments to make our meal perfect. Every dish was exquisite, we had 3 different ramen broths between us, and each was phenomenal, along with the chicken karaage and panko prawns. The ramen noodles are made fresh on site, and they were magnificent!
We were delighted with the quality and variety in our meal, and we will absolutely be back! Thank you for an exceptional first visit 🍜🍜🍜

We had a wonderful dinner at Tonkotsu Duston St.! The food was absolutely amazing — big thanks to the kitchen team for such delicious dishes. We had the chicken ramen and karaage starters, and everyone loved them. The service was also really friendly and attentive. My friend and I had a great time, and we’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!
One of my go-to ramen places in London. Love the Tonkotsu and the weekday £10 lunch deal. There are lighter options for others too! Vitalii served me and everything was quick and easy.

First time eating here at Tonkotsu. We just accidentally passed by the street and this place is a really good find! Ramen tastes good and not so overwhelming. The karaage and chicken katsu is amazing too! Our food was served hot and fresh. Vitalli and the staff are very accommodating and friendly. The place is cozy and such a chill place to just have a good time with loved ones. Totally recommend!

unexpectedly delicious restaurant, had tonkatsu ramen and the chicken katsu curry, along with beer gravity cider, and their yuzu house soda and everything was just like bang on delicious. I'm caught you had this like a aromatic flavors to it with a thin perfect noodles and warmth, and the takata had a perfect crisp along with the savory curry and greens that make it fresh. would definitely come back until this hidden nestled spot
edit: returned from lunch special and relaized its a chain but they the lunch ramesn are just the right amount perhaps a bit smaller but had the chicken chilli and the tokyo with gyozas, the chicken chilli had great flavors and the tokyo needed the chili garlic, tonkatsu was better but still lovely environment and good service and they gave me ramen bucks to spend when back, overall recommended

name: Kakki Katsu
address: 13 Balls Pond Rd, London N1 4AX, UK

reviews.text:
Not sure why it was so quiet -only one there, though there were lots of takeaway orders.

The pumpkin curry was tasty, but would’ve been better with more pumpkin fritters. The rice wasn’t great and could’ve been fresher.   .

The menu didn’t match what was served — sparkling water was listed as bottled and branded, but I was given a different plastic-bottled water.

Great little restaurant and takeaway in the Dalston Junction area, pretty much on the Islington/Hackney border. If you find yourself hungry and craving a katsu curry, teriyaki chicken, or similar then this is your place to go.

Excellent value for money, particularly if you go for the lunch deal and collect in person.

Some seating is available in the restaurant though it's not particularly spacious. I suppose most customers will be looking to collect or get their food delivered through one of the usual apps.

First time at Kakki Katsu and it won’t be the last! We had the Salmon Katsu Set and the Chicken Teriyaki Set – both were super tasty, not oily at all, and the portions were huge. Amazing value for money. Staff were really friendly and greeted us warmly when we walked in, which made the whole experience even better. Highly recommend if you’re after delicious Japanese food at a great price!
Flavourful dishes. Really get more than u pay for. Worth every penny.  Open kitchen adds excitement allowing u to watch chefs in action. Soothing background music. Very Excited to come back again.

The restaurant was empty as we arrived at about 7:00, except for a Just Eat driver and the chefs working behind the counter-slash-kitchen.

The dining area was a scattering of wooden tables and chairs, with instrumental Christmas music playing faintly. Ordering is done using a QR code on the table; the online menu is slightly different to the one outside.

The webpage has a bit of latency, but is a third-party site, not theirs.

The speed of the service shocked me - our starters arrived very quickly, and we'd barely managed to finish those by the time our mains arrived.

I've got to admit, the presentation was far better than I expected - my gyōza were laid out neatly on a dish in a bed of shredded salad, with a small portion of sauce. The chicken katsu arrived with the sauce in a large bowl, with sliced chicken sat on a bed of white rice. Unfortunately I didn't get a photo of the food as it arrived!

The food tasted as wonderful as it looked.

Drinks were slightly pricey for what they were, but the food was reasonably priced for the portion size and quality.

I strongly advise trying the place out if you're local and can't decide where to go!

Had the best dinner after a big walk around London with our dog so it was even better that they were dog friendly! Raju and sufail were incredible. We will 100% come again. Id recommend the pork ramen and the cauliflower bits. Amazing x

The chili chicken ramen was bursting with authentic flavors, and the chicken kara-age was perfectly crispy and delicious. The ginger soda was a refreshing, one of the best I’ve tasted! What truly elevated the experience was Raju’s exceptional service. He was attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to ensure we had a fantastic dining experience. The atmosphere is great, and I highly recommend this place for anyone craving amazing ramen and top-notch service!

Food was lovely we really enjoyed our ramen. The broth was so flavourful and the noodles had a lovely chew to them still. We had the prawn & the classic tonkotsu. Also tried the gyoza which were tasty too.

Such amazing food, great portion sizes. Had a small bowl of their veggie tofu ramen and was thrillllled. Their sides and apps are incredible too, and great happy hour deal. Our servers Sufail and Alisha were literal icons, love them so much

Had an amazing meal at Tonkatsu in Hackney Central! I tried their signature prawn ramen and my husband had the chilli chicken ramen, both were absolutely delicious. The lemonade and ginger soda were super refreshing too.

Big thanks to Mr. Raju and the whole team for their lovely service. They were so friendly and made us feel really welcome. Highly recommend this place if you’re craving some tasty Japanese ramen! 🍜💛

Imagine my surprise when my husband took me here on a cold January night... to eat outside as there is no inside seating. However, despite it being a bit chilly outside, the delicious food warmed me up. Excellent chicken katsu curry (and good value for such a large portion) and yummy chicken gyoza. I will return in the snow!

A small shop with only outside seating, but I was pleasantly surprised by how good the food was! The halal tonkotsu ramen was amazing - great portion and flavourful broth. Salmon avocado sushi roll was also delicious. My friend and I broke our fasts here and were kindly served additional dates and mochi. Excellent service. Really pleased, would definitely recommend!

Tokyo Tokoi is fantastic! The Chicken Katsu Curry is perfectly crispy, juicy, and comes with a rich, comforting curry sauce that’s full of flavor. The Poke Salad is fresh, colorful, and so satisfying—light yet filling. Friendly staff, generous portions, and great value. Definitely my new go-to spot!

These guys are great. Good quality food at a very reasonable price. They absolutely load you up with veg. A really good option for so many items across the menu. Good service. No seating inside but a few tables outside. Offer a discount if you pay with cash.
Absolutely love the food here! Always fresh, flavorful, and made with so much care. a solid 10/10

If you’ve got money to slam down this a place to treat yourself at. Atmosphere is like that of a dimly lit bistro. Food is designed for a more tapas, sharing experience with slightly larger mains. They have a sommelier if you’re a big wino and enjoy pairings but if not cocktails are strong and decent (if you are interested in the wine I would check if they charge for the sommelier). Despite the small portions will happily say that the flavours of the food are stunning. The menu however isn’t something wildly innovative, and they did add a £40 fee on the bill for live music which we asked to be removed. All in all nice but feels like a place that overcharges at any given opportunity.

Dear Mu Restaurant Management,
I recently had the pleasure of dining at your establishment on Saturday evening, and I wanted to share some thoughts on my experience. From the moment I stepped in, I was captivated by the truly stunning ambiance – the layout, the lighting, all contributed to a wonderfully inviting atmosphere. It’s clear that a great deal of thought went into creating such a beautiful space.
However, as the evening progressed, a few elements emerged that, while not entirely detracting from the overall good feelings, did add a certain... unexpected charm to our culinary journey.
Upon being seated, we opted for tap water, which arrived swiftly. While we appreciated the promptness, a small detail like a pour from the staff would have elevated the initial impression, especially considering the price point of an entrée.
Moving onto the starters, we sampled the beef gyoza, a shrimp "dumpling," and the aubergine. The aubergine was a generous and delicious portion, a definite highlight! The beef gyoza, however, tasted rather like a frozen, pre-packaged variety one might find in a local oriental supermarket. The dish described as a "dumpling" proved to be a rather adventurous interpretation, presenting more as a fish cake. Having spent two decades in Asia, I must confess it was a novel take on the concept of a shrimp dumpling.
Throughout our meal, we noticed a certain... independent spirit in the table service. There were no table wipes between courses, nor were fresh plates offered. My partner, having finished his cocktail, was left to ponder the mysteries of an empty glass without a gentle prompt for a refill. Speaking of cocktails, my Tommy's Margarita arrived in a minimalistic fashion – ice in a glass, sans lime or salt. While certainly a unique presentation, it did leave me wondering if I’d inadvertently ordered a glass of iced water.
As for the main courses, we were informed during ordering that our top choice was unavailable, a perfectly understandable occurrence. A mid-meal interlude saw my partner attempt to discreetly pre-order a birthday dessert while I was momentarily away from the table.
The main courses arrived, again, without the accompanying flourish of a freshly wiped table. The salmon, while cooked well, was accompanied by parsnip crisps that bore a striking resemblance to a well-known supermarket snack – a surprisingly whimsical pairing. The nori fries, however, were a true delight, perfectly crispy and served with a lovely sauce. The chicken thigh, regrettably, was a rather unadorned affair, lacking in seasoning or sauce, reminiscent of something one might find at a more casual establishment.
The grand finale of our meal, after finishing our mains, was the revelation that no desserts were available. And, in keeping with the evening's theme, no table wipe accompanied this news either!
In conclusion, while the cooking itself was not inherently flawed, the menu sometimes felt a little uninspired, occasionally clashing with the truly wonderful setting. The ambiance of Mu is genuinely exceptional, creating a fantastic backdrop for an evening out. However, a touch more attentiveness in the front-of-house service, perhaps a few more table wipes, and a reconsideration of the dessert offering, could truly elevate the dining experience to match the beauty of the surroundings. And, on a slightly playful note, for a restaurant offering £14 cocktails and £50 bottles of wine, perhaps the introduction of actual chopsticks would be a charming touch!
Thank you for your time and consideration.
Sincerely,
A curious diner.

I was definitely apprehensive coming here with the review score being 4.2 stars. After walking in this place i just knew i was going to leave extremely satisfied.
Cocktails were great, the food was just wow, honestly i don’t even know what i ordered but i just know everything i tasted was incredible. The short rib could be slightly more tender and less chewy but apart from that everything was excellent, including the matcha cheesecake.
Our waitress was great, kept checking in for drinks, and cleared our table frequently without interrupting conversations or being too overbearing.
The live band was incredible, the atmosphere completely went through the roof as soon as the guys started playing.
I see many reviews complaining about price? Honestly id say its worth every penny. Perfect spot to catch up with an old friend, a date and even a business dinner!
Will be back for sure.

Disappointed with this spot! It definitely feels overhyped and overpriced. The atmosphere and dimly lit tables are lovely but we that didn’t seem to justify the pricing for the food.

We got prawn “dumplings” for starters and they were pretty awful. They were bland and underwhelming. The aubergine was similar - I was expecting them to be much tastier and instead they were a little lifeless and under seasoned. I was waiting to give feedback to the staff but no one ever came around and asked us if the food was okay.

The octopus carpaccio and cucumber salad were probably the tastiest things we had that evening, and even then, they were plates we didn’t feel matched the prices.

Unfortunately I would never come back here.
the most lovely atmosphere! the food was incredible, me and my boyfriend had such great service! the food was so so good, alongside that, the jazz band playing completed it!

Ismail created the delicious food and Ripul helped assist to my dietary requirements and allergies and was able to make me a delicious looking cucumber sushi !! I came for the 25% off but they also have fairly cheap prices the kochi is delicious along side their various selections of nutritious and hygienic options of Asian based foods the perfect lunch pick up best seating area and really warm and comfy the seating and tables are always clean and well maintained
Really lovely sushi and ramen! So affordable as well and the sushi was fresh and delicious
Excellent sushi was very tasty and fresh and the staff were lovely I will definitely be coming back

DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS PLACE!!! You can only place a delivery order through their website but after an hour of placing an order I called to find out, they only just processed the order when I called. They said sushi will be delivered in 15mins. After 45mins I called asking where the sushi is and they said they have to wait for their driver to become available but they can’t give an ETA. What kind of BS service is this?? In the end I got a refund and we were left without food to break fast even though we ordered well in advanced. I WOULD ADVICE NOT TO ORDER HERE!

Delicious, fresh and affordable sushi! Such good quality and lovely staff if dining in for a casual experience but I also love to pick it up for a lovely takeaway. Some really good options. And spotlessly clean!

You can never go wrong with jollof rice, plantain, and chicken - a big portion for £8 only! Beautiful and delicious, the plantains by themselves would be £2. The owner was super nice and friendly.

It’s a little tight inside to walk around, but very cosy!
JOLLOF & BEEF WAS AMAZING! Service quick and easy and even came out to my car when it was ready. Thank you. They are so kind and flavours were 10/10
First time trying this place and it was delicious! The lady at the front was lovely and helped me choose a great meal. Will definitely be back
SOOOOO TASTY！highly recommend

Was unsure about trying this place but I am happy I did. Jollof was delicious cooked perfectly, pounded yam and pepper soup was great too. I think it is a decent price for what it is, great portions and the meat is actually meat pieces rather than grissle. Will definitely be ordering again!

Ordered 2 pounded yam, order arrived with package damaged and I called the restaurant a lady was arguing that she was the one that packed the order, that there is no way but I showed the pictures. This is also not the first time it happened.

Made a bulk order of jollof rice, meat pie, fried plain, puff puff and chin chin. Kept me constantly updated on when the food would arrive, they also were able to provide me extra rice and meat as they were a little low on the meat pie which went down great!

Would definitely order again, probably had the best puff puff I've ever had!

This is the second time I’ve ordered from them and it’s absolutely horrible. First time was was terribly uncooked, items missing from my order. Second, beans was terrible and friend, no oil, felt like it had been refrigerated forever. I honestly can’t give a worse review, better to go to bed hungry.

Went to pick up food after ordering from the too fresh to go app. The lady who served me was incredibly rude. Another member of staff asked for my code so I showed her and the lady who was initially serving me had a go at me for showing the other staff member the code because she was already serving me... I'm just doing what what asked... Have a go at your staff not me. To top it off the food I got was an abysmal portion. Customer service is seriously lacking

Wow! AsoRock delivered exceptional food for our corporate Black History month day.

I would highly recommend for large events. Some of our colleagues had never had some of the food before and loved it. The puff puff, Chicken drumsticks and Jollof with red stew were a ESPECIALLY enjoyed. It was all delicious (and arrived hot).

I kept in contact via WhatsApp for any questions or queries, from deciding what to order, to knowing when the food would be delivered on the day.

The food was really good and the atmosphere was clean, welcoming, and very inviting. From the moment I walked in, the space felt comfortable and well kept, which made the experience even better. I ordered the egusi soup with pounded yam, jollof rice, plantain, and asun. Everything tasted fresh and full of flavor. The egusi soup paired perfectly with the pounded yam, and the jollof rice and plantain were both cooked really well. My favorite part of the meal was definitely the asun — it was seasoned perfectly and had an amazing smoky flavor. Overall, it was a great experience and I would definitely come back again.

The wait for food here was excruciating. We were supposed to eat in. They said the food will take 20 minutes but it ended taking like 1.5 hours and after each 10 minutes, they come and say food is coming in 10 minutes. It was like the 10 minutes was endless. We eventually got up left cause we were going to be late for work. Asked them to refund what we've paid and then excuses started flooding in like the manager was not around. It was just such a disaster. Just for that alone, I can't recommend and won't visit again.

Great restaurant, lovely meal, amazing flavours. You’ll leave with full bellies and happy wallets. The price point is perfect. They are a little stingy with the drinks and also made a mistake with one of the drinks we ordered which they rectified but still charged for. Only downside.
The food was delicious and the service excellent the atmosphere was lovely with live music in the restaurant

Delicious from start to finish.
Excellent service and great atmosphere.
Very helpful with the menu, there was something thing for everyone.
Don’t forget to ask if you like it spicy, or not :)

I have been here twice and enjoyed my meal. The servers were polite and the food came in quickly. I ordered different dishes on both occasions and enjoyed them thoroughly. No complaints. Also I find the food affordable and the portions decent.

I ordered pounded yam and beef today. When I opened the box there was no sauce with my beef. The box and white paper bag was covered in sauce  and the box with the beef was damaged. The beef was very salty and I was sent a big piece of fat. Very disappointing, will never buy from them again.

Thank you Banke’s kitchen for your amazing food and prices!! I’ve been a customer for a very long time now and they never disappoint. Delivery is always quick and food is always amazing!! 10/10 recommend

My mum placed an order for jollof rice as part of their catering service, and while the food may good itself, the customer service was extremely disappointing. I called three days before the scheduled pick up just to amend the collection time as my mum made an initial mistake when placing the order, and the staff and owner were unnecessarily rude on the phone. She insisted on calling my mum directly even though she was right there with me while I made the call. This kind of unprofessional attitude is really off putting and reflects poorly on the business.

Bit of advice and please take it, if you want repeat customers or referrals, you really need to improve how they treat people!

Avoid this place  scammers.
Ordered 2 meat pepper soups and got 2 fish (catfish + tilapia). I’ve got a fish allergy, so it was unsafe. I called them and they were useless — when I called back they hung up twice. Then they had the nerve to tell me to order again so they can “replace” one.

If I could give this 0 stars I would! I ordered pounded yam, egusi and two drinks off uber eats. Firstly they got my order wrong as the driver showed up with no drinks. Secondly the food was cold as if they took it out the fridge. Clearly didn’t even bother to heat it up. I’m staying in a hotel with no resource to heat the meal. By this point I was very frustrated but left with no other option I started to eat the cold food only to taste nonsense. It clearly had not been fried well, I could taste the tomato (mixed with stew) acidity which indicates it not being cooked long enough. I couldn’t even finish the meal, straight into the trash.
Also for the amount I paid (£15.60) why am I getting half of a small container of soup?!

I will never order from this place again!

The most tasteless nigerian food I've ever tried
in my life! The only good thing is their service
and that the beef was tender. I'm new to the area and still exploring, came back from work having
eaten nothing at all and thought to give it a try,
spent £8 and regret it. Tell me how you make rice and stew and there's water at the bottom, also there was barely any stew, the stew
to rice portion was horrible.
Lovely staff, travelled from south London to eat here with a friend. Reasonable price. Thankyou we will be back! :)

Tasty food, customer service is good portion size is ok too but you have to order a couple of meals to fill you up the only thing. Other than that overall a nice place to eat and has been going for years.

I just called as I notice on just eat that price have gone up, when calling I asked does the price match the portions and the phone was put down on my ears. I will not be ordering from here again, i will not part with £14.30 for small size swallow. Its ridiculous.  Just lost a very long time customer.
My goodness! Mama Vic been cooking that good good joloff and chicken and fish for years and u can feel the love in the food!

Wanted to try another West Indian/ African cuisine and stumbled across mana vics. Have never seen it busy nor heard much about it.  Orderd the medium oxtail with two types of rice, I asked if it was spicy and the server replied it is good as it is and that's how we like it, I replied ok but do you have any spicy sauces ( chilli) I was given peppers and onions which were a let down.

After ordering the oxtail and dumplings o proceeded to eat outside the place and found it unpleasant, tomatoes stench oxtail with exuberant amounts of oil leaking. Tasted of poverty without any prideful notes, I was outraged that I had to waste this food and paid more than the menu has intended. The women behind the counter said the menu was a misprint so prices are higher, a word of advice, print new menus prices and please be adapted to customers specifications.

P.s dumplings were soggy and tasted of plain distraught
Delicious and abundant, saved to favourites and will be coming back! Quiet spot in the middle of Dalston. The cook is the loveliest lady.
Amazing lady, amazing food. Made with love and professionalism. Absolutely go for it!
Chicken was soo good and the lady is so friendly. Prices are very reasonable too

name: Mr P Taste Of Africa - Homerton
address: 106 Homerton High St, London E9 6JA, UK

reviews.text:
We tried Mr P today and to be honest the food was good. The meat pie was really nice, the puff puff was amazing and the plantain was alright they could have used plantain that had ripened more so that they would be a bit sweeter. We also got some Waakye and some stew sauce, with a piece of chicken. The food tasted really good and for the price it was worth it.

The Waakye was nice however it did kind of taste burnt like we got the bottom of the pot however it wasn’t too bad and didn’t really changed the taste of the food. The chicken was also quite nice, no problem there.

However, and this is a big however, the food hygiene rating of Mr P on the 13th of June 2024 was a 0 and the comment was that it required urgent improvement. The only problem listed was how the food is stored which I’m guessing is due to the food being stored in the fridge and being heated up using a microwave.

But in all honesty we enjoyed the food we ate and we didn’t have any bad side effect from it. So whether or not you choose to eat from here is up to you, but we’ll definitely be going back, for the puff puff and meat pie.

Ordered turkey stew and the turkey was just boiled and put in a sauce. It was pale and white outside the stew. It wasnt fried after boiling. I ordered jerk chicken and that chicken was warmed up to the point it was dry and hard. No taste at all to show its jerk chicken. The jollof rice and fries rice were mid. Puff puff and meat pie were very delicious.
Ive ordered from this place before it move to Eko old site and I never had any issues. I wonder what has changed. Sad

I requested a very simple dessert, the sweet balls and some plantain. The lady serving me couldn’t pause her phone call conversation for one second to get my order right. She was doing the wrong thing in front of me and I was so confused because I asked her politely. I didn’t get what I wanted as her unbothered facial expression does not appear receptive to constructive criticism. Be nice, it’s free! 🤑

I've  ordered from this restaurant at least 4 times. Today I received this kind of chicken; bad smell and clearly gone off!!! They charge double for the meat and fish pie(£4 each) online, and £2 in the restaurant. They don't always have what you order, for example they had no jellof rice and fish. It's a good thing they call, to at least let you know. The turkey skin had hairs on it also. Overall, food quality is slacking!!!
My partner ordered fried rice tonight via Uber Eats, but the food delivered was spoiled. The fried rice was slimy and tasted awful. I could only eat the chicken and plantain that came with it.

name: The Good Front Room
address: Thomas Tower, Dalston Square, London E8 3GU, UK

reviews.text:
Such a welcome addition to Dalston, located at the back of Dalston Junction and within walking distance from Dalston Kingsland.

The Good Front Room is a continuation of Chef Dom Taylor's original stint at The Langham and if you've followed his success, you know the food will be on point.

The menu consists of Caribbean highlights with a modern twist.  Favourites were the moist and delicate roast sea bream, the short rib (yum!), the red mullet and curry goat.  Great cocktails and a good selection of wine to choose from.

A couple of points deducted for the haphazard service and bill overcharge (on both visits), so do watch that.  That aside, the restaurant has a relaxed vibe and setting and should do well.

Get down there and support!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I recently took my grandson to enjoy fine dining for his 18th birthday at The Good Front Room, and it was a truly special experience. I had previously eaten at the original Good Front Room at The Langham Hotel, so my expectations were high — and I can honestly say Chef Dom did not disappoint, for either me or my grandson. And the bottle of bubbly on the house was truly a lovely treat. Thank you 🙏🏾

His creative twists on our staple Caribbean dishes had our taste buds exploding, taking us on a beautiful walk down memory lane while still feeling fresh and exciting. The waiting staff were friendly, polite and welcoming throughout the evening.

We did understand there were a few teething issues, but nothing that spoiled our experience at all. It was a wonderful evening, and we will definitely be back very soon

Tucked away in the heart of Dalston, The Good Front Room feels exactly like its name suggests — warm, welcoming, and effortlessly cool. The vaulted ceiling and laid-back décor give it that “come in, take your coat off, stay a while” energy. No rush, no fuss, just vibes.

And let’s talk about the music — because it deserves its own little moment. The playlist took me straight down memory lane, the kind that sneaks up on you with a smile. Perfectly pitched too: great atmosphere, never too loud, so you can still chat, laugh, and actually hear yourself think (a rare luxury).

The menu is where things really start to flirt with you. Classic Caribbean foundations with a playful spin — the sort of surprises that tell you this place has personality, not just recipes. You can taste the care, and that always hits differently.

The finish was my favourite part. The rice and peas were pure comfort, rich and full of flavour. The pork was beautifully tender — no wrestling required. And the rum punch? It absolutely had a punch. Sip with confidence… or caution.

Dessert was lovely, though it definitely needed more custard — and yes, I will die on that hill. Still, it didn’t dampen the experience one bit.

All in all, The Good Front Room delivers warmth, flavour, nostalgia, and atmosphere in equal measure. A place that feeds both your belly and your memories. I’d absolutely return — and soon. 🍹🎶🍚 @remnantsrita

What a special place. The Good Front Room is one of a kind. The food is insane.

We came during the 12 Days of Christmas event. There was an incredible set menu, goat’s sausage roll and plantain fritters as hors d’oeuvres, then glazed pork belly and jerk chicken to start. For mains we had the brown stew braised beef and banana leaf fish, with rice and peas, mac and cheese, coleslaw, and plantain on the side. Every single dish was packed with flavour and beautifully cooked.

The spiced bun with whipped blue cheese and cranberry was such a fun, unexpected course, and the sweet potato sticky toffee pudding with mango sorbet was the perfect finish.

We also had a few cocktails which were lovely and really well balanced.

Incredible food, great atmosphere, and one of those meals you keep thinking about afterwards. We’ll definitely be back.

The food is the absolute best, but unfortunately this was a disappointing evening. The Front of house hostess is a gem! Very kind, friendly and welcoming. I was greeted and shown to my seat upon arrival. All staff I encountered were very polite and nice, but seemed to lack experience, or at least experience working together. My low service score was due to the major delays in everything from the bar to the kitchen. I arrived at 8:15 pm and it was 11:26 pm when I left with my main (missing the potatoes, which I was looking forward to because they were suppose to be "proper"), sides and dessert in foil containers. Shout out and thanks to the gentleman who found a shopping bag in the back for me to use. I was really looking forward to this meal. Due to a change in schedule, I even went by myself because I have wanted to try Chef Dom's food for years.
The good: The food. The best jerk chicken I have ever tasted anywhere in the world. I wrote to Jamaican, Antiguan, Trinidadian Canadian family from the restaurant to tell them about it and share pics. Everything I tasted was incredible - even the takeaway at home today!
The hostesses. Both were very professional,  apologetic and understanding. The servers, I could tell, were trying their best.
The bad: not so bad. Opportunities for improvement: Offer guests water when they are seated. I ordered a cocktail and it took 20 minutes to arrive. Nobody stopped by and ask if I needed anything. I asked for water when the cocktail arrived. Communication: speak to your guests and ask of they need/want anything. Let them know there are delays so their expectations are managed. The hostess checked on me more than the servers. Also, communicate with each other. There was a lot of buzz around who was waiting for what and who brought what to which table and what table was what. Perhaps assign servers a dedicated seating area so they can get give their best to the guests in their area and become experts on what's going on in their section.
The ugly: whatever was going on behind the scenes. When customers make a reservation and there's a fairly set menu with a 2-hour max, I never expected spending 3 hours and only a starter and an entrée were served completely. An incomplete main without the sides just didn't make sense.
Conclusion: Chef Dom is a fabulous Chef. I would pay to eat his creations again, anytime, but only if it was catered or if I had a table full of friends with me and we had no plans for at least 4 hours.

All staff members are polite and welcoming. Shop is very clean. They have a great variety of food and the prices is good. The food is very tasty. Fried dumplings are nice and soft, fried chicken is delicious and the jerk chicken is authentic. The sauce on the jerk chicken is absolutely delicious. They cook a fresh pot of soup daily and every day is a different flavour. I will definitely be going back.

I discovered this shop about a month ago, when I was casually walking past. The crazy thing is, I live locally and was not aware of this carribean food shop. Anyway, the jerk chicken was lovely and I shall return when I can't be bothered to cook. 😅✌🏿

Absolutely delicious! A must-visit spot! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I visited Blue Mountain Caribbean Cuisine on the 10th of May and I was blown away. I ordered the steamed fish with crackers 🐟 and it was absolutely divine — full of flavour, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to perfection. You could taste the freshness in every bite! 😋

The presentation was beautiful, and the portion size was generous. The staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive, making the whole experience even better. The restaurant was spotless ✨ and the ambience was relaxed and truly captured that authentic Caribbean vibe 🌴

You can tell this place takes pride in their food and service. Highly recommend for anyone craving real Caribbean-Jamaican cuisine 🇯🇲

I’ll definitely be back! Delicious food, great people, perfect vibes!

I had the small jerk chicken with coleslaw and plantain - all in 9 quid.

Really tasty, am stuffed and got a bit left over for later. The rice and peas was super fresh and a classic jerk sauce.

It was middle of the day so was quiet but that only means super speedy service. Ideal.
Amazing food! The curry goat melted in my mouth. Thank you Kianne for the lovely service!! I’ll be back xxx

name: Possible Kitchen Caribbean Restaurant & Takeaway
address: 26 Downs Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8DB, UK

reviews.text: A really great new spot - staff are really friendly, food is fantastic, and cleanliness is 10/10! Have been twice now and both meals were excellent - really wish the best for these guys!

We recently celebrated my son’s 3rd birthday with a lunch at this wonderful new spot on Hackney Downs Road, and I honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.
From the moment we arrived, the service was exceptional warm, attentive, and genuinely thoughtful. Hosting a children’s birthday can be a little hectic, but the team made everything feel effortless. Every detail was handled with care, and we felt completely looked after throughout.
And the food absolutely delicious. Every dish was beautifully prepared and full of flavour, with a quality that really stood out. It’s rare to find a place that delivers both outstanding food and such a welcoming atmosphere, but this restaurant truly does both.
A special thank you to the manager and the entire team for helping make my son’s birthday so memorable. Your kindness and professionalism did not go unnoticed, and it meant a lot to us.
We’ll definitely be back and will be recommending this gem to friends and family. Thank you again for such a fantastic experience!

This restaurant is the best Caribbean restaurant you will ever visit. Ambiance is great, the owner is amazing and makes you feel welcome.

Every dish I have tried so far on a scale from 1-10 is 10. The curried goat is delicious. The Cow foot soup is the best I ever tasted. The Festival, the fried Dumplings all yummy.

The Fish and vegetarian food is lush. Visit them at 259 Well street in Hackney you won’t regret it.

From the moment we arrived, everything felt welcoming and well-organized. The hostess greeted us with a smile, and the waiter guided us through the menu with thoughtful recommendations. I ordered the pasta with wild mushrooms and truffle oil — absolutely divine! The flavor was deep and earthy, and the texture was perfect. The ambiance was warm and relaxing, ideal for an evening out.

I’ve been here on many occasions as I’ve been working locally for a while now. In the local area this is definitely my favourite place to eat! The food is GREAT, costumer service is GREAT and efficiency is also GREAT! I keep going back for the Oxtail with rice and peas… the way they make it is out of this world. I’m a guy that loves spice, but I choose not to have their spicy sauce on it as it changes the flavour of their cooked meal. Every time is always like the first time. I always look forward to going back there, again and again! See you guys soon!
Very good jerk chicken best I've had in a long while . The lady is very friendly and has a very good energy about her . Top food with. A smile and a bit of banter lovely thank you
Delicious food, good prices and loads of veggie and pescatarian options. The staff were so welcoming and friendly - will be coming back.

Survivor Caribbean Takeaway in Dalston is one of those places that reminds you why good Caribbean food never goes out of style. The food is genuinely great, with generous portions that do not play games and prices that feel fair in a time when everything else seems to be creeping up. You leave full and satisfied, which is always the goal.
The staff are pleasant and welcoming, giving the place a relaxed, friendly vibe that makes you feel comfortable ordering and asking questions. Service can be a little slow at times, especially when they are busy, but that usually tells you the food is being cooked properly rather than rushed. The seating area is small, so it is much better suited to takeaway than sitting in, but that does not really take away from the overall experience.
All in all, it is definitely worth a visit if you are in Dalston and craving proper Caribbean food that delivers on flavour, portion size, and value. You might wait a little, but your taste buds will forgive you.

My favourite Caribbean takeaway in the area. I visit here once a month and enjoy everything on the menu! Food is tasty and portions are generous.
The prices are fair and I'm always satisfied. Staff are really friendly and it's handy that there is a seating area and tables to eat. The only downfall is there is restricted Street parking.

The food is fresh and tasty! Their Jerk chicken is the best I've tasted in London. I wasn't sure about the Jerk sauce and they offered to make me taste it. I really appreciated that. (Great customer service) The jerk sauce was perfect. We came back twice in the same week. Highly recommended!

My food was lovely.. my portion size was also very good.. I ordered small jerk chicken and rice… I also ordered coleslaw which was also very nice.. my food came piping hot and ready to eat.. my only complaint… was I ordered 2 extra jerk gravy.. only one turned up and it was cold…? I was clearly ordering it to go over my jerk chicken and rice…? Why would u send it cold… other than that very enjoyable

Good curried goat and large portions. Only downsides is sometimes the meat curries contain a large amount of bones with less meat than desired. Very friendly staff too. Would definitely recommend, especially if quite hungry.

name: Bana's Grill
address: Army & Navy Pub, 1-3 Matthias Rd, Mayville Estate, London N16 8NN, UK

reviews.text: I used Bana’s Grill To Cook some jerk chicken for my 50th birthday party and oh boy what a treat. The thighs were perfectly cooked perfectly seasoned and went down extremely well with every single guest. There was not a burger left. Highly recommend. Staff were very friendly they came and they delivered to my party location with neat tidy containers in a very timely manner.

We placed a bit of a last minute order with Banas and they really came through for us. Professional service from start to finish and most importantly, the food was fresh and delicious! They even provided heating instructions to ensure that our guests always received hot food. We will definitely book with Banas again!!

I stopped by Bana’s Grill after hearing great things, and it did not disappoint! The chicken was perfectly grilled—crispy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside, with a smoky, flavorful marinade that hit all the right notes. The jerk BBQ sauce was amazing, and the sides (especially the coleslaw & mac & cheese) were fresh and tasty. The staff was super friendly, and the service was quick even during busy periods.The place had a relaxed vibe and was impeccably clean. I’ll definitely be back and recommend it to anyone craving top-notch Caribbean/Cypriot infused food.

Bana’s Grill provided my work lunch week in week out. After the first week of enjoying Bana’s Grill, my colleagues at work started noticing how good the food looked and smelled. Soon, they began pre-ordering their meals with me every week.

Every single time, the food was packed with flavour and perfectly cooked. The portions were always generous, always leaving us satisfied
Finding a place that delivers this level of quality every week is rare, but Bana’s Grill has truly mastered it. Highly recommended!

I’m an Event Manager and have hired Bana’s Grill for several community events, with around 2000 attendees at each, where they have been 1 of 2-4 food vendors on site.

The team are always super friendly both on the day of the event and throughout planning.  They’re on site and set up in great time and make things seamless and stress free.

We’ve had long queues at their stand at all events and they deal with these really well and professionally. The food is flavourful, tasty and hot. We’ve had great feedback from our attendees who have really enjoyed the food.

Would highly recommend them especially for events ☺️

name: Octaves
address: 110 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 7NY, UK

reviews.text: This was a meet up with a cousin i hadn't seen in a long time, so we were looking for a great vibe with great food.  We each chose 5 things off the menu for £25. The portions were good and the presentation was fantastic. The curry goat could have done with a bit more flavour and the oxtail was a bit fatty.  The St Lucia Sour was the most delicious cocktail that washed everything down. The service was exceptional and the sweet reggae music was the perfect vibe!

I would like to begin by expressing my admiration for the concept of this restaurant and the fact that it is Black-owned. However, I feel compelled to share my disappointment with the "all you can eat" offerings. Firstly, I encountered a discrepancy between the pricing advertised on Instagram and TikTok, which indicated £30 per person, and the menu in the restaurant, which listed £50 per person. This constitutes false advertising, and in light of the current cost of living, I believe it is essential for communication and social media updates to reflect accurate pricing to avoid such confusion. Nowhere, not even on the website, did it mention the £50 per person charge for the all-you-can-eat option. Additionally, many other all-you-can-eat establishments charge between £20-30, which made the £50 price feel unreasonable, especially since we had booked for a birthday dinner and had limited options for a Friday evening.

Upon our arrival, the door sign read “closed,” and it wasn’t until we were waiting outside in the cold that someone came to change it. The service from the waitress was adequate, though she seemed frustrated that not all of our party had arrived. While I understand this, a welcoming smile and a warm greeting are fundamental in hospitality.

Now, regarding the food, as someone with Jamaican and Nigerian heritage, I was particularly excited to experience the all-you-can-eat buffet, as I usually have to travel quite far to South London for this. The process was confusing, as we were handed a piece of paper with the dishes from the menu and asked to select quantities for the first, second, or third rounds. There was no clear explanation about this process on their website or social media, which made the experience more complicated. Communication with the staff was also lacking, giving the impression of disorganization.

The "all you can eat" menu only included dishes from the left side of the menu, and unfortunately, the food was underwhelming. The portions were so small. Many of the items, including the curry goat, oxtail, rice and peas, saltfish, fish and vegetable fritters, were disappointing, with a flavour rating of 2/10, which was especially disheartening as they are some of my favourite Caribbean dishes. We had to return food multiple times, such as the plantain, which was under-ripe, hard, and burnt, and the rice and peas, which was also burnt and lacked flavor. The curry goat was very spicy but lacked depth of taste, and the fritters were excessively salty and greasy. We made it clear that we would not be paying the £10 wastage fee since the food was not up to acceptable standards. On several occasions, the waitress seemed reluctant and slightly irritable when we returned items, and the kitchen staff appeared visibly frustrated as well.

As a customer, when I am paying £50 for a meal, I expect it to be of high quality, at least an 8/10, if not a 10/10. I have experience working in hospitality for over 10 yrs and understand the importance of ensuring that customers enjoy both the food and the service, and unfortunately, neither met expectations. Sadly, I won’t be returning, as the food didn’t taste authentic and gave the impression that it catered to more white customers than black afro Caribbean people. The only dish I truly enjoyed was the soup, which, though quite spicy, I can easily make myself at a much lower cost.

I do want to shoutout to the young black lady who was new and served us on multiple occasions. She always interacted with us in a polite and friendly manner. I had planned to use my £20 as tip for the servers but the food was £50 not £30 like on their instagram.

We went on a Sunday around 12.30/1pm and travelled all the way from Southampton (over two hour drive).

I think this place is overpriced for the quality of the food. Everything was extremely over cooked (salmon was so hard, same with the chicken and fried fish). Mac and cheese was tasteless with a hard shell of cheddar sitting on the top and the prawns were unbelievably dry. Rice and peas had no moisture, I think the hill of was uncle bens microwave rice (sent this back) and the jerk chicken was hard to cut. The pieces were also pretty strange, one being the end part of a chicken thigh? Definitely worth giving a full size piece of chicken here.
Not sure if this was an off day but the dry food ruined the experience for me. Perhaps it was old or left over from Saturday? Or maybe to beat the negative comments about waiting for food they are making everything in advance?

Lovely presentation of food and the curry’s were tasty and juicy. I would recommend the goat, oxtail, fritters, fries and coleslaw if I was going to go again and just order from the menu.

I love the restaurant and the service was great. Unfortunately when we gave feedback on the food we didn’t get much back or any verbal acknowledgment other than the receipt.

Save your coin and order from the menu or head to 876 uptown. It is also halal and at £20 per head with amazing quality of food, it’s worth the journey.

Octaves Restaurant overall was ok 👍
Decor could do with an uplift as quite dark and dated. Wooden seats were a bit uncomfortable.
Service wasn't consistant and we were impressed that although we paid a deposit when we booked, we had to pay for our meal upfront and had the worry of a £10 wastage fee if we didn't finish what we ordered. In all fairness, the restaurant had imposed this because customers were taking advantage of the all you can eat menu and over ordering  food.
Our deposit was refunded after we finished eating.
Didn't like the way you had to use a form to tick off the items you wanted each round.
Staff were courteous and polite despite restaurant policies and them answering all our questions.

Food when it came was really delicious 😋

I saw the negative reviews for Octaves but decided to come anyway for a birthday dinner, as it was hyped when it first opened last year, and a new Caribbean restaurant is always a good thing. They were very accommodating to our changes to the large group booking which was appreciated.

We chose to get the a la carte menu instead of the buffet due to most bad reviews being based on the buffet service.

The food was mostly good, the salt fish fritters and peppered prawns were delicious. However, some dishes were very under average and dry, the rice and jerk chicken seemed to be warmed up from the day before. The service wasn’t spectacular, it was really hard to order more food or drinks or get water for the table. Each time we asked we were given a small jug with to fill 3 glasses, for a much larger table. One of the staff members gave an air that we were a massive inconvenience but one of them was very friendly. It seemed like maybe they needed one more server to support.

We brought out surprise birthday cake but they served the cake dishes before bringing the cake out, and the food all came out in waves so the rice was cold by the time the chicken came out. Overall the restaurant is OK, but maybe not worth £35pp

name: Wingbay
address: 171 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BP, UK

reviews.text: The food was delicious and cooked to perfection with quality ingredients, a must try to have a proper taste of the Caribbean cuisine, would definitely recommend and will be back - Special mention to Jay who made me feel welcome from start to finish and made sure I was happy with everything, thank you!

Wing Bay Jamaican Kitchen in N16 is a real gem! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and vibrant. I highly recommend starting with their house rum punch – it was absolutely delicious and the perfect way to kick off the evening. My friend raved about the pepper steak, saying it was packed with flavour and cooked to perfection. The service was friendly and efficient, making for a truly enjoyable dining experience. We'll definitely be back for more of their fantastic food and drinks!

We had the jerk chicken and oxtail boxes, they were both very nice with good portions each and nice refreshing salad that came with our side of choice. We dined in and the service was amazing, we felt very catered to with a lovely candle lit dinner. 😉

Our work staff came here for our work christmas dinner. The food was amazing, the staff were great. We were orginally meant to go to another resturant which was closed só we stumvled across this one and glad this one was open as the food was amazing. I would definetly recomend and the red punch I had is to die for. It was worth every penny.It was a good touch they had background music aswell, our staff team player 2 galed of churacdes on our phones and then the food was there. So the wait time wasn't long at all which was great. I will definetly come again next time with my children. Thank you I will defo be back.

The chicken wings were tasty, and with a portion of fries…the portion was too small for £13. The wait was lengthy but we were informed it would be. Friendly staff, BUT Abit more professionalism wouldn’t go amiss. However I would go back for take away, this place has very real potential to be GREAT, but there isn’t enough of an ambiance for an eat-in meal.

Update- Response to owner.

Thank you for your response.
I wasn’t offered a drink as part of the meal nor was I offered a choice of sauce in my box meal, I opened it to find a bbq dip.
I suppose a drink would make the cost feel more worthwhile.

name: Double Knot - Hackney Downs
address: 1, 1a Downs Ln, Lower Clapton, London E8 2AQ, UK

reviews.text: 10/10 food most definitely recommend! The curry goat loaded patty is a must so flavourful and best quality of food. The loaded fries were definitely loaded with a generous portion of jerk chicken. The food came so quick and you can eat inside or take it away. Service was great too. Will definitely be coming back🤩
