The food was very delicious, well seasoned and flavourful. I would definitely go here again, portions are great worth every penny. I would say jerk chicken loaded fries my favourite.

The customer service was warm and welcoming, and the staff was very informative. They helped me choose the best food options, which I really appreciated. The stuffed lobster mac and cheese was rich in flavour super cheesy, gooey, and absolutely delicious. It had me melting with every bite. I also had the oxtail stuffed patty, and it was just amazing. Everything in it came together perfectly. The prices are affordable, and I definitely know where I’ll be going from now on. It’s a 5-star experience for me ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The service was great the young lady who served me this evening she was spot-on you know sometimes you’ve got places. People look at you up and down but this place felt like Home thank you.

The food I ordered the oxtail patty with Mac and cheese
And I ordered the jerk patty with mac and cheese

1 The oxtail  was amazing definitely going to get that again, just melts in your mouth woooow

2 The jerk it was 1010 no lie definitely coming back to get both of them again. It was amazing.

Thank you all love

I visited Double Knot in Hackney Downs with my two children and chose to dine in. The service leading up to placing my order was awesome, and the staff was very polite and helpful. I tried the prawns and chips, and while the prawn seasoning was lovely, the frying coating was over-crunchy and dark, suggesting possibly old oil. I also found a short hair on one of the chips, which was off-putting. Additionally, when my three-year-old needed to use the restroom, the staff denied her access, which was disappointing. Overall, while the initial service was great, there’s definitely room for improvement in hygiene and customer care.
I was skeptical when i walked in, however the food was faultless and well priced

This is some of the best food I've ever tasted, excellent portions and great price, lovely service and we'll definitely be back for more, even if we do live in NW London. This place is worth the trip with every mouthful 😍 Chicken stew and jerk chicken to die for 🙏🏼
The food here is absolutely delicious! I’m a regular customer and always enjoy coming back.

Nice food but the lady is particularly rude and unwelcoming. Why spend your hard money to be treated like shit
This isn't the firstt time I've been in and even the last time I spent quite a lot of money and was treated with the same disgust it seems. Thisxtime though was made to feel like I was scum.

The service was excellent also the food touch my palet in a delicious way. I would love to visit soon again . I sit and enjoy my meal stew peas and white rice and Jamaican pickles on the side with a Jamaican ting. It was a enjoyable first experience.

Worst Jamaican food I have ever had, I was really looking forward to trying some Jerk Chicken and Rice & Peas for my diner and so I ordered it through uber. I couldn't cut my knife through the chicken meat as it was tough, burnt and definitely not fresh. I was absolutely disgusted coupled with disappointment.
The Rice & Peas was extremely dry and flavourless. My wife and I had to throw our food away. Never again will I be ordering from here. We gave you a try and you failed to impress us.

Absolutely 💯  starving I ate the 2 spinners 2 pice of carrot and a small mouthful of yam!!!! This was a large soup wow!!! This was not soup it was juice wid da bottom of the pot ,I rang and just got rudnesss £5 .50 for juce,oh they guy had the cheek to say you need to request more bits in da soup!!!!BOYCOTT DONT BUY FROM THIS SHOO AND DA RESST OFF THE FOOD SUCKED 17 POUNDS LATER AND STILL HUNGRY

I don’t often write reviews but this was a must! I’m always skeptical on trying new places but me & my daughter gave this a go. We were overly, pleasantly & very happy with trying your delicious food! The flavours were on point! There were no spillages, wrapped nicely, arrived hot & overall one very satisfied customer! We have definitely found a new place to order on our take out days! Thank you! Just for record we had Curry Goat, Mac & cheese, plaintain & dumplings. Highly recommend this wonderful restaurant!

As an Italian, I do recognise when food is made with love. Their curry goat is made with LOTS of love, and slow cooked too!

I ordered many times from Mama's kitchen and was always satisfied. It's take away only so you can either order online or you can pop by (cash only)!
Order of Uber eats and just eats twice they always send old food which tastes stale. Chicken should be white on the inside not black like the food has been rotting for days will not recommend

name: Riteaway Caribbean Delights & Takeaway
address: 113 Downs Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8DB, UK

reviews.text: One of the local spots, if your tryna get that authe tic island flavour at lunch time pop down to Rite Away for the delicious stewed chicken on rice and peas paired with a coselaw, the food will have your mouth watering.

really clean take out restaurant with a small eat in area
i ordered the mac and cheese, it was really good after warmed up in the microwave
service was helpful, cashier was kind and patient with explaining the menu
a bit of music would make for a better atmosphere
Honestly disappointed. The food was cold, bland, and felt rushed. Definitely not worth the money very disrespectful people

My third time ordering and the food is amazing 10/10 everytime!! The oxtail is my favourite, well seasoned and the rice and peas so coconutty. I get all the sides as everything is banging down to the mac and cheese which is a mustttt. Amazing portions and some of the best food I have had in a while, im addicted!!

Catered for my mums 70th birthday, the food was of top standard and loved by all guess. Great portion sizes.

The jerk chicken was especially a hit, will definitely be using again and would 100% recommend to others.

name: R AND B Carribbean Restaurant Hackney
address: 10 Clarence Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8HB, UK

reviews.text: This is what they call food, not worth the money not worth the bother, they get your order wrong and cant cook

Used to come here with my father-in-law who recently passed away on 2/12. I stopped by to pass along this information. I tried to order at the counter and was immediatley refused service.  A bald headed mug with glasses asked me to leave the premises without explaination. Pure disrespect. Ive been downstairs in the "private areas" many times. Not sure why a public resteraunt needs vip areas? Anyones guess is as good as mine

Honestly, I’ll be reading the comments. I don’t understand why people are being so negative for I went to the shop for the first time yesterday and the owner was such an amazing lady.

She even allowed me to come behind her too and check out the food that she was making people saying in the conversation that It’s microwave food. I did not see her. Use a microwave not once.

She served me curry goat, rice and peas and asked for boiled dumpling, So people don’t pay no attention to what these people are saying

Please go down there and try the store for yourself. She cooks the food like good old home Jamaican cooking.

I ordered porridge, jerk chicken and curry goat with boiled dumpling on just eats , they forgot the dumpling ran out of  porridge but  still charged me for it. The steamed veg that came with the curry goat tasted sour and both the chicken and curry goat was mad salty. Save your money
Unprofessional , cancelling people order for no reason, what the point having your shop advertised on just eat then😏

name: People's Choice Caribbean
address: 51B Chatsworth Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0LH, UK

reviews.text: One of the best addresses in London so far for jerk chicken and vegetarian options. I highly recommend. Every time pass by Chadworth road I’ll go grab some food anytime of the day. I always bring my friends there. It’s a really good spot. The owners are really kind and both lovely. Always offering a table for you outside. This spot has great food but also a soul.

Each day Lenny fires up the drum to cook jerk chicken outside his store People’s Choice in Hackney. We walked past one day and it was already sold out, so we went back on a Sunday. Ordered the jerk chicken and it was incredible!

Best jerk chicken i had in a long time, although my first time around returning home from a long trip i needed something to eat and trust me was not disappointed at all. That chicken was well-seasoned, amazing. Highly recommend the jerk chicken 10 out of 10.

Home made, Original Soul Food 👌🏼🤌🏼 Flavours, Price, Service and the Respect you get from this Family Old school Carribbean Take away, you can't get no where else unless you go south London. Jerk is Drum 🛢️ style Cooked to lock in those Smoked Flavours.. I've been going here for the last 3 years and every time it sorts me out for the rest of the evening. 💪🏻💪🏻💪🏻

Felt like a meaty lunch so had oxtail meal w plantain, rice and peas and coleslaw on the side - some of the best carribbean food I've had.

Love the name, convenient spot off the Chatsworth Road, service was lovely and fast, good value for size of portion, no complaints!

Beautiful experience! Went on my birthday. All staff, including the new guy were so friendly & attentive. The food was absolute heaven, plenty of flavourful vegan options. Hummus was some of the best I've had. Vine leaves were well stuffed, substantial, stimulating but not bitter. Gorgeous mocktails, refreshing Turkish tea. To top it, as it was my birthday, they gave us complimentary baklava & sang "Happy Birthday "

From the moment we arrived until we walked out the door the staff made us feel welcome with their warm and friendly attitude. The atmosphere was very chilled.

The service was impressively quick and dishes arrived promptly but never felt rushed. As for the food, it was absolutely delicious. Exactly what I needed.

We'll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a delightful Turkish dining experience.

Oh and the Turkish delight and Turkish tea was the perfect ending!

My wife, our baby, and I visited this restaurant for the first time, and we were truly amazed by everything — the quality of service, the incredible taste and freshness of the food, and the speed of the order. Most importantly, the owner is such a lovely and caring lady who genuinely looks after her customers. It’s clear that they’re already one of the best restaurants in Hackney, and I’m sure they’ll soon become the best in the area. They truly deserve it — the food is simply outstanding.

I specifically recommend Ali Nazik. Perfect.
So so good. Delicious food. Would definitely go back. Everything was juicy, and tasty. The baklava served with ice cream was a great finisher 😍

I went inside There was only two stuff One was by the grill one was by the Doner Guy by the grill Was watching something on his phone I think football and he put his phone on top of the bread so he can have a better view for football. He looked at me and he looked down car watching his football after one minute. He asked me yes please I asked him for life Doner and then he put his head and carried on watching football after one minute he went to the Doner mission. He opened the Doner mission and told his colleague one large Doner and. Carry on watching his football on his phone if you look at the fourth I put he put his phone on top of the bread it was disgusting Food was good

name: Pivaz
address: 34 Chatsworth Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0LP, UK

reviews.text: Superb food in a lovely restaurant. Baba ghanoush outstanding for starter, then a chicken sarma and a sutlach (rice pudding) dessert. Thanks to Baris and the team for an exceptional meal.

We had a wonderful evening at Pivaz! The food was absolutely delicious – full of flavour, beautifully presented, and with generous portions. The atmosphere was warm and relaxed, with both indoor and outdoor seating that created a great vibe.

What truly made the visit special was the owner/waiter. He took his time with each customer, was friendly, attentive, and genuinely cared about making sure everyone had a good experience. People like him are rare – and they make all the difference.

Highly recommended – we’ll definitely be coming back!

We had dinner at Pivaz Hackney tonight, and it was a fantastic experience! Our waitress, Nico, was incredibly sweet and attentive—her service was truly exceptional. She made sure everything was perfect for us and added a special touch to our evening. The service was quick, the staff was friendly, and the cozy ambiance made the night even more enjoyable. The portion sizes were generous, and everything was delicious. Huge thanks to the whole team for a wonderful night

Delicious dinner and a wonderful atmosphere! A special thanks to Lena — she was incredibly attentive, kind, and always smiling. She truly made our evening even better. Thank you for the warm welcome — we’ll definitely be back 💛

100% recommended!
I came for lunch and ended up staying for coffee.
The food was very filling and absolutely delicious (grilled chicken with salad, plus bread with red and garlic sauce), and the coffee was just perfect — a mocha with oat milk.
On top of that, Alex, the waiter, was very attentive and helpful.
I’ve just moved to the area, and I’m sure this will become my go-to place!
Thank you so much 😊

name: Abla Dalston
address: 123-125 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text: I order a yaprak doner and got this back street ally pigeon or horse meat doner. My dogs food looks better and eatable then this crab they served. The salad had carrots and few pices lettuce and some peices of tomatoes.

We popped in today for a quick lunch. The restaurant was empty but the food and the service was lovely. The staff were super friendly and the food was delicious. We got chicken shish kebab plates. The chicken was perfectly cooked and came with rice and a big portion of salad and other sides. The price was also fair for the portion sizes and the restaurant was super clean. Very happy and look forward to visiting again!

We had the lahmacun and lamb beyti — absolutely delicious! Abla Dalston is affordable, and the quality of the food exceeds that of competitors in the area. There were no check-backs, and we had to wave to get attention, but nothing too ridiculous. Overall, I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

Ordered food on ubereats and they sent completely different items to what they advertise.
Supposed to be yaprak doner but they sent rubber lamb meat , i can buy this from across the road for £5 🤣
Cop sis they sent me normal lamb shish
All in all rubbish service never again

We had dinner there ☺️, Food was delicious and service was ver good. They complement our kids with Rice pudding and was very yummy.
We enjoyed a lot ☺️

name: ADANA OCAKBAŞI - Meze & Bar
address: 17 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BH, UK

reviews.text: As a british turk i could confirm that this place cooks the best adana and uykuluk which is a speciality you cant find everywhere.  The staff were very friendly yet professional…. And omggg the uykuluk tastes outta this world. 100% recommend. Also want to say thank you for the beautiful atmosphere and amazing turkish music playlist.

Excellent food & service. We accidentally went in there because another Turkish restaurant across the that i used go in had completely changed their menu. I thought id try this place and was pleasantly surprised. The restaurant had a warm and friendly vibe. The staff were very friendly. The food was exceptional. I am Turkish and know what good Turkish food should taste like. We had the hot meze & the Adana special mixed platter for 2. Will definitely be back!

I went for a late lunch on Friday and was very impressed by the quality of the food on offer. Lamacuns being cooking in a wood fire oven, the adana kebab was fresh , deliciously smokey and flavorful, the dips salad and bread was all out of this world and and plated beautifully. Adana ockakbas is less well know than mangal 1 & mangal 2 in dalston but it's definitely fighting for the top spot for best turkish kebabs in London. The staff were also very welcoming and friendly offered turkish tea after the meal recommended a delicious baklava desert to compliment the tea. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Amazing food and incredible service! The lady who sat us down made us feel like a family member and the waitress was also super sweet. A lot of locals was a sign that the food was going to be delicious and it truly was. Generous portions and good quality. Highly recommend!

Been here a couple of times now . Highly recommend this Turkish restaurant. There is excellent service all round and the chef seems to know how to make authentic food
I also love that you are given free dishes of hummus and salad and bread and onions etc.The service is prompt and attentive. Real value for money - Go!

name: Mersin Tantuni Dalston Restaurant
address: 11 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BH, UK

reviews.text: Really great experience all round. Wonderful service from Zara who gave us great recommendations. The best (and first) Tantuni I’ve ever had - just delicious. Generous portion sizes at a reasonable price. Also a really great Kunefe for dessert. Couldn’t recommend more.

I’m going to be honest; first of all, I’d like to thank them for their customer-oriented service for accommodating us even though we hadn’t booked in advance. However, the taste of the food didn’t really suit my palate, and after trying it, I couldn’t continue eating. It seemed that the ingredients used were basically the same and only the rice or type of bread changed in each dish. We ordered different items, but the meat, cooking style, and flavor were identical.

My dish was very greasy and salty. The pieces of meat were served with fat and extra parts that should have been trimmed off, and everything was completely soaked in oil. The flavor wasn’t very pleasant, although the mixed appetizer platter we ordered at the beginning was good.

Our food took a very long time to arrive, while other orders had already been served, and our friends had to eat their food before it got cold. Although the staff who served us, Zahra, was very polite, attentive and kind.

At the end, we ordered kunafa and tea. The kunafa was ok, not the best, since it was greasy and oily, and instead of ice cream, cream was used on top. Overall, I would recommend this restaurant for the appetizer platter, but for main dishes, I think you need to enjoy oily and salty food to like it.

Best Turkish food in London I’ve ever had. The people here are so kind and hospitable you feel like you’re in your anane’s house. The Tantuni and Kunefe are truly delicious, even Ottolenghi are here! Prices are reasonable too. Do not hesitate and come here!!

Food was amazing!!! and service was friendly BUT they kept rushing me and my friend out because they needed the table even though we said our friend was coming? and our food got served later than people that ordered after us, and for some reason we didn’t get the complimentary pickles or tea… odd! But nonetheless food was amazing so defo coming back anyway

Everything was delicious and service was phenomenal. They love to assist and help you make decisions and give you all the time you need. The künefeci was not too sweet like every other place and coffee wasn't too strong despite being Turkish. 10/10 would recommend!

Bought a lamb shish takeaway served on a fallafel bread in a neat round cardboard dish. Very clean and modern looking inside. An indoor arcade takeaway style restaurant with a seperate small African grill kitchen and a small rotesserie chicken kitchen with seating all in the same complex with earlier closing times.
The takeaway serves lamb shwama and chicken kebab also offering a jerk chicken donner. Not very busy along mare street and rare to have shwama and fallafel in the area besides pitta bread and wrap. It's worth a few minutes walk if you're able to get there before 10:30pm when the grill is turned off on the 11pm closing time.
Would order from here again.
German Doner (beef) is a thing. We'll never go for lamb again. Super friendly service, decent portion, tasty, lovely bread (not pitta), fresh crunchy salad. Definitely coming back !

I've been visiting this place since its update and I liked the Turkish food then, but their new fusion with Caribbean cuisine has really made the food stand out.

The portions were always good and now with the unique taste, it's even better. I really enjoyed the jerk chicken doner kebab, and I'll try some of the other dishes when I visit next time.
Was craving a kebab, and this came up as a new local spot with good reviews. Lives up to it! Fresh flavours, really friendly staff and good range to menu. Will be coming back !
The gentlemen here at true taste munch spot are very hospitable kind and respectful the food is AMAZING! I got the jerk chicken doner and it’s the best thing I’ve eaten all year

name: Somine
address: 131 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text: I had the delicious lentil soup and Turkish tea . The staff Mustafa was very helpful and happy to help . Great vibes , clean & modern !! Must visit !! Highly recommended

Loved it here. Good price for a lot of food. Attentive waiters that cleared the table smoothly, and gave us everything we needed. I had the falafel and halloumi plate and it was yummy, but my favourite thing was the onion plate. My boyfriend had lamb chops and they looked delicious. Would recommend for a date or a lunch if you want a treat!

Great Turkish spot on the corner in Dalston! Super friendly and welcoming service, and the prices are amazing for the quality you get. A reliable, no-fuss place with great value — definitely worth a visit.

one of the best turkish meals i had so far in the uk! i’ve lived in istanbul before so i approve of the authenticity this place has. great portions, well-prepared lamb and chicken cuts… overall an amazing experience.

I come to this place for 8 years. Perfect delicious food. Never changed its quality, always better to best. Super friendly family staff and the food just male you hummmmm . I visit this place every time I travel from Amsterdam to London.  My favourite place 😍 ❤️

Went there on a Friday evening for dinner. The place was lively, but wasn't difficult to get a table for two. We heard that the Ezme salad, of all things, is a standout here, which was the reason we came.

We ordered the ezme, sujuc, rolled filo with cheese, liver on the grill, and adana kebab. The liver was a bit dry, but still taste good. The ezme is definitely a must. The rolled filo was light and crispy, one of the best I've had, and the adana kebab was well made. They gave us bread, and even topped us up, without having to pay for it.

Service was very friendly, attentive, and fast. Oh, and they *do* take credit cards now (just not amex).

I would definitely go there again the next time I'm looking for some good turkish food.
One of my top eats in London. Always consistently great and service never misses. Incredible fresh and juicy meats, chilli sauce always hits the spot. Get a mixed grill for 2 and some hummus kavurma!

One of the best Turkish other than Kebab here specially the role it’s amazing and also liver with the salad and Hummus it’s amazing.
Five star ⭐

Really nice food, informal setting and good prices. Sarma beyti is nice and the other dishes have all been good every time I've been here. It can be busy, noisy and hot from the kitchen but this is part of the atmosphere, great place to come with fri nds or on your own. Have occasionally shared a table when it's been super busy but never in a way that was uncomfortable. Fully recommend it here.

Please make time to go to this incredible grill spot in Dalston. Amazing Lamb Ribs that are selected, spiced, and prepared right before your eyes. Freshly hot off the live fire and served with bread slapped with juices from the grilling lamb and an terrific salad.

name: Mangal Turkish Pizza
address: 27 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8BJ, UK

reviews.text: Can not believe I have only been coming here for 2 months yet i have tried all the Mangals in Dalston—best Lamachuns in London by far which is the Turkish pizza. The kebabs from Mangal are incredibly tender, with juicy lamb chops. My wife and I always start with the 2 Lamachuns then the mixed kebab for two and it's more than enough food and great value for money. Keep up the great work guys you have new customers for life

I had a wonderful experience at this Turkish restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious and full of authentic flavors. The hygiene and cleanliness were excellent, and the staff were very attentive and friendly. I was extremely satisfied and will definitely come back again. Highly recommended!

The food was terrible. The staff especially the manager  were extremely rude and aggressive. He was walking around like he was about to attack customers. He shouted to a waitress during our dinner. They clearly treat customers differently and pick and choose who to behave nicely to. They have no respect for people breaking their fast during Ramadan.
Even though tea is usually complimentary in many places, here they overcharge you and make you feel bad for asking.
We waited hours for the food to arrive. They claimed we were served for 5 hours, but we arrived at 5:00 pm and our food didn’t come until 6:30 pm, even though we were fasting for iftar. Then they rushed us, telling us to eat quickly and leave, and tried to push us out.
Don’t go here and embarrass yourself by paying for such a terrible experience.

Don’t be fooled by the good ratings and come to this place. All those reviews are fake. This is the one you should believe.
We went for the turkish pide but It’s not the same as before ,the old taste and quality are completely gone.
The salad they served us was leftover salad from other tables. It was really bad. The manager there had a terrible attitude and was very aggressive  just because we asked for tea, it felt like he was almost going to hit us. Don’t go to this place and waste your money. You’d honestly be happier going somewhere else. The manager was extremely rude, very unpleasant, and not friendly at all he didn’t smile even once.
When we ask for turkish tea, the manager came and shouted to the staff and got angry with us, because they don’t want to offer tea to anyone.
Even though they charged us more than enough.
Don’t go there.  Believe me
It’s a waste of your money.

If serving delicious food at reasonable prices is a crime then arrest these people!! Was served a delicious dessert on the house after our meal to top things off. Quote from my dining partner- “this is my kind of cake”. Outstanding.

I’ve been coming here for years, even back when it was Barbecue Express, and it’s always been solid. I’m a loyal customer and honestly they’ve never really gone wrong with the doner kebab. The food is consistently good, portions are decent and the service is always friendly and quick.

They recently gave me a banging deal as well which I appreciated. The place is clean, the staff are respectful and it’s one of those reliable spots you can count on.

Also shout out to the lovely young lady who works there – I forgot her name but she’s an absolute legend and always really friendly.

Definitely recommend, especially if you’re on a night out and need that proper late-night pick-me-u
GREAT VAULE OF MONEY!!! Staff are so sweet, especially the girl at the front. Always go for grilled wings and tried lamb ribs this time. Big portions and brilliant taste!

I ordered a mixed döner with rice and a Coke, and for £13 the portion size was genuinely generous. The meat was really well cooked, full of flavour, and the rice was spot on. Everything felt fresh and properly put together.

Service was excellent — Radhika served me and was incredibly friendly and attentive. She even let me try the chillies before adding them to my plate to make sure they weren’t too spicy, which was a really thoughtful touch and much appreciated.

Great food, great value, and genuinely warm service. I’ll definitely be back.
Massive generous portions, food so delicious that melts in your mouth. All nicely  seasoned  and fresh. Also Big Baba that made my meal is a nice chap! Never felt sooo full in my life!
The lamb munch box was juicy and full of flavour, and Radhika made my whole experience even better with her warm smile and amazing service. She even gave me extra sauces 😋 Definitely recommend!

name: Urfa Ocakbasi Restaurant
address: 85 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 8DL, UK

reviews.text: Quality service the best turkish in the area tried lots of Turkish in the area this one is the best in my opinion food extremely tasty and portions of food and price are great too will definitely come again
Great food and lovely staff!!
Had a very nice meal with family.
We were here for a Birthday. The food and service was excellent. The restaurant itself is first class. Nice menu smiling staff and very clean. Best restaurant in Stoke Newington Hackney area

Very special restaurant in heart of North London Stoke Newington the chef's come all the way from Urfa city of Turkey staff are very friendly and helpful. They got very tasty flavour of the food which they use special ingredients to make perfect food plate to their guests and also they have got special offers sometimes keep your eyes open:)) When you talk about kebabs and mezes you will talk about Urfa Ocakbasi Restaurant
Make sure you arrive hungry, the portions are generous and very tasty. I had the mixed meze followed by aubergine kebab. Awesome.

Delicious food, fast service, and great atmosphere. The staff are friendly and attentive. The lamb chops were flavourful with the sauces, and it paired nicely with the rice and salad. Would definitely be back to try other menu options.
The lamb cop shish was amazing. Staff were lovely and food and drinks came quickly.

We recently ordered takeaway from this Turkish restaurant, Anatolia. The portion size was not proportionate, there was way more meat than there was rice. Which wasn’t pleasant. The flavors were decent, though not particularly standout.

We ordered one portion of Adana with Bulga rice and another portion of Lamb shish with white rice. We also got some salad and bread, the bread was cold but it still tasted good and the salad was decent as well. Instead of what we ordered we were given a portion of Lamb shish and bulga rice and a portion of lamb doner with bulga rice.

I went back to say that one of the orders were wrong. The man was dismissive and had a bit of an attitude about it. Instead of offering a quick apology or trying to resolve the issue politely, they made me feel like I was inconveniencing them for pointing out their mistake.

The restaurant has a lot of seats in the restaurant so you can eat in and the restaurant is kept clean. The chairs look old and they are losing their colour. The decor is minimalistic and the restaurant has a lot of space. You can dine in and you can take out. The price is not worth the quality and size of the food. You can try this place if you want but I definitely won’t be back.

Lentil soup! Delicious! £6.50 to eat in, came with bread and salad which I didn’t expect but couldn’t have been happier. Kind staff and very quick service! Great outdoor seating where you can watch the busy Mare Street pass you by.

name: Bebek Baklava
address: 91 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text:
The best baklava I had in London. This was absolutely delicious, served with a Turkish tea.

The owners were lovely, I asked the chef to pick the pastries for me and wasn't disappointed. I can only recommend it!!

Hands down the best Baklava I have ever tried in my life - even surpasses baklava that I’ve had in Turkey! We had the Kuru Baklava and it was truly perfection. We even walked back into the shop to commend them once we had left and tried it ! Highly recommend to all- we will be making this place a regular.
Owner was very nice, but one baklava for £7? Prices are not displayed on purpose, and I think if you’re not Turkish, you are a prime target to get scammed! Beware!

Fantastic place for Turkish tea and baklava. They had a variety of baklava to choose from. The best one for me was the cold baklava, never had it before and the taste was absolutely amazing.

I liked the decor and the ambiance. I would definitely recommend and I'm sure I will be back again soon. This is now are new dessert place after have super kebab!

I have been shopping them since they open.
They are still doing quality and delicious desserts.
Price are affordable.
Thanks.
Recommended!

Miga has been the best restaurant ive been to all year. I knew the place was good but didnt expect for it to blow me away. Every meal I had was flavourful- how can the next bite be better than the one before? Thats exactly how it was. The staff were warm and inviting- you can tell they all have great chemistry together in service. Intimate space but doesnt make you feel claustrophobic. I recommended the place as soon as I got into my uber home. If you have an hesitations, I assure you dont. Thank you Miga. Cant wait to come again.

I mean, I know the restaurant is in Hackney but in my 33 years of adult life I have never been welcomed at a restaurant with a locked front door, most odd! 😉

This was our first experience of a full Korean meal and all the dishes we tried were absolutely delicious, the one slight disappointment was that the karage chicken was not very crispy and a little greasy. The tartare, short rib and pork dish were particularly delicious.

Outstanding Korean cuisine in a casual setting solely focussed on sensational taste of the dishes.
The beef short-rib is glazed in a sweetish sauce and melts in your mouth, 10/10.
The kimchi is flavourful, punchy, crunchy, and very fermented - just the way it should be.
The sauce for the fish salad was spicy and a great addition which pulled it together.

The place is run authentically, have an open grill, and the wait times on food are not long.

It is a popular place, book well ahead and expect to be ushered out when your time runs out.

Such a great modern Korean place in Hackney. The food is authentic, but the vibe is really modern. Highly recommended if you’re trying Korean food for the first time, or as a spot for a first or second date

추천메뉴는 회무침, 강된장입니다

Had a delicious meal here on Friday. Have heard nothing but good things about it and it exceeded expectations.

We tried a range of dishes - all absolutely delicious but the stand out was the beef tartare.

The house wine was also delicious and well priced

Service was impeccable - attentive, friendly staff and the minimal but well finished and quality decor made the dishes (presented beautifully) even more stand out.

Would definitely go back to try the rest of the menu - their take on Korean cuisine is so interesting and everything on the menu sounded delectable.

First time customer here and I had to come in after passing the shop lately and smelling the lovely food.

I must say the lady on the till/also prepared the order was kind and knowledgeable, recommended the Gangjung which was really nice. Fresh garlic, ginger flavours

Had the Chicken Mandoo / dumplings which were some of the best I've had. Can't wait to try something new

Thank you to the kind and warm staff who introduced me to my first taste of Korean cuisine, will see you again soon 💙
Very delicious food and kind staff, the portions are big and we were so full ;)

I live very close to Jijigo so frequently try their menu and I’ve been impressed with everything I’ve ordered. Personal favourites are the katsu curry (far better than wagamamas), the dakgalbi and the Ssambap. Portions are always really generous, especially with the protein. service always friendly, highly recommend!
This place is a hidden gem! The Korean Corn Dogs are amazing! Crispy and delicious. Highly recommend getting it with spicy Mayo and ketchup + sugar. We have been back 3 days in a row!

The corndog tasted quite plain and it didn't hit like corndogs from Bunsik. It would be good if they had more option for sauces and fillings. I can't say anything about the main meals as I haven't tried them yet.

They also have no seating and you can't eat at the counter which is frustrating.

name: Gochu Gang
address: 92 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 7NY, UK

reviews.text: Friendly staff, accommodating. The kids loved the honey butter chicken and garlic soy wings. The skin was very crispy. Great crunchy fries. It was all cooked fresh so we waited in the bench for ten minutes. The smell was great. There’s 2 seats if you want to eat in.

Tonight we ordered two boxes and were really pleased with the quality and taste of the chicken, kimchi, rice and fries. The chicken was as good as we’ve had in London at our favourite restaurants. The sauce was rich and so good we only would have wanted more of it. The chicken pieces were surprisingly big! The service was also very quick and friendly. I will definitely go back.

My friends have been raving about this place ever since it opened so I had to try it for myself. Everything they told me was spot on. Incredible tasty food! Staff are friendly and were able to tell me what they had on the menu and helped me choose. I went for the Tteokbokki and oh my days it was SO DELICIOUS! Will definitely be coming back for more, especially for the fried chicken cos I saw another customer with theirs and it looked amazing.

Always my KFC-go-to, until recently I find them offering pho, and they were used to be District Mot in Leytonstone! It was such a shame they shut down business for good two years ago that they made one of the best Vietnamese pho broth in town. Thanks so much for bring the beautiful broth and pho back.

Decided to try out this new Korean fried chicken restaurant and it did not disappoint. Very warm welcome vibe from the staff and the food was delicious (tried the boneless chicken in sweet and spicy/soy and garlic flavour). Will definitely recommend friends and family to this place 👍🏾
We really enjoyed Summer rolls, Pho & Banh mi here! Broth was very tasty & friendly staff. Highly recommend. We will be back - Thank you!

Absolutely love this place. I've had dinner there with my sister, a solo lunch and takeaway. The pho bo is unreal and my go to. The broth is the cleanest, deepest, silky smooth, soul warming thing ever. Took care of my cold in an instant. You can have well done, raw or mixed beef. I know that the vegetarian (I think it's also vegan) pho option is just as incredible as my sister had this and fell in love. We also had the veggie spring rolls and they were fantastic. I think it's the taro that adds an extra something. I don't know. I couldn't get enough of them... The special bahn mi is just delicious too. Lots of crunchy pickles and a proper helping of meats. The summer rolls are honestly the best I've ever had. The classic is pork and prawn. Stuffed to the gills. Pork and prawn in ever single bite, not like some places with a measly prawn and the majority empty. The accompanying peanut dip is crazy good too. I think it's a little spicy? It makes you want to just shove the whole roll in your face. So, so moreish. The beef in beatle leaves are great. They don't just fall apart but keep their form and just sort of jump with the tangy dip that they come with. My partner and I will be sharing the chicken combo tonight so will update on that later, but judging by everything else, we won't be disappointed, I'm sure.

I would note that this really is a small place so wouldn't recommend being more than 4 people (which is nicer for other guests too in my antisocial opinion). The menu is small too, which guarantees consistent quality. Sometimes they don't have things which is only a shame if you're greedy, like me, and want to eat it all! Again though, this is something that just highlights what a real, little, quality place this is. Everything fresh and if the ingredients aren't there, then they don't put out the dish. This is the perfect place for a solo lunch or dinner for 2 and it's BYOB.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely loved this place! The food was incredible — fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. The staff were so friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. I also loved that it’s BYOB — it made the evening feel really relaxed and personal. Such a gem of a Vietnamese restaurant — I’ll definitely be coming back soon
The best Vietnamese restaurant in London!!! Tried all the well known one but this one hits differently. Tastes like home, and the owner Huong and her family are all so lovely. A must visit.
What a gem!! I had the summer prawn and pork rolls and beef pho and both were so delicious and really generous portions. Can’t wait to go in and try the banh mi, I’d highly recommend!!!

As a long-time die-hard fan of their banh mi, I was beyond thrilled to see them return after their upgrade! Their new space is absolutely stunning and so comfortable to kick back in. I also noticed they’ve updated the menu with some exciting new additions. Today, I tried the Bun Ca, and it was so incredibly delicious that I slurped up every last drop of the broth. The staff even told me that more new dishes are on the way as they finalize the recipes. I can't wait to bring my friends back next time!

This place DESERVES MORE!

My 1st time trying is in 2023, when they still relied on online Vietnamese customers. I had Bún Riêu Ốc - Vietnamese Snail and Crab Noodle Soup 14 and Corn + Pandan Milk 5 each, as I remembered. Everything is so spot-on, the vermicelli’s broth and the subtle scent of corn/ pandan, just like they literally brought the food from Vietnam.

My 2nd time was like 2 weeks later. Cause last time when I did pick-up, I saw they freaking molding their bread. So this time I went for a Classic Banh Mi, I think it’s 10quid sth at that time. Yes, it didn’t disappoint. It was the in-house combo pate + pickles!OMGGG I am not even kidding, I thought I flew back to HCM when I bit onto that pate. Multiple types of meat (charsiu, hams) + sauce from charsiu + pork floss (only OG banh mi like in Vietnam, so rarely seen in UK cause it has to be in-house to be good and it’s extremely time-consuming). I can really see that the team is really committed to their work and made food from love.

I revisited it with a friend last week. And it blew my mind again. We ordered 1 Classic + 1 chicken Hoi An. While the Classic is deep in flavour, Hoi An chicken is more saucy, more refreshing with a sour touch. I got to try their Vietnamese coffee this time. Amazing, Vietnamese arabica with condensed milk. Tasted just right, but my friend found it bitter.

It might sound overhyped but I am GENUINELY SUPPORTING this small restaurant which makes real stuff with real love. The owner actually studied pastry (I saw it on her fb), so yeah I can totally see it in the bread, and in the way they made everything in-house for the quality and identity of their food.
The only problem is that I wish I could afford to have their bánh mì everyday 😭

came in because of the bustling ambiance inside, and was not disappointed. had the banh mi which to be fair cannot be compared against the American places we've been to and can only be compared against the leagues of Vietnamese as it had the same soft baguette texture and full of flavor ingredients that made the Vietnamese banh mis distinct. also had the pho which was a special for the day and doesn't happen all the time and it was nicely presented but not the best. more simple and easy, but the sandwiches the place to be. I also came a little bit late so that they weren't making coffee anymore apparently. so we'll have to come back to have the via coffee

This is the kind of place you travel to. Seriously good bánh mi. The baguette is fresh, made on site. The flavours are so good. They have a lot of selection so you'll find something you like.
It was that tasty, I got another one straight after finishing my first. The people are very friendly too, and the jasmine tea is excellent. There's no contest, this is some of the nicest stuff I've eaten in a while.
I ordered the Vegan Pork Belly Banh Mi with Tofu Summer Rolls. Really delicious home baked Vietnamese baguette bread 🤩 wow

Highly recommend if you’re trying to decide between all the Vietnamese restaurants in the area. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. We ordered the banh xeo and banh mi which were both delicious, the Vietnamese iced coffee is also excellent!
Probably the best Vietnamese restaurant I’ve ever been to in London? And I have been to a dozen of them I reckon. Food is great and environment is clean and classy.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Went here for dinner with three friends and it turned out to be a really lovely find. The food was fresh, comforting and full of flavour. Proper Vietnamese cooking rather than the overly westernised versions you sometimes get in London. The place itself is small but cosy, with a relaxed atmosphere. Everything arrived quickly and the staff were polite and attentive without being over the top. Great little spot on Kingsland Road for a laid back meal

Came into this place based on reviews and am very very happy with the whole experience.
The attentiveness of service was exceptional. The staff are genuinely engaged and curious which makes for such a great experience - vs forced niceness which you can feel through. The staff are amazing and hat off to the chef also because the food was divine.
I will be back for the amazing food service and feel.
Thanks Bep house
Had the sharing platter. Everything really good and will definitely come back to try other dishes. The spring/summer roll that came as part of the platter is a highlight, but everything was good.

name: Pho Viet 101
address: 101 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 0PH, UK

reviews.text:
Visited this establishment today prior to getting a tattoo done nearby.

The food here is Lovely! I ordered a BBQ Pork Banh Mi, Pork Spring Rolls & 2 Phos (1 well-done beef and 1 chicken) with a Vietnamese Iced Coffee also. Everything I tried was a 10/10 packed full of flavour, the beef especially was so tender!

But I have one small negative… Banh Mi has too many carrots lol, made a mess in my car whilst eating it. So damn tasty though! Well done guys!

This place does the best banh mi ever!! I went there 3 days ago and I'm still thinking about it. The baguette was packed full of delicious tasting tofu and veg and wasn't overpriced either (£8.50). I also got some chicken wings (£7.80), and again they didn't scrimp on the portion size. I ordered online and was eligible for a discount as it was my first time visiting. It was ready by the time I got there even though by this point there was a queue forming outside. They take cash and card. 1000% I'm going back.

I think this was the best chicken pho of my life, and I eat alot of pho in alot of places. The broth was gorgeous the chicken was so juicy and plentiful. I ate in, there's seating for 6 about people. Lots of people came and went and they were prepping lots of uber eats orders on a Saturday night - im new to the area and people must know this is a great spot. I'll definitely be coming back.

Best Bành Mì we’ve ever had! Delicious tofu curry too. Tofu in the Bành Mì was loved by someone who would normally be eating chicken - so it means a lot. Complimentary soup was adored. Cat was wonderful and made our whole visit super lovely. Will be back xxx

They only have a couple tables and I had no idea having only ever ordered from them. They BROUGHT a table in for my boyfriend and I to enjoy dinner. We were so touched. Food is authentic, handmade and outstanding, but what blew me away was their kindness, I’m a forever customer.

My friends and I decided to dine here after shopping at the local Y2K thrift warehouse across the road. I had seen this place before when they were closed and was hoping to try it, and I’m so glad I did!
I ordered the seafood pho but asked for just prawn, and they were happy to do that for me. It was so good, very warming and just what I needed after a long day out shopping. One friend ordered the seafood pho with prawn, squid, mussels and fish cake and said it was amazing. My other friends ordered a meat pho dish, and the lunch set menu that came with rice and what looked like a beef and veg stew type of thing, which they absolutely loved!
We had water for the table, although I do wish this had been topped up for us at some point. The place wasn’t busy when we went in but it was full by time we left.
The toilets are immaculate, very bright and probably one of the cleanest I’ve seen in London!
We split the bill 5 ways which the staff were more than happy to do for us. Mine came to just over £15 which I think is great for London!
The location is great too, it’s right by London fields station. Definitely worth visiting! I plan to bring my mum and boyfriend here at some point soon as they both love Vietnamese food as well ✨

Went in for a quick catch-up with a friend. Had a banh-mi because I wasn't starving, but friends noodle salad looked delicious. Super friendly staff, quick service, delicious food. I'd get there early though because it was packed by the time we left! Will be back again.

Went in for lunch and they have a special lunch menu, banh mi an iced coffee for £12 or green tea with a set menu - which the item were £9.5. The portion sizes were great! I had tofu and vegetable pho, it was so fresh, comforting and plentiful. Also had spring rolls to share as a starter and they were 10/10. I’ve left very full! Space is nice in the arches, not heaps of tables so it filled up quite quickly over lunch. Would definitely recommend.
Overall nice, real Vietnam food and tasty. Good service. The matcha drinks ok

I had the best Salted Cold Brew in London!
The soup was rich, this place was an absolute gem.
Brian and Ben such were stand out staffs and genuinely welcoming from the moment we walked in.
We will come back certainly!

Delicious and authentic Vietnamese food at a reasonable price. The Hu Tieu noodle soup is excellent, with a light, clear, and savory broth made from simmering pork bones. It’s the perfect comfort on a chilly day. The lunch deal is a great bargain, and they don’t skimp on portions. Service is prompt and friendly. Highly recommend!"

Excellent restaurant, with a diverse menu beyond just normal pho. If you’re not a first timer, this is great to expand your palette.

Note that the restaurant does not take booking so it is first come first serve. We were there between 1pm and 2pm, and it was very crowded.

Note that the food portions are enormous, so you might just be full with a single main menu item. We ordered a starter to share and a main meal each, and we did not even finish everything.

Wall decoration tries to immitate the wars in Vietnam so it’s an interesting experience. Staff was very efficient and delivery takes normal time (~10-15min depending on how crowded it is).

Nice and cosy Vietnamese restaurant. I ordered a chả cá Lã Vọng and my boyfriend ordered the duck noodles. Portion was good and the service was really nice. The waitress with the nice ribbons on her ponytail (idk her name) was very helpful. Just a note that it will be better for the restaurant to have the ingredients on the menu :) there was pork in the duck noodles and we only found out later.
lunch menu was very affordable and extremely filling - highly recommend the chicken curry! Cant go wrong at all for 15 quid, this place will definitely be my go to for Vietnamese in Dalston

I don't remember this dish name as I asked the staff to choose for me! It was rice with stir-fried meat something, but it was literally so hot and warmed my soul on a cold night out!
the display and quality did not disappoint either
A gem of Mare Street! Food always delicious with authentic flavours and niche regional dishes. Lovely staff! Online reservations not always accurate, best to call.

As a Bun Bo Hue enthusiast and a pilgrim of Vietnamese restaurants + local stalls in Vietnam I can proudly confirm that this has been my favourite outside Vietnam so far.

Something about their broth hits different.. it’s honestly hard to describe but somehow every sip slaps my tongue screaming “How about I complete your life”. My partner who is the biggest non-Asian Pho fan I’ve ever met doesn’t even dare to breathe when slurping these noodles. It’s just simply dang good.

Also the owners are super friendly! Surely you shouldn’t expect what is provided at a Michelin starred French restaurant, but as an Asian myself their lively and lovely attitude is the exact customer service I would love to have.
The owner was super welcoming and attentive. Recommended me another type of pho with more flavour! The portion was massive compared to other viet spots. I’ll be backkkk ❤️

A family-own restaurant with a large menu of classic and traditional Vietnamese dishes with options for vegetarians. Owners are very friendly. Portions are very generous and full of flavours. I loved the banh cuon! Come here if you want an authentic meal and not bothered about the frills!
We love this place east london staple 🙏🏽 great food

name: Uncle Nam's
address: Batley Place, 66 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 7PA, UK

reviews.text: I had the Bún Bò Huế here and it was honestly so good. The broth was super flavourful and had that perfect little spicy kick. The beef was tender, the toppings were fresh, and the portion was actually really big. It tasted proper comforting, like a real homemade bowl. I’d definitely come back just for this.

Used to be ok before new owners took over. Serving for pho is now so much smaller - for £16 it was honestly a joke. There were easily half the amount of noodles and possibly less meat as well. Summer rolls were average - rice paper had not been soaked enough to soften meaning it was still quite tough in areas. Very disappointing as it was a decent local Vietnamese spot but will not be returning again 👎🏽👎🏽

Great custom, great food with fresh ingredients. My brother even had a lesson from the owner on how to use chopsticks. My mum had the mushroom in batter, it was amazing! Hot and sour fishcake soup was wonderful as well as vermicelli pork and summer rolls. Very nice experience. Waitress lovely too. We even had our tea topped up for free

Best Vietnamese in the area! Tonnes of veggie options, we ordered three plates of spring rolls cos we just couldn’t get enough. I loved my pho, the broth was awesome.

We had to get an uber home after because we were just so full 😂
Welcoming service and warm atmosphere, yet pho was not the best I tried. Brisket was a bit too fat, also no garlic to add. Prices are quite high. Overall, a good place if caught hungry in the area.

name: Pho 101
address: 259 Hoxton St, Whitmore Estate, London N1 5LG, UK

reviews.text: Ate here last weekend - food was so yummy and such good value for money! Definitely will be back. Staff were so lovely too, go support your local!

PHO VIET 101 is the first time I tried in Hoxton, and I must say, WOW. "I dare you to try out, delicious traditional Vietnamese food, damm, you won't be disappointed. Especially when they recommend YOU something from the menu, take it you won't be disappointed. I RECOMMEND IT

The food is realllllllly good 👍 😋 👌 😌 😍 🙌  all the above
Great new spot for Vietnamese in Hoxton. The pho was one of the best I’ve had, very reasonably priced and large portion! Can’t wait to come back and try other things on the menu.
Really good food and we were well received by the staff

The ingredients are very fresh, the food tastes great and quite authentic (I was in Vietnam recently). incredibly good!
The staff is also super nice ♥️

Highly recommended.

❤️I am incredibly excited and happy ,I order online every night and usually eat at the restaurant every Sunday. All new menu and new flavors! Perfect! ❤️ The food is 10/10, 100% authentic Vietnamese flavor, the customer service is excellent, friendly, enthusiastic, attentive, and especially clean and tidy!! I highly recommend you come and experience it! 5 stars for quality ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🙏

I love Sen Viet so much and have been missing their food since leaving the king's X area. So glad they opened a branch here. The food is great and the owners friendly! This is going to be a regular venue for us, absolutely recommended 5/5 !
Service is fast and staff really welcoming and friendly. Ordered bun ca cay and i had to say it blew my mind with the flavour inside the bowl. Highly recommend for the first time you come here!

One of my top three Vietnamese restaurants in London. We used to be regulars at their King’s Cross branch before we moved to Hackney, and we really missed it. So we were very happy to hear that they opened a second branch in Hackney.

My favourite dish is the pho. It is always comforting and full of flavour. The staff are also very nice and friendly, which makes it a place we keep coming back to.
Great food with great services! 100% recommended for Vietnamese food lover 🇻🇳.

Cute little place selling delicious vegan Vietnamese dishes. My 16 year old daughter who was very resistant at first seemed to enjoy the food. I think the overall cleanliness was satisfactory but could be improved. I had a bout of diarrhoea the night after eating there so not sure if this was related or not. Despite this, I would eat there again as the food was delicious, fresh and well presented. The staff were friendly, albeit a little shy, but no problems with order and time for food to arrive. Nice little new year display by the door. The starter platter was the favourite, I would have that again.

FANTASTIC VEGAN PLACE!

The absolute highlights for me were:
1. 15C Bun Cha President- I asked the lovely waiter for a recommendation and he suggested this one. It was superb 10/10!
2. Crispy Pancake- The filling combined with the light, crunchy pancake was incredible. Highly recommend this!
3. Fried Rice (side) I saw a previous review mention how good this was so I had to try it. They were right, it’s super flavoursome- I ate it on its own!
4. Sierra Yogurt Smoothie was my favourite drink of the night. Creamy, refreshing and delicious.

Honestly, everything I tried was great, but these are my must haves! The food is fresh and satisfying, you leave feeling full but not heavy.
I’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

I love the food here so much!! Everything tastes authentic and so glad it's all Vegan and cruelty free 💚 We got Banh Cuon, Banana Flower salad, Banh Xeo, Spring Rolls and for the mains Classic Pho, The caramel banana vegan 'fish' with rice. For dessert we had Mango Spring Rolls Coconut Black Rice Yoghurt 😍  Everything was delicious and amazing as always.
We've been to lots of great restaurants in London over the past few weeks, but this has been our favorite. Every dish was fantastic. Looking forward to returning.

Had an amazing lunch here. All the dishes we had were top notch. Served quickly and with a smile. Love this place.

Recommend the pho and the tofu and lemongrass dish.

Also does a 15% discount at lunchtimes (Mon to Fri).

name: Hai Cafe
address: 120b Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0QR, UK

reviews.text:
Unbelievable service, absolutely delicious food.
Blown away. Could’ve drank the curry sauce and slurped up another 3 bowls of veg tofu bun. Summer rolls were a must, and the peanut sauce was exceptional.

Amazinggg food the best pho I've ever had! Cute cozy little restaurant and the staff were so lovely, you can bring your own wine and enjoy. Portions were huge very generous meat servings. As someone born and raised in east asia highly recommend

I think the photos speak for themselves. The food was so tasty and delicious. We shared the crab & chicken spring roll which was plenty between two. We also had the peanut sauce which was Mmmm!
If I was to nick pick, I would have liked this brought out first then the main and they brought it all out together. Also would have liked the water on the table sooner, as had to chase it.
I had the prawn curry - which was so flavoursome with a slight sweetness to it. My other half had the spicy prawn Pho which was most certainly spicy & he thoroughly enjoyed it. Didn’t realise we could BYO drink by paying corkage, but we are not much of drinkers. It was very busy & full inside when we arrived at 6.15pm, even though it only opened at 6pm. We added our name to a waiting list, then went to a very nice bar along the road. Waiting time given was 30-40 mins. A What’s App message tells you when to return. By 7pm we were seated, and by 8pm we had finished! At this time there were a lot more tables available so will bear that in mind next time. However, We enjoyed the atmosphere of the small space and service overall was good, staff helpful and friendly. Will be most definitely be returning after our trip to northern & central Vietnam. It will be interesting to see how the food compares. Spent £46 & had no drinks.

Insanely good. Many gluten free options too
Be prepared to wait, the place is small, but it’s worth it

A bit difficult to find a seat but well worth the wait.

Very delicious, lovingly prepared, authentic Vietnamese food.

Family run business with a small but perfectly executed menu. Dishes are huge!

Will definitely be returning to this one.

name: Bánh Mì Hội-An - Vietnamese Street Food in London

reviews.text: Inauthentic banh mi, the bread was amazing but the rest left much to the imagination. Lettuce was an odd addition, and didn't enjoy the chilli sauce used in place of fresh chilli. Not worth the price, unfortunately will not be returning. Kind staff though.

There is art in these banh mi.

After all these years, and all the new Vietnamese places now popping up in Central London these days, Banh Mi Hoi-An still holds its title as one of the best in London - true to the Hoi An style I've enjoyed in Vietnam. Perfect crisp/soft ratio to the fresh banh mi, and all fillings (whatever you choose) are fresh, plentiful, and well-balanced in flavour and texture. No sad dry sarnies here! Chilli sauce is excellent, as is the Do Chua (light pickled veg). If you catch the seasonal catfish option - take it! Nice rice noodle box option for those who can't eat wheat. All topped with kind, skillfull and efficient service. As a local regular and also of SE Asian descent, I won't go elsewhere!

They do sell out - a sign of just how fresh their produce is, and their local popularity - so make sure you arrive before 1230 and on Fridays, earlier.

One of my favourite spots on Mare Street!! I honestly tell them every time I go their pho is the best! And so cheap! £6 chicken pho - the PERFECT lunch time portion. Their large is £9! So now I’ll put a review here so everyone can see how much I love their amazing pho. They are the nicest people too ❤️
Had the pork classic banh mi with chicken broth for £12, loved both! Lovely little place with very friendly service, hope to be back soon.

Had the spicy rost duck Banh Mi. It was delicious. So much meat inside , the picture doesn't do it justice. Chefs were friendly, and there was quick service despite being very busy. The only downside in the limited seating space , but on a beautiful day I went, standing outside in the sun and breeze actually improved the experience.

name: Lò Việt Food Stand
address: victoria park, market, London E2 9JW, UK

reviews.text: Delicious authentic Vietnamese food from a family run business. Tammi and Tony are really friendly! We love their food so much that we asked them to cater our son's first birthday party. Our guests absolutely loved the mini coconut chicken bahn mi! Thank you guys!

We hired Lo Viet to cater for our wedding and they provided us with canapes, a sit down three course wedding dinner, and evening food. They did not disappoint! The array of Vietnamese dishes were delicious, authentic and our guests (many of whom are also Vietnamese!) could not stop talking about how great the food was. Tammi, Tony and their family were super lovely and easy to communicate with throughout the process of organising things for the wedding day. We were very happy with the service and highly recommend them for events!

What a find, serving from a van, outside the Brunel museum, tasty ,authentic Vietnamese food is served, I had a coconut chicken banh mi,
and a coffee, absolutely wonderful, there is quite an extensive menu to chose from, the proprietors are Vietnamese, and are using their food preparation skills for the benefit of their customers.
Well worth a visit, they are not here every day though.

Love it! This is by far the best banh mi I’ve had in London. Great fillings, and the banh mi is very fresh with a nice crust - brought back memories of having banh mi back in Vietnam. And super friendly owners, keep it up guys 👌🏼

I Lo Viet! ❤. Filling tasty and good service. Are there any vietnamese drinks available? Convenient for me to get something for lunch!

There's actually things I can eat even with my allergies! 😋

I'll be back for some Banh Mi minis soon

That really hit the spot! It can be difficult to find great Mexican food around London but I was really blown away by this place. The nachos were spectacular and probably should have stopped there but had tacos and spice bag with my friend. Went home satisfied and stuffed.

These might just be the best tacos in London. Loved everything we ordered, especially their take on a spice bag (perfectly named the Sex Mex), the carne asada tacos, and the campechano taco. The Mexican-inspired spice bag was huge, great for two people but could have easily fed a few more, and well worth the money. The best part of Thrift Taco, aside from the incredible food and their cozy pub spot at The Howl, is the people behind it. Jillian and Bryn know exactly what they’re doing - amazing people who are clearly passionate about food, hospitality, and creating a great experience. Highly recommended

After being blown away by Thrift Taco’s menu at Doña in Stoke Newington, I just had to follow them to Howl at the Moon to try their current menu. Absolutely the best tacos I’ve had in London, the carne asada tacos are absolutely to die for and their loaded nachos are delicious, so indulgent and exactly what you’re craving after a pint or three. You can tell they put so much thought and precision into everything they serve and are innovative in the best way possible. If you like spice like me you won’t be disappointed by their handcrafted hot sauces either. Just phenomenal all round. Howl at the Moon also has such a fun atmosphere, lovely staff and invitingly cheap pints so you absolutely can’t go wrong.

Finally! An amazing taco in London! Have been looking for a decent taco for awhile and these were wonderfully delicious: spicy, messy, with a perfect corn tortilla - as the taco gods intended! Tried all varieties and each is uniquely tasty - favs are definitely the pork and the sweet potato. Can't wait to go back and stuff myself with tacos ... again.

Outstanding taco goodness! I got the pork which was so juicy and perfectly seasoned. However I swapped with one of my friends to try the sweet potato which surprised me by being my absolute favourite. The flavoured blended so well with phenomenal mouthfeel. The photo definitely doesn't do it justice. Can't wait to try the chicken next!

name: Tortilla Dalston
address: 16 Kingsland High St, London E8 2JP, UK

reviews.text:
Saw this place from across the road whilst I was queuing for a coffee & a sandwich. After wondering should I or should I not ... I've made the walk over to Tortilla.
WoW!... Never have a Burrito & nachos..etc. But this was very tasty! The quantity of food was huge 😋. Price was ok too.
Service was good and fast ..I didn't eat in but the place was clean and quite.
👍

What a great service last night from the 2 ladies and especially Zara who made experience wonderful and prepared the food with such care and love - people like Zara makes you want to come into the shop instead of ordering home! Best 💯👏🌮❤️

Joana was amazing! Super friendly, professional, and very efficient. She made the whole experience easy and enjoyable, took the time to help properly, and had great energy throughout. Excellent customer service — definitely someone who makes you want to come back.

Hi,
I just ordered a Carnitas Burrito to take away, and halfway through eating it I thought it felt lacking.... there was no meat!!
Not sure where to go for these type of customer service questions, happy to delete this review if it was a misunderstanding.

Great customer service from Rameez today he was welcoming friendly, professional and applied a 10% discount, I think he remembers me I make visit and my order is just all the topping, just that. He brightened up my day with is warm 😊 smile. He also seemed like a helpful colleague I saw him assisting a girl behind the till, I think  she may have been a new team member. Topings only.........Thanks Rameez

name: 91 Bites (Best Tacos, Guacamoles, quesadillas, margaritas, micheladas)
address: 87 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text: So yummy Dominic was amazing at his recommendations I would definitely come back
Amazing Spanish and Latin South America Bites. 100% recommend 👌🏻
Walked up Kingsland high rd after the theatre and found this gem.  Fantastic food and service.  Great empanadas and wonderful chimichurri.  We'll be back!
Great service, was understanding and accommodating. Definitely a great price for amazing food with multiple options. And the music and ambience was great too be in!

New place opened up on Kingsland Road and WOW! What a lovely atmosphere, bright and fresh with decor. Friendly staff who explained all the menu to me. I ordered cheeseburger empanada, Peruvian pork bite and wine. All for a great price, two delicious eats and a wine for about 10 in London is amazing. Excited to be back to try their mango slush and more of their tasty food. This is a must try!

Our first time trying tacos MX and it was pretty empty - plenty of seating. Very casual place but cute decor. Jarritos, and freshly made tortilla chips add to authenticity. However there was other food left out and it looked cold so that was a bit unappetising. They gave us free small cup of consommé which was delicious and a few chips and salsa, also really good.

We ordered the twelve tacos to try a mix of different things - we got carnitas, al pastor, birria and chicken tinga. The amount of meat you get in each taco is huge, definitely good value for money. But I will say the ratio of salsa to meat felt a bit off to me, I would have liked more salsa and maybe even more tortilla too. The al pastor was my favourite but the tinned pineapple wasn’t super appetising again. It had a delicious flavour, but it was also a bit greasy. The chicken tinga, birria and carnitas were also pretty tasty but a bit greasy, and birria was a bit dry. I would have liked more salsa again to cut through the fattiness. Tortillas were authentic and menu had something for everyone.

I think the food we tried was 3/5 but we would go back to try something else or maybe try the tacos again on another night such as taco Tuesday.

The chips were great and I’m sure the nachos, burritos, quesadilla would be good too. So I’ll have to report back if we return to try those things!

First I got the chicken taco and beef birria. Absolutely loveddd the beef it was tasty and the chilli sauce they gave with really nice too! Didn't fancy the chicken as much it had a tangy taste to it. But we went for a second round on beef😋

Service was good we went on taco Tuesday so it got busier later into the evening but regardless the lady was really sweet.

Super friendly, super fast service, super delicious food. Complimentary Nacho chips with Salsa was a nice touch. Feels like a very authentic space (in that, they're not overly doing anything with decorations). You go there for good Mexican food, and you get good Mexican food. Will be coming back again (and again, and again).
Delicious Authentic Tacos 🌮. Great Mexican Beer, Good music 🎶. And friendly excellent service.  Been here before, came back for Taco Tuesday. Let’s say they did not disappoint. 🥰🙌

by far the best tacos I've had in the UK. everything tastes like home, the serving style is just like back home, it's perfect. The two woman who were serving us are clearly in love with what they do and you can taste it in every bite of their food. I love y'all and I can't wait to be back

name: Viva Dalston
address: 2 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XN, UK

reviews.text:
We stopped in for a meal before going to the movies just down the street. Perfect location.

The food was very good. Perhaps a bit more spice would have been nice, but I have to admit that I really like a lot of heat!

Great service, priced well. Very nice looking cocktails, even though I’m a beer man!

We would return for sure.

Came here on my friends birthday to escape the rain and it was great! Lovely, attentive staff and cocktails are yummmy. Sat in the garden and had the beetroot and chilli and Jalapeño margaritas which we highly recommend, didn’t eat but food looked good.

White Russian was more ice than booze unfortunately & drinks were too small for the price. Place had a nice atmosphere but unfortunately smelled of old frying oil. Our clothes reeked of it after. Staff was friendly though.

We walking in on a Friday and they have a table for us in 10 min. Food is Mexican style and its delicious.  Margarita cocktails is pretty good too. Place is cosy and full of good vibes. We ordered food for 2 people to shared plus a jug of margarita and we paid £30 each.  Great places

We came here for cocktails and were not let down. The margaritas were perfect and I highly recommend the King Gambit. I also got an espresso martini, which I was reluctant about as it said it had agave rather than sugar syrup, but I was pleasantly surprised, and the whole table was jealous. The service was on point, kind and rapid staff. The garden area is very nice with overhead heating. It wasn’t too busy for a Friday night at 9pm for a table of 5.

name: TA-KO by Victory Mansion
address: 18 Stoke Newington High St, London N16 7PL, UK

reviews.text: Came via First Table and had a great meal, sampling as much of the menu as we could eat! Great Negroni, and the recommendations by staff were really helpful. Service was flawless and it is a lovely space to sit. Would really recommend!!
One of the best places we have eaten at in London for a very long time. Pricey but went via first table. The trout was.... Wow

Tasty food with an interesting spin 🌮 I would recommend the cauliflower and jackfruit tacos, we also had the ‘msg’ fries which were nice but more like potato rounds - they are pretty heavy so would recommend sharing them!

Quick service but did feel that we were slightly rushed out towards the end

I was super impressed by this fully gluten free mexican asian fusion spot. My highlights were the grilled corn (so delicious), the jackfruit taco, which has a hoisin flavour, snd the shiitake crispy rice bites. i had all the vegetarian tacos and everything I had was yummy and fresh.

Booked the private dining room for my partners birthday, couldn't have been happier with the service. They catered really well for all the dietaries, including one that was only relayed when the food was served!?
Food was great, and a lovely space. It was perfect.

name: Latino Hits
address: 14 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XN, UK

reviews.text: We had such a great night as a pre-party place - shame we had to leave as the second part of our night did not equal the atmosphere at Latin Hits. We had so much fun on the dance floor amongst a very diverse crowd. Absolutely loved it. The staff and customers are kind and fun. We will definitely come back. The cocktails are delicious.

Fabulous bar, cheap cocktails that taste absolutely amazing, had a brilliant time with Fatima, our server who was warm and welcoming from start to finish and baba (on the bar was amazing and so fast! Please come here and support our local businesses. (Also they host salsa dance classes downstairs for only 7/9£ !!!

A very social place.
Happy hour for cocktails, 2 for £9, which I imagine draws people in who then eat.
£30 for 6 small plates, we had the vege ones, which were nice but most of it seemed to be mass produced.
The sweet potato fries were nice, a little spicy.
The atmosphere is good, lots of people enjoying themselves, and the prices are ok, thanks to the happy hour.
Good place to go meet friends.

This place has a nice vibe to it however if eating here during the day, bear in mind it is decorated like a bar/club instead of restaurant so it might not be to everyone's liking. The food is good and reasonably priced and the 2 for £9 cocktail deal is great. All in all a good place for a quick bite to eat as the food is served very quickly.

This place is always really busy with good vibes hower I just wanted tacos so I went in the day time when it was quiet. I enjoyed my tacos, they were excellent and didnt scrimp on the fillings. The service was excellent and decor stunning.

name: Burnt Mill - Wood Fired Pizza
address: Ground Floor, 257 Mare St, London E8 3NS, UK

reviews.text:
Um, this isn’t a 4.9 experience! It feels as though it’s mainly a takeaway place & the venue itself is like a large seating area almost.

The pizza itself is nice but nothing wow.

The menu is quite large and caters for vegans. We shared one of the specials with a salad & chicken strips on the side.

The chicken strips were quite nice, we chopped it into the salad which we think made it nicer. The salad was fine, although the olives still had their stones.

No condiments except takeaway garlic dip pots.

Pizza was fine, it’s a pizza. But wasn’t the stone baked experience I was expecting (it is made fresh as you can watch them in the kitchen).

You order & pay at the till so not much to go on for service, although they did bring us extra garlic dip.

I would not go out of my way to eat here. If you’re a local wanting a quick pizza, maybe, but it’s just a normal takeout pizza place.

The starters and drinks arrived in good time! There were a lot of options to choose from which was great. I went with the Chicken pizza and the base was great. We were all surprised by how much pizza there was and it was very filling. The service was amazing and they were always checking to make sure we were having a good time. I highly recommend!
Just been to this place today, Customer Service was great! Pizzas were delicious and fresh, everyone enjoyed it. Would love to come back. Great Environment!

This is from Saudi Eats in London, with 80k+ followers across social platforms.
Instagram & Tiktok: saudieats.ksa

Every Tuesday, this amazing spot lets you roll up your sleeves and create your own pizza masterpiece with your loved ones. With a wide selection of fresh ingredients (all imported straight from Italy!), you can load up on as many toppings as your heart desires. 😮🤩💯 It’s like stepping into a cozy home kitchen making tantalizing pizzas! 🍕

And just when you think it couldn’t get any better, ending the experience with refreshing homemade lemonade perfect for the summer. 🌞

We cannot recommend this spot enough for a fun experience!
Lovely restaurant with super friendly staff and attentive, speedy service. Pizza is excellent and tastes great, amazingly priced too. Will be coming back!

name: World Famous Gordos
