address: 13, Unit C, 23 Westgate St, London E8 3RL, UK

reviews.text: Flavours were incredible. Held in a cool outdoor venue, but the star of the show for its taste & range of options.

One of the best pizza spots in London. An incredibly tasty and concise menu at a great price. The everything bagel crust is to die for and the service is always 100%, the guys are super friendly and always have a smile on their face. Couldn’t recommend these guys enough.

Heard the hype so had to check it out! It didn’t disappoint- the two lads running the place were great, the pizza was top notch & Mola Cola is unreal! I had the chef spesh & Pep, some of the best pizza I’ve had in London! Will be back!
best pizza by the slice in london!!! looooove the sesame crust
Delicious pizza. Quality ingredients. The crust was a highlight, they made it like a New York style everything bagel with sesames and about 5 other seasonings. Slices under £5 as well!

name: Dough Hands East
address: The Spurstowe Arms, 68 Greenwood Rd, London E8 1AB, UK

reviews.text:
Great pizza, the crust and toppings weren perfect, Margerita was the best but as a group we liked them all.
Tried all the sauces and they were delicious.
Relaxed vibe inside with reasonably priced drinks.
Will definitely go back especially as it’s easier to access than a lot of the similar choices in London

Grab a table before ordering. Sublime pizza. This so called ‘London-Style’ or ‘Dough-Hands-Style’ pie is heaven on a plate. Very fresh ingredients. Solid crisp and the crust delivered a nice crunch.

Tried the OG, Marg & the JODE. All very good but fav was the JODE. Nice that you can walk in. Would come back.

Dough Hands serves fantastic pizza — honestly one of the best I’ve had in London. The dough is excellent and they’re generous with the cheese, even right up to the crust. It’s absolutely delicious. The flavour, the vibe and the space itself are all great.

I’m giving four stars instead of five because Sundays are extremely busy, which means long waits for a table and for the food. On my last visit, the pizza took about 45 minutes (which I understand as the place was packed), but it arrived only lukewarm, almost cold. When you go somewhere specifically for great pizza, you don’t expect it to come out cold — that was disappointing.

That said, the quality and taste are excellent. I’d just recommend going early, especially on Sundays, if you want to avoid long waits and guarantee a table

Look maybe it was e it was a Friday night , but my pizza was burnt and cold. I got the og and while it was crispy, the flavour was mid and didn’t live up to the hype from what I’ve heard.

I would be willing to give it another go, but would avoid at busy times.

For £16.50 I expect more.

One of the best pizzas in London. Crispy base, great toppings. Kind of preferring crispy pizza rn. We got margarita with pepporoni and the Jose. I would actually say i preferred the margarita cause i think the Jode was too sweet for me personally with the Honey on it. However still really good. Also garlic and herb dip totally worth it. Vibes wise, this pub is amazing. Super dark, drippy candles in wine bottles, good music. We got a bottle of chilled red which wasn’t crazy priced I think like £30 and it was lovely and I felt classy.

name: Jazzy-Pizza
address: 24 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7XJ, UK

reviews.text:
I don’t know what happened to the place but the food and service has gone down to a shocking level.
I used to trust this place for decent pizza and good price albeit bad decor. Unfortunately, when I ordered takeaway, I was told that they’d only make it once I’m at the store. I reluctantly went to get the pizza thinking at least the food will be okay but the price has gone up (16quid!) and the quality has dropped massively. Too bad as I used to cheer for these guys before..

We dropped in on a Tuesday evening and to say that the place was deserted is an understatement; it was just us and one guy doing the ordering, cooking and clearing! Maybe this is because Jazzy Pizza is linked to the restaurants next door so you can order from all three places whichever one you are sitting in?

Either way we enjoyed a tasty meal regardless of the lack of patrons. I started with the king prawns in a spicy sauce, which were nicely cooked, before moving onto the house pizza. The toppings on this were good and the dough fresh although more thick-crust than I'd prefer.

One other thing to mention is that it's more like a café than a restaurant in that the facilities are pretty basic. For example there's just the one toilet and it contains the gas meter as a notable feature (yet no means to dry your hands). Still I've been in worse toilets.

I was alone here one Tuesday night, one takeaway whilst I was there. One superhero doing the ordering, cookied, clearing, checkout. What a guy! Pizza was really really good. My choice of drink came from next door. I really like the way they do business.

What an amazing pizza experience! These awesome dudes are from Ecuador, and made my friends and I some memorable pies. I really enjoyed the tricolor, which included pesto (green), fresh mozzarella (white), and fresh tomatoes (red). My friends enjoyed the margherita as well as the pepperoni-esque one.

Decent pricing and late night availability further propel this business!

Best Pizza of my lifetime, love it. Kind service, cozy atmosphere. Couldn't understand why it's so empty at our time.
If I would live in London, I would definetily revisit!

(The Mozzarella was on top of the Pizza, I gave it to my boyfriend)

name: QB* Quanto Basta (prev. Pizza Brixton)
address: 494, 496 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5LU, UK

reviews.text:
Tried out this place on Roman Road, and really enjoyed the food. They have a 'proper' pizza oven, and clearly the chef(s) know how to use it 😄 The waitress was really polite and helpful too!

Was hoping to get the meatballs pizza from a previous review on here, but their menu has rotated a bit, so opted for the hot honey pepperoni instead. It was cooked perfectly - crust cooked nicely without being burnt, and the pepperoni also cooked without going dry.

I made the mistake of taking a break after pizza before ordering dessert, as their tiramisu sold out in that short time 😭 but went for the pistachio cake which was nice - really light with good pistachio flavour.

Two things I'd say;
- don't sit next to the window on a cold evening, as there's a constant flow of inconsiderate delivery drivers leaving the door open
- my coat ended up with an odour of fried oil (another table ordered the pizza which is deep fried), so be prepared to deal with it after 😆

The best pizza around by far! Whenever I’m in the area I have to come over to this place. Real Italian pizza made by an Italian, great choice on the menu, and lovely people too.

Very good prices for a London restaurant as well.

What an absolute gem! You will not find better Pizza outside of Puglia! The Chef and his staff were incredible and our food was beyond amazing. I would eat here every day if I could. Do yourself a favor and get here now.!

This is indeed my favourite pizza place in London ! It feels so personal, the stuff treats us as we are part of their Italian family. And don’t start me on the menu! Everything tastes incredible and a little secret:  I’ve heard that the tiramisu is from the chef’s grandma’s recipe  🤫.
Btw it is really cool that they have different specialty pizza that changes regularly. And the prices are very good for the quality you get. And also the restaurant offers gluten free and dairy free pizzas 😍

The VERY BEST GLUTEN FREE PIZZA I have ever had in London !! Authentic taste, juicy , fresh and cooked to perfection !!! PS I had the home made sausage , tomato base , mozzarella and friarielli and It was half price lunch deal WIN WIN

Walked half an hour and came here 20 mins before closing just to get the Dishoom pizza and they managed to make us the last one of the day so last minute. With the garlic bread too!! Such great late night service.

Dishoom pizza was so flavourful and filling. The Garlic bread was not so special, but that Dishoom sauce was amazing. If you like spicy sauce you’ll love that.

Delicious vegan pies!

Loved that we were able to get crisp crust and some nice bubbles!

Was super impressed with the creative flavors, and the sauces are not lacking! Was surprised they went as far as using real vegan yoghurt for the vegan garlic and herb dip!

My partner and I come every month for their special. I sadly can’t have dairy but he can and the lovely people who work here go out of their way to give us the pizzas we want but halved with dairy / dairy-free cheese.

Today we went a step further and  combined this with 2 of the specials on one single pizza and they actually did it! Amazing.

This has become a tradition of ours to come here and it never disappoints.
Absolutely amazing pizza, very welcoming and pleasant staff....

Best takeaway pizza in London and a Superstar team here at yardsale Pizza!
My go to's are the new porker and the holy pepperoni, but the specials are always ace too! They had a recent haggis one for burns night that I really enjoyed.

Pizza very tasty and good quality for the price. Great dough and tomato sauce. I had salsiccia, but found the sausage meat used was very fine, also significantly spicier than I imagined but then I should learn to read a menu more closely!

Olives were actually the blandest I've ever tasted. Seemed very fresh and good quality but no taste, maybe why they seemingly had need seasoned with pepper.

Likewise the dessert was good, but I wouldn't describe it as a Sundae, per the menu.

It was enjoyable though, staff are great and restaurant very stylish and pleasantly spaced out tables.

A nice addition to 'The Village' and certainly a fair price.

Great food, beer, music, atmosphere, cocktails, sides, service. Everything. They’re not stingy at all with the toppings and you can tell all the ingredients are fresh and high quality. The flavours compliment each other so well, and the crust is light and crispy.

Really good pizza with a variety of options on the menu. The Hackney Hellboy was a great take on a vegetarian friendly pizza and well worth trying! The only downside to our experience was that the service felt quite rushed, as if they were trying to turn over tables quickly. Staff could offer to hang coats/direct to coat stands when sitting people in booths.

We were honoured to be first ever official customers here at ACE! Despite high expectations we were not disappointed! The pizza was absolutely divine and reasonably priced. Super happy that they offer Gluten Free too, WITH the same size base as a regular (which at other places not always the standard). We also enjoyed a soft serve after which was equally brilliant and a nice generous size. Plus, they let dogs in! 🐶 Overall 11/10, we’d highly recommend trying this new local sensation ❤️
The waitress (Gabi I think?) was just brilliant, truly a joy. Welcoming and lovely. The hot honey marg is great, the pizza one of the best I’ve had.

name: Vesuvio Wood Oven Pizza (Clapton)
address: 29 Lea Bridge Rd, London E5 9QB, UK

reviews.text: I have been ordering from them for a while, I just happened to be in the area recently and decided to pop in for a few slices. Delicious as usual. Great photo from the pizzaiolo boss man.

Great pizza! Tasty dough! Thin as pizzas should be! Generous portion of ingredients!

I guess some reviewers were not reasoning based on the ingredients and the typical thickness of different types of pizzas! Of course it can be floppy and wet

Try it, totally worth to find out if it’s your style!

Clean and nice place! Great offers and worth the cost!
The best pizza place in Clapton and Hackney! 🍕 Honestly, the taste is so good. The owner is a very friendly guy too. I always get my pizza as a takeaway from here. Highly recommended!

This place is perfect if you are wanting to eat classic Italian pizza, made in front of you in wood fire oven.
There is a step before you enter and it is quite small, you can however order online.
The pizza takes around 15-20 min to be made freshly. The pizza is made in-front of you which is always a pleasure to see.
There is a park nearby so if the weather is great you can eat in the park, they have no seating available in store, so you can only take out.

Customer service is great, very polite and friendly.

Been here a couple times, definitely will recommend if you want to eat Italian pizza.

I've had a few of their pizzas and I've always been impressed. I've taken the time out to write this because this last Vegetarian pizza I've had was amazing, the toppings were fresh and tasty as usual, it weren't too greasy, and the flavours really stood out. The competition nearby offer bland tasteless mush in comparison, these guys are different, their dough is fresh and you can really taste the difference.

name: Voodoo Ray's Dalston
address: 95 Kingsland High St, London E8 2PB, UK

reviews.text: The three times I have been here pizza has been consistent. It is not cheap but usually a slice will be enough to satiate you if you are not too hungry. The spicy pepperoni was tasty but it would have been nice to have a bit more of pepperoni. Very kind staff from Colombia was working there in my last visit.
I ordered the pizzas from deliveroo and it was my son’s birthday and it arrived cold with barely any toppings on it. I had guests and kids waiting for the pizza it was so disappointing. Avoid

Order a pizza today and hate to say but it was terrible. The delivery was fairly quick so can’t blame it on that, but the pizza tasted really weird the tomato sauce was cold and the cheese cold and lumpy not melted cheesy and the dough was soggy. It actually made me gag, and had to bin it as I didn’t feel safe eating it. I rang the restaurant and let them know and they apologised. That was that. I’ve eaten at VR for over 10 years but I don’t know if I can recover from this, the last pizza I had there was not great either but nothing in comparison to what I had this evening. I am sorry to say but I won’t be eating there again.
Wth😂 what happened here? Ordered hot ananas and there's barely any pineapple on this pizza. More dough than the good stuff for £5.40. naaaahh byeee

Ordered Deliveroo from Voodoo Rays as every time I’ve been in store it has been fantastic.

Unfortunately the food arrived freezing cold, half the garlic bread was missing (assumed it was eaten), one pizza arrived looking as if it had been thrown against a wall inside the box and the other pizza just remarkably average.

Your in store experiences have always been very good, if you choose to do delivery you need to ensure it matches the experience inside the restaurant (or at least close to) regardless of whether it is yourselves or Deliveroo.
Very nice pizza and good value. Got the 6 pound mushroom folded pizza. High quality and quick service. Slightly hidden location. Reminded me of L'Antica Pizzeria Da Michele pizzas

Fantastic experience, a true hidden gem in London. The pizza is served fresh and tastes like authentic Neapolitan pizza. I've been coming here for a while and it's always a great meal to end the day. The prices are incredible for the quality you get and the owner is very friendly. I would put 6 stars if I could!!

The closest thing I’ve had to traditional Neapolitan pizza in London! Absolutely gorgeous. Incredible dough cooked perfectly with high quality toppings. Can’t believe they were two pizzas for the price of one. Highly recommend and can’t wait to return.

I’ve been a customer at Pummarola since day one and it’s hands down the best Neapolitan pizza delivery in Hackney. The quality is always spot on, the prices are reasonable, and with the 2 for 1 deal it’s such good value. Proper pizza, proper vibes, every time.

FINALMENTE!!!! UNA PIZZA serial!!!
I had the pleasure of trying one of Roberto's pizzas today and I was so chuffed to have finally found a light, delicious pizza with actual good ingredients.... beautiful sweet ligurian olives, delicious sweet tomato sauce, good olive oil, light n tasty Italian sausage and just the right amount of mozzarella. Thin, light, tasty dough with actual flavour. Grazie Roberto!

I recently visited Pizza Para and tried their pizza with cured salmon – and wow, it absolutely lived up to the hype! It’s the chef’s favorite for a reason. The combination of perfectly cured salmon on that delicious ricotta base was fresh, flavourful, and surprisingly balanced – not your typical pizza, but in the best way possible. Every bite felt like a treat, and it was worth every single penny.
What really sets Pizza Para apart is the unique experience they offer. If you’re looking for something different from the usual pepperoni or margherita, this is the place. The staff is super friendly and happy to help you create your own custom pizza and you can start building one for just £9! In an area where prices can add up quickly, their affordability stands out without skimping on quality or creativity.
Highly recommend heading to Pizza Para if you want an affordable, one-of-a-kind pizza adventure. I’ll definitely be back to experiment with more toppings next time! 🍕🐟

New kid on the block and already stealing hearts since the soft opening last week 🍕

Welcome to the neighbourhood, Pizza Pãrã!
From the moment you step inside, you notice it is different from classic pizza places, a contemporary feeling with art on the walls, creating a warm, creative, and inviting atmosphere. Even better, the artwork isn’t just for show, you can actually purchase pieces you love while you dine.

But the real star? The food!!! Delicious, well crafted pizzas and more that taste as good as the place looks. You can tell care goes into every bite.

Always a joy to see new local spots bringing fresh energy to the area.
Support local, eat local and definitely give Pizza Pãrã a visit 😉
Maybe afterwards just pop in to next door, Map Maison, for a 🥃🍸🍹

Absolutely loved this spot! We tried several different pizzas and every single one was a hit, but the beef pizza was the absolute standout—perfectly seasoned and delicious. Don't skip the charcuterie board either; the homemade breadsticks and chutney with it the perfect way to start the meal. Great vibes and even better food

We did the cooking pizza masterclass. It was FANTASTIC!!. Pyash, the chef, is an incredible passionate teacher. Explained a lot about Pizza’s history, then taught us how to make authentic pizza napoletana. Da italiano, Pizza Para is one of the best I’ve had.

Went there with some friends. The pizza was really good I was pleasantly surprised. It was real Italian dough and topings were good and well balanced. I think it’s the first time I’ve ever like eating Arancini.
The baked good at the entrance are quite technical and with a deep flavour profile which is not so easy to find in London.

Lauretta’s Pizzeria sets the gold standard for authentic, handcrafted pizza - the taste is on another level.
Staff were welcoming, friendly, and clearly passionate about what they do.

We had a table of six and ordered the Margherita, Double Pepperoni, Spicy Roni, and Calabrian Supreme with the Hot Honey and House Garlic dip.

I was lucky enough to sample a slice of each - every one was absolutely delicious.
If I’d had room, I’d have ordered more, but that just gives me the perfect excuse to come back and try the rest!

Lauretta’s is a lovely addition to Columbia Road. Great atmosphere inside, and even better pizza. We’ve been here a couple times now and we are always just blown away by how good it is. The vodka margarita is very tasty but I think the Calabrian supreme takes the golden spot for me. Do yourself a favour and get a garlic dip on the side. This is a pizza you won’t want to share because it’s just that good!!

Thank you Lauretta’s,
We will be back ❤️

Okay so, here we are. London, the new pizza scene. A few new places on the scene. But one place has emerged the best. Out of the fire of the hype of Crisp and Vincenzo’s (truly deserved) I’m sat in this neighbourhood pizza place marvelling at the pie put down in front of me.

Absolutely perfect crispy base and chewy crust, a vodka pie with a pesto swirl. I’m showing it off in pride to my friends at the table with me. Every slice I invite my fellow guests to try a bite despite forgetting they’ve ordered the same thing as me.

The staff are super friendly and easy, nothing is a problem. The rest of the guests are enjoying their evening with nowhere else to be. I’m very happy to sit here the rest of my night.

Service was brilliant, great vibes, exceptional exceptional pizza. I would highly recommend going and we will be back soon. So crisp and brilliant fresh ingredients. 10/10.

We’ve been to a lot of the top rated London pizza houses, Crisp, doughhands, graceys etc - Lauretta’s was on par if not better.

Definitely worth the trip.

One of my favourite pizzas in London. Went on opening night and have been back countless times. Rivals Crip easily and prefer to dough hands, though that is great too!

Easy 5*

name: ACE Pizza at The Pembury Tavern

reviews.text:
Had a great pizza here on a very busy Saturday night. Service was really good and friendly, despite the fact that the place was almost packed, with every table taken.

The pizzas were delicious, with excellent crispy crust. To be completely honest I think Dough Hands up the road are better, BUT this is quieter and more comfortable, has more sauces, and is generally infinitely less of a faff to enjoy. I'm talking a 10% drop in quality for a near-100% improvement in comfort here.

I should also like to point out, praisingly, the sauce pricing policy. Way too many places are engaging in *abusive sauce monetisation*, charging for even basic hot sauce or chili oil. To their credit, ACE continue to provide free chilli oil, and only charge for the crust dips (my favourite was the Truffle), a basic step that more and more pizza pop-ups are neglecting, and that as a London-based pizza enthusiast I cannot help but notice. Thank you for fighting this toxic trend of sauce monetisation.

Good pub with a good selection of beers, great laidback atmosphere and friendly service. Pizzas are good and tasty but for their cost I was expecting more density of toppings. I felt a bit disappointed.

Went with my son on his recommendation from him seeing online. Slightly sceptical but shouldn’t have been as exceeded all my expectations! Pizza was brilliant, good prices for London and brilliant range of beer and drinks. Staff really friendly as well. Couldn’t fault it and would definitely go again next time in London area.
Eaten here multiple times and great pizzas, perfect dough and great toppings. Great pub it's in too with good beers

Disappointing service from a rather arrogant bar tender with black & red hair who was outside having a smoke when I was standing at the bar with no bar staff nearly 10 mins before the kitchen was supposed to close, who then told me they were no longer taking orders. Nice!

name: Rowdy Burgers & Desserts (Dalston)
address: 166 Stoke Newington Rd, London N16 7UY, UK

reviews.text: Ordered 28 pound deal. Chicken sizzler pizza was delicious, cheese and chilly bites were yummy and I loved the wings. Food was piping hot. Will order from here again for sure. Thanks.
Had out of here twice and each time was fabulous 👌 burgers and bbq wings never made getting a picture taken but were so tasty

Not bad. Pizza taste is pretty decent. The thin crust is so thin that it sticks to the pizza box. The size of pizza is questionable as it seemed to be 1 inch less than what was ordered. Will I go there again...? Maybe not...I prefer Slice pizza and grill in Ilford.
Pizza and burger were mid. Halal and open late so that’s awesome tho!

Wow!! Great pizza (chicken sizzler), the chillie cheese bites was great, perfectly spiced and ouuuzzing with plenty of cheese.

I'd also like to point out that they listened to my request, unlike most that don't read the comments.. I asked for plenty of extra fresh chillies and the pizza was great, they even gave me extra chilli sauces. I'll be backkk for more guys. Cheers.

name: Perfetto Pizza ( Bethnal Green )
address: 391 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9RA, UK

reviews.text:
I am genuinely surprised how good the quality has been and also the consistency of it.

Before this review, I ordered 3 seperate times before my verdict.

The foremost issue for me over the past few years has been the dough the shops use. More often then not, it givrs me a lot of trouble to digest and feels like a rubber ball in my stomach. However, these gents, have successfully prevented that from happening to me. I think they roll their own dough, old-skool style. Their crust is also not uniform and a bit jaggedy which I love and tells me they do not use a machine.

The base sauce is delicious! The BBQ has been such a hit in my house where I am typically the only BBQ lover. Now there are 4 of us! The BBQ is not over the top sweet, it has just enough smokiness to counter it.

Finally, they do not cheap out with their base sauce, toppings, and cheese.

Please keep up the good work and don't get greedy!
It’s was a phenomenal bite! Taste of their pizza 9/10 really good pizza chef here and their service is friendly as always highly recommended ⚡️👌
These guys redeemed themselves food got way better and customer service is a lot better. I take back everything I siad before. Marshallah brothers. Just please keep it up

I’m usually a big fan of Perfetto, the Pizza is delicious imo, and I’ve been regular customer for a year now. Would be a 5 Star.
But, it doesn't taste as good when it's cold and over an hour late. This is 2nd time there's been a problem with delivery here recently, but the Pizza is so good I’ll give it last chance. Hope they pay attention and sort it out.

Not only our food was neglected while we sat there for ages wondering where the food is at, the food quality really was terrible and the chicken smelled rotten. I had a terrible stomach pain afterwards. Evert time i remember this experience i feel sick

I just had a fantastic breakfast; honestly, the portion was perfectly balanced, the cappuccino was delicious, you can tell the team has a lot of experience. I even got to chat with the owner, who was very friendly and passionate about his work. Thank you so much, I'll definitely be back every time I'm in London.

Locally vocal about this socially open favourite.
I love a place that's open to everyone from the school mums to the seniors from the couples to the students.  This place is welcoming to everyone.
Oh and the food is always on point.  They've never failed to help me impress visitors.

Keep It Up Barrel !

Is this the best pizza you will ever have? Probably not. But it did what it needed to do, so no complaints here. They have a big variety of options to choose from, and at the low prices they offer, I think you get what you pay for. It's a very relaxed atmosphere and a nice chill place to hang out. There was only one member of staff who I believe was the owner, and he was doing it all! But his customer care was impeccable, and it felt like he was welcoming you to dine at his house! This made everything taste better lol
I would eat here again!

A gem of a place! Recommended by my hotel and it doesn’t disappoint. Run by a brother called Raf, a gentleman and very welcoming. A propa’ local cafe and then some!

Oh and the coffee and food were delicious!

Highly recommend as it was for me!

Thank you

So far impressed!

This beautiful atmospheric cafe has an array of beautiful cakes, pastries and does an amazing deal of pizzas for under £5 I believe before 4 pm!

Very community-focused cafe with beautiful understated interiors but gorgeous terrazzo tiles to spice up the mood.

Very delicious panini and filled savoury toasts. Will be here again for the pizza deal!

*UPDATE*

OK fell for the pizza deal and very impressed! Great pizzas starting at £4.98. They also have a good selection of vegan pizzas. Grab one before 4 pm when the kitchen closes!

As a dessert the red velvet cake and the chocolate swirl cheesecake have been good. Not overly sweet but very fresh and good quality.

Ordered through Uber Eats where it has lots of good reviews - all the fish was mushy and tasted the same. Some of the sushi pieces were just not right and had to be spat out. There was weird stringy white stuff in the tuna. Imagine it's made in a factory off-site with supermarket sushi, not on site, tasted like it. Not sure why it had Shoreditch in the title, it's nowhere near it.
Customer service is exceptionally friendly. The sushi was fresh, prepared well and just gorgeous :)

Have been ordering from here for about a year now. My go to sushi place, even though we were living quite far. Great quality, tasty, cutest packaging. I only order Special sushi, as they are the best value/quality/price product. Recommend to everyone!

Genuinely no idea how this place has decent reviews, this is singlehandedly the worst ramen I have ever eaten. It’s not even ramen, it’s actually udon with horrible broth and unseasoned vegetables. Maybe this is just how food in the uk is but my god it’s horrendous I wouldn’t even pay one pound.
Got a takeaway from here today, was so lovely. The packaging is so cute and the size of all the fish was lovely thick and big.

name: Men Noodle Bar
address: 51 Chatsworth Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0LH, UK

reviews.text: Had a delicious bowl of vegetarian ramen on a cold and rainy London night and it hit the spot! The veggie broth had a lot of flavour(and I’ve had other before which can lack depth of flavour). My husband had the pork ramen and he said it’s the best he’s had in London. Also had the chicken karaage which he was a big fan of. Cool interior space, not fussy, modern.

Came for lunch. Had pork ramen and got gyoza for my toddler.
Ramen noodles were top; broth on the sweet side; pork wonderfully thin and tender.
Staff were excellent.
Kirin ichiban (the first, the best) on tap always gets me through the door and it was poured Japanese style with the micro foamy top.

My 3-year old toddler was welcomed, though if you’re not comfy with them on a stool then maybe avoid. Also he got small chopsticks not a spoon.
Decor and kitchen very chique in a stainless steel kind of way.
Unfortunately we were a bit cold - they had the air con on despite the cold outside so we kept our coats on.
Also I have to remove a star because the toilet was out of service without prior warning - after a pint and a bowl of soup we were caught short.
I’d try the udon and karaage if I came again

The most authentic and flavoursome Japanese noodles I tasted in London.
In a very simple venue full of character rather than deco.
With the most friendly and smiley staff.
10 STARS

Japanese ramen restaurant with outdoor sitting mainly. The food was good (not outstanding I must say). I really liked the starters prawn tempura and chicken. The mains were good but lacked a little bit of flavour. The service was a bit erratic as the dishes came out at different times which meant that the same table ate at different times.

Best Ramen i’ve had had in london!
Friendly staff and great music as well!

I’m sorry but I ordered in person and specifically asked for vegan food. I brought it home and knew something was off and called the restaurant again. They confirmed it was vegetarian, not vegan as was said to me in person. I just waisted a bunch of money cause I can’t eat any of it! Ridiculous in 2026.

If you're in the mood for top-notch sushi without the dine-in experience, this pickup restaurant is a fantastic choice. From the moment you place your order to when you pick it up, the process is smooth and efficient, making it convenient for a quick meal or a special treat.

The sushi here stands out for its exceptional quality. The fish is consistently fresh and flavorful, which is crucial for a great sushi experience. Whether you're a fan of classic rolls like the California Roll or prefer something more adventurous like the spicy tuna or eel, the variety on the menu is impressive. Each roll is crafted with care, featuring well-balanced flavors and generous portions of fish.

One of the standout aspects is the value for money. For the price, you get a generous amount of sushi that is both satisfying and high quality. The portion sizes are substantial, ensuring you get a good bang for your buck. Additionally, the presentation is meticulous, even for pickup orders. The sushi arrives looking as appetizing as it tastes, with carefully arranged rolls and neatly packaged sides.

The restaurant also excels in maintaining consistency. Whether you’re a regular or a first-time customer, you can expect the same high standards each time. The staff is friendly and attentive, making the ordering process straightforward and hassle-free.

Overall, this sushi pickup restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with exceptional value. It's a great option for anyone craving high-quality sushi without the need for a sit-down meal. Highly recommended for both sushi aficionados and casual diners alike.
I’m order online they’re send me extra portion of wonderful sushi for free im really appreciate that.. and the sushi was very taste definitely recommend and I’ll order again !!
We really enjoyed the food and the service was great and friendly. I recomend it a lot.

Fresh and tasty. Made to perfection presentation was on point.
My new local sushi spot.

name: Ona's Bento Sushi Bar
address: 486 Roman Rd, Bow, London E3 5LU, UK

reviews.text: Absolutely impressed by the freshness and flavor of the fish here! It's already my neighborhood favorite with the generous cuts and reasonable prices. Happened to order a box set and a few extra slices of sashimi, you can really see the quality in the marbling of the salmon and the redness of the tuna.

Hadn't written a review in a while but this small, cosy and lovely restaurant 'forced' me to write one again.
So happy we found this place! We ordered gyoza and could hear them being fried behind the counter and they tasted as good as they looked. We were hungry so went for a fried rice bowl and the eel was delicious.
Very friendly and warm staff. Most definitely a recommendation!

The food here was so delicious we had to come back twice in one day. The seared salmon donburi is just incredible and every piece of rice packs flavour that you don’t need to eat quickly. The interiors have gorgeous psychedelic swirls, tiles, iron cups for serving tea, the auntie of the house really looks after this place and makes you feel like you’re entering her home. Genuinely felt like I was in Samurai Gourmet eating here! Friendly, local, honest, nothing fancy but oh so delicious!

Came here for lunch on a saturday without a booking and got a table without having to wait. The food was delicious, especially the pressed sushi thing. Honestly I've never had sushi like that before and i loved it. We also had a nice coffee after. Definitely recommend this place for lunch or dinner!

Extremely good value. Some of the best sushi I’ve had at this price point outside of Japan. Service was incredibly kind.

We were a small group of 3 who ordered a bento box among other things. They threw in a couple complimentary teas and extra nigiri so that we could have one each in the combo. After our first round we unexpectedly had to get more because it was so tasty. Super calm space with cute decor.

A pleasant surprise. We went there with friends and the service was amazing. We had some bits as suggestion of the chef and it didn't disappoint. Not the most spacious place for pram but they were so helpful to fit us in. Sushi was fresh and very well presented. As we had just starters, nibbles in general, found bill on the expensive side, but because we were so well served and everyone was so nice and quick serving us, we paid with no issues. 😍🥰 no baby change for those going there with babies but for us it wasn't an issue.
Really good grub. Highly recommend the prawn gyozas, cod skewers and the sashimi. Staff were really lovely too! Nice vibe - felt like a really good authentic place with great veggie options also.

I went for lunch on a Wednesday and picked the Spicy Tuna Poke from their lunch menu. Added a side of Kimchi. Other then the big bit of cabbage, seen in the picture, the rest of the kimchi was just mush. I think it was on the turn. The Miso soup was nice. The Poke was ok.

Genuinely one of my best eats since I’ve moved to London. The Tuna Belly nigiri was truly amazing, we also had really good sushi rolls and the mushroom Mapo tofu !
The staff were really nice and attentive too.

Overall amazing and will definitely try to bring friends and families visiting in the future !
One of the best dinners I’ve had. The food was truly delicious. The ramen was full of flavor while the fish was fresh and toro was melty. Staff is kind and welcoming. Great experience

name: The Sushi Co - Dalston
address: 15 Kingsland High St, London E8 2JS, UK

reviews.text: Fantastic momo place tucked away off Cambridge heath road. My first time there and service was so friendly. Had the vegetarian momos with salad and cannot recommend it enough, taste was incredible! Prices very decent too.
Great box car restaurant specialising in MoMa and Benton boxes.  Everything was excellent with a no frils restaurant.

Delicious and ace location.

We stayed at the Mama Shelter just down the road from here and snook out of an under nourished party for some more generous portions.
Not disappointed at all, the place is really cool, being central in a container village. You call them up on a little intercom and they buzz you through, brill. We got katsu and sushi plus bits and it was all reasonably priced and really tasty.

I visited this café today and had such a lovely experience. The food was delicious — fresh, thoughtful, and made with real care. I also wanted to mention the warm hospitality: the guy working there was incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. He made the whole atmosphere feel cosy and personal.

Thank you for such a wonderful visit — I’ll definitely be coming back.

Delicious momos, we got chicken with chilli and panfried lamb and broccoli. There is a small seating area in the next shipping container. Lovely food but the space is a bit cold in winter and could have a better ambience.

Nice little burger shack.
Had the  moo! Moo! Madness and the dirty fries, both very good.
Especially the combination of blue cheese and maple bacon on the burger worked really well.
9 pound for the burger is also a fair price.

Would recommend 😊
Super tasty food, quick service and lovely staff. Even gave me a beer on the house, true gents. Thanks guys!

Pretty sure it’s not entirely their fault but I ordered food from them through Deliveroo. I do not recommend. The driver was on the way then stationary for a while. When he arrived I had very little fries left, burger was cold and oily.

Of course I didn’t get my money.

great burgers, loved the naga wings n the loaded fries, must try them👍

the staffs (especially the young guy named Ru) was exceptional, service was 10/10, lovely dining and will definitely try again and again!!
The brisket madness burger is outstanding, beautifully tender meat and the Irish Ballymaloe relish works really well with it. Their home-made sauce is banging too. Definitely recommend!

Visited for the first time today i decided order the hot chick with the help of an amazing employee called talal. The staff were so friendly and patient as its my first time and i wasn’t sure how to navigate the menu. The open kitchen was clean and i observed high food handling standards. Can’t wait to try the burger! Mahdi another employee worked fast to make sure my food was hot and aesthetic

This is from Saudi Eats in London, with 80k+ followers across social platforms.
Instagram & Tiktok: saudieats.ksa

@bronsonsburgers is East London’s best kept secret ;). Bronson’s Burger has truly set a new standard for burger joints with their latest dine-in restaurant.

If you’re craving a top-tier burger with patties so juicy they’ll have you coming back for more, this is the spot to be. With 10 locations across the UK, Bronson’s doesn’t just serve burgers—they elevate them into an art.

The burgers here are really good – juicy and flavorful. However, it’s a shame they don’t serve proper cola, only something called ‘premium cola,’ which tastes quite different. The paprika chips are surprisingly spicy and feel more like chili chips than paprika.

Unfortunately, the atmosphere is lacking. The place feels empty, and nobody seems to eat in, which makes it less inviting.

I love smash burgers! I ordered a couple of these double cheeseburgers with sauce and salad and pickles. The buns are soft and fresh and good size of patties that aren’t smashed too thin , like some places do. The quality of beef was better than average. But not as good as burgers I’ve had elsewhere! But for double this price.
I ordered a chocolate milkshake! Which was ok  ! Nothing to brag about. The staff were extremely busy, because of 50% price reduction on opening. So service was a little rushed and hastily done. Not a problem. Only problem was the atmosphere was far too loud !! With extremely loud music!! More like a night club than a burger outlet! Probably because of the new opening! I think !
I’ll definitely be coming back for more of these tasty burgers! But only if their music is much less noisy. 09/02/25 ordered 2 more of these great smash burgers, and 2 fries . 1 paprika as usual & 1 cheese fries !
The cheese fries are the only dissatisfying disappointment from this place. The cheese was just melted cheese sauce ! Should be stated on the menu! But worse still it wasn’t served separately in a tub .
But poured all over un caringly ! All over the sides of the box ! And the fries were literally mush ! Mush ! I hope the owner reads this ! And serves the sauce separately! I’m deducting 1 star for this reason. And won’t order the cheese fries.

I don't often leave average reviews, see my history. I also recognise that this place is known for burgers and I did not order a burger so I will give it a second chance, also this was the soft opening so I leave this feedback hoping it helps them to improve.

I was glad to see this place open given I had seen their truck nearby for ages and seen their good reviews in the past.

I ordered cheesy fries and the tenders.

The quality of the potato chips are very good but the cheese is terrible, American style cheese sauce, just gloop, not for me. The chips could be seasoned with more salt, or at least ask.

The tenders are poor. A lot of batter very little chicken. The batter lacks seasoning, it's just crispy flour. You'll do better in well known chicken places.

It took about 15 mins to get this order even though there was only one other customer there during that time, this may have been because of the recent opening but I worry if it was a  busy night.

Finally, I wasn't too impressed to see one of the chefs vaping in the kitchen.

name: Smoke & Pepper (Dalston)

reviews.text:
We visited Smoke & Pepper Dalston after many recommendations from family & friends + social media.
Great decor and ambience.. let down by the FOH not being overly knowledgeable nor welcoming.

The Kinder Bueno Milkshake was excellent, great value for money & nicely packaged.
The Loaded Fries were overly saucy & not enough meat otherwise nice crispy fries.
The “Truffle” Burger was not Truffling & met with plastic in our food, according to the Owner & Chefs it was plastic from the fork….. the fork was no where near the burger at the time of discovery!
They were merely apologetic or acknowledging the fact it’s not for human consumption!
Fortunately will NOT be revisiting.
Very expensive.

Absolutely Loved It! Smoke & Pepper Dalston 😍
Smoke and Pepper is an absolute gem! The food was bursting with flavour. Every bite was delicious and perfectly cooked. The presentation was beautiful, and you can really taste the quality and freshness of the ingredients.
The service was just as impressive, friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring. The staff made sure we had everything we needed and checked in at just the right times without being intrusive.
Whether you’re going out for a casual meal or a special occasion, Smoke and Pepper is the perfect spot. I can’t wait to go back — highly recommend!

We were a group of around 15 people, invited for a party at the restaurant and had an absolutely amazing experience. The service was spot on, as well as the food. Absolutely loved the starters especially Algerian chicken tenders. My friend and I ordered different burgers and halved them so we both could try them. I ordered beef brisket and she ordered Oklahoma, both were tasty.

We ended the meal with their original milk cake and Bruce cake. It was an amazing experience, definitely recommended! 💯

Went with my family and honestly, we had the best time. The staff were super friendly and helped us pick out the most popular dishes. We all got different burgers and couldn’t decide whose was better — every single one was amazing! The drinks aren’t your usual ones either — so many options and every one of them hits the spot. Desserts and drinks were world-class — you’d never see it coming. Loved the food, the staff, and the whole vibe. Definitely coming back

I had an excellent experience at Smoke & Pepper. The team was superbly friendly, kind, and welcoming, making the visit feel genuinely warm. The restaurant maintains an impressive level of cleanliness and hygiene, which immediately adds to the comfort and confidence of dining there. And of course, the highlight—the burgers—were absolutely incredible: flavorful, well-crafted, and truly satisfying. A perfect balance of great food, outstanding service, and spotless surroundings. Highly recommended!
Simple, delicious, and creative. Great quality meat, light burgers, and very moreish.

I had a really great experience at Zapata Burger. The burger was delicious, the meat is clearly high quality, and the brioche bun was so good soft and full of flavour. I ordered the Zapata Burger and really enjoyed it.

I’m so happy a place like this has opened in my neighborhood! The lady who served me was very kind and attentive she even offered me a tea while I was waiting for my takeaway, which was such a lovely touch. The place is beautiful and very clean .
I definitely recommend it! 🍔
Simply, Perfect Burger! ❤️
Delicious burgers and a very generous portion of fries. Highly recommend!
A new face in town, offering great burgers and friendly service.  Don’t forget to add your burger list.
I loved everything about this place. Great smash burgers for good value, the onion rings were awesome too. We liked specially the friendly and attentive service.

I’ve been here 3 times this week! Literally my GO-2 smash burger spot. I’m surprised it doesn’t get as packed out during the day but I can imagine in the heart of Dalston it gets BUSYYYYY! Jupiter Burger – London Fields Review

Hype & Expectations (4/5)
Jupiter Burger is an Instagram favourite, With the buzz and the branding, expectations were naturally high. I made the journey across London anticipating a long wait, but the queue moved quickly—from arrival to first bite took around 20–30 minutes, maybe less.

The Burger Experience (3.5/5)
I went for the Jupiter Burger, their premium option featuring a smash patty, sweet onions, iceberg lettuce, and tomato—no fries, which brought it to £10.
•	The first bite hit the spot: the crispy, caramelised smash edges and the sweet onions worked beautifully, delivering that classic American-style burger flavour.
•	The bun was spot on—authentic, soft, and ideal for soaking up all that juicy goodness.
•	But as I got through it, the lettuce and tomato began to get in the way, muting the flavour of the patty and adding extra moisture that made the burger a bit soggy. I found myself rushing through it rather than savouring each bite.

In hindsight, I wish I’d gone for the standard cheeseburger—which seems more focused and likely delivers the cleaner, meat-forward experience I was craving.

Value for Money (4/5)
At £10 without fries, the Jupiter Burger is fairly priced for a London street-style burger, especially given the quality of the ingredients. But as their premium burger, I expected a bit more finesse and clarity of flavour.

Overall Rating: 3.5/5
Jupiter Burger delivers good ingredients and a strong first impression, but the Jupiter itself felt a little over-complicated. The veg dulled the flavour of what could have been a stand-out burger.

Would I return? Yes—but next time, I’m going straight for the standard cheeseburger, which I suspect is the real star of the show.

Is it worth the hype? Almost, there are others out there that are equally as good if not better.
