I opened the bun and could only crumbs of meat and was struggling to see a double beef pate. Honestly this is the worst burger I’ve ever had in my life! Even a McDonald’s cheese burger beats this and I can’t believe I’m saying this lol. Please ignore what you see and hear about bun sum on social media as it’s very misleading and what you see on social media isn’t what you’re presented with in reality. Whilst I was in The restaurant another customer looked at me and agreed that what I was served was very poor. I demanded a refund and hopefully it will show up on my account soon. Please avoid this chain of restaurants and I invite who ever is reading this to read the other reviews which are similar to mine. Bun Sum you’re an absolute disgrace you haven’t the slightest idea about what a good burger is how are these restaurants even still open for business ? Lmao

This place had been on my radar for a long time, and the social media hype has been crazy. Finally, I had the opportunity to visit their Hackney location and decided to try as much as I could.

Here’s what I ordered:

Motz Burger
A solid burger that could have benefited from a bit more seasoning. Thankfully, the onions and smac sauce added enough flavour to make it enjoyable.

Green Chilli Burger
Like the Motz Burger, this one also lacked seasoning. However, the generous portion of green chillis was a perfect hit. The burgers were on the smaller side, but the 50% discount made them a good deal. I wouldn’t pay full price given their size.

Shticky Ribs
The ribs were tasty, with a honey BBQ sauce that was sweet, tangy, and perfectly glazed. The only downside was that there wasn't much meat on them.

Animal Fries
The fries were decent, and the combination of caramelised onions and smac sauce was excellent. However, I was confused by the slice of cheese on the fries when they sell queso cheese.

Loaded Smashed Potatoes
An outstanding combination of flavours with crispy potatoes. I would prefer if they came in a wider container to ensure the toppings are spread more evenly. After finishing the top layers, you’re left with plain chips.

They offer unique drink options and an extensive menu. However, I found the prices a bit high for what you receive. On the bright side, the staff were friendly and quick to clear the tables after customers left.

I’d definitely return to try other items on the menu, possibly at a different location.

Neo taste app bought me to this place. Booked a meal only to find out they don’t do the app - misleading customers. Anyhow we checked the QR code made it to the counter to order . We were not attended for almost 15 mins despite being the only paying customers and 3 delivery guys waiting for the food . We then further sat for 5 mins to order.
To be honest customer service can be upgraded 💯

name: Karv Steakhouse
address: 52 Evering Rd, Lower Clapton, London N16 7SR, UK

reviews.text: Karv Steakhouse is an absolute must-visit! From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with a warm and friendly atmosphere that sets the tone for an incredible dining experience. The platters are truly the star of the show—perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and generously portioned. Every bite tastes fresh, well-seasoned, and thoughtfully prepared, making it ideal for sharing or enjoying all to yourself. What really sets Karv apart, though, is the amazing customer service. The staff is attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about making sure you have a great experience. Karv Steakhouse delivers on quality, taste, and service every single time. Highly recommended!

We got the 4 person sharer platter and everything was so good. The smash burgers were a standout and the Wagyu steak was amazing. All the sides and sauces were honestly spectacular and really tied everything together.

Our waiter was super nice and friendly which made the experience even better. The only reason I’m giving the atmosphere 4 stars is because the place is quite small so it got pretty loud. That might have been because there was a big group seated right next to us though.

Overall great food, great service, and definitely worth it.

Came here with my friend which he recommend highly of this place after seeing a video online. We were no disappointed after ordering their poster for 3-4 people. The staff were all polite and attentive - the food smacked and everything was just cooked to perfection: Smoky, tender and juicy! Best thing I had in my opinion was the bone marrow and toast and the steak. Definitely worth a trip to try this place out!!

Had dinner here with a friend and we were just looking for some good food,and we definitely got it.
The medium-rare steak was cooked perfectly, the mushroom and pepper sauces were really tasty, and the sweet potato fries were delicious.
If I have to mention something, the mojito was a bit too sweet for my taste, but nothing major.
The staff was very friendly and the prices were fair.
The restaurant is small, and it was quite full when we went, which says a lot.
Overall, it was a great experience with excellent food. Highly recommended.

Easily my favourite restaurant local to Tottenham Stadium up the road! — Highly recommend — I always visit before heading to any kind of event there afterwards.

I discovered this place at the start of the year and have returned (4) times to-date since; each experience always consistent and more than impressing the mates I am introducing to it. (All of whom share my love for you guys now, might I add.)

The only thing I’m not personally keen on here is the Bone Marrow (I only tried it for the first time EVER in my last actual visit, and it’s at no fault of the kitchen. I just didn’t personally enjoy it as a first-timer, but I can see why others definitely do. Especially the Sour Dough serving it comes with.)

Highly recommend all the steak cuts, the Grilled Dynamite Prawns, & and literally all their iterations/riffs on Mojitos!

As a suggestion - albeit a selfish one - perhaps upsell the Dynamite Sauce for the steaks too?

Thank you guys again for the consistent, great service every time also.

name: Feast Burgers (Clapton)
address: 176 Clarence Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8DY, UK

reviews.text:
Absolutely terrible experience. The amount of peri salt on the fries was insane completely inedible. It wasn’t seasoning, it was a pile of powder dumped on top. No normal human being could eat this much salt without gagging.
What makes it worse is that this happened TWICE, not once. When I complained, the staff had the nerve to say, “We put this much for everyone.” That is a straight-up lie. No restaurant serves fries buried under a mountain of peri salt like this unless they don’t care at all.
On top of that, the price is ridiculously high for food that’s ruined before you can even eat it. Paying premium prices for something that goes straight to the bin is unacceptable.
Zero quality control, zero accountability, and zero respect for customers. I will not be coming back, and I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone unless you enjoy eating salt by the spoon.

We were craving some desserts
& Found this place.

Their ice creams are good
We tried a few flavours,
Our favourites were
The chocolate & The strawberry one.

We also tried their mozzarella sticks
Which were nice too.

Definitely check out the rest of
Their menu & Give them a go.

Best wishes to everyone at
Feast Burgers (Clapton)

Feast Burger is my go-to cheat meal spot. I usually go for the 6oz Feast Burger meal with lemon pepper wings and a Vimto, and it always hits the spot. It’s the perfect place for me to unwind every few months, enjoy some great food and clear my head on a drive. The sauces are packed with flavor and the milkshakes are top tier too. Always leave feeling full and satisfied.

Brought a chicken meal as a takeaway. Sat at the table while I waited for my order, when it was ready the guy called me over and told me that my order was ready. I asked him several times if that was my order and he said yes, I get home and is a completely different meal. I might have thought it was accident but I distinctly remember the guys looking at me and laughing, didn't understand then but now I did. They must run out and substituted it with a different meal. Now, I couldn't take it back because I left the store, and they can use it as excuse to say I swapped  the orders, so I am writing  this review.
Never eaten in the restaurant but order all the time on Uber Eats. £15.99 for a whole grilled Piri Piri Chicken. Always delicious, great value, never had a bad meal, consistently good.

The burgers are smashed but still incredibly juicy, with loads of flavour in every bite. The Big & Juicy Sando was exactly that, packed, full-on, and seriously satisfying.

We also ordered the loaded fries and asked to swap them for curly fries, which was 100% the right move. They were not shy on the toppings at all and held up really well.

The gingerbread milkshake deserves a special mention. Easily one of the best I've had. Creamy, perfectly spiced, and dangerously addictive to the point you genuinely can't put it down.

Proper comfort food done right. Would happily come back.

I'm still dreaming about their Loaded Tots which was cheesy and topped with generous Chicken pieces. The Hot Dog was perfectly juicy and the Burger was just as good. Everything is cooked fresh and packed full with flavours!

I did also try their Pistachio Milkshake; which could have used with some stronger hints of pistachio.

Been here a couple of times and everytime, everything has been good! The food, desserts and drinks. 10/10 for customer service, thanks to Amad and all the staff for always being friendly and welcoming. See you guys soon. 😊

If you’re looking for somewhere to satisfy your burger cravings, this spot will 100% do that 😍

The star of the show had to be their beef burgers - the Brim Burger and The Meltdown were 100/10! Its been a while since we’ve had such a good burger 😍

The kinder bueno milkshake was also 10/10!

100% recommend 🔥

Really disappointing experience. Pictures look great but received two hotdogs instead dogs instead of my cheesy fries. No drink. Burgers were so soggy, too much sauce and the lettuce and gherkin were soggy and foul. Hair in one of the burgers that definitely wasn’t one of ours. Thick and black, most likely beard hair. Got a refund for the missing fries but honestly the whole order wasn’t worth a penny.

name: FOODEEZ
address: 355 Cambridge Heath Rd, London E2 9RA, UK

reviews.text:
I recently visited Foodez and I can confidently say it was one of the best dining experiences I’ve had. The shawarma was absolutely outstanding  easily the best I’ve ever tried. The flavors were perfectly balanced, and there was something about it that truly sets it apart.

I also ordered a smash burger and a cheeseburger and both were excellent. The quality of the ingredients and the flavor in every bite were impressive. You can really tell they put care into their food.

On top of that, the customer service was exceptional. The staff was friendly welcoming and attentive which made the experience even better.

I highly recommend Foodez to anyone looking for great food and great service. It’s definitely worth a visit!

I have eaten at Foodeez many times and would definitely recommend!
The quality of the food is exceptional, I am really impressed with the smash burgers and buttermilk chicken burger.
There’s a wide variety of items on the menu so something for everyone!
The staff are really nice and friendly and which makes the experience even better, they tell you how long the food will take to be served and provide excellent service. I really liked how the shop only stocks genocide free brands.
Do go and try if you have not already!

Amazing food!
I ordered the buttermilk chicken burger with only a little salad. I usually don't fancy a lot of salad on my burger because it's not always fresh but this salad was crunchy and exceeded my expectation. The burger was moist and flavourful. The thick cut chips were a perfect match and I also really enjoyed the various sauces they had. I took my order with a Lemonade.

We had a smash burger, buttermilk burger and 2 kids meals. The burgers weren’t too bad but we ate in and had the misfortune of witnessing a food delivery of frozen chicken and a huge vat of mayonnaise, that was filthy and it put me off my food instantly. The kids meals were awful and not edible, chicken strips and nuggets were dry and tasted really odd. Chips seemed to be cooked in old oil and were not seasoned so had a bitter cardboard taste. I had to buy my kids snacks from the garage next door to sustain them until dinner so basically a massive waste of money and food

Smash burgers are good. Some people might find it a little spicy, but I do like it that way. The wings are great, works well with the chilli and the red sauce, which they usually offer. Always fresh chips are served. Chicken burgers are great, the buttermilk and the spicy one. Different patties. If you want a halal replacement for the cheeseburger and double cheeseburger they offer that here, only thing I think they can improve on is to not overcook the patty on the cheeseburger/ double cheeseburger. Other than that they're generous on the toppings on the burger which evens that out.

name: Smashology
address: 78C, rear of, 78 Dalston Ln Terrace, Dalston Ln, London E8 3AH, UK

reviews.text:
This new halal burger spot is quickly becoming a real local gem. I’ve been working my way through their menu and honestly, everything I’ve had so far has been amazing. The quality of food really stands out, always consistent and they are clearly very passionate about what they do.

Some top picks you absolutely have to try:
The Double OG smash burger - literally melts in your mouth (don't even think about it, just get it)
The boneless bites in dynamite and mango habanero - spicy but so good!
The grilled wings in peri peri and hot honey
And the buttermilk burger with hot honey sauce

Safe to say, this place has officially become our Friday cravings go to and we’ll definitely keep coming back.

On a side note, very pleased to see they don't stock any boycotted drinks. They have a wide range of Kinza flavours and Salaam Cola.

I’ve had other smash burgers before and they either weren’t the freshest or had some bone bits inside.

This place does them to perfection, I’d recommend the Double OG Smash Burger with Dynamite Boneless Bites

You won’t be disappointed🔥😋
Elite Naga smash burger
One of the best smash burgers I’ve had - guys were super nice too, great addition to Dalston.

This is a dark kitchen setup, but the staff were kind enough to let us eat our collection order outside. The service is excellent, though they stay very busy—I highly recommend ordering ahead to beat the rush!

What a lovely pub. Friendly staff and punters. Great selection of beers and outside seating. Amazing thing about global warming is that we can all now sit outside in December with a beer. What’s not to love

I visited The Dove recently while walking through Broadway Market and honestly had a really great experience. It’s one of those proper traditional pubs that still feels authentic, but also fits perfectly with the buzz of the area. The atmosphere inside is warm, relaxed, and welcoming, and it’s a great place to stop whether you’re out with friends, on a casual day out, or just fancy a quiet drink.
The drink selection is excellent, especially if you like trying different beers and ales. There’s a really good variety on tap and behind the bar, and the staff were happy to give recommendations, which was appreciated. Service in general was friendly and efficient — you don’t feel rushed, but you’re also not waiting ages to be served.
The location is spot on, right in the heart of Broadway Market, so it’s ideal if you’re already in the area shopping or just exploring. It does get busy, especially on weekends, but that just adds to the atmosphere and shows how popular the place is. Despite that, it still feels relaxed and not overcrowded.
I also had some food while I was there and it was really decent — proper pub food, well cooked, and good portion sizes. Nothing overcomplicated, just solid, tasty food that goes perfectly with a drink.
Overall, The Dove is a great pub with a nice vibe, friendly staff, good drinks, and a brilliant location. Definitely somewhere I’d come back to again and would recommend to anyone visiting the area. 🍻

We came as a group of four and had an absolutely wonderful experience! We tried a wide variety of dishes, and every single one was fantastic — full of flavor, beautifully presented, and clearly made with care. The highlight? The signature burgers, limited to just 10 per day — an absolute gem! Bursting with flavor and totally worth it. Can’t recommend this place enough!

1 person behind the bar on a Saturday at 20:45. All the bartenders were beyond rude. They didn't know what a Mexican Mule was.

A lot of middle class wankers with fake corporate jobs with bisexual moustaches. A couple performatively playing chess in a corner.

The revolution won't happen in this place. Avoid at all costs.

The best gluten free fish and chips I’ve ever had. Made with gluten free beer batter, it was crispy and had so much flavour. Bonus that it came with homemade tarter sauce and mushy peas. My go to for gf fish and chips whenever I’m in London!

I mainly come here for the fresh oysters at the market. They are great, but the men who serve aren't so nice all the time, they have a "fake polite" energy that they exude. Also the tried to overcharge me, but I did the math of all the individual oysters I asked for, and said it should cost X price instead, so they had to reduce it. I'm not even a tourist, but they tried to make me fall for this trap; lucky I always check. For these reasons they don't get 5 stars from me, and seafood is my favourite cuisine.

I love the way they handle their fish.

It’s the one and only fishmongers in Broadway market, but the care and attention they give to the fish add so much freshness and flavour. All fish is handled with love.

Their selection of fish is impressive given that it’s a tiny place.

The fish is alway fresh and we’ll presented.

We love going there to buy something special to cook.

We bought fresh mackerel and monk fish today.

Only popped by at the oyster cart, yet.
Fun stop, extremely tasty oysters, favourite was the Irish Carlingford Oyster; fresh, juicy and with an almost green taste.
Focused shucking and a great atmosphere from the stroller parents to the runners stopping by for a quick protein fix.

Purchased a few dozen fresh oysters recently - some from Whitstable and a dozen from Jersey. Highly recommended.
Also got about 250g of seaweed.

A lovely fishmongers that have a range of seafood.
Very friendly and helpful staff.

Some of the best oysters i've had in london. I think the options depend on what time you come. I've come on a Saturday before and there were multiple types of oysters, ranging in price from around £3.50 to £6 each. I got a pricier oyster and it was unbelievably good. I came recently on a Thursday at 6 and the oysters were £2 each. They were still good but not as mind blowing. However the cheaper price made them a great deal. I specifically recommended picking up some oysters then sitting at the pub across the road to get a drink to wash them down with.

name: Black Cat café
address: 76A Clarence Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8HB, UK

reviews.text: I had a delicious meal at Black Cat Café! The staff were very friendly and accommodating, I loved all the vegan food, and thought it was great value for money! I appreciate the art and book shelves there too! Would love to return to try more of their cakes and sweet dishes!

Great and pleasant service, pleasant atmosphere, the food is great and portion size is large! The preparation takes a bit of time, so take it into account.
I took the cat breakfast as I was pretty hungry, but in retrospect the kitten breakfast would've been better for me, finished pretty stuffed!  Would definitely recommend and come back here :)

I had the best time going to this Cafe. The staff were incredible and so lovely! I had the pleasure of having the salad bowl and easy to say it was one of the best I’ve ever had, all was so tasty and the serving size was great. Such a nice environment with  a lovely decorated and spacious setting. The toilets were also very clean and the decor were lovely! Would 10/10 recommend if you’re looking for tasty vegan food 😊
Yummy vegan food, great matcha!!! I think one of the best on Clarence Road

Radical Comfort at Black Cat Café – Hackney Black Cat Café isn’t just a place to eat — it’s a statement. Tucked away on Clarence Road, this volunteer-run, not-for-profit café offers a warm, inclusive space where ethics and flavour go hand in hand. The vibe is unmistakably East London: mismatched furniture, zines on the shelves, and a steady hum of conversation from locals, artists, and activists alike.

The menu is 100% vegan and refreshingly affordable. We tried the seitan burger and the lentil shepherd’s pie — both hearty, flavourful, and deeply satisfying. The portions are generous, and the desserts (especially the chocolate cake) are rich without being cloying. Everything is made with care, and you can taste the difference.

There’s a strong DIY spirit here — from the rotating art on the walls to the community events and fundraisers. Staff are friendly and passionate, and the atmosphere is relaxed, welcoming, and quietly radical.

Whether you’re vegan or just curious, Black Cat offers more than a meal — it’s a space to connect, reflect, and recharge.
Popped in for a steak sandwich, so pleasantly surprised by the quality of the meat! Soft, fabulously cooked, and well seasoned. Would gladly come back for another, highly recommended!
Not had a better steak in London for a long long time. Absolutely delicious. The wine was great too and for £41 you just can’t argue. A place to seek out and travel to eat at.
Very good food! Highly recommend coming to this place for amazing cuts of meat grilled well.  The service was great - very friendly staff.
An absolutely fabulous meal. Completely unpretentious, delicious food and great service. The steak is easily one of the best I've ever had. Don't miss it!

What an excellent evening of amazing food and wine with the best service from Andrea. She was so knowledgeable, shared her recommendations which we tried and loved. Who knew sweetbreads could taste like that?!
London has a lot of steak restaurants but this is up there with the best.

A great pub in viccy park. The food is actually really good - two of us had the chicken Shnitzel and have talked about it multiple times since. Proper wholesome food. We sat outside In Jan as many others were but it didnt feel overly cold as there are plenty of heaters. There were lots of people with dogs, we loved saying hi to them all. Was also child friendly! We will be going back for dinner and a quiz night in the future ☺️

Had my very first Sunday roast here and it was amazing! Great food, friendly service, and such a cozy place to spend the afternoon. The roast was cooked perfectly with generous portions. Highly recommend if you’re in the area!

Myself & ex-work colleagues met up as we often do for a meal & a chat. This was our first & probably last visit based on our experience.

It was chosen as an alternative to our usual spot, based on reviews.

I was greeted very well by a particular bar staff who also took our food order. She advised she would be leaving shortly (it was about 3-30pm). My party of 4 ordered the chicken dish served in a breadcrumb coating, egg & chips with a salad with dressing. Once served the dish, no member of staff came to check if the food was to our liking. The chicken coating was so hard, it knocked against the plate. We were so hungry, the only edible part was the chips & egg. We agreed collectively that it was the worst dish we ever had in a pub. Total cost of the meal was £20 per person. We complained & was offered a complimentary drink each. Nice gesture, but I would have preferred decent food.
I had a phenomenal Sunday roast, Nicky looked after us so well, great value and beyond exceptional service I will definitely come back. all of the staff were so lovely!

This is a lovely pub but much better on a quieter day. We came on a day that was way too busy. But the food in here is decent, the surroundings are lovely as you're in the park itself. It's dog friendly. But beware because of the crowds, it is a queue at the bar system, no table service. Which is fine, but just be aware of this before coming. I have been coming here for over 20 years and have seen the changes in this area and this pub. But I will always visit when I'm in the area as for me it's a part of my Eastend history.

Was sunny so I sat outside to relax after the Ronch exhibition. Looks nice inside, I haven't spent enough time to comment. The beer was crisp and tasty. The pub had a table with quirky recent event fliers, I took camden pop up fashion show that was on that day only.

🚇 Haggerston
🍺 £6.20 Paulaner

The Haggerston sits on the border between Dalston and Haggerston in Hackney, East London. The nearest station is Haggerston.

This pub dates back to 1802 and was originally called The Swan. It was rebuilt in the mid-nineteenth century, and the plinth at the top of the building still bears its former name.

Over the years it has operated under several names, including ‘Richmonds’ and ‘Uncle Sam’s’, before becoming The Haggerston in 2008.

This is a one-bar pub with rustic, traditional charm. The servery is to the right with a marble-topped counter. In the right corner sits the old Joanna; to the left, a DJ booth; and opposite are intimate pew-style booths. The decor includes a boarded floor, exposed brick walls, and an eclectic mix of photos, signs, and mirrors.

Upstairs is a function room, traditionally decorated and complete with its own bar. A standout feature for me was a superb black-and-white photo of the brothers who ran the pub for many years. At the rear is a partially covered beer garden, with more outdoor seating at the front.

The beer selection is excellent, offering premium lagers, local independent brews, and one cask ale from @fivepointsbrew .I went for a Paulaner, a personal favourite—top pint, average price. No food is served, but there are plenty of bar snacks if you’re peckish.

I arrived at 2pm on a mild Saturday in November. The pub was quiet, chilled, and set to a superb soul and jazz soundtrack. Service was first class; the team were friendly and personable. I even received a guided tour from the Guv’nor, who has been here for ten years and is an absolute gent.

This pub really comes alive at night, with live piano on Wednesdays and Thursdays and DJ sets on Fridays and Saturdays. A true institution here is The Alan Weekes Jazz Quintet, which has performed every Sunday for over 25 years.

A fiercely independent pub and a joy to visit. The beer is well chosen, the setting intimate, and the team here are some of the best in the business. I left this boozer with a big smile. I 100% recommend you visit.

Follow @thehaggerston for updates.

📅 1st November 2025

If you want to see all my pub reviews in one place, head to @londonpubmap on Instagram or Facebook. 🍻
Great pub with a credible music offer. Hence why we pitched our services and were politely declined. Can't blame a fella for trying. Best of luck in the world guys.

Always a good vibes here. Music is good, love the atmosphere. Does get super crowded sometimes and can be hard to manoeuvre around the dance floor. Bar as well can be a nightmare to queue up for. But - I do like this place and have been many times now!
Terrible rude bouncers Glenn and Mathew pushing people out in a very rude policing way without a reason. Shame cos otherwise it would have been a vibe.  Never coming back again

Delicious fresh seafood and great live jazz music! We had an amazing time and I would certainly come back.

The only negative I would say is the lack of ventilation.

What an incredible place. The seafood, the amazing service, the live jazz, the atmosphere. It was all on point. Such a unique experience and doesn’t feel like you are in London. We celebrated my birthday and after our dinner we were taken to the place across the street to continue the evening. The owner also sent us a bottle of sparkling wine and the waiter came in singing and dancing, even if no one had requested this! I had only mentioned that it’s a birthday in the booking. Such a gem of a place - I will definitely be back!

celebrated our friend's birthday here for dinner & were served a set menu that consisted of good seafood!

we had oysters, mussels, trout, haddock, & king prawns. 🦐 there were also peas & chips as sides 🍟, and cheesecake & carrot cake for dessert. 🍰

it was a warm night, so we were sat outside. the jazz music added to the atmosphere, although there were times when they took a break & it was quiet. still, excellent vibes! 🎷

the price of the food is pay as you wish, but they do have a drinks menu that you have set prices.

overall a good place for a meal in east london. would definitely come back again.

First of all, we thought we were going to the main restaurant, but we were led to another location across from it because there was no space, even though we had a reservation two months in advance. The atmosphere of the other place was completely different from the main restaurant. The jazz band was not the same, and it was too bright to feel like a jazz bar.

We had to pay a minimum of £30 per person. The menu did not state this minimum requirement, and we felt taken advantage of. Please avoid making the same mistake; this place clearly states its pricing policy is according to how you feel the food and experience are worth. The musicians told us they were not even paid a portion of what we paid.

The food arrived randomly (not in the order it appeared on the menu), and it took a while for all the dishes to arrive. We had to leave early because it was taking so long, yet we still had to pay £30. The seafood was nothing special; the flavours were bland and unexceptional. The oysters were not fresh which was concerning... I have had better seafood at home.

Oh, and the bread was stale and hard to bite into, so overall, would not go here again or recommend this to others.

Loved the atmosphere; the jazz was cool and the seafood was delicious and very good sized portions! We had the seafood tartare for a starter and it was delicious. We enjoyed the fresh oysters (could have done with more lemon but that's not a big deal) and the large portion of clams hit the spot. For the next course we got two very large pieces of fish in very tasty seafood sauce, potato and some of the best chips that I have had, to share between 4 people, which was definitely enough and delicious. The last course was tiger prawns which were very tasty as well and by then we were pleasantly stuffed.The only thing that we didn't enough so much was the cake for dessert which was very heavy and a bit claggy. But we went for the seafood and they definitely delivered! My hubby is allergic to shellfish and he had a bit of a wait for his fish course but it was worth waiting for and as it is a seafood restaurant we appreciated the staff were accommodating. It was a very busy service but the staff, though rushed off their feet were pleasant and courteous. All in all a very good experience and we would definitely return if we are in London again!

This bagel shop is a total gem. The bagels are perfectly chewy on the inside with just the right crisp on the outside—clearly made fresh and done right. The flavors are spot-on, whether you’re going classic or trying something more adventurous, and the cream cheese selection alone is worth the visit.

The staff is friendly, fast, and genuinely seems to care about what they’re serving. Even when it’s busy, the vibe stays warm and welcoming. It’s the kind of place that turns a regular morning into a great one. If you love bagels, this spot is a must.
Bagel on the Park nailed it – creamy oat milk chai, a killer chicken & bacon baguette, and a crunchy, chocolatey cannoli that was pure heaven. Bliss from first sip to last bite! Delicious

What a wonderful establishment. Perfect for a hungover day, we consumed 13 bagels between 8 of us and they definitely hit the spot. Very efficient service and not badly priced either. 100% would recommend.
Been seeing this place on my walks but recently started going in and honesty it became my comfort food! Soo delicious, the coffee is great and ladies working there are always very nice! 1000/10 ❤️

Attentive staff, very welcoming!
Love their salmon and cream cheese bagel!
Do visit! Everyone is soo nice in here
Good fried rice

Best special fried Singapore noodles I’ve had in a while… crispy seaweed was cooked perfectly too. And the driver was so sweet and polite. Definitely ordering again. Please don’t change your recipe/ ingredients or chef ^_^.

I fancied chinese food lastnight so I went to this restaurant listen if you want proper cooked fresh Chinese come to this shop well cooked non greasy nicely seasoned I will definitely come back here. The lady who served us was so cool my new go to.

Best fried rice in Hackney (and I've tried many) It's actually fried, brown and seasoned well.... and not just plain white rice with veg some peas thrown in it. The rest of the dishes are typical UK Chinese  standard. Friendly and reasonable prices.

My new favourite Chinese in East London! Ordered the Salt and Chilli Prawns and the Sweet and Sour Prawns, both great as well as the egg fried rice and noodles. Delivery took around 40 mins (they quoted 35) and they forgot my curry sauce, but delivered it shortly after. Minor issue, will definitely order again!

We went to the bakers to buy bread to get it sliced in store
We waited no one was there
Theres a time lapse between shifts aparently had to wait too long
We left the store and returned
The guy cutting the bread didnt wear gloves while handling the bread
The store isnt at all welcoming the staff lack in thankyou the ones we came across
No one seemed interested
Even on the till the cash option wasnt working
Eventually we was told after waiting a while
Its a shame we love m&s
We wont be rushing back

⸻

I am writing this review to warn other customers.

There is a consistent and recurring issue with price discrepancies in this store. The shelf prices are often lower than the prices charged at the checkout. This has happened on almost every visit, so it cannot reasonably be described as an occasional mistake.

I have raised this matter with staff multiple times, yet no lasting action seems to have been taken. This practice is misleading and creates a lack of trust.

Customers should be extremely careful to check prices and receipts before paying.
Love this place. Great food & staff. Shop is always clean and well organised.
An elderly woman I know is coming here with her disabled daughter. A short while ago, they accused her of theft and are not letting her in. This is slander and very cruel.

Visited to buy some lunch for an event I was going to the next day Friday.  All sandwiches and lunch bowls was dated for the same day Thursday, hardly any was dated for the next day.  A packer was packing out the food stuff so mentioned to him, he said yes that's correct and the prices will be reduced later on in the evening.  Why don't m&s make their sandwiches and lunch boxes dated for the following day or so rather than the same day. Apart from that shop was clean and tidy and staff was helpful and friendly.

name: Brazilian Centre HACKNEY - Produtos Brasileiros (Brazilian Products)

reviews.text: Wow! It was cool to see a specialty butcher and products from Brazil, Portugal and other countries. There were cakes, beans, frozen products and so much to choose from. I felt like I was overseas. It's a great little shop. I'll definitely be back.
Best salgadinhos in London! Love this place, the products are great quality and the service is excellent. Delicious food and lovely people - a little slice of Brasil in east London.
Great selection of Brazilian and Latino goods. The Argentine picanha was perfect!

Very friendly brazilian butcher! I bought 1kg of picanha and my flatmates were impressed by the cut! Can't wait to go back and pick the essentials and a good cut of meat this store has all you need for a legendary barbacoa. Obrigado!!!

Quality of their products and meat have decreased so much this year, to top it all of now they're selling expired goods. Bought a cake mix today (03/11/23) that expired in September 2023. They're asking me to go back to return the item instead of delivering a new one, next time I'll add extra time in my day to return their expired products.

This is just a small pic of Lentils special vegan, which I mostly ate because it was delicious. I served it with salad to stretch it out for 2 portions, as it's generous enough for 2 with side salad or veg. It's absolutely delicious. I have also tried Bean feast, and the vegetable curry. They are absolutely yummy, and feel healthy. It's my Saturday treat, so I don't have to cook. Worth every penny, and cheaper than buying takeaway, and millions times better. Highly recommend. I buy the range from Wholefoods Market Clapham junction. That's a nice shop too!!!
Thank you Rachel, I love your food.
Debbie x

I wanted to love this brand but unfortunately this is my 2nd time trying it and the food being inedible. The Aubergine "pancake" the pancake was soggy/wet and not really a pancake and the smoked mozzarella pasta is basically pasta with mayonnaise and some small bits of mozzarella, too tangy and couldn't eat it.

Had placed an order on their website and tried a few dishes from Laura & her, ... ever so friendly Son Robin. *LoVe all the flavours! *LoVe that their food is NOT overcooked at all (like most other places’) ... and indeed still alive and ‘al dente’. The customer service I’ve received was ‘second to none’ from Robin himself and Steve the delivery man arrived quite early and was very friendly indeed. I couldn’t be happier with my order and defo ‘HIGHLY’ recommend anyone who’s health conscious to try out Laura’s Idea for themselves. ‘You’ll be in for a very tasty treat indeed!’ Ps: my so far ... and probably all time favourite from Lauras Idea is still the extremely yummilicious  ‘Vegetable Calzone!’ ♥️
8 ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ out of 5 stars from me Laura & Robin! Many thanks & the very best of Luck! xx

All sorts of great vegetarian dishes freshly prepared and tasty as.
Love the pesto pasta 🤤
reviews.author_name: Best things in Life Are free!

reviews.text: Wonderful selection of products. Best vegan options in London

Portion size is generous and chips passable, but both chicken quality and crispy coating is mediocre.

I write this as a die-hard KFC fan… knowing that high street chicken shops are invariably weak in comparison. But we can always live in hope, right?

If my review and photos were helpful please leave a thumbs up 👍 Thanks!

That's a chicken fillet burger not a strip burger. Almost no chicken inside taste and smells terrible and chips look like they're re heated few times a day. Disgusting and ended in a bin after two bites. I'm sure good reviews are business owne s or friends

AVOID. I randomly walked in here for a quick lunch. They served me this half cooked chicken, which I only realised after eating a bite.

When I told the young man who served me, he said its perfectly fine!

I threw the rest of the burger in the bin and ate the chips.

Now I feel unwell with an upset tummy.

I had a great experience at Dixy Chicken! The food was fresh, hot, and full of flavor — especially the crispy chicken burgers and spicy wings. The staff were welcoming and served everything quickly, even during a busy time. The restaurant was clean, and the prices were reasonable for the quality. It’s definitely one of my go-to spots for a quick, tasty meal. Highly recommend for anyone craving good chicken!
I ordered a BBQ chicken pizza & BBQ wings.The food was fresh & amazing.The guy who made my food was polite,welcoming and accommodating. 😊

Absolutely disgusting! Food arrived extremely late and restaurant was impossible to contact to chase the food. Not only was the food poorly presented the meat tasted disgusting- we threw the whole order away  (£25 worth) as we were highly concerned about the quality of the meat. Just eat contacted them on our behalf as we couldn’t get through to complain. They refused to refund money but did offer a free dish with our next order- we will NEVER order from this restaurant again. Just eat recommend we contact the local council to report concerns of food quality. 1 star is far too generous rating for this restaurant! Absolute awful experience from start to finsh!

Horribly rude delivery driver, threatened that if we ever ordered from them again but did not answer our phone then they would not deliver.  Unsure why they think this attitude is acceptable when, if I have paid for something and its delivery (card payment) then I expect  to receive it.

The driver was also late.

Will be spending my money elsewhere in future as all I wanted was a Chinese, not a nasty attitude from their delivery driver.

Horrific experience. Ordered at 1am, they said it would be delivered at 2, still nothing by 2:30 despite calling multiple times. They answered first time and then decided to ignore my calls until showing up at 4am and still charging me for the order!! I've spent time and money on expensive calls chasing a refund today.

Utterly horrendous food and service. Ordered at 7 arrived at 9 over 45 minutes after their predicted arrival time (slow as it is). Food was cold and even after reheating one of the dishes was so salty it couldn't be eaten. Food all had to go in the bin which is exactly where the restaurant should go.

Late! Took much longer than time stated on just eat. Called them when in was 5 mins overdue and was told the driver will arrive in 5-10 mins meaning the order will be with me 30 mins late. I hope it's only 30 mins late: seems it will be longer.

Great place for lunch at really affordable prices and nice coffee.

The lamb sausages with mushrooms are really good, as well as the hummus.

Relaxed atmosphere where you can come read a book in the afternoon and chill.

Thank you for providing diners with real, reusable mugs, dishware, and silverware.

By 2050, there will be more plastic in the ocean than fish. And over 95% of the plastic that we produce and consume does not actually get recycled. But rather ends up in landfills, incinerators, and our oceans.

As a customer, it means a lot to me to be able to support local businesses that are helping us to our part to be better to this earth. So keep up the great options!

One thing I was sad to see was the sale of plastic bottled water here. I wonder if you might consider switching to aluminum canned water, or water in glass bottles. The normalization of single use plastics has numbed us all to our overconsumption of it, and it would be really cool to see businesses fighting back against the plastic pollution crisis by limiting the sale of the stuff in the first place.

Thank you for considering, and thank you for the wonderful food and service. And for of course, offering a relatively trash-free meal!

I love this cafe, the hummus is especially delicious and better than I've has anywhere else. The staff are nice and the atmosphere is good. It's slightly off the beaten track, so it's a quiet location.
Definitely recommend popping in if you're in the area.
Very calm and warm place. I love my chai latte the food is delicious. It was so hard to hesitate and not try the cakes. They looked delicious. Love this place

Been wanting to come by here for so long, visited yesterday with some friends and had a nice time :))

Cool spot in London fields, nice atmosphere, good music, interesting artwork / photography. They also put on live music nights, and other events there

The food was delish, good size portion and have a few vegan options for me, which was perfect. I had the falafel box + my friends had the lamb box. The babaganoush was 10/10 too!

The guy working there was so nice and friendly, gave me a food top up for free and let us chill there for a bit after closing time

Definitely worth stopping by if you're in the area

Our most regularly used local bakery, so it’s clearly doing something right. Nice selection of breads and pastries alongside a covered outside area for coffee and snacks. Probably not quite operating at the level of when it was the Danish Bakery (and no longer also trying to be a deli) but still a great place to get fresh sourdough.

Consistently bad service. Chances of being able to order hot food are slim to none depending on how good or bad of a day the server is having.

It’s not like the area has a drought of bakeries so save your time and money and go elsewhere

Great pastries and service
Big selection of fresh baked goods. Sourdough bread is 👌
It has a nice terrace for eating or drinking your coffee.
They also do lunch specials, and have juices.
Be aware they only take cards (due to covid)
I’ll
Be back I’m always back’
One really good breakfast pastry is the bacon Danish roll that also has some chili jam inside
Try or, good for kids as well, very friendly and on a quiet street

Went on the recommendation of friends as we were doing a “bakery tour.” Sadly, we couldn’t really sample their bread as it was sold out, but we did get a couple of sandwiches, so we know what their rolls are like. The lamb sandwich was fine not earth shaking. It is served warm, but by the time mine got to me, the cheese was no longer melty… maybe stand by to collect yours, if possible… Interesting lightly pickled veg inside and spilled out onto the plate. The sausage sandwich was served cold, and ready to go from the counter was pretty good!

The environment is very serviceable. We did take some buns with us for later, these people know what to do with flour and water and sugar!

The “pot” of tea didn’t feel like a value, but the tea was better than average. The latte was nice smooth coffee with just the right amount of milk and a nice foam on top.

INSANE pain suisse. Trust me (I go at least once a week). After trying all the bakeries & coffee shops in the London Fields, Hackney Central and Cambridge Heath areas, Snapery East remains the best one.

name: Goppa' Restaurant&Pizzeria
address: 106 Homerton High St, London E9 6JA, UK

reviews.text: Great pizza, amazing starters, nice atmosphere and good prices too. Definitely a place everyone should discover
Small independent Italian pizzeria, run by Italians, very good pizza and cozy atmosphere. Usual prices for pizza in London, but you can't go wrong with the quality!
Tiny place, lovely staff. Pizzas are very nice here. They also have interesting selection of pasta.

This pizzeria is on my doorstep and always wanted to pop in.  Should have come before. Nice atmosphere,  friendly good service, good food and wine. What more can we ask for? I have my own restaurant so I can be picky and critical, but this did not disappoint at all. Well done.
The starters took a little longer to arrive than expected but it was busy so I'll allow for that. When the braseola arrived I thought wow.. I didn't expect that generous a portion. Overall an enjoyable meal. Thank you. Will go again.

I want to start saying that the pizza is really good. I gave for star because of the location and the atmosphere. The location is not great, in front of a busy road. Moreover, when we arrived there was no one inside and the music was loud and unpleasant. they didn't turn it down while we eat there. The turned it down only when an old couple came in. In summary, was a wired experience but the food was delicious.

name: 107 Wine Bar
address: 107 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text: Such fantastic food and wine. Sadly let down by the incredibly long wait time for each dish and very small portions. Quite a drip feeding style and maybe done to make you drink more wine. But 5 stars because those things can be fixed and more places like this should exist.

We had a bizarre night here. After being seated by one, very lovely, waiter, another server came over and instructed us to move, he then gave us another seating option, but cited a "15-minute limit" that wasn't mentioned before. The etiquette got even weirder - while we were outside for a moment, that same server actually interrupted my date and me while we were kissing to tell me he’d moved my bag, which I left there to ensure that we were coming back to our seats. We came back in to find he'd given our seats away entirely. Given the context, the whole experience felt targeted, not a nice feeling given it was a queer date. Really disappointing for a wine bar in this area.

2 stars because the wine and food were lovely, shame about his attitude.
One of the best dining experiences I've had in a long while, all the food was delicious, and some of the best wine I've tasted. Would happily come back!
Lovely bolthole serving an eclectic (eccentric?) selection of off the beaten track wines in a cosy venue. Well worth browsing the shelves and settling in for a couple. Excellent poster art too...
Lovely staff and vibe and great selection of wine! The food is as amazing too which is a bonus!

name: Domino's Pizza - London - Clapton
address: 113 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 0NP, UK

reviews.text: They did not put any pepperoni on a pepperoni pizza, don't use Domino's as there customers services is totally worthless. It took them almost 6 hrs to respond and only offered to replace the pizza well after.

I recently visited Domino's Pizza in Clapton, and it was a fantastic experience! The food was delicious, and everything we ordered was fresh and flavorful. The pizza had the perfect crust, and the toppings were generous and tasty.
What stood out the most was the staff. They were incredibly friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we walked in. Their positive attitude and willingness to help made our visit even more enjoyable.
Overall, I highly recommend Domino's Pizza Clapton for anyone looking for great pizza and excellent service. I can’t wait to go back!

The pizza was delicious, delivery was quick, and everything was well packaged. I want to give a special shout-out to Ovidiu, an exceptional employee – always polite, attentive, and professional. He truly made the experience better. Highly recommended!👍🏻👍🏻

Ordered  2 pizzas, 1 was correct, 1 wasn't. Phoned up and explained the situation, was told the only way I would get a refund or a replacement would be to wait for someone to come and collect the incorrect pizza. Explained that it was 21:15, by the time they got me a new pizza it would be too late, but they would only give me a refund if they could collect the incorrect pizza. At this point it's either eat an incorrect pizza or wait very late for a correct one. Not happy at all.

Called in yesterday at 22:30 to place an order and I clearly asked at the beginning of the call if it’s possible to place an order for collection and the man asked me straight away what I want. I wanted to place an order for 3 medium pizzas and a portion of chicken wings but when I started saying what I’d like on my 3rd pizza the man on the phone yelled at me saying “you’re ordering too much food!” So to clarify, I asked if this means he’s not going to take my order then?! He told me they were closing at 11 o’clock and that I can order online because they aren’t supposed to accept cash payments at this time in store. After telling him that I’ll just order elsewhere he said that it’s fine, he can take my order but the total has already come to £50 and carried on telling me that it’s a lot of food and a lot of money! Again I told him I will order elsewhere, thanked him and ended the call.
A few minutes later he called me back, apologised “for this” and asked what I wanted to order but I told him that I don’t want to order anymore because clearly it bothered him and that I will order elsewhere.

name: Blend Cafe Ltd
address: HBC Centre, Barnabas Rd, London E9 5SD, UK

name: Caribbean-Kitchen
address: Caribbean Kitchen, 67 Mare St, London E8 4RG, UK

reviews.text: My go-to spot in hackney. Easily one of the best caribbean restaurants in London. Lovely people as well! Every dish is 11/10.

It is always good to discover a new neighbourhood favourite, and Caribbean Kitchen know good food! We got a few different things to share take away - jerk chicken, jerk pork, and a goat curry. They were all delicious, even the rice was deeply flavourful. While we didn’t order them, they had plenty of vego options too. Generous large serves that are enough to keep you going all day and lovely service to top it off :-)
Food is always on point. You'll be sure to have your Oxtail so soft it falls off of the bone. They serve a stellar Guinness Punch too. No complaints! Be sure to try everything.

Went there last week based on a friend recommendation and was not disaapointed. the lovely lady behind the counter was super helpful and accomodating. The menu is simple and easy to understand and the portion sizes are very good. Will definitely return. 5 stars from me!!

⭐☆☆☆☆

I recently purchased a bag from Too Good To Go, expecting to receive surplus food that was still good to eat. Unfortunately, this was my third attempt at this particular store, and I was deeply disappointed again. The items I received were burnt and of poor quality, which is not what I anticipated. I understand the mission behind reducing food waste, but the condition of the food was unacceptable. I won’t be returning to this store again, as it seems they are not meeting the standard expected from the Too Good To Go service.

Found this lovely spot on Google Maps after having a very looong day enjoying our trip in London. We fell in love with the interior and the vibes right away. The staff was extremely nice and helpful explaining the menü. We chose to sit in the window seat to enjoy the view of Broadway Market. Dinner was beautifully presented. The falafel was so tasty and the tahini-date-pistachio flatbread is something we need to go back for, simply amazing! We loved everything about this place and honestly cannot wait to dine here again
The most delicious vegetarian and vegan dishes. So flavourful! Such a cute cosy spot with the loveliest owners/staff! Delicious drinks too!
It was a very, very sweet place. The falafel was delicious, I didn't regret eating it. The music was one of the things that made the place familiar for me.

We had a great dinner at this lovely - cosy place on Broadway market Saturday evening. Third time visiting and once again, very inspired by tasty food that is nicely presented and full of flavour. Service is great too. However, I must comment on a very poor sound system which is basically one speaker in the corner that visitors are trying to overpower with their voices and it makes the whole place really noisy as narrow interior.. previously I asked for music to be turned down and they were always sweet and helpful. Overall experience was good and will be coming again.

Fantastic little veggie place in Hackney. All dishes were delicious and it was easy to see all the thought and care put into them. The environment is also super casual, which I loved. A seat to watch life happen on Broadway market, and gorgeous delicious food is all I could've asked for!

name: Clapton Table
address: 159 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EQ, UK

reviews.text: A fabulous find in Clapton where I was picking up a book from Pages. We had the most delicious brunch, at a cute corner table where we could chat while watching the world go by. Great coffee, very friendly service and really tasty food. The chorizo was so good we had to ask for an extra helping!

I had a very late brunch on a Saturday.
The food is high quality, and reasonably priced.
The service is great: the waiter that served me was very attentive and nice. He knew how to read the room and didn't ask much, while I saw him having a brief chitchat with other costumers.
The atmosphere was very relaxed and my breakfast dish, and chai latte were spot on!
The 'table breakfast' was delicious and the food tasted great, the chai latte sweet the right amount (how I like it).
Unfortunately I am not local, but will definitely try, and come for more! 🙂

Stayed in London round the corner for one night and found this place online. Really good fresh food and the staff are friendly and helpful. Had the beef & chicken burger on the night and came back for the full English the next morning and all were very tasty. The decor in there is lovely as well.

Visiting and one of our neighbours suggested this place for breakfast and we are so glad we came. We had the Turkish eggs and a small kebab plate. The Turkish eggs were so good! It was flavourful, the garlic yogurt was delicious and sourdough bread to clean your plate was well needed! Food, drinks, and service were all perfect! Highly recommend (:

I love this place - great staff and food (club sandwich and lamb kofta are special. My daughter was basically raised here and Farouk and team still accommodate her pancake requests even if it’s not breakfast time. Plus, check out the froth art!

Great food and a lot of wine options to choose from. The dishes were all incredibly tasty though I did find a few of them to be quite similar.
cozy atmosphere and Friendly staff as well.
The food was really good especially the fish. It was very fresh. They grilled it nicely with crispy skin. We love all the food we ordered.

Had a great experience here, the wines are amazing and the food was good too!

Minor points on the food but some of the dishes like the fish one had mayo instead of a sauce which didn’t really make sense to have and the beans with the chicken could have been more a mash or a creamier texture, the pie was the highlight though

A  cute and cosy restaurant with an open-plan kitchen, letting diners watch the chefs at work. The food was delicious and creative, with prices on the higher side.

One thing to note: I was simply taking photos of the overall ambience of the open kitchen, not of any specific chef or sous chef, when a team member tapped my shoulder to say I needed permission. While polite, it felt a bit passive- aggressive, especially since the open kitchen is clearly meant to be the highlight of the restaurant and part of the experience.

Given that the beautifully decorated open kitchen is a key reason people visit, as seen in countless reviews (eg. Google, TikTok, Instagram, etc) this rule felt out of place and left an odd vibe.
10/10 food, 10/10 service, 10/10 vibes. Sit on the kitchen island. The farro dish is one of the best things we’ve eaten in a long time. Great options for vegi. We left full and tipsy.

name: GAIL's Bakery Victoria Park
address: Victoria Park, 87 Lauriston Rd, London E9 7HL, UK

reviews.text: My absolute favourite team in East London! I'm there every single morning and they make my day every time. :-) I don't know what more you can ask from your baristas/ bakery team. I genuinely look forward to seeing them every day because I know that it's a guaranteed smile right there and then. Thank you so much!! I don't take you for granted. :-)

The staff here are cheerful and friendly but professional at all times, despite being so busy. Good tea and coffee and tasty snacks. The potato and rosemary sourdough is particularly delicious. Anisah was very helpful with snack suggestions. A great spot to recharge one's batteries after a park walk.0

The customer service at GAIL’s Victoria Park is honestly second to none. It’s not just good once, it’s consistently amazing every single time I visit with my family. All the staff are so smiley, friendly, and genuinely high-vibe people, which makes such a difference. The whole place has such a lovely, wholesome feel to it. You always feel welcome and looked after. Just a really beautiful vibe all round!

I recently visited the Victoria Park branch and had a good experience. This small location often has long queues, so I recommend using the app to pre-order your drinks and items.

I used the app to order an iced matcha with cucumber and elderflower, along with a blueberry and custard brioche bun for collection in advance. However, it still took a while for my order to be prepared and handed to me.

On the positive side, the staff at this location were very friendly, and there is a nice selection of sandwiches, baked goods, and desserts available.

very friendly and welcoming staff. our pastries were good, usual Gail's (high) standard. unfortunately our long black coffee were very poor (too much water and too high water temperature - basically destroyed all aroma). we were seated in the narrow passage leading to the back garden, and we had to get up every few minutes to let someone out/in. plus, it's full of dogs (sorry, I love them, but not indoors, not seating on the chairs next to the, literally touching).

name: Chestersway Chicken Clapton
address: 179 Lower Clapton Rd, Lower Clapton, London E5 8EQ, UK

reviews.text: Verry nice food and fresh highly recommend their burgers and chicken wings their perri perri chicken and rice is also really nice 😊

Chesterway chicken in Hackney was one of the worst food experiences I’ve ever had. The moment I opened the box, I had a bad feeling — the food looked sloppy, smelled off, and tasted even worse. And unfortunately, my instincts were right. After eating it, I ended up feeling violently sick. I’m talking extreme stomach pains and a miserable night that I would not wish on anyone.

I can’t say what the issue was, but whatever I ate did not sit right at all, and it was honestly one of the most unpleasant reactions I’ve ever had to a meal. The whole thing felt like a complete waste of money and a health gamble I deeply regret taking.

I will absolutely never order from this place again, and based on my own experience, I’d strongly recommend avoiding it

I remember this place when it used to be called Sam's many years ago so was interested to see if it would still be any good. Ordered hash browns and they were absolutely divine! My friend ordered a burger and was equally impressed. The gentleman at the front was friendly, funny and honestly made our night - we need more people like him in the world :)
Wow amazing food, amazing price, amazing service. What more can anyone asked for at 2:20am!!!
Very tasty halal burger, Highly recommended.

name: Yeast Bakery
address: Unit 1, Canal Place, 1-3 Sheep Ln, London E8 4QS, UK

reviews.text: Nice place slightly tucked away near Broadway Market so they weren't full. Lots of interesting cakes and pastries. We had the French Toast at £14.95 which is overpriced for the area. The toast and maple syrup itself was great but it comes with nothing. Everywhere else I've had french toast serves it with fruit. Given the price it needs to be more than just toast and syrup

This place is absolutely beautiful, located right next to a canal. I had the cheese and onion toastie, a cinnamon bun and a cappuccino, also picked up an almond croissant. Everything was lovely, and the service was incredible. The owner and barista are two absolute sweethearts who made us feel so welcome. Definitely recommend treating yourself to this place.

The best bakery in London and I’ve been to the many of the alleged top 10. Incredible food, service and the decor is gorgeous. It’s a family run business with an amazing story. I’ve tried both the brunch and newly opened bistro which is a must. Everything we had was exception. Make sure to get the oxtail croquets, Sirloin steak, layered potatoes and chocolate tart!

We came to the Bistro on a Saturday night for our anniversary and had a lovely experience. The owners were so nice, a family-run business, and the food was spectacular. The steak with chimichurri was a standout, with the layered potatoes a close second. Highly recommend!
Quiet cozy family run cafe. Coffee is great and pastries are a hit and miss. Staff were very friendly

Booked a one night stay here for a weekend in January. The room I had was very spacious, generally very clean, with plenty of facilities. The service was good the staff very attentive to any needs and the food onsite was very well done and tasty. My only add on was that evening meal dinner was not particularly hot and I was the only person having dinner at the time. However it was well cooked, easy to get too from London Bridge and a pleasant stay - would stay again and recommend.

I had a generally good stay at this hotel, especially on the first day. Everything was clean and comfortable, and one Romanian staff member (unfortunately I didn’t catch his name) was extremely friendly, helpful, and welcoming. His attitude really made a positive impression on us.

However, on the second day he was no longer there, and the experience changed. At breakfast, the food was nearly empty and not properly replenished. There was another staff member, a girl with braided hair, who was very impolite. My friend approached her to ask for a broom because the children had accidentally broken a glass. She looked at her very rudely and took about 15 minutes to come and clean it. During that time, she was on her phone, while broken glass was left on the floor with children around, which felt unsafe and unprofessional.

Overall, the hotel has potential, but the quality of service really depends on the staff on duty. Better consistency and professionalism would improve the experience a lot.

Excellent location
Very friendly staff, in particular Angela the chef and her team couldn’t do enough for me at breakfast. Check in very easy. Rooms very clean and spacious.
Highly recommend, best ones another stay in February

I recently stayed at the Premier Inn Hackney and overall had a very pleasant experience. The staff were extremely polite, welcoming, and always ready to assist, which really made a positive impression.
The room was clean and equipped with all the basic amenities one might need for a comfortable stay. The mattress was especially comfortable, ensuring a good night’s sleep after long days exploring London. Breakfast was decent with a good variety of options — though I did notice there wasn’t any kind of cheese available, which could be a nice addition in the future.
On the downside, the Wi-Fi speed was extremely slow, even though we had upgraded to the “ultimate” connection option. Also, there were a few visible stains on the carpet, which slightly detracted from the otherwise clean feel of the room.
The location is excellent — just a short walk from Dalston Junction station, with plenty of bus connections nearby, making it easy to get around the city.
Overall, a comfortable and convenient stay with great service. I would consider staying here again, especially if the Wi-Fi issue is improved.

We stayed 4 nights with children and had a beautiful experience. Staff is wonderful, especially receptionist Neta, waitresses Christina and Sefina and chef Angela, always ready to satisfy our requests and kind with the kids. Rooms are wide, pretty clean (a little dusty on top of beds) and quite comfortable. The Premier Inn Hackney is well connected by Dalston Junction train station and lots of buses, making it easy to visit the city and go to Stansted airporT. I would recommend it for sure and come back there.

name: Souvlakiland
address: 199A Homerton High St, London E9 6BB, UK

reviews.text: It's not about the atmosphere; this is essentially a kebab shop. But it is such a good one. I got the chicken gyros and it was deeply enjoyable. It tasted like properly roasted chicken with some nice crispy bits but overall very juicy and not at all greasy. The bread is freshly made and very soft, the salad is crisp and the tazatzki is somehow thick and light. I almost shed a tear...

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had an amazing experience at Souvlaki Land London! The food was absolutely delicious — real authentic Greek taste, fresh, and full of flavor. The portions were generous, and everything was cooked perfectly. The chef was such a kind and friendly person, always smiling and welcoming. The place was very clean and well-kept, with great attention to hygiene.
Definitely a 10 out of 10 experience — highly recommended! 🇬🇷👏

Basic but delicious!! A real hidden gem of a spot in Hackney. The souvlaki wraps are always fresh and stuffed to the brim with meat and toppings, and the owner is always cheerful and friendly. A great quick lunch option, I’ve been coming regularly for the past several years so thought it was about time I left a review.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
One of my favourite spots in Hackney! I got a pork and chicken gyros with halloumi and it was absolutely delicious. The owner was super friendly and even gave me an extra piece of chicken, which I sat down and enjoyed before taking my gyros home. I don’t even live in Hackney but I always make sure to stop by whenever I’m in the area — the gyros here remind me of when I was actually in Greece. Highly recommend!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Souvlaki Land London was a wonderful experience! The food was delicious with very generous portions – totally worth it. The place was super clean, and everything looked well taken care of. The chef was extremely friendly and made us feel very welcome. Definitely coming back again! 🇬🇷🥙👏
